  [inst : SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M]
  [inst_1 : M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {S : Set M} {n r : ℕ} {G : Type}
  [inst_2 : LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero G] [inst_3 : Valued (DiamondIntegral.Section2.VF M) G]
  {A : SpecialTransformations.DefinableGeometry.DefSet (SpecialTransformations.Section4.rawMixedSpace n r) S}
  (D : DiamondIntegral.Section6.CentripetalData A),
  ∀ p ∈ A.carrier,
    (p.2 ∈ D.activeTags.carrier → D.focusPoint p ∉ A.carrier) →
      D.point p =
        (Function.update p.1 D.coordinate (p.1 D.coordinate - D.extendedFocus p),
          Fin.append (fun x => DiamondIntegral.Section6.branchTag false) p.2) :=
fun {M} [SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M] [M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {S}
    {n r} {G} [LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero G] [Valued (DiamondIntegral.Section2.VF M) G] {A} D p hp hAbsent =>

    (Eq.trans
      (congrFun'
        (congrArg Eq
          (congr
            (congrArg Prod.mk
              (congrArg (Function.update p.1 D.coordinate)
                (Eq.trans
                  (congrArg (HAdd.hAdd (p.1 D.coordinate - D.extendedFocus p))

                      (ite_congr
                        (Eq.trans
                          (congrFun'
                            (congrArg Eq
                              (DiamondIntegral.Section6.CentripetalData.core_false_of_focus_absent D p hp hAbsent))
                            true)
                          Bool.false_eq_true)
                        (fun a => Eq.refl (D.coefficient * D.extendedFocus p)) fun a => Eq.refl 0)
                      (if_false (D.coefficient * D.extendedFocus p) 0)))
                  (add_zero (p.1 D.coordinate - D.extendedFocus p)))))
            (congrFun'
              (congrArg Fin.append
                (funext fun x =>
                  DiamondIntegral.Section6.branchTag.congr_simp (D.core p) false
                    (DiamondIntegral.Section6.CentripetalData.core_false_of_focus_absent D p hp hAbsent)))
              p.2)))
        (Function.update p.1 D.coordinate (p.1 D.coordinate - D.extendedFocus p),
          Fin.append (fun x => DiamondIntegral.Section6.branchTag false) p.2))
      (eq_self
        (Function.update p.1 D.coordinate (p.1 D.coordinate - D.extendedFocus p),
          Fin.append (fun x => DiamondIntegral.Section6.branchTag false) p.2)))

  [inst : SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M]
  [inst_1 : M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {S : Set M} {n r : ℕ} {G : Type}

  have hQBase :=
    of_eq_true
      (Eq.trans
        (congrFun'
          (congrArg Eq
            (Eq.trans
              (congrArg Fin.init
                (congrArg Prod.fst
                  (congrArg Subtype.val

  [inst : SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M] [M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF]

                        DiamondIntegral.Section2.vfValue (F.focus u) < DiamondIntegral.Section2.vfValue (d u)) →
                      M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF00 →
                        ∀ (p q : ↑(F.offsetCoreDomain dMap).carrier),
                          (↑((DiamondIntegral.Section6.centripetalStepMap E).toFun ⟨↑p, ⋯⟩)).2 =
                              (↑((DiamondIntegral.Section6.centripetalStepMap E).toFun ⟨↑q, ⋯⟩)).2 ↔
                            (↑p).2 = (↑q).2 :=
fun {M} [SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M] [M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {S} {r}
    {G} [LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero G] [Valued (DiamondIntegral.Section2.VF M) G] {A} F d dMap hdMap E hCoord
    hActive hFocus hCore hRV hCenters hd hSmall h00 p q =>
  {
    mp := fun h =>
      (DiamondIntegral.Section6.CentripetalData.coordinate_step_same_labels E h00
          ⟨↑p, DiamondIntegral.Section6.UnaryFocusData.offsetCoreDomain_subset F dMap p.property⟩
          ⟨↑q, DiamondIntegral.Section6.UnaryFocusData.offsetCoreDomain_subset F dMap q.property⟩ h).left,
    mpr := fun hTags =>
      let p' := ⟨↑p, DiamondIntegral.Section6.UnaryFocusData.offsetCoreDomain_subset F dMap p.property⟩;
      let q' := ⟨↑q, DiamondIntegral.Section6.UnaryFocusData.offsetCoreDomain_subset F dMap q.property⟩;
      have hComponentTags :=
        id
          (of_eq_true
            (Eq.trans
              (congr
                (congrArg Eq
                  (congrArg Prod.snd
                    (congr
                      (congrArg Prod.mk
                        (congrArg (Function.update (↑p).1 E.coordinate)
                          (congrArg (HAdd.hAdd ((↑p).1 E.coordinate - E.extendedFocus ↑p))

                              (fun a => Eq.refl (E.coefficient * E.extendedFocus ↑p)) fun a => Eq.refl 0))))
                      (congr
                        (congrArg Fin.append
                          (funext fun x =>
                            DiamondIntegral.Section6.branchTag.congr_simp (E.core ↑p) false (hCore (↑p) p.property)))
                        hTags))))
                (congrArg Prod.snd
                  (congr
                    (congrArg Prod.mk
                      (congrArg (Function.update (↑q).1 E.coordinate)
                        (congrArg (HAdd.hAdd ((↑q).1 E.coordinate - E.extendedFocus ↑q))
                          (ite_congr (congrFun' (congrArg Eq (hCore (↑q) q.property)) true)
                            (fun a => Eq.refl (E.coefficient * E.extendedFocus ↑q)) fun a => Eq.refl 0))))
                    (congrFun'
                      (congrArg Fin.append
                        (funext fun x =>
                          DiamondIntegral.Section6.branchTag.congr_simp (E.core ↑q) false (hCore (↑q) q.property)))
                      (↑q).2))))
              (eq_self (Fin.append (fun x => DiamondIntegral.Section6.branchTag false) (↑q).2))));
      have hVF :=
        DiamondIntegral.Section6.ambient_boundary_core_image_tagged F d dMap hdMap E hCoord hActive hFocus hCore hRV
          hCenters hd hSmall (↑(E.bijection.toFun p')) (Exists.intro p rfl) (↑(E.bijection.toFun q'))
          (Exists.intro q rfl) hComponentTags;
      id
        (id
          (fun hVF =>
            id
              (fun hComponentTags =>
                Eq.mpr
                  (id
                    (congrArg
                      (fun _a =>
                        Fin.append _a (E.point ↑p).2 =
                          Fin.append (DiamondIntegral.Section2.tupleRV M (E.point ↑q).1) (E.point ↑q).2)
                      hVF))
                  (Eq.mpr
                    (id
                      (congrArg
                        (fun _a =>
                          Fin.append (DiamondIntegral.Section2.tupleRV M (E.point ↑q).1) _a =
                            Fin.append (DiamondIntegral.Section2.tupleRV M (E.point ↑q).1) (E.point ↑q).2)
                        hComponentTags))
                    (Eq.refl (Fin.append (DiamondIntegral.Section2.tupleRV M (E.point ↑q).1) (E.point ↑q).2))))
              hComponentTags)
          hVF) }

  [inst_1 : M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {a b : DiamondIntegral.Section2.VF M},

      id
        (fun he' =>
          Eq.mp (congrArg (fun _a => _a) (propext not_le))
            (Eq.mp
              (congrArg (fun _a => ¬_a)
                (propext (SpecialTransformations.Section3.Values.vf_pred_iff_gamma_le b (a - b))))
              he'))
        (Eq.mp
          (congrArg (fun _a => _a)
            (propext (CanonicalRV.encoded_eq_iff_close a.property b.property fun h => hb (Subtype.ext h))))
          he'),
    mpr := DiamondIntegral.Section6.rv_eq_of_value_close hb }

@DiamondIntegral.Section6.corePiece_factorization : ∀ {M : Type}
  [inst : SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M]
  [inst_1 : M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {X : Type u_1}
  (A : Set (DiamondIntegral.Section2.VF M × X)) (focus center : X → DiamondIntegral.Section2.VF M)

  (∀ (x : X), ↑(α x) ≤ DiamondIntegral.Section2.vfValue (center x)) →
    (∀ (x : X) (a b : DiamondIntegral.Section2.VF M),
        ↑(α x) < DiamondIntegral.Section2.vfValue (a - b) → ((a, x) ∈ A ↔ (b, x) ∈ A)) →
      DiamondIntegral.Section6.CorePiece A focus center =
        {p | DiamondIntegral.Section2.vfValue (center p.2) < DiamondIntegral.Section2.vfValue p.1} ∩
          Prod.snd ⁻¹' DiamondIntegral.Section6.FocusBase A focus
theorem DiamondIntegral.Section6.corePiece_factorization.{u_1} : ∀ {M : Type}
  [inst : SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M]
  [inst_1 : M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {X : Type u_1}
  (A : Set (DiamondIntegral.Section2.VF M × X)) (focus center : X → DiamondIntegral.Section2.VF M)
  (α : X → DiamondIntegral.Section2.Gamma M),
  (∀ (x : X), ↑(α x) ≤ DiamondIntegral.Section2.vfValue (center x)) →
    (∀ (x : X) (a b : DiamondIntegral.Section2.VF M),
        ↑(α x) < DiamondIntegral.Section2.vfValue (a - b) → ((a, x) ∈ A ↔ (b, x) ∈ A)) →
      DiamondIntegral.Section6.CorePiece A focus center =
        {p | DiamondIntegral.Section2.vfValue (center p.2) < DiamondIntegral.Section2.vfValue p.1} ∩
          Prod.snd ⁻¹' DiamondIntegral.Section6.FocusBase A focus :=
fun {M} [SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M] [M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {X} A
    focus center α hα hA =>
  Set.ext fun p =>
    id
      (have hd := fun hp =>
        Eq.mpr
          (id
            (congrArg (LT.lt ↑(α p.2))
              (congrArg DiamondIntegral.Section2.vfValue (add_sub_cancel_left (focus p.2) p.1))))
          (LE.le.trans_lt (hα p.2) hp);
      {
        mp := fun x =>
          match x with
          | ⟨hp, ha⟩ => ⟨hp, (hA p.2 (focus p.2 + p.1) (focus p.2) (hd hp)).mp ha⟩,
        mpr := fun x =>
          match x with
          | ⟨hp, ha⟩ => ⟨hp, (hA p.2 (focus p.2 + p.1) (focus p.2) (hd hp)).mpr ha⟩ })

@DiamondIntegral.Section6.coreTranslate_image_exact : ∀ {M : Type}
  [inst : SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M]
  [inst_1 : M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {X : Type u_1}
  (A : Set (DiamondIntegral.Section2.VF M × X)) (focus center : X → DiamondIntegral.Section2.VF M)

          ↑(α x) < DiamondIntegral.Section2.vfValue (a - b) → ((a, x) ∈ A ↔ (b, x) ∈ A)) →

theorem DiamondIntegral.Section6.coreTranslate_image_exact.{u_1} : ∀ {M : Type}
  [inst : SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M]
  [inst_1 : M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {X : Type u_1}
  (A : Set (DiamondIntegral.Section2.VF M × X)) (focus center : X → DiamondIntegral.Section2.VF M)
  (α : X → DiamondIntegral.Section2.Gamma M),
  (∀ (x : X), center x ≠ 0) →
    (∀ (x : X), ↑(α x) ≤ DiamondIntegral.Section2.vfValue (center x)) →
      (∀ (x : X) (a b : DiamondIntegral.Section2.VF M),
          ↑(α x) < DiamondIntegral.Section2.vfValue (a - b) → ((a, x) ∈ A ↔ (b, x) ∈ A)) →
        DiamondIntegral.Section6.coreTranslate center '' DiamondIntegral.Section6.CorePiece A focus center =
          {p | DiamondIntegral.Section2.rv M p.1 = DiamondIntegral.Section2.rv M (center p.2) ∧ (focus p.2, p.2) ∈ A} :=
fun {M} [SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M] [M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {X} A
    focus center α hc hα hA =>
  Eq.mpr
    (id
      (congrArg
        (fun _a =>
          DiamondIntegral.Section6.coreTranslate center '' _a =
            {p | DiamondIntegral.Section2.rv M p.1 = DiamondIntegral.Section2.rv M (center p.2) ∧ (focus p.2, p.2) ∈ A})
        (DiamondIntegral.Section6.corePiece_factorization A focus center α hα hA)))
    (Set.ext fun p =>
      {
        mp := fun a =>
          Exists.casesOn a fun w h =>
            Prod.casesOn (motive := fun x =>
              x ∈
                    {p | DiamondIntegral.Section2.vfValue (center p.2) < DiamondIntegral.Section2.vfValue p.1} ∩
                      Prod.snd ⁻¹' DiamondIntegral.Section6.FocusBase A focus ∧
                  DiamondIntegral.Section6.coreTranslate center x = p →
                p ∈
                  {p |
                    DiamondIntegral.Section2.rv M p.1 = DiamondIntegral.Section2.rv M (center p.2) ∧
                      (focus p.2, p.2) ∈ A})
              w
              (fun d x h =>
                And.casesOn h fun left right =>
                  And.casesOn left fun hd hmem =>
                    right ▸
                      ⟨(DiamondIntegral.Section6.rv_eq_iff_value_close (hc x)).mpr
                          (Eq.mpr
                            (id
                              (congrArg (LT.lt (DiamondIntegral.Section2.vfValue (center x)))
                                (congrArg DiamondIntegral.Section2.vfValue (add_sub_cancel_right d (center x)))))
                            (have this := hd;
                            this)),
                        hmem⟩)
              h,
        mpr := fun a =>
          And.casesOn a fun hrv hmem =>
            Exists.intro (p.1 - center p.2, p.2)
              ⟨⟨(DiamondIntegral.Section6.rv_eq_iff_value_close (hc p.2)).mp hrv, hmem⟩,
                Prod.ext (sub_add_cancel p.1 (center p.2)) rfl⟩ })

@DiamondIntegral.Section6.AlphaInvariant.coordinate_shift_iff : ∀ {M : Type}
  [inst : SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M] [hM : M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF]
  {n : ℕ} {α : Fin n → DiamondIntegral.Section2.Gamma M} {A : Set (Fin n → DiamondIntegral.Section2.VF M)},
  DiamondIntegral.Section6.AlphaInvariant α A →
    ∀ (a : Fin n → DiamondIntegral.Section2.VF M) (j : Fin n) (d : DiamondIntegral.Section2.VF M),
      ↑(α j) < DiamondIntegral.Section2.vfValue d → (Function.update a j (a j + d) ∈ A ↔ a ∈ A)
theorem DiamondIntegral.Section6.AlphaInvariant.coordinate_shift_iff : ∀ {M : Type}
  [inst : SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M] [hM : M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF]
  {n : ℕ} {α : Fin n → DiamondIntegral.Section2.Gamma M} {A : Set (Fin n → DiamondIntegral.Section2.VF M)},
  DiamondIntegral.Section6.AlphaInvariant α A →
    ∀ (a : Fin n → DiamondIntegral.Section2.VF M) (j : Fin n) (d : DiamondIntegral.Section2.VF M),
      ↑(α j) < DiamondIntegral.Section2.vfValue d → (Function.update a j (a j + d) ∈ A ↔ a ∈ A) :=
fun {M} [SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M] [M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {n} {α}
    {A} hA a j d hd =>
  hA (Function.update a j (a j + d)) a fun i =>
    if hi : i = j then
      Eq.symm hi ▸
        Eq.mpr
          (id
            (congrArg (LT.lt ↑(α j))
              (congrArg DiamondIntegral.Section2.vfValue
                (Eq.trans (congrFun' (congrArg HSub.hSub (Function.update_self j (a j + d) a)) (a j))
                  (add_sub_cancel_left (a j) d)))))
          hd
    else
      Eq.mpr
        (id
          (congrArg (LT.lt ↑(α i))
            (congrArg DiamondIntegral.Section2.vfValue
              (Eq.trans
                (congrFun'
                  (congrArg HSub.hSub
                    ((fun x_0 v f => (fun x_0 => Function.update_of_ne hi) x_0 v f)
                      (fun a => DiamondIntegral.Section2.VF M) (a j + d) a))
                  (a i))
                (sub_self (a i))))))
        (SpecialTransformations.Section9.gamma_lt_value_zero (α i))

fun {M} [SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M] [M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {r k}
    {S} {G} [LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero G] [Valued (DiamondIntegral.Section2.VF M) G] h00 hc linear {κ} hκ hs hv V
    hsmall hΓ hV hVS hSV hnt A hA hAD hARV htag j hHead R N hN P hPA hP hControl =>
  Nonempty.casesOn
    (DiamondIntegral.Section6.binary_active_root_preparation_with_base_displacement h00 hc linear hκ hs hv V hsmall hΓ
      hV hVS hSV hnt A hA hAD hARV htag j hHead R (N + 1) hN P hPA hP hControl)
    fun F =>
    let C := fun i => (F.map.restrict (hPA i)).image;
    have hCsub := fun i ⦃q⦄ a => Exists.casesOn a fun p hp => hp ▸ (F.map.toFun ⟨↑p, hPA i p.property⟩).property;
    have hC := fun i =>
      have h :=
        DiamondIntegral.Section6.SpecialCovariantChain.properHomeomorphism (F.restrictions i) h00 hc linear hκ hs hv
          hsmall hΓ;
      DiamondIntegral.Section6.ProperCovariant.target_properInvariant h00 hc linear hκ hs hv hsmall hΓ h.covariant
        (Function.Bijective.surjective h.bijective);
    Exists.casesOn
      (DiamondIntegral.Section6.exists_continuous_coordinate_root_step h00 hc linear hκ hs hv V hsmall hΓ hV hVS hSV hnt
        F.target F.proper F.doublyBounded F.tagged F.roots (N + 1) F.bound F.active
        (fun p hp hu => (F.active_iff p hp).mp hu)
        (DiamondIntegral.Section6.unary_focus_tail_continuous
          (F.roots.meanMap h00 (N + 1) F.bound (DiamondIntegral.Section6.projectedActiveDomain F.target F.active)))
        C hCsub hC F.control)
      fun Q h =>
      Exists.casesOn h fun D h =>
        And.casesOn h fun hQN right =>
          And.casesOn right fun hTags right =>
            And.casesOn right fun hControlQ right =>
              And.casesOn right fun hCoord right =>
                And.casesOn right fun hActive right =>
                  And.casesOn right fun hMean right =>
                    And.casesOn right fun hProtected hStep =>
                      have hOldActive := fun p hp =>
                        (F.active_iff p (F.roots.subset hp)).mpr
                          ((DiamondIntegral.Section6.CoordinateRootFamily.mem_activeBase F.roots (Fin.init p.1) p.2).mp
                            (Exists.intro ⟨p, hp⟩ rfl));
                      have hAllActive := fun p hp =>
                        Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => p.2 ∈ _a.carrier) hActive))
                          (Exists.casesOn (hTags (Exists.intro p ⟨hp, rfl⟩)) fun q h =>
                            And.casesOn h fun hq he => he ▸ hOldActive q hq);
                      have hAllMean := fun p hp => hMean p (Q.subset hp) (hActive ▸ hAllActive p hp);
                      let E := fun i => (hProtected i).choose;
                      have hE := fun i => Exists.choose_spec (hProtected i);
                      let R' := Q.stepFamily D h00 hCoord hAllActive hAllMean;
                      let f := DiamondIntegral.Section6.centripetalStepMap D;
                      let g := f.comp F.map;
                      have hNarrow := fun i =>
                        DiamondIntegral.Section6.CompatibleCentripetalChain.literal_restriction h00
                          (DiamondIntegral.Section6.SimultaneousCentripetalChain.atPiece hStep i) (hCsub i);
                      have hComposite := fun i =>
                        DiamondIntegral.Section6.SpecialCovariantChain.comp (F.restrictions i) (hNarrow i);
                      have hImage := fun i =>
                        DiamondIntegral.Section6.image_eq_of_surjective_liesOver g
                          ((f.restrict (hCsub i)).toImage.comp (F.map.restrict (hPA i)).toImage)
                          (Function.Bijective.surjective
                            (DiamondIntegral.Section6.SpecialCovariantChain.bijective (hComposite i) h00))
                          (hPA i) fun x => rfl;
                      have hTail :=
                        DiamondIntegral.Section6.RVCoordinateDisplacement.of_fixed 0 fun p =>
                          id
                            (of_eq_true
                              (Eq.trans
                                (congrFun'
                                  (congrArg Eq
                                    (Eq.trans
                                      (congrFun'
                                        (congrArg Prod.fst
                                          (congrFun'
                                            (congrArg Prod.mk
                                              (congr (congrArg (Function.update ⋯) hCoord)
                                                (congrFun' (congrArg HAdd.hAdd ⋯) (if ⋯ then ⋯ else 0))))
                                            (Fin.append (fun x => DiamondIntegral.Section6.branchTag (D.core ⋯))
                                              (↑p).2)))
                                        0)
                                      ((fun x_0 v f =>
                                          (fun x_0 => Function.update_of_ne (of_decide_eq_true (id (Eq.refl true)))) x_0
                                            v f)
                                        (fun a => DiamondIntegral.Section2.VF M)
                                        ((↑p).1 (Fin.last (0 + 1)) - D.extendedFocus ↑p +
                                          if D.core ↑p = true then D.coefficient * D.extendedFocus ↑p else 0)
                                        (↑p).1)))
                                  ((↑p).1 0))
                                (eq_self ((↑p).1 0))));
                      Exists.casesOn
                        (DiamondIntegral.Section6.SpecialCovariantChain.retainsRV
                          (DiamondIntegral.Section6.CentripetalChain.toSpecial
                            (DiamondIntegral.Section6.SimultaneousCentripetalChain.toChain hStep)))
                        fun hTailArity hTailRetain =>
                        Nonempty.intro
                          { arity := 2 + (1 + F.arity),
                            target := (DiamondIntegral.Section6.regularizeMap D.map.image).image, map := g,
                            special :=
                              DiamondIntegral.Section6.SpecialCovariantChain.comp F.special
                                (DiamondIntegral.Section6.CentripetalChain.toSpecial
                                  (DiamondIntegral.Section6.SimultaneousCentripetalChain.toChain hStep)),
                            baseDisplacement :=
                              DiamondIntegral.Section6.RVCoordinateDisplacement.comp F.baseDisplacement hTail
                                (DiamondIntegral.Section6.rvTailIndex hTailArity) hTailRetain,
                            proper :=
                              DiamondIntegral.Section6.regularization_properInvariant h00 hc hκ hs hv D.map.image
                                (DiamondIntegral.Section6.CentripetalData.image_properInvariant D h00 hc hκ hs hv)
                                (DiamondIntegral.Section6.CentripetalData.image_vfDoublyBounded D),
                            doublyBounded :=
                              DiamondIntegral.Section6.regularized_vfDoublyBounded
                                (DiamondIntegral.Section6.CentripetalData.image_vfDoublyBounded D),
                            pullback :=
                              DiamondIntegral.Section6.CentripetalData.regularized_image_rvPullback h00 D F.pullback,
                            tagged :=
                              Eq.mpr
                                (id
                                  (congrArg
                                    (fun _a =>
                                      ∀ p ∈ _a,
                                        ∀ q ∈ _a,
                                          p.2 = q.2 →
                                            DiamondIntegral.Section2.tupleRV M ⋯ = DiamondIntegral.Section2.tupleRV M ⋯)
                                    (have this := DiamondIntegral.Section6.regularization_carrier D.map.image;
                                    this)))
                                (DiamondIntegral.Section6.regularized_tagged D.map.image.carrier),
                            headTag := Fin.castAdd (1 + F.arity) (Fin.last 1),
                            head_tag := fun p hp =>
                              DiamondIntegral.Section6.centripetal_step_leading_term D p hp (Fin.last 1),
                            roots := R',
                            bound :=
                              DiamondIntegral.Section6.CoordinateRootFamily.stepFamily_bound Q D h00 hCoord hAllActive
                                hAllMean N hQN,
                            control := fun i =>
                              have h :=
                                DiamondIntegral.Section6.CoordinateRootFamily.root_control_step Q D (E i) (hE i) h00
                                  hCoord hAllActive hAllMean (hControlQ i);
                              id
                                (fun h =>
                                  Eq.mp
                                    (congrArg (fun _a => DiamondIntegral.Section6.CoordinateRootControl R' _a.carrier)
                                      (hImage i))
                                    h)
                                h,
                            restrictions := fun i =>
                              DiamondIntegral.Section6.SpecialCovariantChain.restriction_of_liesOver h00 g
                                (hComposite i) (hPA i) fun x => rfl }

    hsmall hΓ hV hVS hSV hnt A hA hAD =>
  let H :=
    { carrier := DiamondIntegral.Section2.rvHull A.carrier,
      definable := (DiamondIntegral.Section6.ProperInvariant.rvHull hA).definable };
  have hHD :=
    Exists.casesOn hAD fun γ hγ =>
      Exists.intro γ fun p hp i =>
        Exists.casesOn ((DiamondIntegral.Section2.mem_rvHull_iff A.carrier p).mp hp) fun z h =>
          And.casesOn h fun hz right =>
            And.casesOn right fun hVF right =>
              have he := congrArg SpecialTransformations.Section3.Values.vrv (congrFun hVF i);
              id (fun he => Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => ↑γ⁻¹ ≤ _a ∧ _a ≤ ↑γ) (Eq.symm he))) (hγ z hz i)) he;
  let H₀ := (DiamondIntegral.Section6.regularizeMap H).image;
  let R := (DiamondIntegral.Section6.regularizeMap A).image;
  let a₀ := DiamondIntegral.Section6.regularization A;

  have hRH := fun ⦃q⦄ a =>
    Exists.casesOn a fun p hp => Exists.intro ⟨↑p, DiamondIntegral.Section2.subset_rvHull A.carrier p.property⟩ hp;
  have hR := DiamondIntegral.Section6.regularization_properInvariant h00 hc hκ hs hv A hA hAD;
  have hH₀ :=
    DiamondIntegral.Section6.regularization_properInvariant h00 hc hκ hs hv H
      (DiamondIntegral.Section6.ProperInvariant.rvHull hA) hHD;
  have hTag :=
    Eq.mpr
      (id
        (congrArg
          (fun _a =>
            ∀ p ∈ _a,
              ∀ z ∈ _a, p.2 = z.2 → DiamondIntegral.Section2.tupleRV M p.1 = DiamondIntegral.Section2.tupleRV M z.1)
          (have this := DiamondIntegral.Section6.regularization_carrier H;

fun {M} [SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M] [M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {r k}
    {S} {G} [LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero G] [Valued (DiamondIntegral.Section2.VF M) G] h00 hc linear {κ} hκ hs hv V
    hsmall hΓ hV hVS hSV hnt A hA R N hN P hP hControl ω hLevels hForm =>
  let C := (DiamondIntegral.Section6.vfDropLast A).image;
  let f := DiamondIntegral.Section6.scalarIndicatorMap C R.activeBase;
  let H := Fin.cons A.carrier fun i => (P i).carrier;

    (DiamondIntegral.Section6.finite_properInvariant_uniform_named_radius h00 hc linear hκ hs hv hsmall hΓ H fun i =>
      Fin.cases hA hP i)

    And.casesOn h fun hβ right =>
      And.casesOn right fun hβ1 hInv =>
        Exists.casesOn
          (DiamondIntegral.Section6.gamma_form_all_levels_uniform_invariant h00 hc linear hκ hs hv hsmall hΓ hA
            (DiamondIntegral.Section6.gammaFormExtension ω)
            (DiamondIntegral.Section6.gammaFormExtension_graph_definable ω) hLevels)
          fun α h =>
          And.casesOn h fun hα right =>
            And.casesOn right fun hα1 right =>
              And.casesOn right fun hInvA hInvLevels =>
                let δ := max α β;
                have hδ := DiamondIntegral.Section6.gamma_max_named α β hα hβ;
                have hδ0 := LE.le.trans hα1 (le_max_left α β);
                have hCInv := fun u =>

                    (id
                      (congrArg (fun _a => DiamondIntegral.Section6.AlphaInvariant (fun x => δ) _a)
                        (DiamondIntegral.Section6.vfDropLast_image_fibre u)))
                    (DiamondIntegral.Section6.AlphaInvariant.image_init
                      (DiamondIntegral.Section6.AlphaInvariant.larger_radius (hInv 0 u) fun x => le_max_right α β));
                Exists.casesOn
                  (DiamondIntegral.Section6.exists_named_vf_above_radius Valued.v hv hc h00 V S hV hVS hSV hnt δ hδ0 hδ)
                  fun s h =>

                    And.casesOn right fun hsdef hδs =>
                      let Q :=

                            DiamondIntegral.Section6.AlphaInvariant.larger_radius (hInv i u) fun x => le_max_right α β)
                          fun γ u =>
                          DiamondIntegral.Section6.AlphaInvariant.larger_radius (hInvLevels γ u) fun x =>
                            le_max_left α β;
                      Exists.casesOn
                        (DiamondIntegral.Section6.FMT.exists_continuous_focus_freezing_with_invariant_domains h00 hc hκ
                          hs hsmall hv δ hCInv s hs0 hsdef (LT.lt.le hδs) f
                          (DiamondIntegral.Section6.unary_focus_tail_continuous f) Q hQ (Fin.castSucc 0))
                        fun F h =>
                        And.casesOn h fun hCont hProd =>
                          let R' :=
                            R.frozen F.balls F.centers 0 F.separated F.balls_definable F.centers_definable
                              (hProd (Sum.inl 0));
                          have hRange := fun p =>
                            id

                                    R.activeBase.carrier then

                                  (id
                                    (congr (congrArg Or (congrFun' (congrArg Eq (ite_eq_right h)) 0))

                                  Eq.mpr
                                    (id
                                      (congrArg (fun _a => DiamondIntegral.Section6.ProperInvariant S _a)

  [inst_1 : M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {r k : ℕ} {S : Set M} {G : Type}
  [inst_2 : LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero G] [inst_3 : Valued (DiamondIntegral.Section2.VF M) G],
  M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF00 →
    CanonicalStructure.IsCanonical →
      DiamondIntegral.Section2.GammaPiecewiseRationalAffineInput →
        ∀ {κ : Cardinal.{0}},
          Cardinal.aleph0 < κ →
            SpecialTransformations.Section3.Saturated M κ →
              (∀ (x y : DiamondIntegral.Section2.VF M),
                  SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.VFValued.predV x y ↔ Valued.v x ≤ Valued.v y) →
                ∀ (V : Set M),
                  Cardinal.mk ↑S < κ →
                    DiamondIntegral.Section2.NontrivialDefinableGamma { real := S, gamma := ∅ } →
                      (∀ a ∈ V, SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.iVF a) →
                        V ⊆ S →
                          S ⊆ SpecialTransformations.Section3.algebraicClosureSet V →
                            (∃ x, x ≠ 0 ∧ Valued.v ↑x ≠ 1) →
                              ∀
                                (A :
                                  SpecialTransformations.DefinableGeometry.DefSet
                                    (SpecialTransformations.Section4.rawMixedSpace 2 r) S),
                                DiamondIntegral.Section6.ProperInvariant S A.carrier →
                                  DiamondIntegral.Section2.IsRVPullback A.carrier →
                                    ∀
                                      (C :
                                        Fin k →
                                          SpecialTransformations.DefinableGeometry.DefSet
                                            (SpecialTransformations.Section4.rawMixedSpace 2 r) S)
                                      (hCA : ∀ (i : Fin k), (C i).carrier ⊆ A.carrier),
                                      (∀ (i : Fin k), DiamondIntegral.Section6.ProperInvariant S (C i).carrier) →
                                        ∃ s B f,
                                          DiamondIntegral.Section6.SpecialCovariantChain A B f ∧
                                            DiamondIntegral.Section6.ProperInvariant S B.carrier ∧
                                              DiamondIntegral.Section6.VFDoublyBounded B.carrier ∧
                                                DiamondIntegral.Section2.IsRVPullback B.carrier ∧
                                                  ∀ (i : Fin k),
                                                    DiamondIntegral.Section6.SpecialCovariantChain (C i)
                                                        (f.restrict ⋯).image (f.restrict ⋯).toImage ∧
                                                      DiamondIntegral.Section2.IsRVPullback
                                                        (f.restrict ⋯).image.carrier :=
fun {M} [SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M] [M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {r k}
    {S} {G} [LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero G] [Valued (DiamondIntegral.Section2.VF M) G] h00 hc linear {κ} hκ hs hv V
    hsmall hΓ hV hVS hSV hnt A hA hARV C hCA hC =>
  Exists.casesOn
    (DiamondIntegral.Section6.exists_initial_preparation_protecting_family h00 hc linear hκ hs hv V hsmall hΓ hV hVS hSV
      hnt A hA C hCA hC)
    fun A₀ h =>
    Exists.casesOn h fun f₀ h =>
      And.casesOn h fun hf₀ right =>
        And.casesOn right fun hA₀ right =>
          And.casesOn right fun hA₀D right =>
            And.casesOn right fun hA₀RV right =>
              And.casesOn right fun htag₀ hPieces₀ =>
                let C₀ := fun i => (f₀.restrict (hCA i)).image;
                have hC₀A₀ := fun i ⦃q⦄ a =>
                  Exists.casesOn a fun p hp => hp ▸ (f₀.toFun ⟨↑p, hCA i p.property⟩).property;
                let A₁ := (DiamondIntegral.Section6.regularizeMap A₀).image;
                let f₁ := DiamondIntegral.Section6.regularization A₀;
                let C₁ := fun i => (f₁.restrict (hC₀A₀ i)).image;
                have hC₀ := fun i => (hPieces₀ i).right;
                have hC₀D := fun i => Exists.casesOn hA₀D fun γ hγ => Exists.intro γ fun p hp => hγ p (hC₀A₀ i hp);
                have hf₁ := DiamondIntegral.Section6.SpecialCovariantChain.regularize A₀ hA₀ hA₀D;
                have hP₁ := fun i =>
                  DiamondIntegral.Section6.regularization_restriction_chain h00 (hC₀A₀ i) (hC₀ i) (hC₀D i);
                have hC₁A₁ := fun i ⦃q⦄ a =>
                  Exists.casesOn a fun p hp => hp ▸ (f₁.toFun ⟨↑p, hC₀A₀ i p.property⟩).property;
                have hC₁ := fun i =>
                  have h :=
                    DiamondIntegral.Section6.SpecialCovariantChain.properHomeomorphism (hP₁ i) h00 hc linear hκ hs hv
                      hsmall hΓ;
                  DiamondIntegral.Section6.ProperCovariant.target_properInvariant h00 hc linear hκ hs hv hsmall hΓ
                    h.covariant (Function.Bijective.surjective h.bijective);
                have hA₁ := DiamondIntegral.Section6.regularization_properInvariant h00 hc hκ hs hv A₀ hA₀ hA₀D;
                have htag₁ :=
                  Eq.mpr
                    (id
                      (congrArg
                        (fun _a =>
                          ∀ p ∈ _a,
                            ∀ q ∈ _a,
                              p.2 = q.2 →
                                DiamondIntegral.Section2.tupleRV M p.1 = DiamondIntegral.Section2.tupleRV M q.1)
                        (have this := DiamondIntegral.Section6.regularization_carrier A₀;
                        this)))
                    (DiamondIntegral.Section6.regularized_tagged A₀.carrier);
                let j := Fin.castAdd (2 + (2 + r)) (Fin.last 1);
                have hHead := fun p hp =>
                  Exists.casesOn hp fun a ha =>
                    Eq.mpr
                      (id
                        (congrArg (fun _a => DiamondIntegral.Section2.rv M (_a.1 (Fin.last 1)) = _a.2 j) (Eq.symm ha)))
                      (id
                        (of_eq_true
                          (Eq.trans
                            (congrArg (Eq (DiamondIntegral.Section2.rv M ((↑a).1 (Fin.last 1))))
                              (Fin.append_left (DiamondIntegral.Section2.tupleRV M (↑a).1) (↑a).2 (Fin.last 1)))
                            (eq_self (DiamondIntegral.Section2.rv M ((↑a).1 (Fin.last 1)))))));
                Exists.casesOn
                  (DiamondIntegral.Section6.binary_preparation_of_doublyBounded_tagged h00 hc linear hκ hs hv V hsmall
                    hΓ hV hVS hSV hnt A₁ hA₁ (DiamondIntegral.Section6.regularized_vfDoublyBounded hA₀D)
                    (DiamondIntegral.Section6.regularization_rvPullback A₀ (hA₀RV hARV)) htag₁ j hHead C₁ hC₁A₁ hC₁)
                  fun s h =>
                  Exists.casesOn h fun B h =>
                    Exists.casesOn h fun f h =>
                      And.casesOn h fun hf right =>
                        And.casesOn right fun hB right =>
                          And.casesOn right fun hBD right =>
                            And.casesOn right fun hBRV hPieces =>
                              let g := (f.comp f₁).comp f₀;
                              Exists.intro s
                                (Exists.intro B
                                  (Exists.intro g
                                    ⟨DiamondIntegral.Section6.SpecialCovariantChain.comp hf₀
                                        (DiamondIntegral.Section6.SpecialCovariantChain.comp hf₁ hf),
                                      ⟨hB, ⟨hBD, ⋯⟩⟩⟩))

theorem DiamondIntegral.Section6.rvScalarBinaryParameterLocus_at : ∀ {M : Type}
  [inst : SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M]
  [inst_1 : M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {S : Set M} {p r n : ℕ}
  (T : DiamondIntegral.Section6.ContinuousRVGraphTemplate S p r n 1) (a : Fin p → M) (ha : a ∈ T.good),
  a ∈ DiamondIntegral.Section6.rvScalarBinaryParameterLocus T ↔
    ∀ (u : Fin r → DiamondIntegral.Section2.RVInfinity M) (x : Fin n → DiamondIntegral.Section2.VF M),
      T.value a ha u x 0 = 0 ∨ T.value a ha u x 0 = 1 :=
fun {M} [SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M] [M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {S}
    {p r n} T a ha =>
  {
    mp := fun h u x =>
      have hRow :=
        h (Sum.elim (SpecialTransformations.Section4.rvValues u) (SpecialTransformations.Section4.vfValues x));
      have hInput := ⟨Exists.intro u rfl, Exists.intro x rfl⟩;
      Or.casesOn hRow (fun hBad => False.elim (hBad hInput)) fun h =>
        Or.casesOn h
          (fun hZero =>
            Or.inl
              (Subtype.ext
                ((DiamondIntegral.Section6.rvScalarTemplateLevel_at T a ha u x
                      SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Transfer.iVFZero).mp
                  hZero)))
          fun hOne =>
          Or.inr
            (Subtype.ext
              ((DiamondIntegral.Section6.rvScalarTemplateLevel_at T a ha u x
                    SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Transfer.iVFOne).mp
                hOne)),
    mpr := fun h z =>
      if hInput : Sum.elim a z ∈ DiamondIntegral.Section6.rvVFTemplateInputs p r n then
        Or.inr
          (id
            (fun hInput =>
              Exists.casesOn hInput.left fun u hu =>
                Exists.casesOn hInput.right fun x hx =>
                  have he :=
                    funext fun i =>
                      Sum.casesOn (motive := fun t =>
                        i = t →
                          Sum.elim (SpecialTransformations.Section4.rvValues u)
                              (SpecialTransformations.Section4.vfValues x) i =
                            z i)
                        i (fun i_1 h => Eq.symm h ▸ congrFun hu i_1) (fun i_1 h => Eq.symm h ▸ congrFun hx i_1)
                        (Eq.refl i);
                  Eq.mpr
                    (id
                      (congrArg
                        (fun _a =>
                          Sum.elim a _a ∈
                            DiamondIntegral.Section6.rvScalarTemplateLevel T
                                SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Transfer.iVFZero ∪
                              DiamondIntegral.Section6.rvScalarTemplateLevel T
                                SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Transfer.iVFOne)
                        (Eq.symm he)))
                    (Or.casesOn (motive := fun t =>
                      h u x = t →
                        Sum.elim a
                            (Sum.elim (SpecialTransformations.Section4.rvValues u)
                              (SpecialTransformations.Section4.vfValues x)) ∈
                          DiamondIntegral.Section6.rvScalarTemplateLevel T
                              SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Transfer.iVFZero ∪
                            DiamondIntegral.Section6.rvScalarTemplateLevel T
                              SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Transfer.iVFOne)
                      (h u x)
                      (fun hZero h =>
                        Or.inl
                          ((DiamondIntegral.Section6.rvScalarTemplateLevel_at T a ha u x
                                SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Transfer.iVFZero).mpr
                            (congrArg Subtype.val hZero)))
                      (fun hOne h =>
                        Or.inr
                          ((DiamondIntegral.Section6.rvScalarTemplateLevel_at T a ha u x
                                SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Transfer.iVFOne).mpr
                            (congrArg Subtype.val hOne)))
                      (Eq.refl (h u x))))
            hInput)
      else Or.inl hInput }

    Exists.casesOn (DiamondIntegral.Section2.vfValue_surjective ↑γ) fun c hcval =>
      have hc0 := fun he =>

              this)

    Eq.mp
      (congr (congrArg Eq ((fun p => DiamondIntegral.Section6.BranchedShearData.map_labels T p) p))

            (congrArg
              (fun _a =>

  [inst : SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M]

theorem DiamondIntegral.Section6.BranchedShearData.target_coordinate_replacement : ∀ {M : Type}
  [inst : SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M]
  [inst_1 : M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {S : Set M} {n r : ℕ} {G : Type}
  [inst_2 : LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero G] [inst_3 : Valued (DiamondIntegral.Section2.VF M) G]
  {A : SpecialTransformations.DefinableGeometry.DefSet (SpecialTransformations.Section4.rawMixedSpace (n + 1) r) S}
  (T : DiamondIntegral.Section6.BranchedShearData A) (p : ↑A.carrier) (d : DiamondIntegral.Section2.VF M),
  DiamondIntegral.Section2.rv M d = DiamondIntegral.Section2.rv M ((↑(T.map.toFun p)).1 (Fin.last n)) →
    (Function.update (↑(T.map.toFun p)).1 (Fin.last n) d, (↑(T.map.toFun p)).2) ∈ T.target.carrier :=
fun {M} [SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M] [M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {S}
    {n r} {G} [LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero G] [Valued (DiamondIntegral.Section2.VF M) G] {A} T p d hRV =>
  let v := T.outputLabels p;
  let δ := T.offset (Fin.append (↑p).2 v) (Fin.init (↑p).1) 0;
  let x := Function.update (↑p).1 (Fin.last n) (d - δ);
  have hLeading :=
    have h := Eq.trans hRV (DiamondIntegral.Section6.BranchedShearData.map_leading T p);
    Eq.mp
      (congrArg (fun _a => DiamondIntegral.Section2.rv M d = _a T.leading)
        (DiamondIntegral.Section6.BranchedShearData.map_labels T p))
      h;
  have hχ := T.full_disc (↑p).1 (↑p).2 v (DiamondIntegral.Section6.BranchedShearData.selected_indicator T p) d hLeading;
  have hx := (T.source x (↑p).2).mpr (Exists.intro v hχ);
  let q := ⟨(x, (↑p).2), hx⟩;
  have hLabels :=
    T.unique x (↑p).2 (T.outputLabels q) v (DiamondIntegral.Section6.BranchedShearData.selected_indicator T q) hχ;
  have hInit := DiamondIntegral.Section6.init_update_last (↑p).1 (d - δ);
  have hBase :=
    Eq.mpr
      (id
        (congrArg (fun _a => _a = Fin.init (↑(T.map.toFun p)).1)
          (DiamondIntegral.Section6.BranchedShearData.map_base T q)))
      (Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => Fin.init (↑q).1 = _a) (DiamondIntegral.Section6.BranchedShearData.map_base T p)))
        hInit);
  have hActive :=
    Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => _a = d) (DiamondIntegral.Section6.BranchedShearData.map_last T q)))
      (Eq.mpr
        (id

              ⟨Eq.mp (congrArg (fun _a => T.indicator (Fin.append (a, u).2 _a) a 0 = 1) hOut)
                  (Eq.mp (congrArg (fun _a => T.indicator (Fin.append _a (T.outputLabels p)) a 0 = 1) hIn)
                    (Eq.mp (congrArg (fun _a => T.indicator (Fin.append (↑p).2 (T.outputLabels p)) _a 0 = 1) hVF) hχ)),
                have hValue := DiamondIntegral.Section6.BranchedShearData.map_value T p;
                have hF := congrArg Prod.fst hfp;
                Eq.trans (Eq.symm hF)
                  (congrArg Prod.fst
                    (Eq.mp
                      (congrArg
                        (fun _a =>
                          ↑(T.map.toFun p) =
                            (Fin.snoc (Fin.init a) (a (Fin.last n) + T.offset (Fin.append (a, u).2 _a) (Fin.init a) 0),
                              _a))

                        (congrArg
                          (fun _a =>
                            ↑(T.map.toFun p) =
                              (Fin.snoc (Fin.init a)
                                  (a (Fin.last n) + T.offset (Fin.append _a (T.outputLabels p)) (Fin.init a) 0),
                                T.outputLabels p))
                          hIn)
                        (Eq.mp
                          (congrArg
                            (fun _a =>
                              ↑(T.map.toFun p) =
                                (Fin.snoc (Fin.init _a)
                                    (_a (Fin.last n) + T.offset (Fin.append (↑p).2 (T.outputLabels p)) (Fin.init _a) 0),
                                  T.outputLabels p))
                            hVF)
                          hValue))))⟩)
            hOut,
    mpr := fun a_1 =>
      And.casesOn a_1 fun hχ hb =>
        have ha := (T.source a u).mpr (Exists.intro v hχ);
        let p := ⟨(a, u), ha⟩;
        have hLabels :=
          T.unique a u (T.outputLabels p) v (DiamondIntegral.Section6.BranchedShearData.selected_indicator T p) hχ;
        have hValue :=
          Eq.mpr
            (id
              (congrArg (fun _a => _a = (T.fieldMap u v a, v))
                (DiamondIntegral.Section6.BranchedShearData.map_value T p)))
            (Eq.mpr
              (id
                (congrArg
                  (fun _a =>
                    (Fin.snoc (Fin.init (↑p).1)
                          ((↑p).1 (Fin.last n) + T.offset (Fin.append (↑p).2 _a) (Fin.init (↑p).1) 0),
                        _a) =
                      (T.fieldMap u v a, v))
                  hLabels))
              (Eq.refl
                (Fin.snoc (Fin.init (↑p).1) ((↑p).1 (Fin.last n) + T.offset (Fin.append (↑p).2 v) (Fin.init (↑p).1) 0),
                  v)));

  Fin p ⊕ Fin (r + s) ⊕ Fin (n + 1) → (Fin p ⊕ Fin (n + 1) ⊕ Fin r) ⊕ Fin s :=

          (fun _a =>
            _a ↔

    {S} {G} [LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero G] [Valued (DiamondIntegral.Section2.VF M) G] {A} {B} {f} {X} h00 F hinj R C
    hCA hSource hPrepared htag =>

  let U := DiamondIntegral.Section6.selectedRVTagSet (DiamondIntegral.Section6.locusTags B Q) F.target.labels;

    Exists.casesOn
      (Function.Bijective.surjective (DiamondIntegral.Section6.SpecialCovariantChain.bijective F.special h00) ⟨q, hq⟩)
      fun p hp =>
      have hPoint := congrArg Subtype.val hp;

        DiamondIntegral.Section6.restricted_image_mem_iff_of_inverse f hinj hCA (X.oldPoint p)
          (↑(f.toFun (X.oldPoint p))) rfl;

          (Eq.mp (congrArg (fun _a => (Fin.init _a.1, _a.2 ∘ F.target.labels).2 = (↑(f.toFun (X.oldPoint p))).2) hPoint)
            h);
      have hIndicator := DiamondIntegral.Section6.CarriedChainLift.root_indicator_transport h00 F hinj R p;

          (Iff.trans hOldMem

              (Iff.symm
                (Eq.mp

                          (Fin.init (↑p).1, (↑p).2) ∈ R.activeBase.carrier)
                      hPoint)
                    hIndicator))))))

  let E := D.carryCoordinate k hW;
  have hFocus := DiamondIntegral.Section6.CentripetalData.carryCoordinate_extendedFocus D k hW p hp;
  have hCore := DiamondIntegral.Section6.CentripetalData.carryCoordinate_core D k hW p hp;
  have hInit :=
    id
      (Eq.mpr
        (id
          (congrArg (fun _a => _a = (D.point (Fin.init p.1, p.2)).1)

                        if _a = true then D.coefficient * D.extendedFocus (Fin.init p.1, p.2) else 0) =

                hCore))
            (Eq.refl
              (Function.update (Fin.init p.1) D.coordinate
                (p.1 D.coordinate.castSucc - D.extendedFocus (Fin.init p.1, p.2) +
                  if D.core (Fin.init p.1, p.2) = true then D.coefficient * D.extendedFocus (Fin.init p.1, p.2)
                  else 0))))));
  have hLast :=
    id
      (Function.update_of_ne (Ne.symm (Fin.castSucc_ne_last D.coordinate))
        (p.1 E.coordinate - E.extendedFocus p + if E.core p = true then E.coefficient * E.extendedFocus p else 0) p.1);

    (Trans.trans (Eq.symm (Fin.snoc_init_self (E.point p).1))

            (fun _a =>
              Fin.snoc _a ((E.point p).1 (Fin.last n)) =

          (Eq.refl (Fin.snoc (D.point (Fin.init p.1, p.2)).1 (p.1 (Fin.last n)))))))

                        _a ∈ (DiamondIntegral.Section6.rvCoordinateBundle D.map.image (Fin.natAdd 1 k)).carrier)
                      (DiamondIntegral.Section6.CentripetalData.carryCoordinate_point D k hW p hp)))
                  ⟨id
                      (Eq.mpr
                        (id
                          (congrArg (fun _a => (_a, (D.point (Fin.init p.1, p.2)).2) ∈ D.map.image.carrier)
                            (Fin.init_snoc (p.1 (Fin.last n)) (D.point (Fin.init p.1, p.2)).1)))
                        (Eq.mpr
                          (id
                            (congrArg
                              (fun _a => ((D.point (Fin.init p.1, p.2)).1, (D.point (Fin.init p.1, p.2)).2) ∈ _a)
                              (DiamondIntegral.Section6.CentripetalData.image_carrier D)))
                          (Exists.intro (Fin.init p.1, p.2) ⟨hp.left, rfl⟩))),
                    Eq.mpr
                      (id
                        (congr
                          (congrArg Eq
                            (DiamondIntegral.Section2.rv.congr_simp M
                              ((Fin.snoc (D.point (Fin.init p.1, p.2)).1 (p.1 (Fin.last n)),
                                    (D.point (Fin.init p.1, p.2)).2).1
                                (Fin.last n))
                              (p.1 (Fin.last n))
                              (Fin.snoc_last (p.1 (Fin.last n))
                                (Function.update (Fin.init p.1) D.coordinate

                                    if D.core (Fin.init p.1, p.2) = true then

                          (Fin.append_right (fun x => DiamondIntegral.Section6.branchTag (D.core (Fin.init p.1, p.2)))
                            p.2 k)))
                      hp.right⟩,
        mpr := fun hq =>
          Exists.casesOn
            (have this :=
              Eq.mpr
                (id
                  (congrArg (fun _a => (Fin.init q.1, q.2) ∈ _a)
                    (Eq.symm (DiamondIntegral.Section6.CentripetalData.image_carrier D))))
                hq.left;

                            (Fin.snoc_last (q.1 (Fin.last n)) a.1)))
                        (a.2 k)))
                    (Eq.trans hq.right hOld)⟩;
              Exists.intro p
                ⟨hp,
                  Eq.mpr
                    (id
                      (congrArg (fun _a => _a = q)
                        (DiamondIntegral.Section6.CentripetalData.carryCoordinate_point D k hW p hp)))
                    (Eq.mpr
                      (id (congrArg (fun _a => (Fin.snoc (D.point _a).1 (p.1 (Fin.last n)), (D.point _a).2) = q) hbase))

  [inst : SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M] [M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {n : ℕ}
  (a : Fin (n + 1) → DiamondIntegral.Section2.VF M) (j : Fin n) (c : DiamondIntegral.Section2.VF M),
  Fin.init (Function.update a j.castSucc c) = Function.update (Fin.init a) j c :=

    c =>
  funext fun i =>
    if hi : i = j then
      Eq.symm hi ▸
        of_eq_true
          (Eq.trans (congr (congrArg Eq (Function.update_self j.castSucc c a)) (Function.update_self j c (Fin.init a)))
            (eq_self c))

      have hij := fun h => hi (Fin.castSucc_inj.mp h);
      of_eq_true
        (Eq.trans
          (congr
            (congrArg Eq
              ((fun x_0 v f => (fun x_0 => Function.update_of_ne hij) x_0 v f) (fun a => DiamondIntegral.Section2.VF M)
                c a))
            ((fun x_0 v f => (fun x_0 => Function.update_of_ne hi) x_0 v f) (fun a => DiamondIntegral.Section2.VF M) c
              (Fin.init a)))

theorem DiamondIntegral.Section6.CarriedChainLift.pushCoordinateRoots_form_control : ∀ {M : Type}
  [inst : SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M]
  [inst_1 : M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {n r s : ℕ} {S : Set M} {G : Type}
  [inst_2 : LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero G] [inst_3 : Valued (DiamondIntegral.Section2.VF M) G]
  {A : SpecialTransformations.DefinableGeometry.DefSet (SpecialTransformations.Section4.rawMixedSpace n r) S}
  {B : SpecialTransformations.DefinableGeometry.DefSet (SpecialTransformations.Section4.rawMixedSpace n s) S}
  {f : SpecialTransformations.DefinableGeometry.Map A B} {X : DiamondIntegral.Section6.CarriedRefinementFrame A}
  (h00 : M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF00) (F : DiamondIntegral.Section6.CarriedChainLift X f)
  (hinj : Function.Injective f.toFun) (R : DiamondIntegral.Section6.CoordinateRootFamily X.bundle)
  (ω :
    SpecialTransformations.DefinableGeometry.Map X.bundle
      (SpecialTransformations.DefinableGeometry.DefSet.univ DiamondIntegral.Section6.rawGammaPresentation S)),
  DiamondIntegral.Section6.CoordinateFormRootControl R (DiamondIntegral.Section6.gammaFormExtension ω) →
    DiamondIntegral.Section6.CoordinateFormRootControl (F.pushCoordinateRoots hinj R)
      (DiamondIntegral.Section6.gammaFormExtension (ω.comp (F.map.inverse ⋯))) :=
fun {M} [SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M] [M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {n r s}
    {S} {G} [LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero G] [Valued (DiamondIntegral.Section2.VF M) G] {A} {B} {f} {X} h00 F hinj R ω
    hControl b u a ρ hAmbient hAvoid x hx y hy =>
  have hBij := DiamondIntegral.Section6.SpecialCovariantChain.bijective F.special h00;
  have hCenter := hAmbient a (SpecialTransformations.Section3.Balls.centre_mem_openDisc Valued.v a ρ);
  Exists.casesOn (Function.Bijective.surjective hBij ⟨(Fin.snoc b a, u), hCenter⟩) fun anchor hAnchor =>
    have hAnchorPoint := congrArg Subtype.val hAnchor;
    let oldB := Fin.init (↑anchor).1;
    let oldU := (↑anchor).2;
    have hInput := fun z p he =>
      have hInit :=
        Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => Fin.init _a.1 = Fin.init (↑(F.map.toFun anchor)).1) he))
          (Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => Fin.init (Fin.snoc b z, u).1 = Fin.init _a.1) hAnchorPoint))
            (Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => _a = Fin.init (Fin.snoc b a, u).1) (Fin.init_snoc z b)))
              (Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => b = _a) (Fin.init_snoc a b))) (Eq.refl b))));
      have hTags :=
        Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => _a.2 = (↑(F.map.toFun anchor)).2) he))
          (Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => (Fin.snoc b z, u).2 = _a.2) hAnchorPoint)) (Eq.refl (Fin.snoc b z, u).2));
      have h := DiamondIntegral.Section6.CarriedChainLift.input_point_on_fibre F hinj p anchor hInit hTags;
      id
        (Eq.mp
          (congrArg (Eq ↑p)
            (congrFun'
              (congrArg Prod.mk
                (congrArg (Fin.snoc (Fin.init (↑anchor).1))
                  (Eq.trans (congrFun' (congrArg Prod.fst he) (Fin.last n)) (Fin.snoc_last z b))))
              (↑anchor).2))
          h);
    have hSource := fun z hz =>
      Exists.casesOn (Function.Bijective.surjective hBij ⟨(Fin.snoc b z, u), hAmbient z hz⟩) fun p hp =>
        hInput z p (congrArg Subtype.val hp) ▸ p.property;
    have hOldAvoid := fun z hz hzDisc =>
      Exists.casesOn (Function.Bijective.surjective hBij ⟨(Fin.snoc b z, u), hAmbient z hzDisc⟩) fun p hp =>
        have hpPoint := congrArg Subtype.val hp;
        have hpInput := hInput z p hpPoint;
        have hpRoot := Eq.symm hpInput ▸ (DiamondIntegral.Section6.CoordinateRootFamily.mem_fibre R oldB oldU z).mp hz;
        have hzNew :=
          (DiamondIntegral.Section6.CoordinateRootFamily.mem_fibre (F.pushCoordinateRoots hinj R) b u z).mpr
            (Exists.intro ⟨↑p, hpRoot⟩ hpPoint);
        hAvoid z hzNew hzDisc;
    have hValue := fun z hz =>
      let q := ⟨(Fin.snoc b z, u), hAmbient z hz⟩;
      let p := (F.map.inverse hBij).toFun q;
      have hp := congrArg Subtype.val (SpecialTransformations.DefinableGeometry.Map.apply_inverse F.map hBij q);
      have hpInput := hInput z p hp;
      id
        (Eq.mpr
          (id
            (congrArg (fun _a => _a = DiamondIntegral.Section6.gammaFormExtension ω (Fin.snoc oldB z, oldU))
              (DiamondIntegral.Section6.gammaFormExtension_at
                (ω.comp (F.map.inverse (DiamondIntegral.Section6.SpecialCovariantChain.bijective F.special h00))) q)))
          (id
            (have h := congrArg (DiamondIntegral.Section6.gammaFormExtension ω) hpInput;
            Eq.mp
              (congrArg (fun _a => _a = DiamondIntegral.Section6.gammaFormExtension ω (Fin.snoc oldB z, oldU))
                (DiamondIntegral.Section6.gammaFormExtension_at ω p))
              h)));
    Eq.trans (hValue x hx) (Eq.trans (hControl oldB oldU a ρ hSource hOldAvoid x hx y hy) (Eq.symm (hValue y hy)))

theorem DiamondIntegral.Section6.regularize_bundle_label_selection : ∀ {M : Type}
  [inst : SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M]
  [inst_1 : M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {n r s : ℕ}
  (p : DiamondIntegral.Section2.Mixed M (n + 1) s) (π : Fin r → Fin s),
  (Fin.init (DiamondIntegral.Section6.regularize p).1,
      (DiamondIntegral.Section6.regularize p).2 ∘
        DiamondIntegral.Section6.regularizedBundleLabels n s ∘ DiamondIntegral.Section6.regularizedLabelSelection n π) =
    DiamondIntegral.Section6.regularize (Fin.init p.1, p.2 ∘ π) :=
fun {M} [SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M] [M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {n r s}
    p π =>
  Prod.ext
    (Eq.refl
      (Fin.init (DiamondIntegral.Section6.regularize p).1,
          (DiamondIntegral.Section6.regularize p).2 ∘
            DiamondIntegral.Section6.regularizedBundleLabels n s ∘
              DiamondIntegral.Section6.regularizedLabelSelection n π).1)
    (funext fun i =>
      Fin.addCases
        (fun j =>
          Eq.mpr
            (id
              (congr
                (congrArg Eq
                  (Eq.trans
                    (congrArg (Fin.append (DiamondIntegral.Section2.tupleRV M p.1) p.2)
                      (Eq.trans
                        (congrArg (Fin.addCases (fun i => Fin.castAdd s i.castSucc) (Fin.natAdd (n + 1)))
                          (Fin.addCases_left j))
                        (Fin.addCases_left j)))
                    (Fin.append_left (DiamondIntegral.Section2.tupleRV M p.1) p.2 j.castSucc)))
                (Fin.append_left (DiamondIntegral.Section2.tupleRV M (Fin.init p.1)) (p.2 ∘ π) j)))
            (Eq.refl (DiamondIntegral.Section2.tupleRV M p.1 j.castSucc)))
        (fun j =>
          of_eq_true
            (Eq.trans
              (congr
                (congrArg Eq
                  (Eq.trans
                    (congrArg (Fin.append (DiamondIntegral.Section2.tupleRV M p.1) p.2)
                      (Eq.trans
                        (congrArg (Fin.addCases (fun i => Fin.castAdd s i.castSucc) (Fin.natAdd (n + 1)))
                          (Fin.addCases_right j))
                        (Fin.addCases_right (π j))))
                    (Fin.append_right (DiamondIntegral.Section2.tupleRV M p.1) p.2 (π j))))
                (Fin.append_right (DiamondIntegral.Section2.tupleRV M (Fin.init p.1)) (p.2 ∘ π) j))
              (eq_self (p.2 (π j)))))
        i)

    {S} {G} [LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero G] [Valued (DiamondIntegral.Section2.VF M) G] {A} {B} {f} {X} h00 F hinj p a
    hVF hRV =>
  let q := (Fin.snoc (Fin.init (↑(F.map.toFun a)).1) ((↑p).1 (Fin.last n)), (↑(F.map.toFun a)).2);
  have hQ :=
    ⟨Eq.mpr
        (id
          (congrArg (Membership.mem F.target.base.carrier)
            (congrFun' (congrArg Prod.mk (Fin.init_snoc ((↑p).1 (Fin.last n)) (Fin.init (↑(F.map.toFun a)).1)))
              (↑(F.map.toFun a)).2)))

              (congrArg (fun _a => DiamondIntegral.Section2.rv M _a = q.2 F.target.freeLabel)
                (Fin.snoc_last ((↑p).1 (Fin.last n)) (Fin.init (↑(F.map.toFun a)).1))))

    (Function.Bijective.surjective (DiamondIntegral.Section6.SpecialCovariantChain.bijective F.special h00) ⟨q, hQ⟩)
    fun b hb =>

      Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => Fin.init _a.1 = Fin.init (↑(F.map.toFun a)).1) hBpoint))
        (Fin.init_snoc ((↑p).1 (Fin.last n)) (Fin.init (↑(F.map.toFun a)).1));

    id
      (fun hInput =>
        have hbp :=
          Subtype.ext
            (Eq.mp (congrArg (fun _a => ↑b = (_a, (↑p).2)) (Fin.snoc_init_self (↑p).1))
              (Eq.mp (congrArg (fun _a => ↑b = (Fin.snoc (Fin.init (↑p).1) ((↑p).1 (Fin.last n)), _a)) (Eq.symm hRV))
                (Eq.mp (congrArg (fun _a => ↑b = (Fin.snoc _a ((↑p).1 (Fin.last n)), (↑a).2)) (Eq.symm hVF))
                  (Eq.mp

                      (Fin.snoc_last ((↑p).1 (Fin.last n)) (Fin.init (↑(F.map.toFun a)).1)))
                    hInput))));

    hPX hControl b u a ρ hAmbient hAvoid x hx y hy =>
  have hBij := DiamondIntegral.Section6.SpecialCovariantChain.bijective F.special h00;
  have hCenter := hAmbient a (SpecialTransformations.Section3.Balls.centre_mem_openDisc Valued.v a ρ);
  Exists.casesOn (Function.Bijective.surjective hBij ⟨(Fin.snoc b a, u), hCenter⟩) fun anchor hAnchor =>
    have hAnchorPoint := congrArg Subtype.val hAnchor;
    let oldB := Fin.init (↑anchor).1;
    let oldU := (↑anchor).2;

      have hInit :=
        Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => Fin.init _a.1 = Fin.init (↑(F.map.toFun anchor)).1) he))

theorem DiamondIntegral.Section6.CarriedChainLift.rootImage_fibre_subset : ∀ {M : Type}
  [inst : SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M]
  [inst_1 : M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {n r s : ℕ} {S : Set M} {G : Type}
  [inst_2 : LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero G] [inst_3 : Valued (DiamondIntegral.Section2.VF M) G]
  {A : SpecialTransformations.DefinableGeometry.DefSet (SpecialTransformations.Section4.rawMixedSpace n r) S}
  {B : SpecialTransformations.DefinableGeometry.DefSet (SpecialTransformations.Section4.rawMixedSpace n s) S}
  {f : SpecialTransformations.DefinableGeometry.Map A B} {X : DiamondIntegral.Section6.CarriedRefinementFrame A}
  (F : DiamondIntegral.Section6.CarriedChainLift X f),
  Function.Injective f.toFun →
    ∀ (R : DiamondIntegral.Section6.CoordinateRootFamily X.bundle) (a : ↑X.bundle.carrier)
      (b : Fin n → DiamondIntegral.Section2.VF M) (u : Fin F.target.arity → DiamondIntegral.Section2.RVInfinity M),
      Fin.init (↑(F.map.toFun a)).1 = b →
        (↑(F.map.toFun a)).2 = u →
          {x | (Fin.snoc b x, u) ∈ (F.rootImage R).carrier} ⊆
            {x | (Fin.snoc (Fin.init (↑a).1) x, (↑a).2) ∈ R.roots.carrier} :=
fun {M} [SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M] [M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {n r s}
    {S} {G} [LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero G] [Valued (DiamondIntegral.Section2.VF M) G] {A} {B} {f} {X} F hinj R a b u
    hVF hRV ⦃x⦄ a_1 =>
  Exists.casesOn a_1 fun p hp =>
    let pA := ⟨↑p, R.subset p.property⟩;
    have he := hp;
    have hInit :=
      Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => Fin.init _a.1 = Fin.init (↑(F.map.toFun a)).1) he))
        (Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => _a = Fin.init (↑(F.map.toFun a)).1) (Fin.init_snoc x b)))
          (Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => b = _a) hVF)) (Eq.refl b)));
    have hTags := Eq.trans (congrArg Prod.snd he) (Eq.symm hRV);
    have hInput := DiamondIntegral.Section6.CarriedChainLift.input_point_on_fibre F hinj pA a hInit hTags;
    id
      (fun hInput =>
        id
          (Eq.mpr
            (id
              (congrArg (fun _a => _a ∈ R.roots.carrier)
                (Eq.symm
                  (Eq.mp (congrArg (fun _a => ↑pA = (Fin.snoc (Fin.init (↑a).1) _a, (↑a).2)) (Fin.snoc_last x b))
                    hInput))))
            p.property))
      (Eq.mp (congrArg (fun _a => ↑pA = (Fin.snoc (Fin.init (↑a).1) (_a.1 (Fin.last n)), (↑a).2)) he) hInput)

  [inst : SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M]
  [inst_1 : M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {n r s : ℕ} {S : Set M} {G : Type}
  [inst_2 : LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero G] [inst_3 : Valued (DiamondIntegral.Section2.VF M) G]
  {A : SpecialTransformations.DefinableGeometry.DefSet (SpecialTransformations.Section4.rawMixedSpace n r) S}
  {B : SpecialTransformations.DefinableGeometry.DefSet (SpecialTransformations.Section4.rawMixedSpace n s) S}
  {f : SpecialTransformations.DefinableGeometry.Map A B} {X : DiamondIntegral.Section6.CarriedRefinementFrame A}
  (F : DiamondIntegral.Section6.CarriedChainLift X f) (hinj : Function.Injective f.toFun)
  (R : DiamondIntegral.Section6.CoordinateRootFamily X.bundle) (N : ℕ),
  R.Bound N → (F.pushCoordinateRoots hinj R).Bound N :=
fun {M} [SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M] [M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {n r s}
    {S} {G} [LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero G] [Valued (DiamondIntegral.Section2.VF M) G] {A} {B} {f} {X} F hinj R N hN
    b u =>
  if hne : ((F.pushCoordinateRoots hinj R).fibre b u).Nonempty then
    Exists.casesOn hne fun x hx =>
      Exists.casesOn
        ((DiamondIntegral.Section6.CoordinateRootFamily.mem_fibre (F.pushCoordinateRoots hinj R) b u x).mp hx)
        fun p hp =>
        let a := ⟨↑p, R.subset p.property⟩;
        have he := hp;
        have hVF :=
          Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => Fin.init _a.1 = b) he))
            (Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => _a = b) (Fin.init_snoc x b))) (Eq.refl b));
        have hRV := congrArg Prod.snd he;
        have hSub := fun ⦃y⦄ hy =>
          (DiamondIntegral.Section6.CoordinateRootFamily.mem_fibre R (Fin.init (↑a).1) (↑a).2 y).mpr
            (DiamondIntegral.Section6.CarriedChainLift.rootImage_fibre_subset F hinj R a b u hVF hRV
              ((DiamondIntegral.Section6.CoordinateRootFamily.mem_fibre (F.pushCoordinateRoots hinj R) b u y).mp hy));
        LE.le.trans (Finset.card_le_card hSub) (hN (Fin.init (↑a).1) (↑a).2)
  else
    Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => _a.card ≤ N) (Finset.not_nonempty_iff_eq_empty.mp hne)))
      (Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => _a ≤ N) Finset.card_empty)) (Nat.zero_le N))

    hCoeff p hp =>

          (Eq.mp
            (congrArg

@DiamondIntegral.Section6.CentripetalData.point_on_branch : ∀ {M : Type}
  [inst : SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M]
  [inst_1 : M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {n r : ℕ} {S : Set M} {G : Type}

  {A : SpecialTransformations.DefinableGeometry.DefSet (SpecialTransformations.Section4.rawMixedSpace n r) S}
  (D : DiamondIntegral.Section6.CentripetalData A) (u : Fin r → DiamondIntegral.Section2.RVInfinity M) (b : Bool)
  {a : Fin n → DiamondIntegral.Section2.VF M},
  a ∈ D.branch u b →
    D.point (a, u) = (DiamondIntegral.Section6.coordinateShear D.coordinate (D.branchFocus u b) a, D.outputTags u b)
theorem DiamondIntegral.Section6.CentripetalData.point_on_branch : ∀ {M : Type}
  [inst : SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M]
  [inst_1 : M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {n r : ℕ} {S : Set M} {G : Type}
  [inst_2 : LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero G] [inst_3 : Valued (DiamondIntegral.Section2.VF M) G]
  {A : SpecialTransformations.DefinableGeometry.DefSet (SpecialTransformations.Section4.rawMixedSpace n r) S}
  (D : DiamondIntegral.Section6.CentripetalData A) (u : Fin r → DiamondIntegral.Section2.RVInfinity M) (b : Bool)
  {a : Fin n → DiamondIntegral.Section2.VF M},
  a ∈ D.branch u b →
    D.point (a, u) = (DiamondIntegral.Section6.coordinateShear D.coordinate (D.branchFocus u b) a, D.outputTags u b) :=
fun {M} [SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M] [M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {n r}
    {S} {G} [LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero G] [Valued (DiamondIntegral.Section2.VF M) G] {A} D u b {a} ha =>
  Prod.ext
    (if hu : u ∈ D.activeTags.carrier then
      Eq.mpr
        (id
          (congrArg
            (fun _a =>
              _a.1 = (DiamondIntegral.Section6.coordinateShear D.coordinate (D.branchFocus u b) a, D.outputTags u b).1)
            (DiamondIntegral.Section6.CentripetalData.point.eq_1 D (a, u))))
        (Eq.mpr
          (id
            (congrArg
              (fun _a =>
                (Function.update (a, u).1 D.coordinate
                        ((a, u).1 D.coordinate - _a + if D.core (a, u) = true then D.coefficient * _a else 0),
                      Fin.append (fun x => DiamondIntegral.Section6.branchTag (D.core (a, u))) (a, u).2).1 =
                  (DiamondIntegral.Section6.coordinateShear D.coordinate (D.branchFocus u b) a, D.outputTags u b).1)
              (DiamondIntegral.Section6.CentripetalData.extendedFocus_active D ha.left hu)))
          (Eq.mpr
            (id
              (congrArg
                (fun _a =>
                  (Function.update (a, u).1 D.coordinate
                          ((a, u).1 D.coordinate - D.focus (Function.update (a, u).1 D.coordinate 0) (a, u).2 +
                            if _a = true then D.coefficient * D.focus (Function.update (a, u).1 D.coordinate 0) (a, u).2
                            else 0),
                        Fin.append (fun x => DiamondIntegral.Section6.branchTag _a) (a, u).2).1 =
                    (DiamondIntegral.Section6.coordinateShear D.coordinate (D.branchFocus u b) a, D.outputTags u b).1)
                ha.right))
            (Eq.mpr
              (id
                (congr
                  (congrArg Eq
                    (congrArg (Function.update a D.coordinate)
                      (congrArg (HAdd.hAdd (a D.coordinate - D.focus (Function.update a D.coordinate 0) u))
                        (ite_congr (Eq.refl (b = true))
                          (fun a_1 => Eq.refl (D.coefficient * D.focus (Function.update a D.coordinate 0) u)) fun a =>
                          Eq.refl 0))))
                  (congrArg (Function.update a D.coordinate)
                    (congrArg (HAdd.hAdd (a D.coordinate))
                      (Eq.trans
                        (ite_congr (eq_true hu)
                          (fun a_1 =>
                            Eq.refl
                              (if b = true then (D.coefficient - 1) * D.focus (Function.update a D.coordinate 0) u
                              else -D.focus (Function.update a D.coordinate 0) u))
                          fun a => Eq.refl 0)
                        (ite_true
                          (if b = true then (D.coefficient - 1) * D.focus (Function.update a D.coordinate 0) u
                          else -D.focus (Function.update a D.coordinate 0) u)
                          0))))))
              (congrArg (Function.update a D.coordinate)
                (Bool.casesOn (motive := fun t =>
                  b = t →
                    (a D.coordinate - D.focus (Function.update a D.coordinate 0) u +
                        if b = true then D.coefficient * D.focus (Function.update a D.coordinate 0) u else 0) =
                      a D.coordinate +
                        if b = true then (D.coefficient - 1) * D.focus (Function.update a D.coordinate 0) u
                        else -D.focus (Function.update a D.coordinate 0) u)
                  b
                  (fun h =>
                    Eq.ndrec (motive := fun b =>
                      a ∈ D.branch u b →
                        (a D.coordinate - D.focus (Function.update a D.coordinate 0) u +
                            if b = true then D.coefficient * D.focus (Function.update a D.coordinate 0) u else 0) =
                          a D.coordinate +
                            if b = true then (D.coefficient - 1) * D.focus (Function.update a D.coordinate 0) u
                            else -D.focus (Function.update a D.coordinate 0) u)
                      (fun ha =>
                        Eq.mpr
                          (id
                            (congr
                              (congrArg Eq
                                (Eq.trans
                                  (congrArg (HAdd.hAdd (a D.coordinate - D.focus (Function.update a D.coordinate 0) u))
                                    (Eq.trans
                                      (ite_congr Bool.false_eq_true
                                        (fun a_1 =>
                                          Eq.refl (D.coefficient * D.focus (Function.update a D.coordinate 0) u))
                                        fun a => Eq.refl 0)
                                      (ite_false (D.coefficient * D.focus (Function.update a D.coordinate 0) u) 0)))
                                  (add_zero (a D.coordinate - D.focus (Function.update a D.coordinate 0) u))))
                              (congrArg (HAdd.hAdd (a D.coordinate))
                                (Eq.trans
                                  (ite_congr Bool.false_eq_true
                                    (fun a_1 =>
                                      Eq.refl ((D.coefficient - 1) * D.focus (Function.update a D.coordinate 0) u))
                                    fun a_1 => Eq.refl (-D.focus (Function.update a D.coordinate 0) u))
                                  (ite_false ((D.coefficient - 1) * D.focus (Function.update a D.coordinate 0) u)
                                    (-D.focus (Function.update a D.coordinate 0) u))))))
                          (sub_eq_add_neg (a D.coordinate) (D.focus (Function.update a D.coordinate 0) u)))
                      (Eq.symm h) ha)
                  (fun h =>
                    Eq.ndrec (motive := fun b =>
                      a ∈ D.branch u b →
                        (a D.coordinate - D.focus (Function.update a D.coordinate 0) u +
                            if b = true then D.coefficient * D.focus (Function.update a D.coordinate 0) u else 0) =
                          a D.coordinate +
                            if b = true then (D.coefficient - 1) * D.focus (Function.update a D.coordinate 0) u
                            else -D.focus (Function.update a D.coordinate 0) u)
                      (fun ha =>
                        Eq.mpr
                          (id
                            (congr
                              (congrArg Eq
                                (congrArg (HAdd.hAdd (a D.coordinate - D.focus (Function.update a D.coordinate 0) u))
                                  (Eq.trans
                                    (ite_congr (eq_self true)
                                      (fun a_1 =>
                                        Eq.refl (D.coefficient * D.focus (Function.update a D.coordinate 0) u))
                                      fun a => Eq.refl 0)
                                    (ite_true (D.coefficient * D.focus (Function.update a D.coordinate 0) u) 0))))
                              (congrArg (HAdd.hAdd (a D.coordinate))
                                (Eq.trans
                                  (ite_congr (eq_self true)
                                    (fun a_1 =>

  [inst : SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M]
  [inst_1 : M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {n r : ℕ} {S : Set M} {G : Type}

  (D : DiamondIntegral.Section6.CentripetalData A) {p q : DiamondIntegral.Section2.Mixed M n r},
  p ∈ A.carrier →
    q ∈ A.carrier →
      p.2 = q.2 → (∀ (i : Fin n), i ≠ D.coordinate → p.1 i = q.1 i) → D.extendedFocus p = D.extendedFocus q :=
fun {M} [SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M] [M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {n r}
    {S} {G} [LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero G] [Valued (DiamondIntegral.Section2.VF M) G] {A} D {p q} hp hq hu hother =>
  if hact : p.2 ∈ D.activeTags.carrier then
    have hactq := hu ▸ hact;
    Eq.mpr
      (id
        (congrArg (fun _a => _a = D.extendedFocus q)
          (DiamondIntegral.Section6.CentripetalData.extendedFocus_active D hp hact)))
      (Eq.mpr
        (id
          (congrArg (fun _a => D.focus (Function.update p.1 D.coordinate 0) p.2 = _a)
            (DiamondIntegral.Section6.CentripetalData.extendedFocus_active D hq hactq)))

                of_eq_true

                    (congr (congrArg Eq (Function.update_self D.coordinate 0 p.1))
                      (Function.update_self D.coordinate 0 q.1))

                (hother i hi);

            (id

                  D.focus (Function.update q.1 D.coordinate 0) _a = D.focus (Function.update q.1 D.coordinate 0) q.2)

            (Eq.refl (D.focus (Function.update q.1 D.coordinate 0) q.2)))))
  else

      (id
        (congrArg (fun _a => _a = D.extendedFocus q)
          (DiamondIntegral.Section6.CentripetalData.extendedFocus_inactive D hact)))
      (Eq.mpr
        (id
