theorem DiamondIntegral.Section6.CentripetalData.point_injective_on : ∀ {M : Type}
  [inst : SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M]
  [inst_1 : M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {n r : ℕ} {S : Set M} {G : Type}
  [inst_2 : LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero G] [inst_3 : Valued (DiamondIntegral.Section2.VF M) G]
  {A : SpecialTransformations.DefinableGeometry.DefSet (SpecialTransformations.Section4.rawMixedSpace n r) S}
  (D : DiamondIntegral.Section6.CentripetalData A),
  M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF00 → Set.InjOn D.point A.carrier :=
fun {M} [SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M] [M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {n r}
    {S} {G} [LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero G] [Valued (DiamondIntegral.Section2.VF M) G] {A} D h00 ⦃p⦄ hp ⦃q⦄ hq he =>
  have hOld :=
    funext fun i =>
      Eq.mp
        (congr (congrArg Eq (Fin.append_right (fun x => DiamondIntegral.Section6.branchTag (D.core p)) p.2 i))
          (Fin.append_right (fun x => DiamondIntegral.Section6.branchTag (D.core q)) q.2 i))
        (congrArg (fun z => z.2 (Fin.natAdd 1 i)) he);
  have hTag :=
    Eq.mp
      (congr (congrArg Eq (Fin.append_left (fun x => DiamondIntegral.Section6.branchTag (D.core p)) p.2 0))
        (Fin.append_left (fun x => DiamondIntegral.Section6.branchTag (D.core q)) q.2 0))
      (congrArg (fun z => z.2 (Fin.castAdd r 0)) he);
  have hCore := DiamondIntegral.Section6.branchTag_injective h00 hTag;
  have hOther := fun i hi =>
    Eq.mp
      (congr
        (congrArg Eq
          ((fun x_0 v f => (fun x_0 => Function.update_of_ne hi) x_0 v f) (fun a => DiamondIntegral.Section2.VF M)
            (p.1 D.coordinate - D.extendedFocus p + if D.core p = true then D.coefficient * D.extendedFocus p else 0)
            p.1))
        ((fun x_0 v f => (fun x_0 => Function.update_of_ne hi) x_0 v f) (fun a => DiamondIntegral.Section2.VF M)
          (q.1 D.coordinate - D.extendedFocus q + if D.core q = true then D.coefficient * D.extendedFocus q else 0)
          q.1))
      (congrArg (fun z => z.1 i) he);
  have hFocus := DiamondIntegral.Section6.CentripetalData.extendedFocus_same_other D hp hq hOld hOther;
  have hJ := congrArg (fun z => z.1 D.coordinate) he;
  have hJ' :=
    have hsub :=
      add_right_cancel
        (Eq.mp
          (congrArg
            (fun _a =>
              (p.1 D.coordinate - D.extendedFocus q + if _a = true then D.coefficient * D.extendedFocus q else 0) =
                q.1 D.coordinate - D.extendedFocus q + if D.core q = true then D.coefficient * D.extendedFocus q else 0)
            hCore)
          (Eq.mp
            (congrArg
              (fun _a =>
                (p.1 D.coordinate - _a + if D.core p = true then D.coefficient * _a else 0) =
                  q.1 D.coordinate - D.extendedFocus q +
                    if D.core q = true then D.coefficient * D.extendedFocus q else 0)
              hFocus)
            (Eq.mp
              (congr
                (congrArg Eq
                  (Function.update_self D.coordinate
                    (p.1 D.coordinate - D.extendedFocus p +
                      if D.core p = true then D.coefficient * D.extendedFocus p else 0)
                    p.1))
                (Function.update_self D.coordinate
                  (q.1 D.coordinate - D.extendedFocus q +
                    if D.core q = true then D.coefficient * D.extendedFocus q else 0)
                  q.1))
              hJ)));
    Trans.trans
      (Trans.trans (Eq.symm (sub_add_cancel (p.1 D.coordinate) (D.extendedFocus q)))
        (congrArg (fun x => x + D.extendedFocus q) hsub))
      (sub_add_cancel (q.1 D.coordinate) (D.extendedFocus q));
  Prod.ext (funext fun i => if hi : i = D.coordinate then Eq.symm hi ▸ hJ' else hOther i hi) hOld

@DiamondIntegral.Section6.determinant_one_of_fixed_rows : ∀ {n : ℕ} {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K]
  (D : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) K) (j : Fin n),
  (∀ (i : Fin n), i ≠ j → ∀ (k : Fin n), D i k = 1 i k) → D j j = 1 → D.det = 1
theorem DiamondIntegral.Section6.determinant_one_of_fixed_rows.{u_1} : ∀ {n : ℕ} {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K]
  (D : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) K) (j : Fin n),
  (∀ (i : Fin n), i ≠ j → ∀ (k : Fin n), D i k = 1 i k) → D j j = 1 → D.det = 1 :=
fun {n} {K} [Field K] D j hrow hjj =>
  let I := 1;
  have he :=
    Matrix.ext fun i k =>
      if hij : i = j then
        Eq.symm hij ▸ Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => D j k = _a k) Matrix.updateRow_self)) (Eq.refl (D j k))
      else Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => D i k = _a k) (Matrix.updateRow_ne hij))) (hrow i hij k);
  have hr :=
    funext fun i =>
      Eq.mpr
        (id
          (congrFun'
            (congrArg Eq
              (Eq.trans
                (Eq.trans (congrFun (Finset.sum_congr (Eq.refl Finset.univ) fun x a => Eq.refl (D j x • 1 x)) i)
                  (Finset.sum_apply i Finset.univ fun c => D j c • 1 c))
                (Finset.sum_congr (Eq.refl Finset.univ) fun x a => Eq.refl (D j x * if x = i then 1 else 0))))
            (D j i)))
        (Eq.mpr
          (id
            (congrArg (fun _a => _a = D j i)
              (Finset.sum_eq_single i
                (fun k a hki =>
                  of_eq_true
                    (Eq.trans
                      (congrFun'
                        (congrArg Eq
                          (Eq.trans (congrArg (HMul.hMul (D j k)) (ite_eq_right_of_eq_false 1 0 (eq_false hki)))
                            (mul_zero (D j k))))
                        0)
                      (eq_self 0)))
                (of_eq_true
                  (Eq.trans
                    (implies_congr (Eq.trans (congrArg Not (Finset.mem_univ._simp_1 i)) not_true_eq_false)
                      (congrFun'
                        (congrArg Eq
                          (Eq.trans (congrArg (HMul.hMul (D j i)) (ite_eq_left_of_eq_true 1 0 (eq_self i)))
                            (mul_one (D j i))))
                        0))
                    IsEmpty.forall_iff._simp_1)))))
          (of_eq_true
            (Eq.trans
              (congrFun'
                (congrArg Eq
                  (Eq.trans (congrArg (HMul.hMul (D j i)) (ite_eq_left_of_eq_true 1 0 (eq_self i))) (mul_one (D j i))))
                (D j i))
              (eq_self (D j i)))));
  Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => _a.det = 1) he))
    (Eq.trans (congrArg (fun row => (I.updateRow j row).det) (Eq.symm hr))
      (Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => _a = 1) (Matrix.det_updateRow_sum I j (D j))))
        (Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => _a • I.det = 1) hjj))
          (Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => _a = 1) (one_smul K I.det)))
            (Eq.mpr
              (id
                (congrArg (fun _a => _a.det = 1)
                  (have this := rfl;
                  this)))
              (Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => _a = 1) Matrix.det_one)) (Eq.refl 1)))))))

      (funext fun i =>
        Fin.lastCases

            (Eq.trans
              (congr (congrArg Eq (Function.update_self (Fin.last n) 0 (↑a).1))
                (Function.update_self (Fin.last n) 0 (↑b).1))

                (congr
                  (congrArg Eq

                      (fun a => SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Transfer.VFType) 0 (↑a).1))

                    (fun a => SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Transfer.VFType) 0 (↑b).1)))

    (funext fun i =>
      List.Mem.casesOn (motive := fun a_1 x =>
        List.finRange 1 = a_1 → Fintype.complete i ≍ x → ↑(D.focusMap.toFun a) i = ↑(D.focusMap.toFun b) i)

              ∀ (this : i ∈ Fintype.elems),

                  this ≍ List.Mem.head as →
                    ↑(D.focusMap.toFun a) ((fun i => i) ⟨0, Nat.le_refl 1⟩) =

theorem DiamondIntegral.Section6.CentripetalData.extendOnTags_extendedFocus : ∀ {M : Type}
  [inst : SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M]
  [inst_1 : M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {n r : ℕ} {S : Set M} {G : Type}

  (U : SpecialTransformations.DefinableGeometry.DefSet (SpecialTransformations.Section4.rawRVSpace r) S)

  (hA : DiamondIntegral.Section6.ProperInvariant S A.carrier) (hAD : DiamondIntegral.Section6.VFDoublyBounded A.carrier)

    ∀ p ∈ A.carrier,
      ∀ q ∈ A.carrier, p.2 = q.2 → DiamondIntegral.Section2.tupleRV M p.1 = DiamondIntegral.Section2.tupleRV M q.1),

    {S} {G} [LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero G] [Valued (DiamondIntegral.Section2.VF M) G] {A C} D U hC hA hAD htag p
    hp =>
  let E := D.extendOnTags U hC hA hAD htag;
  have hpA :=
    let E := D.extendOnTags U hC hA hAD htag;
    (Eq.mp (congrArg (fun _a => p ∈ _a) hC) hp).left;
  have hpU := (Eq.mp (congrArg (fun _a => p ∈ _a) hC) hp).right;

    have hEact := ⟨hact, hpU⟩;

        (congrArg (fun _a => _a = D.extendedFocus p)
          (DiamondIntegral.Section6.CentripetalData.extendedFocus_inactive E hEact)))

theorem DiamondIntegral.Section6.CentripetalData.extendOnTags_point : ∀ {M : Type}
  [inst : SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M]
  [inst_1 : M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {n r : ℕ} {S : Set M} {G : Type}
  [inst_2 : LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero G] [inst_3 : Valued (DiamondIntegral.Section2.VF M) G]
  {A C : SpecialTransformations.DefinableGeometry.DefSet (SpecialTransformations.Section4.rawMixedSpace n r) S}
  (D : DiamondIntegral.Section6.CentripetalData C)
  (U : SpecialTransformations.DefinableGeometry.DefSet (SpecialTransformations.Section4.rawRVSpace r) S)
  (hC : C.carrier = (DiamondIntegral.Section6.focusActive A U).carrier)
  (hA : DiamondIntegral.Section6.ProperInvariant S A.carrier) (hAD : DiamondIntegral.Section6.VFDoublyBounded A.carrier)
  (htag :
    ∀ p ∈ A.carrier,
      ∀ q ∈ A.carrier, p.2 = q.2 → DiamondIntegral.Section2.tupleRV M p.1 = DiamondIntegral.Section2.tupleRV M q.1),
  ∀ p ∈ C.carrier, (D.extendOnTags U hC hA hAD htag).point p = D.point p :=
fun {M} [SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M] [M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {n r}
    {S} {G} [LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero G] [Valued (DiamondIntegral.Section2.VF M) G] {A C} D U hC hA hAD htag p
    hp =>
  let E := D.extendOnTags U hC hA hAD htag;
  have hExt := DiamondIntegral.Section6.CentripetalData.extendOnTags_extendedFocus D U hC hA hAD htag p hp;
  have hCore :=
    id
      (Eq.mpr
        (id
          (congrFun'
            (congrArg Eq
              (Decidable.decide.congr_simp
                (DiamondIntegral.Section2.vfValue (E.coefficient * E.extendedFocus p) <
                  DiamondIntegral.Section2.vfValue (p.1 E.coordinate - E.extendedFocus p))
                (DiamondIntegral.Section2.vfValue (E.coefficient * D.extendedFocus p) <
                  DiamondIntegral.Section2.vfValue (p.1 E.coordinate - D.extendedFocus p))
                (congr
                  (congrArg LT.lt (congrArg DiamondIntegral.Section2.vfValue (congrArg (HMul.hMul E.coefficient) hExt)))
                  (congrArg DiamondIntegral.Section2.vfValue (congrArg (HSub.hSub (p.1 E.coordinate)) hExt)))))
            (decide
              (DiamondIntegral.Section2.vfValue (D.coefficient * D.extendedFocus p) <
                DiamondIntegral.Section2.vfValue (p.1 D.coordinate - D.extendedFocus p)))))
        (Eq.refl
          (decide
            (DiamondIntegral.Section2.vfValue (E.coefficient * D.extendedFocus p) <
              DiamondIntegral.Section2.vfValue (p.1 E.coordinate - D.extendedFocus p)))));
  id
    (Eq.mpr
      (id
        (congrFun'
          (congrArg Eq
            (congr
              (congrArg Prod.mk
                (congrArg (Function.update p.1 E.coordinate)
                  (congr (congrArg HAdd.hAdd (congrArg (HSub.hSub (p.1 E.coordinate)) hExt))
                    (ite_congr (congrFun' (congrArg Eq hCore) true) (fun a => congrArg (HMul.hMul E.coefficient) hExt)
                      fun a => Eq.refl 0))))
              (congrFun'
                (congrArg Fin.append
                  (funext fun x => DiamondIntegral.Section6.branchTag.congr_simp (E.core p) (D.core p) hCore))
                p.2)))
          (Function.update p.1 D.coordinate
              (p.1 D.coordinate - D.extendedFocus p + if D.core p = true then D.coefficient * D.extendedFocus p else 0),
            Fin.append (fun x => DiamondIntegral.Section6.branchTag (D.core p)) p.2)))
      (Eq.refl
        (Function.update p.1 E.coordinate
            (p.1 E.coordinate - D.extendedFocus p + if D.core p = true then E.coefficient * D.extendedFocus p else 0),
          Fin.append (fun x => DiamondIntegral.Section6.branchTag (D.core p)) p.2)))

  [inst : SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M]
  [inst_1 : M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {n r : ℕ} {S : Set M} {G : Type}
  [inst_2 : LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero G] [inst_3 : Valued (DiamondIntegral.Section2.VF M) G]
  {A : SpecialTransformations.DefinableGeometry.DefSet (SpecialTransformations.Section4.rawMixedSpace n r) S}
  (D : DiamondIntegral.Section6.CentripetalData A),
  DiamondIntegral.Section2.IsRVPullback A.carrier →
    ∀ a ∈ A.carrier,
      a.2 ∈ D.activeTags.carrier →
        ∀ (y : DiamondIntegral.Section2.VF M),
          DiamondIntegral.Section2.vfValue (D.extendedFocus a) < DiamondIntegral.Section2.vfValue y →
            DiamondIntegral.Section2.vfValue y ≤ DiamondIntegral.Section2.vfValue (D.coefficient * D.extendedFocus a) →
              ∃ b ∈ A.carrier,
                D.core b = false ∧
                  D.point b =
                    (Function.update a.1 D.coordinate y,
                      Fin.append (fun x => DiamondIntegral.Section6.branchTag false) a.2) :=
fun {M} [SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M] [M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {n r}
    {S} {G} [LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero G] [Valued (DiamondIntegral.Section2.VF M) G] {A} D hA a ha hu y hSmall
    hCut =>
  let focus := D.extendedFocus a;
  let b := (Function.update a.1 D.coordinate (focus + y), a.2);
  have hf0 := DiamondIntegral.Section6.CentripetalData.focus_nonzero D ha hu;
  have hSame :=
    have he :=
      (DiamondIntegral.Section6.rv_eq_iff_value_close hf0).mpr
        (Eq.mpr
          (id
            (congrArg (LT.lt (DiamondIntegral.Section2.vfValue focus))
              (congrArg DiamondIntegral.Section2.vfValue (add_sub_cancel_left focus y))))
          hSmall);
    have hFocusRV :=
      Eq.mpr
        (id
          (congrArg (fun _a => DiamondIntegral.Section2.rv M _a = DiamondIntegral.Section2.rv M (a.1 D.coordinate))
            (have this := DiamondIntegral.Section6.CentripetalData.extendedFocus_active D ha hu;
            this)))
        (D.focusRV a ha hu);
    Eq.trans he hFocusRV;
  have hb :=
    DiamondIntegral.Section6.rvPullback_mem_of_sameRV hA ha
      (funext fun i =>
        if hi : i = D.coordinate then
          Eq.symm hi ▸
            id
              (Eq.mpr
                (id
                  (congrArg (Eq (DiamondIntegral.Section2.rv M (a.1 D.coordinate)))
                    (DiamondIntegral.Section2.rv.congr_simp M (b.1 D.coordinate) (focus + y)
                      (Function.update_self D.coordinate (focus + y) a.1))))
                (Eq.symm hSame))
        else
          id
            (of_eq_true
              (Eq.trans
                (congrArg (Eq (DiamondIntegral.Section2.rv M (a.1 i)))
                  (DiamondIntegral.Section2.rv.congr_simp M (b.1 i) (a.1 i)
                    ((fun x_0 v f => (fun x_0 => Function.update_of_ne hi) x_0 v f)
                      (fun a => DiamondIntegral.Section2.VF M) (focus + y) a.1)))

      rfl;

      (DiamondIntegral.Section6.CentripetalData.extendedFocus_same_other D ha hb rfl fun i hi =>

              ((fun x_0 v f => (fun x_0 => Function.update_of_ne hi) x_0 v f) (fun a => DiamondIntegral.Section2.VF M)
                (focus + y) a.1))

  have hCore :=

        (Eq.mpr

            (congr
              (congrArg LE.le
                (congrArg DiamondIntegral.Section2.vfValue
                  (Eq.trans
                    (congr (congrArg HSub.hSub (Function.update_self D.coordinate (D.extendedFocus a + y) a.1)) hFocus)

              (congrArg DiamondIntegral.Section2.vfValue (congrArg (HMul.hMul D.coefficient) hFocus))))
          hCut));
  Exists.intro b
    ⟨hb,
      ⟨hCore,
        Prod.ext
          (of_eq_true
            (Eq.trans
              (congrFun'
                (congrArg Eq
                  (congrArg Prod.fst
                    (congr
                      (congrArg Prod.mk
                        (Eq.trans
                          (congrArg (Function.update (Function.update a.1 D.coordinate (focus + y)) D.coordinate)
                            (Eq.trans
                              (congr
                                (congrArg HAdd.hAdd
                                  (Eq.trans
                                    (congr (congrArg HSub.hSub (Function.update_self D.coordinate (focus + y) a.1))
                                      hFocus)
                                    (add_sub_cancel_left focus y)))

                                  (ite_congr (Eq.trans (congrFun' (congrArg Eq hCore) true) Bool.false_eq_true)
                                    (fun a => congrArg (HMul.hMul D.coefficient) hFocus) fun a => Eq.refl 0)
                                  (ite_false (D.coefficient * focus) 0)))
                              (add_zero y)))
                          (Function.update_idem (focus + y) y a.1)))
                      (congrFun'
                        (congrArg Fin.append
                          (funext fun x => DiamondIntegral.Section6.branchTag.congr_simp (D.core b) false hCore))
                        a.2))))
                (Function.update a.1 D.coordinate y))
              (eq_self (Function.update a.1 D.coordinate y))))
          (of_eq_true
            (Eq.trans
              (congrFun'
                (congrArg Eq

              ∀ (T : DiamondIntegral.Section6.CentripetalProgramTemplate S p n r s)

                        (∀ (i : Fin k),
                            DiamondIntegral.Section6.ProperInvariant (S ∪ Set.range a) ((P i).fibre a).carrier) →
                          Nonempty (DiamondIntegral.Section6.CentripetalProgramRealization T A P a)

theorem DiamondIntegral.Section6.exists_common_named_coefficient : ∀ {M : Type}
  [inst : SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M]
  [inst_1 : M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {S : Set M} {I : Type} [Finite I]
  (a : I → DiamondIntegral.Section2.VF M),
  (∀ (i : I), a i ≠ 0) →
    (∀ (i : I), 1 ≤ DiamondIntegral.Section2.vfValue (a i)) →
      (∀ (i : I), S.Definable₁ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV {↑(a i)}) →
        ∃ c,
          c ≠ 0 ∧
            S.Definable₁ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV {↑c} ∧
              1 ≤ DiamondIntegral.Section2.vfValue c ∧
                ∀ (i : I), DiamondIntegral.Section2.vfValue (a i) ≤ DiamondIntegral.Section2.vfValue c :=

  have hIndex := fun x hx =>
    Exists.casesOn (Finset.mem_image.mp hx) fun i h => And.casesOn h fun left he => Exists.intro i he;
  have hEpos := fun x hx =>
    Exists.casesOn (Finset.mem_image.mp hx) fun i h =>
      And.casesOn h fun left right =>
        Eq.ndrec (motive := fun x => x ∈ E → 1 ≤ DiamondIntegral.Section2.vfValue x) (fun hx => hpos i) right hx;
  have hENZ := fun x hx =>

      And.casesOn h fun left right => Eq.ndrec (motive := fun x => x ∈ E → x ≠ 0) (fun hx => hNZ i) right hx;

              Eq.casesOn (motive := fun a x => s' = a → e'_6 ≍ x → A.Definable L s ≍ A.Definable L s') e'_6
                (fun h =>
                  Eq.ndrec (motive := fun s' => ∀ (e_6 : s = s'), e_6 ≍ Eq.refl s → A.Definable L s ≍ A.Definable L s')

                (Eq.refl s') (HEq.refl e'_6))
            M S SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV inst (Fin 1) {z | z 0 ∈ Subtype.val '' ↑E}
            (⋃ i, {z | z 0 = ↑(a i)})

theorem DiamondIntegral.Section6.complementUndoShift_rv_constant : ∀ {M : Type}
  [inst : SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M]
  [inst_1 : M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {S : Set M} {n r s : ℕ}
  {A : SpecialTransformations.DefinableGeometry.DefSet (SpecialTransformations.Section4.rawMixedSpace (n + 1) r) S}
  {B : SpecialTransformations.DefinableGeometry.DefSet (SpecialTransformations.Section4.rawMixedSpace (n + 1) s) S}

  (∀ (i : Fin n), DiamondIntegral.Section6.RVCoordinateDisplacement f i.castSucc) →
    ∀ (p z : ↑B.carrier),
      (↑p).2 = (↑z).2 →
        (DiamondIntegral.Section6.complementUndoShift f hf).toFun p =
          (DiamondIntegral.Section6.complementUndoShift f hf).toFun z :=

  Subtype.ext
    (funext fun i =>
      Fin.lastCases
        (Eq.trans (DiamondIntegral.Section6.complementUndoShift_last f hf p)
          (Eq.symm (DiamondIntegral.Section6.complementUndoShift_last f hf z)))
        (fun j =>
          id
            (Eq.mpr
              (id
                (congrArg
                  (fun _a =>
                    _a =
                      DiamondIntegral.Section6.rvTranslationVector (DiamondIntegral.Section6.complementUndoShift f hf) z
                        j.castSucc)
                  (DiamondIntegral.Section6.complementUndoShift_castSucc f hf p j)))
              (Eq.mpr
                (id
                  (congrArg (fun _a => (↑((f.inverse hf).toFun p)).1 j.castSucc - (↑p).1 j.castSucc = _a)
                    (DiamondIntegral.Section6.complementUndoShift_castSucc f hf z j)))
                (have h :=
                  hD j ((f.inverse hf).toFun p) ((f.inverse hf).toFun z)
                    (Eq.mpr
                      (id
                        (congrArg (fun _a => (↑_a).2 = (↑(f.toFun ((f.inverse hf).toFun z))).2)
                          (SpecialTransformations.DefinableGeometry.Map.apply_inverse f hf p)))
                      (Eq.mpr
                        (id
                          (congrArg (fun _a => (↑p).2 = (↑_a).2)
                            (SpecialTransformations.DefinableGeometry.Map.apply_inverse f hf z)))
                        hTags));
                Eq.mp
                  (congr (congrArg Eq (neg_sub ((↑p).1 j.castSucc) ((↑((f.inverse hf).toFun p)).1 j.castSucc)))
                    (neg_sub ((↑z).1 j.castSucc) ((↑((f.inverse hf).toFun z)).1 j.castSucc)))
                  (congrArg (fun x => -x)
                    (Eq.mp
                      (congrArg
                        (fun _a =>
                          (↑p).1 j.castSucc - (↑((f.inverse hf).toFun p)).1 j.castSucc =
                            (↑_a).1 j.castSucc - (↑((f.inverse hf).toFun z)).1 j.castSucc)
                        (SpecialTransformations.DefinableGeometry.Map.apply_inverse f hf z))

  [inst : SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M]

    {S} {G} [LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero G] [Valued (DiamondIntegral.Section2.VF M) G] h00 hc linear {κ} hκ hs hv V
    hsmall hΓ hV hVS hSV hnt A hA hAD htag R N hN U hNonempty hTail P hPA hP hControl =>
  let C := DiamondIntegral.Section6.projectedActiveDomain A U;
  let f := R.meanMap h00 N hN C;
  have hFocusRV := DiamondIntegral.Section6.CoordinateRootFamily.meanMap_leadingTerm R h00 N hN U htag hNonempty;

    (DiamondIntegral.Section6.exists_protected_projected_focus_freezing h00 hc linear hκ hs hv V hsmall hΓ hV hVS hSV
      hnt A hA U f hTail hFocusRV P hP)
    fun F h =>
    And.casesOn h fun hCont right =>
      And.casesOn right fun hRV right =>
        And.casesOn right fun hProdA hProdP =>
          let R' := R.frozen F.balls F.centers 0 F.separated F.balls_definable F.centers_definable hProdA;
          have hN' :=
            DiamondIntegral.Section6.CoordinateRootFamily.frozen_bound R F.balls F.centers 0 F.separated
              F.balls_definable F.centers_definable hProdA N hN;
          have hControl' := fun i =>
            DiamondIntegral.Section6.CoordinateRootFamily.frozen_control R F.balls F.centers 0 F.separated

              hVS hSV hnt A hA hAD htag U (F.frozenMap f) hCont hRV P hPA hP)
            fun D h =>
            And.casesOn h fun hj right =>
              And.casesOn right fun hU right =>
                And.casesOn right fun hFocus hE =>
                  have hMean := fun p hp hu =>
                    Eq.mpr
                      (id
                        (congrArg
                          (fun _a => _a = SpecialTransformations.Section3.Barycentre.mean (R'.fibre (Fin.init p.1) p.2))

                            (Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => p.2 ∈ _a.carrier) hU)) hu))))
                      (Eq.mpr
                        (id

                            (fun _a =>
                              _a = SpecialTransformations.Section3.Barycentre.mean (R'.fibre (Fin.init p.1) p.2))

                        (Eq.mpr
                          (id
                            (congrArg
                              (fun _a =>
                                DiamondIntegral.Section6.totalFocusFibre (F.frozenMap f) p.2
                                    (Fin.init (Function.update p.1 _a 0)) 0 =
                                  SpecialTransformations.Section3.Barycentre.mean (R'.fibre (Fin.init p.1) p.2))
                              hj))
                          (Eq.mpr
                            (id

                                (fun _a =>
                                  DiamondIntegral.Section6.totalFocusFibre (F.frozenMap f) p.2 _a 0 =
                                    SpecialTransformations.Section3.Barycentre.mean (R'.fibre (Fin.init p.1) p.2))
                                (DiamondIntegral.Section6.init_update_last p.1 0)))
                            (let pC := ⟨(Fin.init p.1, p.2), Exists.intro ⟨p, ⟨hp, hu⟩⟩ rfl⟩;
                            have hAt :=
                              congrFun
                                (DiamondIntegral.Section6.totalFocusFibre_at (F.frozenMap f) p.2 (Fin.init p.1)
                                  pC.property)
                                0;
                            have hFrozen :=
                              DiamondIntegral.Section6.CoordinateRootFamily.frozen_meanMap_value R h00 N hN F hProdA pC;
                            Trans.trans (Trans.trans hAt (Eq.symm hFrozen))
                              (DiamondIntegral.Section6.CoordinateRootFamily.meanMap_value R' h00 N hN' C pC)))));
                  let E := fun i => (hE i).choose;
                  Exists.intro R'
                    (Exists.intro D
                      ⟨hN',

  [inst : SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M] [M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF]
  {r n m : ℕ}

    (Fin r → DiamondIntegral.Section2.RVInfinity M) →
      (Fin n → DiamondIntegral.Section2.VF M) → Fin m → DiamondIntegral.Section2.VF M),
  ((SpecialTransformations.Section4.rawMixedSpace n r).relation (SpecialTransformations.Section4.rawVFSpace m)
      fun x y => f x.2 x.1 = y) =
    (fun z => z ∘ DiamondIntegral.Section6.rvFamilyGraphIndex n r m) ⁻¹' DiamondIntegral.Section6.rvVFGraph f :=

    f =>
  let P := SpecialTransformations.Section4.rawMixedSpace n r;
  let Q := SpecialTransformations.Section4.rawVFSpace m;
  let e := Sum.elim (Sum.inl ∘ Sum.inr) (Sum.elim (Sum.inl ∘ Sum.inl) Sum.inr);

    Set.ext fun z =>
      {
        mp := fun a =>
          Exists.casesOn a fun hp h =>
            Exists.casesOn h fun hq hEq =>
              let x := P.decode ⟨z ∘ Sum.inl, hp⟩;

                  (have hX := SpecialTransformations.Section4.mixedValues_decode ⟨z ∘ Sum.inl, hp⟩;

                                  (Sum.elim (SpecialTransformations.Section4.vfValues x.1)
                                    (SpecialTransformations.Section4.vfValues _a)) =
                                (fun z => z ∘ e) z)
                            hEq))
                        (funext fun i =>
                          Sum.casesOn i (fun i => congrFun hX (Sum.inr i)) fun val =>
                            Sum.casesOn val (fun i => congrFun hX (Sum.inl i)) fun i => congrFun hY i))
                    hEq)),
        mpr := fun a =>
          Exists.casesOn a fun u h =>
            Exists.casesOn h fun x hCode =>
              have hX :=
                funext fun i =>
                  Sum.casesOn (motive := fun t =>
                    i = t → SpecialTransformations.Section4.mixedValues (x, u) i = (z ∘ Sum.inl) i) i
                    (fun i_1 h => Eq.symm h ▸ congrFun hCode (Sum.inr (Sum.inl i_1)))
                    (fun i_1 h => Eq.symm h ▸ congrFun hCode (Sum.inl i_1)) (Eq.refl i);
              have hY := funext fun i => congrFun hCode (Sum.inr (Sum.inr i));
              have hp := hX ▸ SpecialTransformations.Section4.mixedValues_mem_domain (x, u);
              have hq := Exists.intro (f u x) hY;
              have hx :=
                SpecialTransformations.Section4.mixedValues_injective
                  (Eq.trans (SpecialTransformations.Section4.mixedValues_decode ⟨z ∘ Sum.inl, hp⟩) (Eq.symm hX));
              have hy :=
                SpecialTransformations.Section4.vfValues_injective
                  (Eq.trans (SpecialTransformations.Section4.vfValues_decode ⟨z ∘ Sum.inr, hq⟩) (Eq.symm hY));
              Exists.intro hp
                (Exists.intro hq
                  (Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => (fun x y => f x.2 x.1 = y) _a (Q.decode ⟨z ∘ Sum.inr, hq⟩)) hx))
                    (Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => (fun x y => f x.2 x.1 = y) (x, u) _a) hy))
                      (Eq.refl (f (x, u).2 (x, u).1))))) };

                SpecialTransformations.Section4.vfValues_injective

  [inst : SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M]

  Function.update a j 0 = Function.update b j 0 →
    ContinuousAt (fun x => focus (Function.update x j 0)) a → ContinuousAt (fun x => focus (Function.update x j 0)) b :=

    {n} {G} [LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero G] [inst_3 : Valued (DiamondIntegral.Section2.VF M) G] j focus a b he ha =>
  let d := a j - b j;
  let T := DiamondIntegral.Section6.coordinateShear j fun x => d;
  have hT := DiamondIntegral.Section6.continuousAt_coordinateShear j (fun x => d) b continuousAt_const;
  have hTb :=
    funext fun i =>
      if hi : i = j then
        Eq.symm hi ▸
          Eq.mpr
            (id
              (congrFun'
                (congrArg Eq
                  (Eq.trans (congrFun (DiamondIntegral.Section6.coordinateShear.eq_1 j (fun x => a j - b j) b) j)
                    (Function.update_self j (b j + (a j - b j)) b)))
                (a j)))
            (DiamondIntegral.Section6.continuousAt_erasedFocus_transport._abel_1_1 j a b)
      else
        have hei :=
          Eq.mp
            (congr
              (congrArg Eq
                ((fun x_0 v f => (fun x_0 => Function.update_of_ne hi) x_0 v f) (fun a => DiamondIntegral.Section2.VF M)
                  0 a))
              ((fun x_0 v f => (fun x_0 => Function.update_of_ne hi) x_0 v f) (fun a => DiamondIntegral.Section2.VF M) 0
                b))
            (congrFun he i);
        Eq.trans (DiamondIntegral.Section6.coordinateShear_other j i hi (fun x => d) b) (Eq.symm hei);
  have ha' := Eq.symm hTb ▸ ha;
  have hcomp := ContinuousAt.comp ha' hT;
  Eq.mpr
    (eq_of_heq
      ((fun X Y inst inst_4 f f' e'_5 x =>
          Eq.casesOn (motive := fun a x_1 => f' = a → e'_5 ≍ x_1 → ContinuousAt f x ≍ ContinuousAt f' x) e'_5
            (fun h =>
              Eq.ndrec (motive := fun f' => ∀ (e_5 : f = f'), e_5 ≍ Eq.refl f → ContinuousAt f x ≍ ContinuousAt f' x)
                (fun e_5 h => HEq.refl (ContinuousAt f x)) (Eq.symm h) e'_5)

        inst_3.toTopologicalSpace (fun x => focus (Function.update x j 0))

        (funext fun x => congrArg focus (Eq.symm (DiamondIntegral.Section6.coordinateShear_erase j (fun x => d) x))) b))
    hcomp

  [inst : SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M] [M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF]
  {S : Set M} {p n m : ℕ} (T : DiamondIntegral.Section6.ContinuousVFGraphTemplate S p n m) (t : Fin p → M)
  (ht : t ∈ T.good), {z | Sum.elim t z ∈ T.graph} = SpecialTransformations.Section8.vfGraph (T.value t ht) :=
fun {M} [SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M] [M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {S}
    {p n m} T t ht =>
  Set.ext fun z =>
    {
      mp := fun hz =>
        have hSort := T.sorted (Sum.elim t z) hz;
        let x := fun i => ⟨z (Sum.inl i), hSort.left i⟩;
        have hEta :=
          funext fun i =>
            Sum.casesOn (motive := fun t => i = t → Sum.elim (z ∘ Sum.inl) (z ∘ Sum.inr) i = z i) i
              (fun val h => Eq.symm h ▸ Eq.refl (Sum.elim (z ∘ Sum.inl) (z ∘ Sum.inr) (Sum.inl val)))
              (fun val h => Eq.symm h ▸ Eq.refl (Sum.elim (z ∘ Sum.inl) (z ∘ Sum.inr) (Sum.inr val))) (Eq.refl i);
        have hOld := Eq.symm hEta ▸ hz;
        have hUnique :=
          ht.left.right (z ∘ Sum.inl) (z ∘ Sum.inr) (SpecialTransformations.Section4.vfValues (T.value t ht x)) hOld
            (DiamondIntegral.Section6.ContinuousVFGraphTemplate.value_mem T t ht x);
        Exists.intro x
          (funext fun i =>
            Sum.casesOn (motive := fun t_1 =>
              i = t_1 →
                (fun x =>
                      Sum.elim (SpecialTransformations.Section4.vfValues x)
                        (SpecialTransformations.Section4.vfValues (T.value t ht x)))
                    x i =
                  z i)
              i
              (fun i_1 h =>
                Eq.symm h ▸
                  Eq.refl
                    ((fun x =>
                        Sum.elim (SpecialTransformations.Section4.vfValues x)
                          (SpecialTransformations.Section4.vfValues (T.value t ht x)))
                      x (Sum.inl i_1)))
              (fun i_1 h => Eq.symm h ▸ Eq.symm (congrFun hUnique i_1)) (Eq.refl i)),
      mpr := fun a =>
        Exists.casesOn a fun x h => h ▸ DiamondIntegral.Section6.ContinuousVFGraphTemplate.value_mem T t ht x }

                Sum.elim x z →

theorem DiamondIntegral.Section6.exists_promoted_continuous_vf_graph_template : ∀ {M : Type}
  [inst : SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M]
  [inst_1 : M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {S : Set M} {p n m : ℕ} {G : Type}
  [inst_2 : LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero G] [inst_3 : Valued (DiamondIntegral.Section2.VF M) G],
  (∀ (x y : DiamondIntegral.Section2.VF M),
      SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.VFValued.predV x y ↔ Valued.v x ≤ Valued.v y) →

        Continuous f → ∃ T, a ∈ T.good ∧ {z | Sum.elim a z ∈ T.graph} = SpecialTransformations.Section8.vfGraph f :=
fun {M} [SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M] [M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {S}
    {p n m} {G} [LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero G] [Valued (DiamondIntegral.Section2.VF M) G] hv a f hf hCont =>

    (SpecialTransformations.ModelTheory.promote_definable_tuple_fibre SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV S a
      (SpecialTransformations.Section8.vfGraph f) hf)
    fun R h =>
    And.casesOn h fun hR hSection =>
      let H := {z | (z ∘ Sum.inl, z ∘ Sum.inr) ∈ R};
      let W :=
        H ∩
          {z |
            (∀ (i : Fin n), SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.iVF (z (Sum.inr (Sum.inl i)))) ∧
              ∀ (i : Fin m), SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.iVF (z (Sum.inr (Sum.inr i)))};
      have hW :=
        Set.Definable.inter hR
          (Set.Definable.inter
            (Set.Definable.preimage_comp (fun i => Sum.inr (Sum.inl i))
              (SpecialTransformations.Section8.vfRawUniverse_definable S n))
            (Set.Definable.preimage_comp (fun i => Sum.inr (Sum.inr i))
              (SpecialTransformations.Section8.vfRawUniverse_definable S m)));
      let T := { graph := W, definable := hW, sorted := fun x h => h.right };
      have hT :=
        Set.ext fun z =>
          have hAt := Set.ext_iff.mp hSection z;
          { mp := fun hz => hAt.mp hz.left,
            mpr := fun hz =>
              ⟨hAt.mpr hz,
                Exists.casesOn hz fun x h =>
                  Eq.ndrec (motive := fun z =>
                    ((a, z) ∈ R ↔ z ∈ SpecialTransformations.Section8.vfGraph f) →
                      Sum.elim a z ∈
                        {z |
                          (∀ (i : Fin n), SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.iVF (z (Sum.inr (Sum.inl i)))) ∧
                            ∀ (i : Fin m), SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.iVF (z (Sum.inr (Sum.inr i)))})
                    (fun hAt => ⟨fun i => (x i).property, fun i => (f x i).property⟩) h hAt⟩ };
      Exists.intro T ⟨DiamondIntegral.Section6.ContinuousVFGraphTemplate.good_of_graph hv T a f hT hCont, hT⟩

theorem DiamondIntegral.Section6.RelativeApertureData.coordinate_ne_zero : ∀ {M : Type}
  [inst : SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M]
  [inst_1 : M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {n r : ℕ} {S : Set M} {G : Type}
  [inst_2 : LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero G] [inst_3 : Valued (DiamondIntegral.Section2.VF M) G]
  {A : SpecialTransformations.DefinableGeometry.DefSet (SpecialTransformations.Section4.rawMixedSpace n r) S}
  (D : DiamondIntegral.Section6.RelativeApertureData A)
  (p : ↑(DiamondIntegral.Section6.focusActive A D.activeTags).carrier), (↑p).1 D.coordinate ≠ 0 :=
fun {M} [SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M] [M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {n r}
    {S} {G} [LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero G] [Valued (DiamondIntegral.Section2.VF M) G] {A} D p h0 =>
  have hrv := D.focusRV (↑p) p.property.left p.property.right;
  have hf :=
    (DiamondIntegral.Section2.rv_eq_zero_iff (D.focus (Function.update (↑p).1 D.coordinate 0) (↑p).2)).mp
      (Eq.mp
        (congrArg
          (fun _a => DiamondIntegral.Section2.rv M (D.focus (Function.update (↑p).1 D.coordinate 0) (↑p).2) = _a)
          DiamondIntegral.Section2.rv_zero)
        (Eq.mp
          (congrArg
            (fun _a =>
              DiamondIntegral.Section2.rv M (D.focus (Function.update (↑p).1 D.coordinate 0) (↑p).2) =
                DiamondIntegral.Section2.rv M _a)
            h0)
          hrv));
  have hle := D.endpoint_nonnegative p;
  have he0 := D.endpoint_nonzero p;
  have hlt := (DiamondIntegral.Section6.rv_eq_iff_value_close he0).mp rfl;
  not_le.mpr
    (Eq.mp
      (congrArg
        (fun _a =>
          DiamondIntegral.Section2.vfValue (D.endpoint (Function.update (↑p).1 D.coordinate 0) (↑p).2) <
            DiamondIntegral.Section2.vfValue _a)
        (sub_self (D.endpoint (Function.update (↑p).1 D.coordinate 0) (↑p).2)))
      hlt)
    (Eq.mp
      (congrArg
        (fun _a =>
          DiamondIntegral.Section2.vfValue _a ≤
            DiamondIntegral.Section2.vfValue (D.endpoint (Function.update (↑p).1 D.coordinate 0) (↑p).2))
        hf)
      hle)

                  (id
                    (congrArg (fun _a => DiamondIntegral.Section2.rv M _a = DiamondIntegral.Section2.rv M (p.1 k))

                  (Eq.refl (DiamondIntegral.Section2.rv M (p.1 k))))))
        (fun k =>
          of_eq_true
            (Eq.trans
              (congr
                (congrArg Eq (Fin.append_right (DiamondIntegral.Section2.tupleRV M (Function.update p.1 j d)) p.2 k))
                (Fin.append_right (DiamondIntegral.Section2.tupleRV M p.1) p.2 k))

theorem DiamondIntegral.Section6.coordinate_bundle_of_replacement : ∀ {M : Type}
  [inst : SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M]
  [inst_1 : M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {n r : ℕ} {S : Set M}
  (W : SpecialTransformations.DefinableGeometry.DefSet (SpecialTransformations.Section4.rawMixedSpace (n + 1) r) S)
  (k : Fin r),
  (∀ p ∈ W.carrier, DiamondIntegral.Section2.rv M (p.1 (Fin.last n)) = p.2 k) →
    (∀ p ∈ W.carrier,
        ∀ (d : DiamondIntegral.Section2.VF M),
          DiamondIntegral.Section2.rv M d = DiamondIntegral.Section2.rv M (p.1 (Fin.last n)) →
            (Function.update p.1 (Fin.last n) d, p.2) ∈ W.carrier) →
      W.carrier =
        (DiamondIntegral.Section6.rvCoordinateBundle (DiamondIntegral.Section6.vfDropLast W).image k).carrier :=
fun {M} [SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M] [M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {n r}
    {S} W k htag hreplace =>
  Set.ext fun q =>
    { mp := fun hq => ⟨Exists.intro ⟨q, hq⟩ rfl, htag q hq⟩,
      mpr := fun a =>
        And.casesOn a fun left hqtag =>
          Exists.casesOn left fun p hp =>
            have hinit := congrArg Prod.fst hp;
            have htags := congrArg (fun z => z.2) hp;
            have hrv :=
              Eq.mpr
                (id (congrArg (fun _a => DiamondIntegral.Section2.rv M (q.1 (Fin.last n)) = _a) (htag (↑p) p.property)))
                (Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => DiamondIntegral.Section2.rv M (q.1 (Fin.last n)) = _a k) htags))
                  (Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => _a = q.2 k) hqtag)) (Eq.refl (q.2 k))));
            have hmem := hreplace (↑p) p.property (q.1 (Fin.last n)) hrv;
            have he :=
              Prod.ext
                (funext fun i =>
                  Fin.lastCases
                    (of_eq_true
                      (Eq.trans
                        (congrFun' (congrArg Eq (Function.update_self (Fin.last n) (q.1 (Fin.last n)) (↑p).1))
                          (q.1 (Fin.last n)))
                        (eq_self (q.1 (Fin.last n)))))
                    (fun j =>
                      Eq.mpr
                        (id
                          (congrFun'
                            (congrArg Eq
                              ((fun x_0 v f => (fun x_0 => Function.update_of_ne (Fin.castSucc_ne_last j)) x_0 v f)
                                (fun a => SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Transfer.VFType) (q.1 (Fin.last n)) (↑p).1))
                            (q.1 j.castSucc)))
                        (congrFun hinit j))
                    i)
                htags;
            he ▸ hmem }

  [inst_1 : M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {S : Set M} {n r : ℕ} {G : Type}
  [inst_2 : LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero G] [inst_3 : Valued (DiamondIntegral.Section2.VF M) G]
  {A : SpecialTransformations.DefinableGeometry.DefSet (SpecialTransformations.Section4.rawMixedSpace (n + 1) r) S}
  (ω :
    SpecialTransformations.DefinableGeometry.Map A
      (SpecialTransformations.DefinableGeometry.DefSet.univ DiamondIntegral.Section6.rawGammaPresentation S))
  (e : Fin (n + 1) ≃ Fin (n + 1)),
  (∀ (u : (SpecialTransformations.Section4.rawRVSpace r).Carrier) (γ : DiamondIntegral.Section2.Gamma M),
      IsOpen {x | (x, u) ∈ A.carrier ∧ DiamondIntegral.Section6.gammaFormExtension ω (x, u) = γ}) →
    ∀ (u : (SpecialTransformations.Section4.rawRVSpace r).Carrier) (γ : DiamondIntegral.Section2.Gamma M),
      IsOpen
        {x |
          (x, u) ∈ (DiamondIntegral.Section6.reindexedVFSet A e).carrier ∧
            DiamondIntegral.Section6.gammaFormExtension (DiamondIntegral.Section6.reindexedGammaForm ω e) (x, u) = γ} :=
fun {M} [SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M] [M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {S}
    {n r} {G} [LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero G] [Valued (DiamondIntegral.Section2.VF M) G] {A} ω e hLevels u γ =>
  have he :=
    Set.ext fun x =>
      {
        mp := fun a =>
          And.casesOn a fun hx hγ =>
            have hOld := (DiamondIntegral.Section6.mem_reindexedVFSet A e (x, u)).mp hx;
            ⟨hOld,
              Eq.trans
                (DiamondIntegral.Section6.gammaFormExtension_at ω
                  ⟨DiamondIntegral.Section6.reindexVFPoint e.symm (x, u), hOld⟩)
                (Eq.mp
                  (congrArg (fun _a => _a = γ)
                    (DiamondIntegral.Section6.gammaFormExtension_at (DiamondIntegral.Section6.reindexedGammaForm ω e)
                      ⟨(x, u), hx⟩))
                  hγ)⟩,
        mpr := fun a =>
          And.casesOn a fun hx hγ =>
            have hNew := (DiamondIntegral.Section6.mem_reindexedVFSet A e (x, u)).mpr hx;
            ⟨hNew,
              Eq.mpr
                (id
                  (congrArg (fun _a => _a = γ)
                    (DiamondIntegral.Section6.gammaFormExtension_at (DiamondIntegral.Section6.reindexedGammaForm ω e)
                      ⟨(x, u), hNew⟩)))
                (Eq.trans
                  (Eq.symm (DiamondIntegral.Section6.gammaFormExtension_at ω ⟨((fun x => x ∘ ⇑e.symm) x, u), hx⟩))
                  hγ)⟩ };
  Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => IsOpen _a) he))
    (IsOpen.preimage (continuous_pi fun i => continuous_apply (e.symm i)) (hLevels u γ))

theorem DiamondIntegral.Section6.descended_gamma_level_fibre : ∀ {M : Type}
  [inst : SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M]
  [inst_1 : M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {n r : ℕ} {S : Set M}
  {A : SpecialTransformations.DefinableGeometry.DefSet (SpecialTransformations.Section4.rawMixedSpace (n + 1) r) S}
  (ω :
    SpecialTransformations.DefinableGeometry.Map A
      (SpecialTransformations.DefinableGeometry.DefSet.univ DiamondIntegral.Section6.rawGammaPresentation S))
  (η :
    SpecialTransformations.DefinableGeometry.Map (DiamondIntegral.Section6.vfDropLast A).image
      (SpecialTransformations.DefinableGeometry.DefSet.univ DiamondIntegral.Section6.rawGammaPresentation S)),
  (∀ (p : ↑A.carrier), η.toFun ((DiamondIntegral.Section6.vfDropLast A).toImage.toFun p) = ω.toFun p) →
    ∀ (u : Fin r → DiamondIntegral.Section2.RVInfinity M) (γ : DiamondIntegral.Section2.Gamma M),
      {b |
          (b, u) ∈ (DiamondIntegral.Section6.vfDropLast A).image.carrier ∧
            DiamondIntegral.Section6.gammaFormExtension η (b, u) = γ} =
        Fin.init '' {a | (a, u) ∈ A.carrier ∧ DiamondIntegral.Section6.gammaFormExtension ω (a, u) = γ} :=
fun {M} [SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M] [M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {n r}
    {S} {A} ω η hη u γ =>
  Set.ext fun b =>
    {
      mp := fun a =>
        And.casesOn a fun hb hγ =>
          Exists.casesOn hb fun p hp =>
            have hTags := congrArg (fun z => z.2) hp;
            have hInit := congrArg (fun z => z.1) hp;
            have hVal :=
              have hAt :=
                Eq.mpr
                  (id
                    (congrArg (fun _a => _a = DiamondIntegral.Section6.gammaFormExtension ω ↑p)
                      (DiamondIntegral.Section6.gammaFormExtension_at η
                        ((DiamondIntegral.Section6.vfDropLast A).toImage.toFun p))))
                  (Eq.mpr
                    (id
                      (congrArg (fun _a => ↑(η.toFun ((DiamondIntegral.Section6.vfDropLast A).toImage.toFun p)) = _a)
                        (DiamondIntegral.Section6.gammaFormExtension_at ω p)))
                    (congrArg Subtype.val (hη p)));
              have he := hp;
              Eq.mp
                (congrArg
                  (fun _a =>
                    DiamondIntegral.Section6.gammaFormExtension η _a = DiamondIntegral.Section6.gammaFormExtension ω ↑p)
                  he)
                hAt;
            Exists.intro (↑p).1
              ⟨⟨hTags ▸ p.property,
                  Eq.mpr
                    (id
                      (congrArg (fun _a => DiamondIntegral.Section6.gammaFormExtension ω ((↑p).1, _a) = γ)
                        (Eq.symm hTags)))
                    (Eq.trans (Eq.symm hVal) hγ)⟩,
                hInit⟩,
      mpr := fun a =>
        Exists.casesOn a fun a h =>
          And.casesOn h fun left right =>
            And.casesOn left fun ha hγ =>
              right ▸
                let p := ⟨(a, u), ha⟩;
                ⟨Exists.intro p rfl,
                  have hVal := congrArg Subtype.val (hη p);
                  have hAt :=
                    Eq.mpr
                      (id
                        (congrArg (fun _a => _a = DiamondIntegral.Section6.gammaFormExtension ω ↑p)
                          (DiamondIntegral.Section6.gammaFormExtension_at η
                            ((DiamondIntegral.Section6.vfDropLast A).toImage.toFun p))))
                      (Eq.mpr
                        (id
                          (congrArg
                            (fun _a => ↑(η.toFun ((DiamondIntegral.Section6.vfDropLast A).toImage.toFun p)) = _a)
                            (DiamondIntegral.Section6.gammaFormExtension_at ω p)))
                        hVal);
                  Eq.trans hAt hγ⟩ }

@DiamondIntegral.Section6.raw_unary_vf_parameter_iff : ∀ {M : Type}
  [inst : SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M] [M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF]
  (a : Fin 1 → M), a ∈ (SpecialTransformations.Section4.rawVFSpace 1).domain ↔ ∃ b, a = fun x => ↑b
theorem DiamondIntegral.Section6.raw_unary_vf_parameter_iff : ∀ {M : Type}
  [inst : SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M] [M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF]
  (a : Fin 1 → M), a ∈ (SpecialTransformations.Section4.rawVFSpace 1).domain ↔ ∃ b, a = fun x => ↑b :=
fun {M} [SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M] [M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] a =>
  {
    mp := fun a_1 =>
      Exists.casesOn a_1 fun v hv =>
        Exists.intro (v 0)
          (funext fun i =>
            List.Mem.casesOn (motive := fun a_2 x => List.finRange 1 = a_2 → Fintype.complete i ≍ x → a i = ↑(v 0))
              (Fintype.complete i)
              (fun as h =>
                List.cons.noConfusion h fun head_eq =>
                  Eq.ndrec (motive := fun i =>
                    ∀ (this : i ∈ Fintype.elems), [] ≍ as → this ≍ List.Mem.head as → a i = ↑(v 0))
                    (fun this tail_eq =>
                      Eq.ndrec (motive := fun as =>
                        this ≍ List.Mem.head as → a ((fun i => i) ⟨0, Nat.le_refl 1⟩) = ↑(v 0))

theorem DiamondIntegral.Section6.CoordinateRootFamily.remainingRoots_iff : ∀ {M : Type}
  [inst : SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M]
  [inst_1 : M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {n r : ℕ} {S : Set M} {G : Type}
  [inst_2 : LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero G] [inst_3 : Valued (DiamondIntegral.Section2.VF M) G]
  {A : SpecialTransformations.DefinableGeometry.DefSet (SpecialTransformations.Section4.rawMixedSpace (n + 1) r) S}
  (R : DiamondIntegral.Section6.CoordinateRootFamily A) (D : DiamondIntegral.Section6.CentripetalData A),
  M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF00 →
    ∀ (q : DiamondIntegral.Section2.Mixed M (n + 1) (n + 1 + (1 + r))),
      q ∈ (R.remainingRoots D).carrier ↔
        ∃ a, ↑a ∈ R.roots.carrier ∧ D.core ↑a = false ∧ DiamondIntegral.Section6.regularize (D.point ↑a) = q :=
fun {M} [SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M] [M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {n r}
    {S} {G} [LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero G] [Valued (DiamondIntegral.Section2.VF M) G] {A} R D h00 q =>
  {
    mp := fun a =>
      And.casesOn a fun left hflag =>
        Exists.casesOn left fun p hp =>
          let a := ⟨↑p, R.subset p.property⟩;
          have he := hp;
          have hh := congrArg (fun z => z.2 (Fin.natAdd (n + 1) (Fin.castAdd r 0))) he;
          Exists.intro a
            ⟨p.property,
              ⟨DiamondIntegral.Section6.branchTag_injective h00
                  (Eq.trans
                    (Eq.mp
                      (congrArg (fun _a => _a = q.2 (Fin.natAdd (n + 1) (Fin.castAdd r 0)))
                        (DiamondIntegral.Section6.CentripetalData.regularized_core_flag D ↑a))
                      hh)
                    hflag),
                he⟩⟩,
    mpr := fun a =>
      Exists.casesOn a fun a h =>
        And.casesOn h fun ha right =>
          And.casesOn right fun hCore he =>
            ⟨Exists.intro ⟨↑a, ha⟩ he,
              Eq.mpr
                (id
                  (congrArg
                    (fun _a => _a.2 (Fin.natAdd (n + 1) (Fin.castAdd r 0)) = DiamondIntegral.Section6.branchTag false)
                    (Eq.symm he)))
                (Eq.mpr
                  (id
                    (congrArg (fun _a => _a = DiamondIntegral.Section6.branchTag false)
                      (DiamondIntegral.Section6.CentripetalData.regularized_core_flag D ↑a)))
                  (Eq.mpr
                    (id
                      (congrArg
                        (fun _a => DiamondIntegral.Section6.branchTag _a = DiamondIntegral.Section6.branchTag false)
                        hCore))
                    (Eq.refl (DiamondIntegral.Section6.branchTag false))))⟩ }

fun {M} [SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M] [M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {n r}
    {S} {G} [LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero G] [Valued (DiamondIntegral.Section2.VF M) G] h00 {A P} {D} {E} h =>

    {

        Exists.casesOn ((DiamondIntegral.Section6.CentripetalData.mem_coreRegularizedImage E h00 q).mp hq) fun a h_1 =>
          And.casesOn h_1 fun ha right =>

              ⟨(DiamondIntegral.Section6.CentripetalData.mem_coreRegularizedImage D h00 q).mpr
                  (Exists.intro a
                    ⟨h.subset ha,
                      ⟨DiamondIntegral.Section6.ApertureRestrictionData.core h a ha ▸ hCore,
                        Eq.trans
                          (Eq.symm
                            (congrArg DiamondIntegral.Section6.regularize

@DiamondIntegral.Section6.finiteMean_sameRV : ∀ {M : Type} [inst : SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M]
  [inst_1 : M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {G : Type} [inst_2 : LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero G]
  [inst_3 : Valued (DiamondIntegral.Section2.VF M) G],

    (∀ (x y : DiamondIntegral.Section2.VF M),
        SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.VFValued.predV x y ↔ Valued.v x ≤ Valued.v y) →
      ∀ (F : Finset (DiamondIntegral.Section2.VF M)),
        F.Nonempty →
          ∀ (t : DiamondIntegral.Section2.RVInfinity M),
            (∀ x ∈ F, DiamondIntegral.Section2.rv M x = t) →
              DiamondIntegral.Section2.rv M (SpecialTransformations.Section3.Barycentre.mean F) = t
theorem DiamondIntegral.Section6.finiteMean_sameRV : ∀ {M : Type}
  [inst : SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M]
  [inst_1 : M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {G : Type} [inst_2 : LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero G]
  [inst_3 : Valued (DiamondIntegral.Section2.VF M) G],
  M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF00 →
    (∀ (x y : DiamondIntegral.Section2.VF M),
        SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.VFValued.predV x y ↔ Valued.v x ≤ Valued.v y) →
      ∀ (F : Finset (DiamondIntegral.Section2.VF M)),
        F.Nonempty →
          ∀ (t : DiamondIntegral.Section2.RVInfinity M),
            (∀ x ∈ F, DiamondIntegral.Section2.rv M x = t) →
              DiamondIntegral.Section2.rv M (SpecialTransformations.Section3.Barycentre.mean F) = t :=
fun {M} [SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M] [M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {G}
    [LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero G] [Valued (DiamondIntegral.Section2.VF M) G] h00 hv F hne t hR =>
  Exists.casesOn hne fun a ha =>
    if ha0 : a = 0 then
      have haZero := congrArg (DiamondIntegral.Section2.rv M) ha0;
      have hx0 := fun x hx =>
        (CanonicalRV.encodedRv_zero_iff x).mp
          (Eq.trans (congrArg Subtype.val (Eq.trans (hR x hx) (Eq.trans (Eq.symm (hR a ha)) haZero)))
            ((CanonicalRV.encodedRv_zero_iff 0).mpr rfl));
      have he :=
        Finset.ext fun x =>
          { mp := fun hx => Finset.mem_singleton.mpr (hx0 x hx),
            mpr := fun hx => Eq.symm (Eq.mp (congrArg (fun _a => _a) (propext Finset.mem_singleton)) hx) ▸ ha0 ▸ ha };
      have hm :=
        of_eq_true
          (Eq.trans
            (congrFun'
              (congrArg Eq
                (Eq.trans
                  (congr
                    (congrArg HDiv.hDiv
                      (Eq.trans (Finset.sum_congr he fun x a => Eq.refl x) (Finset.sum_singleton (fun x => x) 0)))
                    (Eq.trans (congrArg Nat.cast (Eq.trans (congrArg Finset.card he) (Finset.card_singleton 0)))
                      Nat.cast_one))
                  (div_one 0)))
              0)
            (eq_self 0));
      Eq.trans (congrArg (DiamondIntegral.Section2.rv M) (Eq.trans hm (Eq.symm ha0))) (hR a ha)
    else
      let ρ := SpecialTransformations.Section3.Balls.openRadius (Valued.v a) ((map_ne_zero Valued.v).mpr ha0);
      have hBall := SpecialTransformations.Section3.Balls.rvFibre_eq_openDisc Valued.v hv a ha0;
      have hAll := fun x hx =>
        Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => x ∈ _a) (Eq.symm hBall)))
          (congrArg Subtype.val (Eq.trans (hR x hx) (Eq.symm (hR a ha))));
      have hm :=
        SpecialTransformations.Section3.Barycentre.mean_mem_openDisc Valued.v hv h00 F (Exists.intro a ha) a ρ hAll;
      id
        (fun hm =>
          Eq.trans
            (have this := Subtype.ext hm;
            this)
            (hR a ha))
        (Eq.mp (congrArg (fun _a => SpecialTransformations.Section3.Barycentre.mean F ∈ _a) (Eq.symm hBall)) hm)
'DiamondIntegral.Section6.finiteMean_sameRV' depends on axioms: [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]

  [inst : SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M] [M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF]

                                    w (some 0) ∈ SpecialTransformations.Section3.OpenBallCodes.underlying ↑D ∧
                                      ↑(c D) = w none) ∨
                                  ¬_a ∧ w ∈ {w | w (some 0) = w none})
                            (propext (hAnyEq w))))
                        {
                          mp := fun hf =>
                            if hx : ∃ D, w (some 0) ∈ SpecialTransformations.Section3.OpenBallCodes.underlying ↑D then

                                Or.inl
                                  (Exists.intro D

                                        (Eq.symm
                                          (DiamondIntegral.Section6.FMT.familyFreeze_inside
                                            (fun i => SpecialTransformations.Section3.OpenBallCodes.underlying ↑i)
                                            (fun D => ↑(c D)) hsep D (w (some 0)) hD))
                                        hf⟩)
                            else
                              Or.inr
                                ⟨hx,
                                  Eq.trans
                                    (Eq.symm
                                      (DiamondIntegral.Section6.FMT.familyFreeze_outside
                                        (fun x => SpecialTransformations.Section3.OpenBallCodes.underlying ↑x)
                                        (fun D => ↑(c D)) (w (some 0)) (not_exists.mp hx)))
                                    hf⟩,
                          mpr := fun a =>
                            Or.casesOn a
                              (fun h =>
                                Exists.casesOn h fun D h =>
                                  And.casesOn h fun hD hc =>
                                    Eq.trans
                                      (DiamondIntegral.Section6.FMT.familyFreeze_inside

                                    (fun x => SpecialTransformations.Section3.OpenBallCodes.underlying ↑x)

                                  he }))))))))
      (Set.Definable.union hactive (Set.Definable.inter (Set.Definable.compl hany) heq)))

@DiamondIntegral.Section6.definable_finite_index_parameter_descent : ∀ {M : Type}
  [inst : SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M] [M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF]
  {S T : Set M} {ι : Type} [Finite ι] (C : Set (ι → M)),
  T.Definable SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV C →
    (∀ b ∈ T, S.Definable₁ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV {b}) →
      S.Definable SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV C
theorem DiamondIntegral.Section6.definable_finite_index_parameter_descent : ∀ {M : Type}
  [inst : SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M] [M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF]
  {S T : Set M} {ι : Type} [Finite ι] (C : Set (ι → M)),
  T.Definable SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV C →
    (∀ b ∈ T, S.Definable₁ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV {b}) →
      S.Definable SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV C :=
fun {M} [inst : SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M] [M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF]
    {S T} {ι} [Finite ι] C hC hParams =>
  let e := Fintype.equivFin ι;
  have hFin := Set.Definable.preimage_comp (⇑e) hC;
  have hS := SpecialTransformations.DefinableConstants.eliminate_parameters {x | x ∘ ⇑e ∈ C} hParams hFin;
  Eq.mpr
    (eq_of_heq
      ((fun M A L inst α s s' e'_6 =>
          Eq.casesOn (motive := fun a x => s' = a → e'_6 ≍ x → A.Definable L s ≍ A.Definable L s') e'_6
            (fun h =>
              Eq.ndrec (motive := fun s' => ∀ (e_6 : s = s'), e_6 ≍ Eq.refl s → A.Definable L s ≍ A.Definable L s')
                (fun e_6 h => HEq.refl (A.Definable L s)) (Eq.symm h) e'_6)
            (Eq.refl s') (HEq.refl e'_6))
        M S SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV inst ι C ((fun g => g ∘ ⇑e.symm) ⁻¹' {x | x ∘ ⇑e ∈ C})
        (Set.ext fun x =>
          id
            (of_eq_true
              (Eq.trans
                (congrArg (Iff (x ∈ C))
                  (congrArg (Membership.mem C) (congrArg (Function.comp x) (Equiv.symm_comp_self e))))
                (iff_self (x ∈ C)))))))
    (Set.Definable.preimage_comp (⇑e.symm) hS)
'DiamondIntegral.Section6.definable_finite_index_parameter_descent' depends on axioms: [propext,
 Classical.choice,
 Quot.sound]

@DiamondIntegral.Section6.DiamondCategory.VFObject.levelSet_geometry : ∀ {M : Type}
  [inst : SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M]
  [inst_1 : M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {S : Set M} {n : ℕ}

theorem DiamondIntegral.Section6.DiamondCategory.VFObject.levelSet_geometry : ∀ {M : Type}
  [inst : SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M]
  [inst_1 : M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {S : Set M} {n : ℕ}
  (A : DiamondIntegral.Section6.DiamondCategory.VFObject S n) (γ : DiamondIntegral.Section2.Gamma M),
  DiamondIntegral.Section6.ProperInvariantGeometry (A.levelSet γ) :=
fun {M} [SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M] [M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {S} {n}
    A γ =>
  have hsub := fun p hp => hp.1;
  { vfBounded := DiamondIntegral.Section6.VFBounded.mono A.proper.vfBounded hsub,
    rvBounded := DiamondIntegral.Section6.RVSupportDoublyBounded.mono A.proper.rvBounded hsub,
    fibers := fun t =>
      Exists.casesOn (A.proper.radii t) fun α h =>
        And.casesOn h fun left hα =>
          Exists.casesOn (A.formCovariant t) fun β h =>
            And.casesOn h fun left hβ =>
              Exists.intro (fun i => max (α i) (β i)) fun x y hxy =>
                have hxyα := fun i => lt_of_le_of_lt (le_max_left ↑(α i) ↑(β i)) (hxy i);
                have hxyβ := fun i => lt_of_le_of_lt (le_max_right ↑(α i) ↑(β i)) (hxy i);
                {
                  mp := fun a =>
                    Exists.casesOn a fun hx hγ =>
                      have hy := (hα x y hxyα).mp hx;
                      Exists.intro hy (Eq.trans (Eq.symm (hβ x y hx hy hxyβ)) hγ),
                  mpr := fun a =>
                    Exists.casesOn a fun hy hγ =>
                      have hx := (hα x y hxyα).mpr hy;
                      Exists.intro hx (Eq.trans (hβ x y hx hy hxyβ) hγ) } }

@DiamondIntegral.Section6.DiamondCategory.cycleRange_symm_eq_iff : ∀ {n : ℕ} (i x : Fin n),
  (Equiv.symm i.cycleRange) x = i ↔ ↑x = 0
theorem DiamondIntegral.Section6.DiamondCategory.cycleRange_symm_eq_iff : ∀ {n : ℕ} (i x : Fin n),
  (Equiv.symm i.cycleRange) x = i ↔ ↑x = 0 :=
fun {n} i x =>
  have this := NeZero.of_pos (Fin.pos i);
  {
    mp := fun h =>
      have h' := congrArg (⇑i.cycleRange) h;
      Eq.mpr
        (id
          (congrArg (fun _a => ↑_a = 0)
            (Eq.mp (congrArg (fun _a => x = _a) (Fin.cycleRange_self i))
              (Eq.mp (congrArg (fun _a => _a = i.cycleRange i) (Equiv.apply_symm_apply i.cycleRange x)) h'))))
        (Eq.refl ↑0),
    mpr := fun h =>
      Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => _a) (propext (Equiv.symm_apply_eq i.cycleRange))))
        (Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => x = _a) (Fin.cycleRange_self i))) (Fin.ext h)) }

@DiamondIntegral.Section6.DiamondCategory.cycleRange_ne_zero : ∀ {n : ℕ} {i k : Fin n}, k ≠ i → ↑(i.cycleRange k) ≠ 0
theorem DiamondIntegral.Section6.DiamondCategory.cycleRange_ne_zero : ∀ {n : ℕ} {i k : Fin n},
  k ≠ i → ↑(i.cycleRange k) ≠ 0 :=
fun {n} {i k} hk h =>
  hk
    (have h' := (DiamondIntegral.Section6.DiamondCategory.cycleRange_symm_eq_iff i (i.cycleRange k)).mpr h;
    Eq.mp (congrArg (fun _a => _a = i) (Equiv.symm_apply_apply i.cycleRange k)) h')

theorem DiamondIntegral.Section6.DiamondEmpty.properCovariant_of_empty : ∀ {M : Type}
  [inst : SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M]
  [inst_1 : M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {S : Set M} {n m r s : ℕ},
  CanonicalStructure.IsCanonical →
    ∀ {A : SpecialTransformations.DefinableGeometry.DefSet (SpecialTransformations.Section4.rawMixedSpace n r) S}
      {B : SpecialTransformations.DefinableGeometry.DefSet (SpecialTransformations.Section4.rawMixedSpace m s) S}
      (f : SpecialTransformations.DefinableGeometry.Map A B),
      A.carrier = ∅ → DiamondIntegral.Section6.ProperCovariant f :=
fun {M} [SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M] [M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {S}
    {n m r s} hc {A} {B} f hA =>
  have hE := { false := fun p => Eq.le hA p.property };
  { sourceVFBounded := Exists.intro 1 fun x hp => False.elim (Eq.le hA hp),
    imageVFBounded :=
      Exists.intro 1 fun x x_1 =>
        match (motive :=
          x ∈ DiamondIntegral.Section6.mixedMapRange f → ∀ (i : Fin m), ↑1 ≤ DiamondIntegral.Section2.vfValue (x.1 i))
          x_1 with
        | Exists.intro p h => isEmptyElim p,
    sourceRVBounded := Exists.intro 1 fun x hp => False.elim (Eq.le hA hp),
    imageRVBounded :=
      Exists.intro 1 fun x x_1 =>
        match (motive :=
          x ∈ DiamondIntegral.Section6.mixedMapRange f →
            ∀ (i : Fin s),
              ↑1⁻¹ ≤ SpecialTransformations.Section3.Values.vrv (x.2 i) ∧
                SpecialTransformations.Section3.Values.vrv (x.2 i) ≤ ↑1)
          x_1 with
        | Exists.intro p h => isEmptyElim p,
    radii := fun u v =>
      have named := fun {k} x =>
        Set.Definable.mono (DiamondIntegral.Section6.gamma_one_named hc) fun x hx => Or.inl (Or.inl hx);
      Exists.intro (fun x => 1)
        (Exists.intro (fun x => 1)
          ⟨named,
            ⟨named,
              ⟨fun x x_1 x_2 =>
                {
                  mp := fun x_3 =>
                    match x_3 with
                    | Exists.intro w (Exists.intro p h) => isEmptyElim p,
                  mpr := fun x_3 =>
                    match x_3 with
                    | Exists.intro w (Exists.intro p h) => isEmptyElim p },
                ⟨fun x x_1 x_2 =>
                  {
                    mp := fun x_3 =>
                      match x_3 with
                      | Exists.intro w (Exists.intro p h) => isEmptyElim p,
                    mpr := fun x_3 =>
                      match x_3 with
                      | Exists.intro w (Exists.intro p h) => isEmptyElim p },
                  fun x x_1 =>
                  match (motive :=
                    x ∈ DiamondIntegral.Section6.graphFibreSource f u v →
                      ∀ b ∈ DiamondIntegral.Section6.graphFibreSource f u v,
                        (DiamondIntegral.Section6.ballSetoid fun x => 1) x b →
                          (DiamondIntegral.Section6.ballSetoid fun x => 1)
                            (DiamondIntegral.Section6.graphFibreMap f u v x)
                            (DiamondIntegral.Section6.graphFibreMap f u v b))
                    x_1 with
                  | Exists.intro w (Exists.intro p h) => isEmptyElim p⟩⟩⟩⟩) }

    U x =>
  if h : {t | (x, t) ∈ (SpecialTransformations.Section4.rvLift U.object).carrier}.Nonempty then
    Exists.casesOn h fun t0 h =>
      Exists.casesOn h fun u0 h =>
        And.casesOn h fun left hv0 =>
          Set.Finite.subset (Set.Finite.image Subtype.val (U.finiteVolume (U.object.volume.toFun u0))) fun ⦃t⦄ a =>
            Exists.casesOn a fun u h =>
              And.casesOn h fun hu hv => Exists.intro u ⟨Subtype.ext (Eq.trans hv (Eq.symm hv0)), hu⟩

theorem DiamondIntegral.Section6.DiamondLiftHomomorphism.homeo_zero : ∀ {M : Type}
  [inst : SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M]
  [inst_1 : M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {S : Set M} {G : Type}
  [inst_2 : LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero G] [inst_3 : Valued (DiamondIntegral.Section2.VF M) G] {r s : ℕ}
  {A : SpecialTransformations.DefinableGeometry.DefSet (SpecialTransformations.Section4.rawMixedSpace 0 r) S}
  {B : SpecialTransformations.DefinableGeometry.DefSet (SpecialTransformations.Section4.rawMixedSpace 0 s) S}
  (f : SpecialTransformations.DefinableGeometry.Map A B),
  Function.Bijective f.toFun →
    DiamondIntegral.Section6.RVSupportDoublyBounded A.carrier →
      DiamondIntegral.Section6.RVSupportDoublyBounded B.carrier →
        DiamondIntegral.Section6.ProperCovariantHomeomorphism f :=
fun {M} [SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M] [M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {S} {G}
    [LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero G] [Valued (DiamondIntegral.Section2.VF M) G] {r s} {A} {B} f hf hA hB =>
  have cov := fun {r s} {A} {B} g hA hB =>
    { sourceVFBounded := Exists.intro 1 fun x x_1 i => Fin.elim0 i,
      imageVFBounded := Exists.intro 1 fun x x_1 i => Fin.elim0 i, sourceRVBounded := hA,
      imageRVBounded :=
        DiamondIntegral.Section6.RVSupportDoublyBounded.mono hB fun x x_1 =>
          match x_1 with
          | Exists.intro p hp => hp ▸ (g.toFun p).property,
      radii := fun u v =>
        Exists.intro (fun i => i.elim0)
          (Exists.intro (fun i => i.elim0)
            ⟨fun i => Fin.elim0 i,
              ⟨fun i => Fin.elim0 i,
                ⟨fun a b x =>
                  Eq.mpr
                    (id
                      (congrArg
                        (fun _a =>
                          _a ∈ DiamondIntegral.Section6.graphFibreSource g u v ↔
                            b ∈ DiamondIntegral.Section6.graphFibreSource g u v)
                        (Subsingleton.elim a b)))
                    Iff.rfl,
                  ⟨fun a b x =>
                    Eq.mpr
                      (id
                        (congrArg
                          (fun _a =>
                            _a ∈ DiamondIntegral.Section6.graphFibreRange g u v ↔
                              b ∈ DiamondIntegral.Section6.graphFibreRange g u v)
                          (Subsingleton.elim a b)))
                      Iff.rfl,
                    fun x x_1 x_2 x_3 x_4 i => Fin.elim0 i⟩⟩⟩⟩) };
  have cont := fun {r s} {A} {B} g u v =>
    Set.Subsingleton.continuousOn Set.subsingleton_of_subsingleton (DiamondIntegral.Section6.graphFibreMap g u v);
  { bijective := hf, covariant := cov f hA hB, continuous := cont f, inverseCovariant := cov (f.inverse hf) hB hA,
    inverseContinuous := cont (f.inverse hf) }

@DiamondIntegral.Section6.DiamondProduct.product_proper : ∀ {M : Type}
  [inst : SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M]
  [inst_1 : M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {S : Set M} {n m r s : ℕ}
  (A : SpecialTransformations.DefinableGeometry.DefSet (SpecialTransformations.Section4.rawMixedSpace n r) S)
  (B : SpecialTransformations.DefinableGeometry.DefSet (SpecialTransformations.Section4.rawMixedSpace m s) S),
  DiamondIntegral.Section6.ProperInvariant S A.carrier →
    DiamondIntegral.Section6.ProperInvariant S B.carrier →
      DiamondIntegral.Section6.ProperInvariant S (SpecialTransformations.Section4.mixedProductDomain A B).carrier
theorem DiamondIntegral.Section6.DiamondProduct.product_proper : ∀ {M : Type}
  [inst : SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M]
  [inst_1 : M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {S : Set M} {n m r s : ℕ}
  (A : SpecialTransformations.DefinableGeometry.DefSet (SpecialTransformations.Section4.rawMixedSpace n r) S)
  (B : SpecialTransformations.DefinableGeometry.DefSet (SpecialTransformations.Section4.rawMixedSpace m s) S),
  DiamondIntegral.Section6.ProperInvariant S A.carrier →
    DiamondIntegral.Section6.ProperInvariant S B.carrier →
      DiamondIntegral.Section6.ProperInvariant S (SpecialTransformations.Section4.mixedProductDomain A B).carrier :=
fun {M} [SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M] [M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {S}
    {n m r s} A B hA hB =>
  Exists.casesOn hA.vfBounded fun γa hγa =>
    Exists.casesOn hB.vfBounded fun γb hγb =>
      Exists.casesOn hA.rvBounded fun δa hδa =>
        Exists.casesOn hB.rvBounded fun δb hδb =>
          { definable := (SpecialTransformations.Section4.mixedProductDomain A B).definable,
            vfBounded :=
              Exists.intro (min γa γb) fun p hp i =>
                have h := (SpecialTransformations.Section4.mem_mixedProductDomain A B p).mp hp;
                Fin.addCases
                  (fun j =>
                    le_trans
                      (have this := min_le_left γa γb;
                      this)
                      (hγa (p.1 ∘ Fin.castAdd m, p.2 ∘ Fin.castAdd s) h.left j))
                  (fun j =>
                    le_trans
                      (have this := min_le_right γa γb;
                      this)
                      (hγb (p.1 ∘ Fin.natAdd n, p.2 ∘ Fin.natAdd r) h.right j))
                  i,
            rvBounded :=
              Exists.intro (max δa δb) fun p hp i =>
                have h := (SpecialTransformations.Section4.mem_mixedProductDomain A B p).mp hp;
                Fin.addCases
                  (fun j =>
                    have hj := hδa (p.1 ∘ Fin.castAdd m, p.2 ∘ Fin.castAdd s) h.left j;
                    ⟨le_trans
                        (have this := inv_le_inv_iff.mpr (le_max_left δa δb);
                        this)
                        hj.left,
                      le_trans hj.right
                        (have this := le_max_left δa δb;
                        this)⟩)
                  (fun j =>
                    have hj := hδb (p.1 ∘ Fin.natAdd n, p.2 ∘ Fin.natAdd r) h.right j;
                    ⟨le_trans
                        (have this := inv_le_inv_iff.mpr (le_max_right δa δb);
                        this)
                        hj.left,
                      le_trans hj.right
                        (have this := le_max_right δa δb;
                        this)⟩)
                  i,
            radii := fun t =>
              Exists.casesOn (hA.radii (t ∘ Fin.castAdd s)) fun α h =>
                And.casesOn h fun hαn hα =>
                  Exists.casesOn (hB.radii (t ∘ Fin.natAdd r)) fun β h =>
                    And.casesOn h fun hβn hβ =>
                      Exists.intro (Fin.append α β)
                        ⟨DiamondIntegral.Section6.DiamondProduct.namedRadii_append hαn hβn, fun x y hxy =>
                          have hxy' := hxy;
                          id
                            (Eq.mpr
                              (id
                                (congrArg
                                  (fun _a =>
                                    _a ↔ (y, t) ∈ (SpecialTransformations.Section4.mixedProductDomain A B).carrier)
                                  (propext (SpecialTransformations.Section4.mem_mixedProductDomain A B (x, t)))))
                              (Eq.mpr
                                (id
                                  (congrArg
                                    (fun _a =>
                                      ((x, t).1 ∘ Fin.castAdd m, (x, t).2 ∘ Fin.castAdd s) ∈ A.carrier ∧
                                          ((x, t).1 ∘ Fin.natAdd n, (x, t).2 ∘ Fin.natAdd r) ∈ B.carrier ↔
                                        _a)
                                    (propext (SpecialTransformations.Section4.mem_mixedProductDomain A B (y, t)))))
                                (and_congr
                                  (hα ((x, t).1 ∘ Fin.castAdd m) ((y, t).1 ∘ Fin.castAdd m)
                                    (DiamondIntegral.Section6.DiamondProduct.congruent_left hxy'))
                                  (hβ ((x, t).1 ∘ Fin.natAdd n) ((y, t).1 ∘ Fin.natAdd n)
                                    (DiamondIntegral.Section6.DiamondProduct.congruent_right hxy')))))⟩ }

  [inst : SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M]

  [inst : SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M]
  [inst_1 : M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {S : Set M} {n m : ℕ}
  (hc : CanonicalStructure.IsCanonical) (A : DiamondIntegral.Section6.DiamondCategory.VFObject S n)

  (t : Fin (A.labels + B.labels) → DiamondIntegral.Section2.RVInfinity M),

    DiamondIntegral.Section6.NamedRadii S t α ∧
      ∀ (x y : (SpecialTransformations.Section4.rawVFSpace (n + m)).Carrier)

        (hy : (y, t) ∈ (SpecialTransformations.Section4.mixedProductDomain A.carrier B.carrier).carrier),

          DiamondIntegral.Section6.gammaMapValue (DiamondIntegral.Section6.DiamondProduct.productForm hc A B)
              ⟨(x, t), hx⟩ =
            DiamondIntegral.Section6.gammaMapValue (DiamondIntegral.Section6.DiamondProduct.productForm hc A B)
              ⟨(y, t), hy⟩ :=

    {n m} hc A B t =>

    And.casesOn h fun hαn hα =>
      Exists.casesOn (B.formCovariant (t ∘ Fin.natAdd A.labels)) fun β h =>
        And.casesOn h fun hβn hβ =>
          Exists.intro (Fin.append α β)
            ⟨DiamondIntegral.Section6.DiamondProduct.namedRadii_append hαn hβn, fun x y hx hy hxy =>
              Eq.mpr

                    (fun _a =>
                      _a =

                          (DiamondIntegral.Section6.DiamondProduct.productForm hc A B) ⟨(y, t), hy⟩)
                    (DiamondIntegral.Section6.DiamondProduct.productForm_value hc A B x t hx)))
                (Eq.mpr
                  (id
                    (congrArg
                      (fun _a =>
                        DiamondIntegral.Section6.gammaMapValue A.form
                              ⟨(x ∘ Fin.castAdd m, t ∘ Fin.castAdd B.labels),
                                ((SpecialTransformations.Section4.mem_mixedProductDomain A.carrier B.carrier (x, t)).mp
                                    hx).left⟩ *
                            DiamondIntegral.Section6.gammaMapValue B.form
                              ⟨(x ∘ Fin.natAdd n, t ∘ Fin.natAdd A.labels),
                                ((SpecialTransformations.Section4.mem_mixedProductDomain A.carrier B.carrier (x, t)).mp
                                    hx).right⟩ =
                          _a)
                      (DiamondIntegral.Section6.DiamondProduct.productForm_value hc A B y t hy)))
                  (Eq.mpr
                    (id
                      (congrArg
                        (fun _a =>
                          _a *
                              DiamondIntegral.Section6.gammaMapValue B.form
                                ⟨(x ∘ Fin.natAdd n, t ∘ Fin.natAdd A.labels),
                                  ((SpecialTransformations.Section4.mem_mixedProductDomain A.carrier B.carrier
                                          (x, t)).mp
                                      hx).right⟩ =
                            DiamondIntegral.Section6.gammaMapValue A.form
                                ⟨(y ∘ Fin.castAdd m, t ∘ Fin.castAdd B.labels),
                                  ((SpecialTransformations.Section4.mem_mixedProductDomain A.carrier B.carrier

    (fun {r} A hA => DiamondIntegral.Section6.DiamondCategory.UnaryFactorization.id A)
    (fun {r} A hA hVF =>
      DiamondIntegral.Section6.DiamondCategory.UnaryFactorization.step
        (DiamondIntegral.Section6.regularization_properHomeomorphism h00 hc linear hκ hs hv hsmall hΓ A hA hVF)
