          Or.inr
            (Exists.intro ⟨0, hn⟩
              (Exists.intro ⟨0, hn⟩
                (DiamondIntegral.Section6.DiamondCategory.VFUnaryRelativeAt.relativelyUnary fun x x_1 x_2 => rfl)))))
    (fun {r} A D =>
      DiamondIntegral.Section6.DiamondCategory.UnaryFactorization.step
        (DiamondIntegral.Section6.CentripetalData.properHomeomorphism D h00 hc linear hκ hs hv hsmall hΓ)

            (Exists.intro D.coordinate

      have hu :=

fun {M} [SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M] [M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {S} {n}
    {G} [LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero G] [Valued (DiamondIntegral.Section2.VF M) G] h00 hc linear {κ} hκ hs hv hsmall
    hΓ A {ω} hω L hP =>
  have this := DiamondIntegral.Section6.vf_charZero_of_model00 h00;
  have hform := fun p =>
    have hlabel := Subtype.ext (Eq.symm (L.label_eq p));
    Eq.mpr
      (id
        (congrArg (fun _a => _a = DiamondIntegral.Section6.gammaMapValue A.form p)
          (DiamondIntegral.Section6.DiamondLift.liftForm_value
            (DiamondIntegral.Section6.DiamondSurjectivity.liftDataObject L) (L.map.toFun p))))
      (Eq.mpr
        (id
          (congrArg
            (fun _a =>
              DiamondIntegral.Section6.gammaMapValue
                  (DiamondIntegral.Section6.DiamondSurjectivity.liftDataObject L).form _a =
                DiamondIntegral.Section6.gammaMapValue A.form p)
            hlabel))
        (Eq.trans (L.form_preserves p) (hω p)));
  Exists.casesOn
    (DiamondIntegral.Section6.DiamondSurjectivity.special_objects h00 hc linear hκ hs hv hsmall hΓ L.special
      (DiamondIntegral.Section6.DiamondTransport.ofObject A))
    fun Y h =>
    And.casesOn h fun hXY hY =>
      let Z :=
        DiamondIntegral.Section6.DiamondTransport.ofObject
          (DiamondIntegral.Section6.DiamondLift.liftObject
            (DiamondIntegral.Section6.DiamondSurjectivity.liftDataObject L) hP);
      have hYZ := fun q =>
        Exists.casesOn
          (Function.Bijective.surjective (DiamondIntegral.Section6.SpecialCovariantChain.bijective L.special h00) q)
          fun p h => h ▸ Eq.trans (hY p) (Eq.symm (hform p));
      have hchain :=
        have h :=
          DiamondIntegral.Section6.DiamondCategory.ObjectFactorization.comp hXY
            (DiamondIntegral.Section6.DiamondCategory.ObjectFactorization.step
              (DiamondIntegral.Section6.DiamondTransport.id_step h00 hc linear hκ hs hv hsmall hΓ Y Z hYZ));
        have e := DiamondIntegral.Section6.DiamondTransport.id_comp_map L.map;
        e ▸ h;
      DiamondIntegral.Section6.DiamondGroupoid.morphism_of_generic h00 hc hs hsmall L.map
        (DiamondIntegral.Section6.SpecialCovariantChain.bijective L.special h00) hchain fun p hp =>
        Exists.casesOn
          (DiamondIntegral.Section6.SpecialCovariantChain.unit_derivative_of_independent L.special h00 hc (LT.lt.le hκ)
            hs hsmall hv p hp)
          fun D h =>
          And.casesOn h fun hD hdet =>
            Exists.intro D
              ⟨hD,
                Eq.mpr
                  (id
                    (congrArg

theorem DiamondIntegral.Section6.rvGammaJacobian_congr_values : ∀ {M : Type}
  [inst : SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M]
  [inst_1 : M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {n : ℕ}
  {a b c d : Fin n → DiamondIntegral.Section2.RVInfinity M}
  {ha : ∀ (i : Fin n), ↑(a i) ≠ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.iRVZero}
  {hb : ∀ (i : Fin n), ↑(b i) ≠ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.iRVZero}
  {hc : ∀ (i : Fin n), ↑(c i) ≠ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.iRVZero}
  {hd : ∀ (i : Fin n), ↑(d i) ≠ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.iRVZero},
  a = c →
    b = d →
      SpecialTransformations.Section9.rvGammaJacobian a b ha hb =
        SpecialTransformations.Section9.rvGammaJacobian c d hc hd :=
fun {M} [SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M] [M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {n}
    {a b c d} {ha} {hb} {hc} {hd} hA hB =>
  Eq.casesOn (motive := fun a_1 t =>
    c = a_1 →
      hA ≍ t →
        SpecialTransformations.Section9.rvGammaJacobian a b ha hb =
          SpecialTransformations.Section9.rvGammaJacobian c d hc hd)
    hA
    (fun h =>
      Eq.ndrec (motive := fun {c} =>
        ∀ {hc : ∀ (i : Fin n), ↑(c i) ≠ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.iRVZero} (hA : a = c),
          hA ≍ Eq.refl a →
            SpecialTransformations.Section9.rvGammaJacobian a b ha hb =
              SpecialTransformations.Section9.rvGammaJacobian c d hc hd)
        (fun {hc} hA h =>
          Eq.casesOn (motive := fun a_1 t =>
            d = a_1 →
              hB ≍ t →
                SpecialTransformations.Section9.rvGammaJacobian a b ha hb =
                  SpecialTransformations.Section9.rvGammaJacobian a d hc hd)
            hB
            (fun h =>
              Eq.ndrec (motive := fun {d} =>
                ∀ {hd : ∀ (i : Fin n), ↑(d i) ≠ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.iRVZero} (hB : b = d),
                  hB ≍ Eq.refl b →
                    SpecialTransformations.Section9.rvGammaJacobian a b ha hb =
                      SpecialTransformations.Section9.rvGammaJacobian a d hc hd)
                (fun {hd} hB h => Eq.refl (SpecialTransformations.Section9.rvGammaJacobian a b ha hb)) (Eq.symm h) hB)
            (Eq.refl d) (HEq.refl hB))
        (Eq.symm h) hA)
    (Eq.refl c) (HEq.refl hA)

theorem DiamondIntegral.Section6.ApertureSpecializationTest.integer_aperture_test : ∀ (N : ℕ),
  DiamondIntegral.Section6.ApertureSpecializationTest.annularFactor 1 (-1) (2 * N) = 0 :=
fun N =>
  of_eq_true
    (Eq.trans
      (congrFun'
        (congrArg Eq
          (Eq.trans
            (congrFun'
              (congrArg HSub.hSub
                (Eq.trans
                  (congr
                    (congrArg HAdd.hAdd
                      (Eq.trans
                        (congrFun' (congrArg HMul.hMul (sub_self 1)) (∑ i ∈ Finset.range (2 * N), (-1) ^ (i + 1)))
                        (zero_mul (∑ i ∈ Finset.range (2 * N), (-1) ^ (i + 1)))))
                    (Eq.trans (pow_mul (-1) 2 N)
                      (Eq.trans
                        (congrFun'
                          (congrArg HPow.hPow (Eq.trans (Even.neg_pow (of_eq_true even_two._simp_1) 1) (one_pow 2))) N)
                        (one_pow N))))
                  (zero_add 1)))
              1)
            (sub_self 1)))
        0)
      (eq_self 0))

@DiamondIntegral.Section6.finite_curve_excisions : ∀ {X : Type u_1} {Y : Type u_2} (P : Set X) (Q : Set Y)
  (F E : Finset X) (G D : Finset Y),
  Disjoint P ↑E →
    Disjoint Q ↑D →
      ∀ (f : X → Y),
        Set.BijOn f (P \ ↑F ∪ ↑E) (Q \ ↑G ∪ ↑D) →
          ∃ C L,
            ↑C ⊆ P \ ↑F ∧ ↑L ⊆ Q \ ↑G ∧ Set.BijOn f (P \ ↑(F ∪ C)) (Q \ ↑(G ∪ L)) ∧ E.card + C.card = D.card + L.card
theorem DiamondIntegral.Section6.finite_curve_excisions.{u_1, u_2} : ∀ {X : Type u_1} {Y : Type u_2} (P : Set X)
  (Q : Set Y) (F E : Finset X) (G D : Finset Y),
  Disjoint P ↑E →
    Disjoint Q ↑D →
      ∀ (f : X → Y),
        Set.BijOn f (P \ ↑F ∪ ↑E) (Q \ ↑G ∪ ↑D) →
          ∃ C L,
            ↑C ⊆ P \ ↑F ∧ ↑L ⊆ Q \ ↑G ∧ Set.BijOn f (P \ ↑(F ∪ C)) (Q \ ↑(G ∪ L)) ∧ E.card + C.card = D.card + L.card :=
fun {X} {Y} P Q F E G D hE hD f hf =>
  let C := {x | x ∈ P \ ↑F ∧ f x ∈ D};
  let L := f '' ↑E ∩ (Q \ ↑G);
  have hCF :=
    Set.Finite.of_injOn (fun x hx => hx.right) (fun x hx y hy he => hf.right.left (Or.inl hx.left) (Or.inl hy.left) he)
      (Finset.finite_toSet D);
  have hLF := Set.Finite.subset (Set.Finite.image f (Finset.finite_toSet E)) Set.inter_subset_left;
  have hCSub := fun x hx => hx.left;
  have hLSub := Set.inter_subset_right;
  have hEC := Set.disjoint_left.mpr fun x hxE hxC => Set.disjoint_left.mp hE hxC.left.left hxE;
  have hDL := Set.disjoint_left.mpr fun y hyD hyL => Set.disjoint_left.mp hD hyL.right.left hyD;
  have hCore :=
    ⟨fun ⦃x⦄ hx =>
      have hxP := ⟨hx.left, fun h => hx.right (Or.inl h)⟩;
      have hxC := fun h => hx.right (Or.inr h);
      have hfy := Or.casesOn (hf.left (Or.inl hxP)) (fun h => h) fun h => False.elim (hxC ⟨hxP, h⟩);
      ⟨hfy.left, fun h =>
        Or.casesOn h (fun h => hfy.right h) fun h =>
          Exists.casesOn h.left fun e h =>
            And.casesOn h fun heE he =>
              have hex := hf.right.left (Or.inr heE) (Or.inl hxP) he;
              Set.disjoint_left.mp hE hx.left (hex ▸ heE)⟩,
      ⟨fun ⦃x⦄ hx ⦃y⦄ hy he =>
        hf.right.left (Or.inl ⟨hx.left, fun h => hx.right (Or.inl h)⟩) (Or.inl ⟨hy.left, fun h => hy.right (Or.inl h)⟩)
          he,
        fun ⦃y⦄ hy =>
        have hyQ := ⟨hy.left, fun h => hy.right (Or.inl h)⟩;
        Exists.casesOn (hf.right.right (Or.inl hyQ)) fun x h =>
          And.casesOn h fun hx hfx =>
            have hxP :=
              Or.casesOn hx (fun h => h) fun h => False.elim (hy.right (Or.inr ⟨Exists.intro x ⟨h, hfx⟩, hyQ⟩));
            Exists.intro x
              ⟨⟨hxP.left, fun a =>
                  Or.casesOn a (fun hF => hxP.right hF) fun hC => Set.disjoint_left.mp hD hy.left (hfx ▸ hC.right)⟩,
                hfx⟩⟩⟩;
  have hPatch :=
    ⟨fun ⦃x⦄ hx =>
      Or.casesOn hx
        (fun h => Or.casesOn (hf.left (Or.inr h)) (fun hy => Or.inr ⟨Exists.intro x ⟨h, rfl⟩, hy⟩) fun hy => Or.inl hy)
        fun h => Or.inl h.right,
      ⟨fun ⦃x⦄ hx ⦃y⦄ hy he =>
        hf.right.left (Or.elim hx Or.inr fun h => Or.inl h.left) (Or.elim hy Or.inr fun h => Or.inl h.left) he,
        fun ⦃y⦄ hy =>
        Or.casesOn hy
          (fun h =>
            Exists.casesOn (hf.right.right (Or.inr h)) fun x h_1 =>
              And.casesOn h_1 fun hx hfx =>
                Exists.intro x ⟨Or.casesOn hx (fun hx => Or.inr ⟨hx, Eq.symm hfx ▸ h⟩) fun hx => Or.inl hx, hfx⟩)
          fun h => Exists.casesOn h.left fun x h => And.casesOn h fun hx hfx => Exists.intro x ⟨Or.inl hx, hfx⟩⟩⟩;
  Exists.intro hCF.toFinset
    (Exists.intro hLF.toFinset
      ⟨Eq.mpr (id (congrFun' (congrArg LE.le (Set.Finite.coe_toFinset hCF)) (P \ ↑F))) hCSub,
        ⟨Eq.mpr (id (congrFun' (congrArg LE.le (Set.Finite.coe_toFinset hLF)) (Q \ ↑G))) hLSub,
          ⟨Eq.mpr
              (id
                (congr
                  (congrArg (Set.BijOn f)
                    (congrArg (sdiff P)
                      (Eq.trans (Finset.coe_union F hCF.toFinset)
                        (congrArg (Union.union ↑F) (Set.Finite.coe_toFinset hCF)))))
                  (congrArg (sdiff Q)
                    (Eq.trans (Finset.coe_union G hLF.toFinset)
                      (congrArg (Union.union ↑G) (Set.Finite.coe_toFinset hLF))))))
              hCore,
            have hCard := Set.BijOn.ncard_eq hPatch;
            Eq.mp (congrArg (fun _a => E.card + hCF.toFinset.card = D.card + _a) (Set.ncard_eq_toFinset_card L hLF))
              (Eq.mp (congrArg (fun _a => E.card + _a = D.card + L.ncard) (Set.ncard_eq_toFinset_card C hCF))
                (Eq.mp (congrArg (fun _a => E.card + C.ncard = _a + L.ncard) (Set.ncard_coe_finset D))
                  (Eq.mp (congrArg (fun _a => _a + C.ncard = (↑D).ncard + L.ncard) (Set.ncard_coe_finset E))
                    (Eq.mp
                      (congrArg (fun _a => (↑E).ncard + C.ncard = _a)
                        (Set.ncard_union_eq hDL (Finset.finite_toSet D) hLF))
                      (Eq.mp
                        (congrArg (fun _a => _a = (↑D ∪ L).ncard) (Set.ncard_union_eq hEC (Finset.finite_toSet E) hCF))
                        hCard)))))⟩⟩⟩)

@DiamondIntegral.Section6.exists_disjoint_definable_finite_choice : ∀ {M : Type}
  [inst : SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M] {S : Set M} {p k : ℕ} (U : Set (Fin p → M)),
  S.Definable SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV U →
    ∀ (Q : Fin k → Set (Fin p → M)),
      (∀ (i : Fin k), S.Definable SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV (Q i)) →
        (∀ a ∈ U, ∃ i, a ∈ Q i) →
          ∃ C,
            (∀ (i : Fin k), S.Definable SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV (C i)) ∧
              (∀ (i : Fin k), C i ⊆ U ∩ Q i) ∧ (∀ a ∈ U, ∃ i, a ∈ C i) ∧ ∀ (i j : Fin k), ∀ a ∈ C i, a ∈ C j → i = j
theorem DiamondIntegral.Section6.exists_disjoint_definable_finite_choice : ∀ {M : Type}
  [inst : SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M] {S : Set M} {p k : ℕ} (U : Set (Fin p → M)),
  S.Definable SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV U →
    ∀ (Q : Fin k → Set (Fin p → M)),
      (∀ (i : Fin k), S.Definable SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV (Q i)) →
        (∀ a ∈ U, ∃ i, a ∈ Q i) →
          ∃ C,
            (∀ (i : Fin k), S.Definable SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV (C i)) ∧
              (∀ (i : Fin k), C i ⊆ U ∩ Q i) ∧ (∀ a ∈ U, ∃ i, a ∈ C i) ∧ ∀ (i j : Fin k), ∀ a ∈ C i, a ∈ C j → i = j :=
fun {M} [SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M] {S} {p k} U hU Q hQ hCover =>
  let earlier := fun i => ⋃ j, Q ↑j;
  let C := fun i => (U ∩ Q i) \ earlier i;
  have hEarlier := fun i => Set.definable_iUnion_of_finite fun j => hQ ↑j;
  have memEarlier := fun i a =>
    of_eq_true
      (Eq.trans
        (congrFun'
          (congrArg Iff
            (Eq.trans DiamondIntegral.Section6.exists_disjoint_definable_finite_choice._simp_1_1
              (Eq.trans DiamondIntegral.Section6.exists_disjoint_definable_finite_choice._simp_1_2
                (congrArg Exists
                  (funext fun a_1 =>
                    Eq.trans
                      (propext
                        (exists_prop_congr (fun h => Iff.of_eq (Eq.refl (a ∈ Q a_1))) (Iff.of_eq (Eq.refl (a_1 < i)))))
                      DiamondIntegral.Section6.exists_disjoint_definable_finite_choice._simp_1_3)))))
          (∃ a_1 < i, a ∈ Q a_1))
        (iff_self (∃ a_1 < i, a ∈ Q a_1)));
  Exists.intro C
    ⟨fun i => Set.Definable.sdiff (Set.Definable.inter hU (hQ i)) (hEarlier i),
      ⟨fun x => Set.sdiff_subset,
        ⟨fun a ha =>
          let I := {i | a ∈ Q i};
          have hI :=
            Exists.casesOn (hCover a ha) fun i hi => Exists.intro i (Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_univ i, hi⟩);
          let i := I.min' hI;
          Exists.intro i
            ⟨⟨ha, (Finset.mem_filter.mp (Finset.min'_mem I hI)).right⟩, fun h =>
              Exists.casesOn ((memEarlier i a).mp h) fun j h =>
                And.casesOn h fun hji hj =>
                  not_lt_of_ge (Finset.min'_le I j (Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_univ j, hj⟩)) hji⟩,
          fun i j a hi hj =>
          Or.casesOn (lt_trichotomy i j)
            (fun h => False.elim (hj.right ((memEarlier j a).mpr (Exists.intro i ⟨h, hi.left.right⟩)))) fun h =>
            Or.casesOn h (fun h => h) fun h =>
              False.elim (hi.right ((memEarlier i a).mpr (Exists.intro j ⟨h, hj.left.right⟩)))⟩⟩⟩

 Classical.choice,

  [inst : L.Structure M] {P Q : SpecialTransformations.DefinableGeometry.Space L M} {S : Set M} {I : Type} [Finite I]
  (A : SpecialTransformations.DefinableGeometry.DefSet P S) (B : SpecialTransformations.DefinableGeometry.DefSet Q S)
  (C : I → SpecialTransformations.DefinableGeometry.DefSet P S)
  (f : (i : I) → SpecialTransformations.DefinableGeometry.Map (C i) B) (hsub : ∀ (i : I), (C i).carrier ⊆ A.carrier),

    (∀ (i j : I) (p : ↑(C i).carrier) (q : ↑(C j).carrier), ↑p = ↑q → ↑((f i).toFun p) = ↑((f j).toFun q)) →
      ∃ g, ∀ (i : I) (p : ↑(C i).carrier), ↑(g.toFun ⟨↑p, ⋯⟩) = ↑((f i).toFun p) :=

  let R := fun x y => ∃ i, (f i).graph x y;
  have hR :=
    id
      (have he :=
        Set.ext fun z =>
          Eq.mpr
            (id
              (congr
                (congrArg Iff
                  (congrFun'
                    (congrArg Membership.mem
                      (congrArg Set.ofPred
                        (funext fun z =>
                          propext
                            (exists_prop_congr
                              (fun h =>
                                exists_prop_congr
                                  (fun h_1 =>
                                    Iff.of_eq

                                        (∃ i, (f i).graph (P.decode ⟨z ∘ Sum.inl, h⟩) (Q.decode ⟨z ∘ Sum.inr, h_1⟩))))
                                  (Iff.of_eq (Eq.refl (z ∘ Sum.inr ∈ Q.domain))))
                              (Iff.of_eq (Eq.refl (z ∘ Sum.inl ∈ P.domain)))))))
                    z))
                DiamondIntegral.Section6.exists_finite_glued_map._simp_1_1))
            {
              mp := fun a =>
                Exists.casesOn a fun w h =>
                  Exists.casesOn h fun w_1 h =>
                    Exists.casesOn h fun w_2 h =>
                      Eq.mpr
                        (id
                          (congrArg Exists
                            (funext fun i =>
                              Eq.trans
                                (propext
                                  (exists_prop_congr
                                    (fun h =>
                                      Iff.of_eq
                                        (Eq.trans
                                          (propext
                                            (exists_prop_congr
                                              (fun h_1 =>
                                                Iff.of_eq
                                                  (Eq.refl
                                                    ((f i).graph (P.decode ⟨z ∘ Sum.inl, h⟩)
                                                      (Q.decode ⟨z ∘ Sum.inr, h_1⟩))))
                                              (Iff.of_eq (eq_true w_1))))
                                          exists_true_left._simp_1))
                                    (Iff.of_eq (eq_true w))))
                                exists_true_left._simp_1)))
                        (Exists.intro w_2 h),
              mpr := fun a =>
                Exists.casesOn a fun w h =>
                  Exists.casesOn h fun w_1 h =>
                    Exists.casesOn h fun w_2 h =>
                      Eq.mpr
                        (id
                          (Eq.trans
                            (propext
                              (exists_prop_congr
                                (fun h =>
                                  Iff.of_eq

  [inst : SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M]
  [inst_1 : M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {S : Set M} {n : ℕ} (hc : CanonicalStructure.IsCanonical)
  {U V : DiamondIntegral.Section6.MeasuredRVObject S n} (e : DiamondIntegral.Section6.MeasuredRVIso U V)

  ∃ T,
    ∀ (u : ↑(DiamondIntegral.Section6.measuredPartialReplacement hc e ∅ hFin).object.domain.carrier),
      T.iso.iso.hom.map.toFun u = u :=

  Finset.induction_on I
    (Exists.intro
      (DiamondIntegral.Section6.MeasuredRVUnaryChain.identity
        (DiamondIntegral.Section6.measuredPartialReplacement hc e ∅ hFin))
      fun x => rfl)
    fun i I hi ih =>
    Exists.casesOn ih fun T hT =>
      let H :=
        DiamondIntegral.Section6.MeasuredRVUnaryChain.step i
          (DiamondIntegral.Section6.measuredPartialReplacementStep hc e I i hFin)

            (DiamondIntegral.Section6.measuredPartialReplacement hc e (insert i I) hFin));
      Exists.intro (T.comp H) fun u =>
        Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => _a = u) (DiamondIntegral.Section6.MeasuredRVUnaryChain.comp_map T H u)))
          (Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => H.iso.iso.hom.map.toFun _a = u) (hT u)))
            (Eq.refl (H.iso.iso.hom.map.toFun u)))

@DiamondIntegral.Section6.exists_disjoint_prepared_program_choice : ∀ {M : Type}
  [inst : SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M]

theorem DiamondIntegral.Section6.exists_disjoint_prepared_program_choice : ∀ {M : Type}
  [inst : SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M]
  [inst_1 : M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {S : Set M} {p n r k l : ℕ} (X : Set (Fin p → M)),
  S.Definable SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV X →
    ∀ (A : DiamondIntegral.Section6.MixedSetParameterTemplate S p n r)
      (P : Fin k → DiamondIntegral.Section6.MixedSetParameterTemplate S p n r)
      (T : Fin l → (s : ℕ) × DiamondIntegral.Section6.CentripetalProgramTemplate S p n r s),
      (∀ a ∈ X, ∃ i, a ∈ (T i).snd.preparedGood A P) →
        ∃ C,
          (∀ (i : Fin l), S.Definable SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV (C i)) ∧
            (∀ (i : Fin l), C i ⊆ X ∩ (T i).snd.preparedGood A P) ∧
              (∀ a ∈ X, ∃ i, a ∈ C i) ∧ ∀ (i j : Fin l), ∀ a ∈ C i, a ∈ C j → i = j :=
fun {M} [SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M] [M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {S}
    {p n r k l} X hX A P T hCover =>
  let earlier := fun i => ⋃ j, (T ↑j).snd.preparedGood A P;
  let C := fun i => (X ∩ (T i).snd.preparedGood A P) \ earlier i;
  have hEarlier := fun i =>
    Set.definable_iUnion_of_finite fun j =>
      DiamondIntegral.Section6.CentripetalProgramTemplate.preparedGood_definable (T ↑j).snd A P;
  have memEarlier := fun i a =>
    of_eq_true
      (Eq.trans
        (congrFun'
          (congrArg Iff
            (Eq.trans DiamondIntegral.Section6.exists_disjoint_prepared_program_choice._simp_1_1
              (Eq.trans DiamondIntegral.Section6.exists_disjoint_prepared_program_choice._simp_1_2
                (congrArg Exists
                  (funext fun a_1 =>
                    Eq.trans
                      (propext
                        (exists_prop_congr (fun h => Iff.of_eq (Eq.refl (a ∈ (T a_1).snd.preparedGood A P)))
                          (Iff.of_eq (Eq.refl (a_1 < i)))))
                      DiamondIntegral.Section6.exists_disjoint_prepared_program_choice._simp_1_3)))))
          (∃ a_1 < i, a ∈ (T a_1).snd.preparedGood A P))
        (iff_self (∃ a_1 < i, a ∈ (T a_1).snd.preparedGood A P)));
  Exists.intro C
    ⟨fun i =>
      Set.Definable.sdiff
        (Set.Definable.inter hX
          (DiamondIntegral.Section6.CentripetalProgramTemplate.preparedGood_definable (T i).snd A P))
        (hEarlier i),
      ⟨fun x => Set.sdiff_subset,
        ⟨fun a ha =>
          let I := {i | a ∈ (T i).snd.preparedGood A P};
          have hI :=
            Exists.casesOn (hCover a ha) fun i hi => Exists.intro i (Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_univ i, hi⟩);
          let i := I.min' hI;
          Exists.intro i
            ⟨⟨ha, (Finset.mem_filter.mp (Finset.min'_mem I hI)).right⟩, fun h =>
              Exists.casesOn ((memEarlier i a).mp h) fun j h =>
                And.casesOn h fun hji hj =>
                  have hjI := Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_univ j, hj⟩;
                  not_lt_of_ge (Finset.min'_le I j hjI) hji⟩,
          fun i j a hi hj =>
          Or.casesOn (lt_trichotomy i j)
            (fun h => False.elim (hj.right ((memEarlier j a).mpr (Exists.intro i ⟨h, hi.left.right⟩)))) fun h =>
            Or.casesOn h (fun h => h) fun h =>
              False.elim (hi.right ((memEarlier i a).mpr (Exists.intro j ⟨h, hj.left.right⟩)))⟩⟩⟩

theorem DiamondIntegral.Section6.properInvariant_of_finite_cover : ∀ {M G : Type}
  [inst : SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M]
  [inst_1 : M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] [inst_2 : LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero G]
  [inst_3 : Valued (DiamondIntegral.Section2.VF M) G] {n r k : ℕ} {S : Set M},
  M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF00 →
    CanonicalStructure.IsCanonical →
      ∀ {κ : Cardinal.{0}},
        Cardinal.aleph0 < κ →
          SpecialTransformations.Section3.Saturated M κ →
            (∀ (x y : DiamondIntegral.Section2.VF M),
                SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.VFValued.predV x y ↔ Valued.v x ≤ Valued.v y) →
              ∀
                (A :
                  SpecialTransformations.DefinableGeometry.DefSet (SpecialTransformations.Section4.rawMixedSpace n r) S)
                (C :
                  Fin k →
                    SpecialTransformations.DefinableGeometry.DefSet (SpecialTransformations.Section4.rawMixedSpace n r)
                      S),
                (∀ (i : Fin k), (C i).carrier ⊆ A.carrier) →
                  (∀ (i : Fin k), DiamondIntegral.Section6.ProperInvariant S (C i).carrier) →
                    (∀ p ∈ A.carrier, ∃ i, p ∈ (C i).carrier) → DiamondIntegral.Section6.ProperInvariant S A.carrier :=
fun {M G} [SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M] [M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF]
    [LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero G] [Valued (DiamondIntegral.Section2.VF M) G] {n r k} {S} h00 hc {κ} hκ hs hv A C
    hCA hC hCover =>
  let α := fun i => Exists.choose (hC i).vfBounded;
  let β := fun i => Exists.choose (hC i).rvBounded;
  Exists.casesOn (Set.Finite.bddBelow (Set.finite_range α)) fun a ha =>
    Exists.casesOn (Set.Finite.bddAbove (Set.finite_range β)) fun b hb =>
      have hVF :=
        Exists.intro a fun p hp j =>
          Exists.casesOn (hCover p hp) fun i hi =>
            have hLower := ha (Set.mem_range_self i);
            LE.le.trans hLower (Exists.choose_spec (hC i).vfBounded p hi j);
      have hRV :=
        Exists.intro b fun p hp j =>
          Exists.casesOn (hCover p hp) fun i hi =>
            have hβ := hb (Set.mem_range_self i);
            have hVal := Exists.choose_spec (hC i).rvBounded p hi j;
            ⟨LE.le.trans
                (have this := inv_le_inv' hβ;
                this)
                hVal.left,
              LE.le.trans hVal.right hβ⟩;
      (DiamondIntegral.Section6.lemma_6_5 h00 hc hκ hs hv A.carrier A.definable hVF hRV).mpr fun u =>
        have hEq :=
          Set.ext fun x =>
            { mp := fun hx => Exists.casesOn (hCover (x, u) hx) fun i hi => Set.mem_iUnion.mpr (Exists.intro i hi),
              mpr := fun hx => Exists.casesOn (Set.mem_iUnion.mp hx) fun i hi => hCA i hi };
        Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => IsClopen _a) hEq))
          (isClopen_iUnion_of_finite fun i => DiamondIntegral.Section6.ProperInvariant.clopen_fibres hv (hC i) u)

theorem DiamondIntegral.Section6.rvDataPack_label_injective : ∀ {M : Type}
  [inst : SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M]
  [inst_1 : M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {L l : ℕ},
  M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF00 →
    ∀ {m₁ m₂ : ℕ} {i j : Fin l} {u : Fin m₁ → DiamondIntegral.Section2.RVInfinity M}
      {v : Fin m₂ → DiamondIntegral.Section2.RVInfinity M},
      DiamondIntegral.Section6.rvDataPack i u = DiamondIntegral.Section6.rvDataPack j v → i = j :=
fun {M} [SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M] [M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {L l}
    h00 {m₁ m₂} {i j} {u} {v} he =>
  Decidable.byContradiction fun hij =>
    have h := congrArg (fun w => w (Fin.natAdd L i)) he;
    have hBad :=
      Eq.mp
        (congr
          (congrArg Eq
            (Eq.trans
              (Fin.append_right (fun j => if h : ↑j < m₁ then u ⟨↑j, h⟩ else DiamondIntegral.Section6.branchTag false)
                (fun j => DiamondIntegral.Section6.branchTag (decide (j = i))) i)
              (DiamondIntegral.Section6.branchTag.congr_simp (decide (i = i)) true
                (Eq.trans (Decidable.decide.congr_simp (i = i) True (eq_self i)) (decide_true instDecidableTrue)))))
          (Eq.trans
            (Fin.append_right (fun j => if h : ↑j < m₂ then v ⟨↑j, h⟩ else DiamondIntegral.Section6.branchTag false)
              (fun j_1 => DiamondIntegral.Section6.branchTag (decide (j_1 = j))) i)
            (DiamondIntegral.Section6.branchTag.congr_simp (decide (i = j)) false
              (Eq.trans (Decidable.decide.congr_simp (i = j) False (eq_false hij)) (decide_false instDecidableFalse)))))
        h;
    have hBool := DiamondIntegral.Section6.branchTag_injective h00 hBad;
    Eq.casesOn (motive := fun a t => false = a → hBool ≍ t → False) hBool
      (fun h => False.elim (noConfusion_of_Nat Bool.ctorIdx h)) (Eq.refl false) (HEq.refl hBool)

theorem DiamondIntegral.Section6.finiteRVTemplateChoice_graph_at : ∀ {M : Type}
  [inst : SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M]
  [inst_1 : M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {S : Set M} {p r n m k : ℕ}
  (T : Fin k → DiamondIntegral.Section6.ContinuousRVGraphTemplate S p r n m) (U : Set (Fin p → M))
  (hU : S.Definable SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV U) (C : Fin k → Set (Fin p → M))
  (hC : ∀ (i : Fin k), S.Definable SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV (C i)),

      ∀ (a : Fin p → M) (i : Fin k),
        a ∈ C i →
          {z | Sum.elim a z ∈ (DiamondIntegral.Section6.finiteRVTemplateChoice T U hU C hC).graph} =
            {z | Sum.elim a z ∈ (T i).graph} :=
fun {M} [SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M] [M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {S}
    {p r n m k} T U hU C hC hSub hDisj a i hi =>
  Set.ext fun z =>
    {
      mp := fun hz =>
        Or.casesOn hz
          (fun hz =>
            Exists.casesOn (Set.mem_iUnion.mp hz) fun j hj =>
              have hji := hDisj j i a hj.left hi;
              Eq.ndrec (motive := fun j =>
                Sum.elim a z ∈ {z | z ∘ Sum.inl ∈ C j} ∩ (T j).graph → z ∈ {z | Sum.elim a z ∈ (T i).graph})
                (fun hj => hj.right) (Eq.symm hji) hj)
          fun hz => False.elim (hz.left (hSub i hi)),
      mpr := fun hz => Or.inl (Set.mem_iUnion.mpr (Exists.intro i ⟨hi, hz⟩)) }

  [inst_1 : M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {S : Set M}
  (U : DiamondIntegral.Section6.MeasuredRVObject S 1)
  (a :
    SpecialTransformations.DefinableGeometry.Map U.object.domain
      (SpecialTransformations.DefinableGeometry.DefSet.univ (SpecialTransformations.Section4.rawVFSpace 1) S)),
  (∀ (u : ↑U.object.domain.carrier), DiamondIntegral.Section2.rv M (↑(a.toFun u) 0) = U.object.value u 0) →
    ∀ (u : ↑U.object.domain.carrier), ↑(U.volumeGamma u) = DiamondIntegral.Section2.vfValue (↑(a.toFun u) 0) :=
fun {M} [SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M] [M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {S} U a
    ha u =>
  have hp :=
    Exists.intro u
      ⟨rfl,
        funext fun i =>
          List.Mem.casesOn (motive := fun a_1 x =>
            List.finRange 1 = a_1 →
              Fintype.complete i ≍ x →
                U.object.value u i = SpecialTransformations.Section4.tupleRV (↑(a.toFun u), ↑u).1 i)
            (Fintype.complete i)
            (fun as h =>
              List.cons.noConfusion h fun head_eq =>
                Eq.ndrec (motive := fun i =>
                  ∀ (this : i ∈ Fintype.elems),
                    [] ≍ as →
                      this ≍ List.Mem.head as →
                        U.object.value u i = SpecialTransformations.Section4.tupleRV (↑(a.toFun u), ↑u).1 i)
                  (fun this tail_eq =>
                    Eq.ndrec (motive := fun as =>
                      this ≍ List.Mem.head as →
                        U.object.value u ((fun i => i) ⟨0, Nat.le_refl 1⟩) =
                          SpecialTransformations.Section4.tupleRV (↑(a.toFun u), ↑u).1
                            ((fun i => i) ⟨0, Nat.le_refl 1⟩))
                      (fun h => Eq.symm (ha u)) (eq_of_heq tail_eq))
                  (eq_of_heq head_eq) (Fintype.complete i))
            (fun b {as} a_1 h =>
              List.cons.noConfusion h fun head_eq =>
                Eq.ndrec (motive := fun b =>
                  [] ≍ as →
                    Fintype.complete i ≍ List.Mem.tail b a_1 →
                      U.object.value u i = SpecialTransformations.Section4.tupleRV (↑(a.toFun u), ↑u).1 i)
                  (fun tail_eq =>
                    Eq.ndrec (motive := fun {as} =>
                      ∀ (a_2 : List.Mem i as),
                        Fintype.complete i ≍ List.Mem.tail ((fun i => i) ⟨0, Nat.le_refl 1⟩) a_2 →
                          U.object.value u i = SpecialTransformations.Section4.tupleRV (↑(a.toFun u), ↑u).1 i)
                      (fun a_2 h =>
                        List.Mem.casesOn (motive := fun a_3 x =>
                          [] = a_3 →
                            a_2 ≍ x →
                              U.object.value u i = SpecialTransformations.Section4.tupleRV (↑(a.toFun u), ↑u).1 i)
                          a_2 (fun as h => False.elim (noConfusion_of_Nat List.ctorIdx h))
                          (fun b {as} a_3 h => False.elim (noConfusion_of_Nat List.ctorIdx h)) (Eq.refl [])
                          (HEq.refl a_2))
                      (eq_of_heq tail_eq) a_1)
                  (eq_of_heq head_eq))
            (Eq.refl (List.finRange 1)) (HEq.refl (Fintype.complete i))⟩;
  let p := ⟨(↑(a.toFun u), ↑u), hp⟩;
  have hu := Subtype.ext rfl;
  have h := DiamondIntegral.Section6.rvLift_volume_gamma_value U p;
  Eq.mp (congrArg (Eq ↑(U.volumeGamma u)) (congrArg DiamondIntegral.Section2.vfValue (Fin.prod_univ_one (↑p).1)))
    (Eq.mp (congrArg (fun _a => ↑(U.volumeGamma _a) = DiamondIntegral.Section2.vfValue (∏ i, (↑p).1 i)) hu) h)

                        (hd p).left (he p).left).mp

            { sourceOffset := dMap, targetOffset := eMap, sourceNonzero := fun p => (hd p).left,
              targetNonzero := fun p => (he p).left, sourceFloor := fun p => (hd p).right,

    ∀ (i : Fin n), i ≠ j → ↑β < DiamondIntegral.Section2.vfValue (a i - b i) :=

  {

      Eq.mp
        (congrArg (LT.lt ↑β)
          (congrArg DiamondIntegral.Section2.vfValue
            (congr
              (congrArg HSub.hSub

                b))))
        (h i),

          Eq.mpr
            (id
              (congrArg (LT.lt ↑β)

                      (fun a => DiamondIntegral.Section2.VF M) 0 a))
                  ((fun x_0 v f => (fun x_0 => Function.update_of_ne hi) x_0 v f)
                    (fun a => DiamondIntegral.Section2.VF M) 0 b)))))

@DiamondIntegral.Section6.mem_focusIndependentParameterLocus_map_iff : ∀ {M : Type}
  [inst : SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M] [M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF]
  {T : Set M} {n r : ℕ} {ι : Type} [Finite ι] (R : Set (ι ⊕ (Fin n ⊕ Fin r) ⊕ Fin 1 → M)) (a : ι → M) (j : Fin n)
  {A : SpecialTransformations.DefinableGeometry.DefSet (SpecialTransformations.Section4.rawMixedSpace n r) T}
  (f :
    SpecialTransformations.DefinableGeometry.Map A
      (SpecialTransformations.DefinableGeometry.DefSet.univ (SpecialTransformations.Section4.rawVFSpace 1) T)),
  {z | Sum.elim a z ∈ R} =
      (SpecialTransformations.Section4.rawMixedSpace n r).relation (SpecialTransformations.Section4.rawVFSpace 1)
        f.graph →

      ∀ (p q : ↑A.carrier),
        (↑p).2 = (↑q).2 → (∀ (i : Fin n), i ≠ j → (↑p).1 i = (↑q).1 i) → ↑(f.toFun p) 0 = ↑(f.toFun q) 0)
theorem DiamondIntegral.Section6.mem_focusIndependentParameterLocus_map_iff : ∀ {M : Type}
  [inst : SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M] [M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF]
  {T : Set M} {n r : ℕ} {ι : Type} [Finite ι] (R : Set (ι ⊕ (Fin n ⊕ Fin r) ⊕ Fin 1 → M)) (a : ι → M) (j : Fin n)
  {A : SpecialTransformations.DefinableGeometry.DefSet (SpecialTransformations.Section4.rawMixedSpace n r) T}
  (f :
    SpecialTransformations.DefinableGeometry.Map A
      (SpecialTransformations.DefinableGeometry.DefSet.univ (SpecialTransformations.Section4.rawVFSpace 1) T)),
  {z | Sum.elim a z ∈ R} =
      (SpecialTransformations.Section4.rawMixedSpace n r).relation (SpecialTransformations.Section4.rawVFSpace 1)
        f.graph →
    (a ∈ DiamondIntegral.Section6.focusIndependentParameterLocus R j ↔
      ∀ (p q : ↑A.carrier),
        (↑p).2 = (↑q).2 → (∀ (i : Fin n), i ≠ j → (↑p).1 i = (↑q).1 i) → ↑(f.toFun p) 0 = ↑(f.toFun q) 0) :=
fun {M} [SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M] [M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {T}
    {n r} {ι} [Finite ι] R a j {A} f hSection =>
  have hAt := fun z => Iff.trans (Set.ext_iff.mp hSection z) (DiamondIntegral.Section6.scalarMapGraph_iff f z);
  {
    mp := fun h p q hRV hOther =>
      have hp :=
        (hAt
              (Sum.elim (SpecialTransformations.Section4.mixedValues ↑p)
                (SpecialTransformations.Section4.vfValues ↑(f.toFun p)))).mpr
          (Exists.intro p rfl);
      have hq :=
        (hAt
              (Sum.elim (SpecialTransformations.Section4.mixedValues ↑q)
                (SpecialTransformations.Section4.vfValues ↑(f.toFun q)))).mpr
          (Exists.intro q rfl);
      have hInd :=
        h
          (Sum.elim (SpecialTransformations.Section4.mixedValues ↑p)
            (SpecialTransformations.Section4.vfValues ↑(f.toFun p)))
          (Sum.elim (SpecialTransformations.Section4.mixedValues ↑q)
            (SpecialTransformations.Section4.vfValues ↑(f.toFun q)))
          hp hq;
      id
        (fun hInd =>
          Subtype.ext (hInd (fun k => congrArg (fun u => ↑(u k)) hRV) fun i hi => congrArg Subtype.val (hOther i hi)))
        hInd,
    mpr := fun h x y hx hy =>
      Exists.casesOn ((hAt x).mp hx) fun p h_1 =>
        Eq.ndrec (motive := fun x =>
          Sum.elim a x ∈ R → Sum.elim a (Sum.elim x y) ∈ DiamondIntegral.Section6.focusIndependenceCondition ι j)
          (fun hx =>
            Exists.casesOn ((hAt y).mp hy) fun q h_2 =>
              Eq.ndrec (motive := fun y =>
                Sum.elim a y ∈ R →
                  Sum.elim a
                      (Sum.elim
                        (Sum.elim (SpecialTransformations.Section4.mixedValues ↑p)
                          (SpecialTransformations.Section4.vfValues ↑(f.toFun p)))
                        y) ∈
                    DiamondIntegral.Section6.focusIndependenceCondition ι j)
                (fun hy =>
                  id fun hRV hOther =>
                    congrArg Subtype.val
                      (h p q (funext fun k => Subtype.ext (hRV k)) fun i hi => Subtype.ext (hOther i hi)))
                h_2 hy)
          h_1 hx }

    hv X {B A} f hf hQC g ω hChain hBranch hOutside =>
  Exists.casesOn
    (DiamondIntegral.Section6.SpecialCovariantChain.retainsRV
      (DiamondIntegral.Section6.CentripetalChain.toSpecial
        (DiamondIntegral.Section6.SynchronizedCentripetalChain.toChain
          (DiamondIntegral.Section6.FormCompatibleSynchronizedChain.toSynchronized hChain))))
    fun hrs hRetain =>
    let σ := DiamondIntegral.Section6.rvTailIndex hrs;
    let V := DiamondIntegral.Section6.selectedRVTagSet X.tags σ;
    have hRV := fun x => funext (hRetain x);
    have hSelected := fun x =>
      id (Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => _a ∈ X.tags.carrier ↔ (↑x).2 ∈ X.tags.carrier) (hRV x))) Iff.rfl);
    have hSource :=
      have he :=
        DiamondIntegral.Section6.image_eq_of_surjective_liesOver g f hf
          (DiamondIntegral.Section6.SynchronizedTagBranchFrame.subset X) fun x => Eq.symm (hBranch x);
      have hi :=
        DiamondIntegral.Section6.map_branch_image g
          (Function.Bijective.surjective
            (DiamondIntegral.Section6.SpecialCovariantChain.bijective
              (DiamondIntegral.Section6.CentripetalChain.toSpecial
                (DiamondIntegral.Section6.SynchronizedCentripetalChain.toChain
                  (DiamondIntegral.Section6.FormCompatibleSynchronizedChain.toSynchronized hChain)))
              h00))
          X.tags σ hRV (DiamondIntegral.Section6.SynchronizedTagBranchFrame.subset X) X.source_eq;
      congrArg SpecialTransformations.DefinableGeometry.DefSet.carrier (Eq.trans he hi);
    have hPieces := fun i =>

          (g.restrict (LE.le.trans (hQC i) (DiamondIntegral.Section6.SynchronizedTagBranchFrame.subset X))) rfl fun x =>
          Eq.symm (hBranch ⟨↑x, hQC i x.property⟩);
      Eq.trans hImage
        (congrArg SpecialTransformations.DefinableGeometry.DefSet.carrier
          (DiamondIntegral.Section6.map_tag_slice_image g X.tags σ hRV (X.pieces_subset i)
            (LE.le.trans (hQC i) (DiamondIntegral.Section6.SynchronizedTagBranchFrame.subset X)) (X.pieces_eq i)));
    have hPartial := fun x hx y hy hxy hu =>
      Exists.casesOn
        (Function.Bijective.surjective
          (DiamondIntegral.Section6.SpecialCovariantChain.bijective
            (DiamondIntegral.Section6.CentripetalChain.toSpecial
              (DiamondIntegral.Section6.SynchronizedCentripetalChain.toChain
                (DiamondIntegral.Section6.FormCompatibleSynchronizedChain.toSynchronized hChain)))
            h00)
          ⟨x, hx⟩)
        fun a ha =>
        Exists.casesOn
          (Function.Bijective.surjective
            (DiamondIntegral.Section6.SpecialCovariantChain.bijective
              (DiamondIntegral.Section6.CentripetalChain.toSpecial
                (DiamondIntegral.Section6.SynchronizedCentripetalChain.toChain
                  (DiamondIntegral.Section6.FormCompatibleSynchronizedChain.toSynchronized hChain)))
              h00)
            ⟨y, hy⟩)
          fun b hb =>
          have haV := congrArg Subtype.val ha;
          have hbV := congrArg Subtype.val hb;
          have hOld :=
            Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => _a = (↑b).2) (Eq.symm (hRV a))))
              (Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => (↑(g.toFun a)).2 ∘ σ = _a) (Eq.symm (hRV b))))
                (Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => _a.2 ∘ σ = (↑(g.toFun b)).2 ∘ σ) haV))
                  (Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => x.2 ∘ σ = _a.2 ∘ σ) hbV))
                    (Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => _a ∘ σ = y.2 ∘ σ) hxy)) (Eq.refl (y.2 ∘ σ))))));
          have hau := fun h =>
            hu (Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => _a.2 ∈ V.carrier) (Eq.symm haV))) ((hSelected a).mpr h));
          have hbu := hOld ▸ hau;
          Eq.mpr

              (congrArg (fun _a => DiamondIntegral.Section2.tupleRV M _a.1 = DiamondIntegral.Section2.tupleRV M y.1)
                (Eq.symm haV)))

                    DiamondIntegral.Section2.tupleRV M (↑(g.toFun a)).1 = DiamondIntegral.Section2.tupleRV M _a.1)

                      (fun _a => DiamondIntegral.Section2.tupleRV M (↑a).1 = DiamondIntegral.Section2.tupleRV M _a)
                      (hOutside b hbu)))
                  (X.outside_tagged (↑a) a.property (↑b) b.property hOld hau))));

      { ambient := A, pieces := fun i => (g.restrict (X.pieces_subset i)).image, tags := V,
        proper :=
          DiamondIntegral.Section6.SpecialCovariantChain.target_properInvariant h00 hc hκ hs hv

              (DiamondIntegral.Section6.SynchronizedCentripetalChain.toChain

            X.doublyBounded,
        pieces_subset := fun i y hy =>
          Exists.casesOn hy fun x hx => hx ▸ ((g.restrict (X.pieces_subset i)).toFun x).property,
        pieces_proper := fun i =>
          DiamondIntegral.Section6.SpecialCovariantChain.target_properInvariant h00 hc hκ hs hv
            (DiamondIntegral.Section6.CompatibleCentripetalChain.literal_restriction h00
              (DiamondIntegral.Section6.SynchronizedCentripetalChain.atPiece
                (DiamondIntegral.Section6.FormCompatibleSynchronizedChain.toSynchronized hChain) i)
              (X.pieces_subset i)),
        source_eq := hSource, pieces_eq := hPieces, outside_tagged := hPartial };
    Exists.intro
      { output := Y, map := g, chain := DiamondIntegral.Section6.FormCompatibleSynchronizedChain.toSynchronized hChain,
        piece_images := fun x => rfl, branch := hBranch, selected := hSelected, outside := hOutside }
      hChain

theorem DiamondIntegral.Section6.FMT.productDomain_iff_set_equality.{u_1, u_2} : ∀ {X : Type u_1} {Y : Type u_2}

                      (and_true True))))

            (Eq.trans (congr (congrArg And (eq_true hx)) Set.mem_setOf_eq) (true_and ((c, y) ∈ A)))))

                (DiamondIntegral.Section6.FMT.mixedFamilyFreeze balls centers j (b, u)).1 u x))))

                (fun _a =>

      DiamondIntegral.Section6.FMT.CoordinateProductDomain P (DiamondIntegral.Section6.FMT.vfOpenBall ↑D) (centers D)

      DiamondIntegral.Section6.CoordinateRootControl (R.frozen balls centers j hsep hballs hcenters hprodA) P :=
fun {M} [SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M] [M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {n r}
    {S} {G} [LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero G] [Valued (DiamondIntegral.Section2.VF M) G] {A} R balls centers j hsep
    hballs hcenters hprodA P hprodP hControl b u a ρ hAmbient hAvoid x hx y hy =>
  let q := DiamondIntegral.Section6.FMT.mixedFamilyFreeze balls centers j (b, u);
  have hAmbient' := fun z hz =>
    have hm :=
      DiamondIntegral.Section6.FMT.mixedFamilyFreeze_mapsTo balls centers j.castSucc A.carrier hsep hprodA
        (hAmbient z hz);
    Eq.mp
      (congrArg (fun _a => _a ∈ A.carrier) (DiamondIntegral.Section6.FMT.mixedFamilyFreeze_snoc balls centers j b z u))
      hm;
  have hAvoid' := fun z hz =>
    hAvoid z
      (Eq.mpr
        (id
          (congrArg (fun _a => z ∈ _a)
            (DiamondIntegral.Section6.CoordinateRootFamily.frozen_fibre R balls centers j hsep hballs hcenters hprodA b
              u)))
        hz);
  have h := hControl q.1 u a ρ hAmbient' hAvoid' x hx y hy;
  have hX :=
    DiamondIntegral.Section6.FMT.mixedFamilyFreeze_mem_iff balls centers j.castSucc hsep P hprodP (Fin.snoc b x, u);
  have hY :=
    DiamondIntegral.Section6.FMT.mixedFamilyFreeze_mem_iff balls centers j.castSucc hsep P hprodP (Fin.snoc b y, u);
  Iff.trans
    (Iff.symm
      (Eq.mp
        (congrArg (fun _a => _a ∈ P ↔ (Fin.snoc b x, u) ∈ P)
          (DiamondIntegral.Section6.FMT.mixedFamilyFreeze_snoc balls centers j b x u))

    {G} [LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero G] [Valued (DiamondIntegral.Section2.VF M) G] balls c hsep s hs0 hRadius Q
    hCover ω hControl x y hClose u =>
  have hSame := fun D =>
    Exists.casesOn (hRadius (↑D) D.property) fun a ha =>
      Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => x ∈ _a ↔ y ∈ _a) ha))
        { mp := fun hx => (SpecialTransformations.Section3.Balls.strictDisc_recenter_iff Valued.v a x y s hx).mp hClose,
          mpr := fun hy =>
            have hrev := Eq.trans_lt (Valuation.map_sub_swap Valued.v x y) hClose;
            (SpecialTransformations.Section3.Balls.strictDisc_recenter_iff Valued.v a y x s hy).mp hrev };

    Exists.casesOn hx fun D hD =>
      have hy := (hSame D).mp hD;

            (Eq.refl (ω (fun x => c D, u)))))

              ((SpecialTransformations.Section3.Balls.strictDisc_recenter_iff Valued.v a z x s hza).mp hxz));

fun {M} [SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M] [M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {r} {T}
    {G} [LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero G] [Valued (DiamondIntegral.Section2.VF M) G] balls c hsep s hs0 hRadius Q
    hCover hHit ω hControl a ρ hAvoid x hx y hy u =>
  if hSmall : ↑(OrderDual.ofDual ρ) ≤ Valued.v s then
    DiamondIntegral.Section6.FMT.frozenUnaryValue_uniform_constancy balls c hsep s hs0 hRadius Q hCover ω hControl x y
      (LT.lt.trans_le (DiamondIntegral.Section6.FMT.disc_difference_lt✝ a y x ρ hy hx) hSmall) u
  else
    have hLarge := lt_of_not_ge hSmall;
    have hOutside := fun z hz D hD =>
      Exists.casesOn (hHit D) fun q h =>
        And.casesOn h fun hq hqD =>
          Exists.casesOn (hRadius (↑D) D.property) fun b hb =>
            have hzB := (Set.ext_iff.mp hb z).mp hD;
            have hqB := (Set.ext_iff.mp hb q).mp hqD;
            have hqz :=
              DiamondIntegral.Section6.FMT.disc_difference_lt✝ b q z
                (SpecialTransformations.Section3.Balls.openRadius (Valued.v s) ((map_ne_zero Valued.v).mpr hs0)) hqB
                hzB;
            hAvoid q hq
              (id
                (Trans.trans
                  (Trans.trans
                    (congrArg (⇑Valued.v)
                      (DiamondIntegral.Section6.FMT.frozenUnaryValue_obstacle_control._abel_1_1 a z q))
                    (Valuation.map_add Valued.v (q - z) (z - a)))
                  (max_lt (LT.lt.trans hqz hLarge) hz)));
    have hFx :=
      Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => _a = x) (DiamondIntegral.Section6.FMT.vfFamilyFreeze_eq balls c hsep x)))
        (DiamondIntegral.Section6.FMT.familyFreeze_outside
          (fun D => {y | ↑y ∈ SpecialTransformations.Section3.OpenBallCodes.underlying ↑D}) c x (hOutside x hx));
    have hFy :=
      Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => _a = y) (DiamondIntegral.Section6.FMT.vfFamilyFreeze_eq balls c hsep y)))
        (DiamondIntegral.Section6.FMT.familyFreeze_outside
          (fun D => {y | ↑y ∈ SpecialTransformations.Section3.OpenBallCodes.underlying ↑D}) c y (hOutside y hy));
    id
      (Eq.mpr
        (id
          (congrArg
            (fun _a => ω (fun x => _a, u) = ω (fun x => DiamondIntegral.Section6.FMT.vfFamilyFreeze balls c y, u)) hFx))
        (Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => ω (fun x_1 => x, u) = ω (fun x => _a, u)) hFy))
          (hControl a ρ hAvoid x hx y hy u)))

    {n r k} {G} [LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero G] [Valued (DiamondIntegral.Section2.VF M) G] {A} h00 hc linear {κ} hκ
    hs hv V hsmall hΓ hV hVS hSV hnt F hARV P hPA hP =>
  let H := Fin.cons A.carrier fun i => (P i).carrier;
  have hH := fun i => Fin.cases F.proper hP i;
  Exists.casesOn
    (DiamondIntegral.Section6.finite_properInvariant_uniform_named_radius h00 hc linear hκ hs hv hsmall hΓ H hH)
    fun γ h =>

      And.casesOn right fun hγ1 hInv =>
        Exists.casesOn
          (DiamondIntegral.Section6.FullFocusGraphData.uniform_named_erased_covariance h00 hc linear hκ hs hv hsmall hΓ
            F hARV γ hγ)
          fun β₀ h =>

            let β := max γ β₀;
            have hβ := DiamondIntegral.Section6.gamma_max_named γ β₀ hγ hβ₀;
            have hInvAll := fun i u =>
              DiamondIntegral.Section6.AlphaInvariant.larger_radius (hInv i u) fun j =>

            Exists.casesOn (DiamondIntegral.Section6.FullFocusGraphData.image_lowerBound F) fun η hLower =>

                  (DiamondIntegral.Section6.scalarFocusImage_definable F.map) η hLower γ hγ)
                fun c h =>

                  And.casesOn right fun hcpos right =>

  [inst : SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M] [M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF]

                            (DiamondIntegral.Section6.CentripetalFusionRepair.protectedComponent_compatible R i) (↑a)

      {
        mp := fun hz =>
          And.casesOn
            ((DiamondIntegral.Section6.mem_rvLabelPullback (R.residualTarget hCoeffMem)
                  (fun i =>
                    Fin.addCases (DiamondIntegral.Section6.centripetalBaseLabels R.component π)
                      (DiamondIntegral.Section6.centripetalLocalLabels R.component σ) i)

            fun hzR hzPi =>
            Exists.casesOn (DiamondIntegral.Section6.CentripetalFusionRepair.stage_preimage R ⟨z, hzR.left⟩) fun p hp =>
              id
                (fun hp =>
                  have hRes := Eq.symm hp ▸ hzR.right;
                  have hNew := Eq.symm hp ▸ hzPi;
                  have hpPi :=
                    ((DiamondIntegral.Section6.CentripetalFusionRepair.residual_point_data R h00 hCoeffMem p hRes).right
                          i).mp
                      hNew;
                  ⟨Exists.intro ⟨↑p, hpPi⟩ hp, hzR.right⟩)
                hp,
        mpr := fun a =>
          And.casesOn a fun left hTags =>
            Exists.casesOn left fun p hp =>
              let a := ⟨↑p, DiamondIntegral.Section6.CentripetalFusionRepair.sourcePiece_subset R i p.property⟩;
              id
                (fun hp =>
                  have hRes := Eq.symm hp ▸ hTags;

                        (fun i =>

                        (DiamondIntegral.Section6.unaryIndexedMixedFamily R.parameter
                          ((DiamondIntegral.Section6.CentripetalProgramTemplate.centripetal K).pieceTarget A (P i)))
                        z).mpr
                    ⟨⟨hp ▸ (R.stageMap.toFun a).property, hTags⟩, hp ▸ hNew⟩)
                hp })

@DiamondIntegral.Section6.sumMixedGammaGraph_eq_relation : ∀ {M : Type}
  [inst : SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M]
  [inst_1 : M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {n r : ℕ} {S : Set M}

    ↑A.carrier →
      ↑(SpecialTransformations.DefinableGeometry.DefSet.univ DiamondIntegral.Section6.rawGammaPresentation S).carrier)
  (ω : DiamondIntegral.Section2.Mixed M n r → DiamondIntegral.Section2.Gamma M),
  (∀ (p : ↑A.carrier), ↑(f p) = ω ↑p) →
    ((SpecialTransformations.Section4.rawMixedSpace n r).relation DiamondIntegral.Section6.rawGammaPresentation
        fun x γ => ∃ p, ↑p = x ∧ ↑(f p) = γ) =
      DiamondIntegral.Section6.sumMixedGammaGraph A.carrier ω
theorem DiamondIntegral.Section6.sumMixedGammaGraph_eq_relation : ∀ {M : Type}
  [inst : SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M]
  [inst_1 : M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {n r : ℕ} {S : Set M}
  (A : SpecialTransformations.DefinableGeometry.DefSet (SpecialTransformations.Section4.rawMixedSpace n r) S)
  (f :
    ↑A.carrier →
      ↑(SpecialTransformations.DefinableGeometry.DefSet.univ DiamondIntegral.Section6.rawGammaPresentation S).carrier)
  (ω : DiamondIntegral.Section2.Mixed M n r → DiamondIntegral.Section2.Gamma M),
  (∀ (p : ↑A.carrier), ↑(f p) = ω ↑p) →
    ((SpecialTransformations.Section4.rawMixedSpace n r).relation DiamondIntegral.Section6.rawGammaPresentation
        fun x γ => ∃ p, ↑p = x ∧ ↑(f p) = γ) =
      DiamondIntegral.Section6.sumMixedGammaGraph A.carrier ω :=
fun {M} [SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M] [M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {n r}
    {S} A f ω hf =>
  Set.ext fun z =>
    {
      mp := fun a =>
        Exists.casesOn a fun hx h =>
          Exists.casesOn h fun hγ h =>
            Exists.casesOn h fun p h =>
              And.casesOn h fun hpx hpγ =>
                ⟨hγ,
                  Exists.intro ↑p
                    ⟨p.property,
                      ⟨Eq.mpr
                          (id (congrArg (fun _a => SpecialTransformations.Section4.mixedValues _a = z ∘ Sum.inl) hpx))
                          (SpecialTransformations.Section4.mixedValues_decode ⟨z ∘ Sum.inl, hx⟩),
                        Eq.trans (Eq.symm hpγ) (hf p)⟩⟩⟩,
      mpr := fun a =>
        And.casesOn a fun hγ right =>
          Exists.casesOn right fun p h =>
            And.casesOn h fun hp right =>
              And.casesOn right fun hpc hpγ =>
                have hx := hpc ▸ SpecialTransformations.Section4.mixedValues_mem_domain p;
                have hdecode :=
                  SpecialTransformations.Section4.mixedValues_injective
                    (Eq.trans (SpecialTransformations.Section4.mixedValues_decode ⟨z ∘ Sum.inl, hx⟩) (Eq.symm hpc));
                Exists.intro hx
                  (Exists.intro hγ (Exists.intro ⟨p, hp⟩ ⟨Eq.symm hdecode, Eq.trans (hf ⟨p, hp⟩) (Eq.symm hpγ)⟩)) }

@DiamondIntegral.Section6.isClopen_equal_levels : ∀ {X : Type u_1} {Y : Type u_2} [inst : TopologicalSpace X]
  (A : Set X) (f : X → Y),
  IsClopen A → (∀ (y : Y), IsOpen {a | a ∈ A ∧ f a = y}) → IsClopen {p | p.1 ∈ A ∧ p.2 ∈ A ∧ f p.1 = f p.2}
theorem DiamondIntegral.Section6.isClopen_equal_levels.{u_1, u_2} : ∀ {X : Type u_1} {Y : Type u_2}
  [inst : TopologicalSpace X] (A : Set X) (f : X → Y),
  IsClopen A → (∀ (y : Y), IsOpen {a | a ∈ A ∧ f a = y}) → IsClopen {p | p.1 ∈ A ∧ p.2 ∈ A ∧ f p.1 = f p.2} :=
fun {X} {Y} [TopologicalSpace X] A f hA hlevels =>
  have hopen :=
    isOpen_iff_mem_nhds.mpr fun p a =>
      And.casesOn a fun ha right =>
        And.casesOn right fun hb he =>
          have hn := IsOpen.mem_nhds (IsOpen.prod (hlevels (f p.1)) (hlevels (f p.1))) ⟨⟨ha, rfl⟩, ⟨hb, Eq.symm he⟩⟩;
          Filter.mem_of_superset hn fun q hq =>
            ⟨hq.left.left, ⟨hq.right.left, Eq.trans hq.left.right (Eq.symm hq.right.right)⟩⟩;
  have hcomp :=
    isOpen_iff_mem_nhds.mpr fun p hp =>
      if ha : p.1 ∈ A then
        if hb : p.2 ∈ A then
          have hne := fun h => hp ⟨ha, ⟨hb, h⟩⟩;
          have hn := IsOpen.mem_nhds (IsOpen.prod (hlevels (f p.1)) (hlevels (f p.2))) ⟨⟨ha, rfl⟩, ⟨hb, rfl⟩⟩;
          Filter.mem_of_superset hn fun ⦃q⦄ hq hR =>
            hne (Eq.trans (Eq.symm hq.left.right) (Eq.trans hR.right.right hq.right.right))
        else
          have ho := IsOpen.preimage continuous_snd IsClosed.isOpen_compl;
          Filter.mem_of_superset (IsOpen.mem_nhds ho hb) fun q hq hR => hq hR.right.left
      else
        have ho := IsOpen.preimage continuous_fst IsClosed.isOpen_compl;
        Filter.mem_of_superset (IsOpen.mem_nhds ho ha) fun q hq hR => hq hR.left;
  ⟨isOpen_compl_iff.mp hcomp, hopen⟩

          DiamondIntegral.Section6.GammaFormParameterTemplate.casesOn (motive := fun t =>

@DiamondIntegral.Section6.exists_generating_tuple_exchange : ∀ {E : Type u_1} (N : Matroid E) {n : ℕ} (a : Fin n → E)

  Set.range a ⊆ N.E →

theorem DiamondIntegral.Section6.exists_generating_tuple_exchange.{u_1} : ∀ {E : Type u_1} (N : Matroid E) {n : ℕ}
  (a : Fin n → E) (b : E),
  Set.range a ⊆ N.E →
    b ∈ N.closure (Set.range a) →
      b ∉ N.closure ∅ → ∃ i, N.closure (Set.range (Function.update a i b)) = N.closure (Set.range a) :=
fun {E} N {n} a b ha hb hb0 =>
  let P := fun I => b ∈ N.closure (a '' ↑I);
  Exists.casesOn
    (exists_minimalFor_of_wellFoundedLT P Finset.card
      (Exists.intro Finset.univ
        (Eq.mpr
          (id
            (congrFun'
              (congrArg Membership.mem
                (congrArg N.closure (Eq.trans (congrArg (Set.image a) Finset.coe_univ) Set.image_univ)))
              b))
          hb)))
    fun I hI =>
    have hne :=
      Decidable.byContradiction fun h =>
        have he := Finset.not_nonempty_iff_eq_empty.mp h;
        have h := MinimalFor.prop hI;
        hb0
          (Eq.mp
            (Eq.trans (congrArg (fun I => b ∈ N.closure (a '' ↑I)) he)
              (congrFun'
                (congrArg Membership.mem
                  (congrArg N.closure (Eq.trans (congrArg (Set.image a) Finset.coe_empty) (Set.image_empty a))))
                b))
            h);
    Exists.casesOn hne fun i hi =>
      have hNo := fun h =>
        have hlt := Finset.card_erase_lt_of_mem hi;
        not_le_of_gt hlt (MinimalFor.le_of_le hI h (Nat.le_of_lt hlt));
      have hSet :=
        Eq.mp (congrArg (Eq ↑I) (Finset.coe_insert i (I.erase i)))
          (congrArg (fun J => ↑J) (Eq.symm (Finset.insert_erase hi)));
      have hYes :=
        have h := MinimalFor.prop hI;
        id
          (fun h =>
            Eq.mp (congrArg (fun _a => b ∈ N.closure _a) Set.image_insert_eq)
              (Eq.mp (congrArg (fun _a => b ∈ N.closure (a '' _a)) hSet) h))
          h;
      have hEx := Matroid.mem_closure_insert hNo hYes;
      let c := Function.update a i b;
      have hbC := Exists.intro i (Function.update_self i b a);
      have hRest := fun ⦃z⦄ a_1 =>
        Exists.casesOn a_1 fun k h =>
          And.casesOn h fun hk right =>
            right ▸ Exists.intro k (Function.update_of_ne (Finset.mem_erase.mp hk).left b a);
      have hExC := Matroid.closure_subset_closure N (Set.insert_subset hbC hRest) hEx;
      Exists.intro i
        (Set.Subset.antisymm
          (Matroid.closure_subset_closure_of_subset_closure fun ⦃z⦄ a_1 =>
            Exists.casesOn a_1 fun k h =>
              h ▸
                if hk : k = i then
                  Eq.symm hk ▸
                    Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (Membership.mem (N.closure (Set.range a))) (Function.update_self i b a))) hb
                else
                  Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => _a ∈ N.closure (Set.range a)) (Function.update_of_ne hk b a)))
                    (Matroid.mem_closure_of_mem' N (Exists.intro k rfl) (ha (Exists.intro k rfl))))
          (Matroid.closure_subset_closure_of_subset_closure fun ⦃z⦄ a_1 =>
            Exists.casesOn a_1 fun k h =>
              h ▸
                if hk : k = i then Eq.symm hk ▸ hExC
                else
                  have hmem := Exists.intro k (Function.update_of_ne hk b a);
                  Matroid.mem_closure_of_mem' N hmem (ha (Exists.intro k rfl))))

theorem DiamondIntegral.Section6.goodBoundaryCoefficients_iff : ∀ {M : Type}
  [inst : SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M]
  [inst_1 : M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {S : Set M} {r s : ℕ}
  {A : SpecialTransformations.DefinableGeometry.DefSet (SpecialTransformations.Section4.rawMixedSpace 1 r) S}
  {B : SpecialTransformations.DefinableGeometry.DefSet (SpecialTransformations.Section4.rawMixedSpace 1 s) S}
  (hc : CanonicalStructure.IsCanonical) (f : SpecialTransformations.DefinableGeometry.Map A B)
  (E : SpecialTransformations.DefinableGeometry.DefSet (SpecialTransformations.Section4.rawMixedSpace 1 r) S)
  (hEA : E.carrier ⊆ A.carrier) (hRV : DiamondIntegral.Section2.IsRVPullback A.carrier)
  (hD : DiamondIntegral.Section6.VFDoublyBounded A.carrier)
  (c : ↑(DiamondIntegral.Section6.positiveBoundaryCoefficients hc).carrier),
  ↑c ∈ (DiamondIntegral.Section6.goodBoundaryCoefficients hc f E hEA hRV hD).carrier ↔
    DiamondIntegral.Section6.uniformBoundaryCoreGood hc f E hEA hRV hD c :=
fun {M} [SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M] [M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {S}
    {r s} {A} {B} hc f E hEA hRV hD c =>
  {
    mp := fun a =>
      And.casesOn a fun hcPos hcGood p =>
        Decidable.byContradiction fun hn =>
          let z := DiamondIntegral.Section6.boundaryPairInput hc E p c;
          let b := ⟨↑z, Exists.intro z ⟨rfl, hn⟩⟩;
          hcGood (Exists.intro b rfl),
    mpr := fun hGood =>
      ⟨c.property, fun a =>
        Exists.casesOn a fun b hb =>
          Exists.casesOn b.property fun z h =>
            And.casesOn h fun hz hBad =>
              have hCoeff := Eq.trans (congrArg Prod.snd hz) hb;
              let p := ⟨(↑z).1, z.property.left⟩;
              have hEq := Subtype.ext (Prod.ext rfl hCoeff);
              hBad (Eq.symm hEq ▸ hGood p)⟩ }

theorem DiamondIntegral.Section6.graphFibre_comp_iff : ∀ {M : Type}
  [inst : SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M] [M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF]
  {n m k r s t : ℕ} {S : Set M}
  {A : SpecialTransformations.DefinableGeometry.DefSet (SpecialTransformations.Section4.rawMixedSpace n r) S}
  {B : SpecialTransformations.DefinableGeometry.DefSet (SpecialTransformations.Section4.rawMixedSpace m s) S}
  {C : SpecialTransformations.DefinableGeometry.DefSet (SpecialTransformations.Section4.rawMixedSpace k t) S}

  (u : Fin r → DiamondIntegral.Section2.RVInfinity M) (w : Fin t → DiamondIntegral.Section2.RVInfinity M)
  (a : Fin n → DiamondIntegral.Section2.VF M) (c : Fin k → DiamondIntegral.Section2.VF M),
  DiamondIntegral.Section6.graphFibre (g.comp f) u w a c ↔
    ∃ v b, DiamondIntegral.Section6.graphFibre f u v a b ∧ DiamondIntegral.Section6.graphFibre g v w b c :=
fun {M} [SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M] [M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF]
    {n m k r s t} {S} {A} {B} {C} f g u w a c =>
  {
    mp := fun a_1 =>
      Exists.casesOn a_1 fun p h =>
        And.casesOn h fun hp hgp =>
          Exists.intro (↑(f.toFun p)).2
            (Exists.intro (↑(f.toFun p)).1 ⟨Exists.intro p ⟨hp, rfl⟩, Exists.intro (f.toFun p) ⟨rfl, hgp⟩⟩),
    mpr := fun a_1 =>
      Exists.casesOn a_1 fun v h =>
        Exists.casesOn h fun b h =>
          And.casesOn h fun left right =>
            Exists.casesOn left fun p h =>
              And.casesOn h fun hp hfp =>
                Exists.casesOn right fun q h =>
                  And.casesOn h fun hq hgq =>
                    have he := Subtype.ext (Eq.trans hfp (Eq.symm hq));
                    Exists.intro p ⟨hp, id (Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => ↑(g.toFun _a) = (c, w)) he)) hgq)⟩ }

theorem DiamondIntegral.Section6.inverse_comp_eq : ∀ {M : Type}
  [inst : SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M] [M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF]
  {n m k r s t : ℕ} {S : Set M}
  {A : SpecialTransformations.DefinableGeometry.DefSet (SpecialTransformations.Section4.rawMixedSpace n r) S}
  {B : SpecialTransformations.DefinableGeometry.DefSet (SpecialTransformations.Section4.rawMixedSpace m s) S}
  {C : SpecialTransformations.DefinableGeometry.DefSet (SpecialTransformations.Section4.rawMixedSpace k t) S}
  (f : SpecialTransformations.DefinableGeometry.Map A B) (g : SpecialTransformations.DefinableGeometry.Map B C)
  (hf : Function.Bijective f.toFun) (hg : Function.Bijective g.toFun),
  (g.comp f).inverse ⋯ = (f.inverse hf).comp (g.inverse hg) :=
fun {M} [SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M] [M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF]
    {n m k r s t} {S} {A} {B} {C} f g hf hg =>
  SpecialTransformations.DefinableGeometry.Map.ext fun c =>
    Function.Bijective.injective (Function.Bijective.comp hg hf)
      (have hright :=
        id
          (Eq.mpr
            (id
              (congrArg (fun _a => g.toFun _a = c)
                (SpecialTransformations.DefinableGeometry.Map.apply_inverse f hf ((g.inverse hg).toFun c))))
            (Eq.mpr
              (id (congrArg (fun _a => _a = c) (SpecialTransformations.DefinableGeometry.Map.apply_inverse g hg c)))
              (Eq.refl c)));
      Eq.trans (SpecialTransformations.DefinableGeometry.Map.apply_inverse (g.comp f) (Function.Bijective.comp hg hf) c)
        (Eq.symm hright))

theorem DiamondIntegral.Section6.GraphContinuous.comp : ∀ {M : Type}
  [inst : SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M]
  [inst_1 : M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {n m k r s t : ℕ} {S : Set M}
  {A : SpecialTransformations.DefinableGeometry.DefSet (SpecialTransformations.Section4.rawMixedSpace n r) S}
  {B : SpecialTransformations.DefinableGeometry.DefSet (SpecialTransformations.Section4.rawMixedSpace m s) S}
  {C : SpecialTransformations.DefinableGeometry.DefSet (SpecialTransformations.Section4.rawMixedSpace k t) S} {G : Type}
  [inst_2 : LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero G] [inst_3 : Valued (DiamondIntegral.Section2.VF M) G]
  {f : SpecialTransformations.DefinableGeometry.Map A B} {g : SpecialTransformations.DefinableGeometry.Map B C},
  DiamondIntegral.Section6.GraphContinuous g →
    DiamondIntegral.Section6.GraphContinuous f → DiamondIntegral.Section6.GraphContinuous (g.comp f) :=
fun {M} [SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M] [M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF]
    {n m k r s t} {S} {A} {B} {C} {G} [LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero G] [Valued (DiamondIntegral.Section2.VF M) G] {f}
    {g} hg hf =>
  have hNopen := fun u v w => ContinuousOn.isOpen_inter_preimage (hf.right u v) (hf.left u v) (hg.left v w);
  ⟨fun u w =>
    isOpen_iff_mem_nhds.mpr fun a ha =>
      Exists.casesOn ((DiamondIntegral.Section6.graphFibreSource_comp_iff f g u w a).mp ha) fun v h =>
        And.casesOn h fun haF haG =>
          Filter.mem_of_superset (IsOpen.mem_nhds (hNopen u v w) ⟨haF, haG⟩) fun b hb =>
            (DiamondIntegral.Section6.graphFibreSource_comp_iff f g u w b).mpr (Exists.intro v ⟨hb.left, hb.right⟩),
    fun u w a ha =>
    Exists.casesOn ((DiamondIntegral.Section6.graphFibreSource_comp_iff f g u w a).mp ha) fun v h =>
      And.casesOn h fun haF haG =>
        have hF := ContinuousOn.continuousAt (hf.right u v) (IsOpen.mem_nhds (hf.left u v) haF);
        have hG := ContinuousOn.continuousAt (hg.right v w) (IsOpen.mem_nhds (hg.left v w) haG);
        have he :=
          Filter.mem_of_superset (IsOpen.mem_nhds (hNopen u v w) ⟨haF, haG⟩) fun b hb =>
            DiamondIntegral.Section6.graphFibreMap_comp_eq f g u v w hb.left hb.right;
        ContinuousAt.continuousWithinAt (ContinuousAt.congr_of_eventuallyEq (ContinuousAt.comp hG hF) he)⟩

  [inst : SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M] [M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF]

  {B : SpecialTransformations.DefinableGeometry.DefSet (SpecialTransformations.Section4.rawMixedSpace m s) S}

  (v w : Fin s → DiamondIntegral.Section2.RVInfinity M),
  v ≠ w →
    Disjoint (DiamondIntegral.Section6.graphFibreSource f u v) (DiamondIntegral.Section6.graphFibreSource f u w) :=
fun {M} [SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M] [M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF]
    {n m r s} {S} {A} {B} f u v w hvw =>
  Set.disjoint_left.mpr fun ⦃a⦄ a_1 =>
    Exists.casesOn a_1 fun b h =>
      Exists.casesOn h fun p h =>
        And.casesOn h fun hp hfp a_2 =>
          Exists.casesOn a_2 fun c h =>
            Exists.casesOn h fun q h =>
              And.casesOn h fun hq hfq =>
                have he := Subtype.ext (Eq.trans hp (Eq.symm hq));
                hvw (congrArg Prod.snd (Eq.trans (Eq.symm hfp) (Eq.symm he ▸ hfq)))

theorem DiamondIntegral.Section6.headGammaFormMap_levels_open : ∀ {M : Type}
  [inst : SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M]
  [inst_1 : M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {S : Set M} {n r : ℕ} {G : Type}
  [inst_2 : LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero G] [inst_3 : Valued (DiamondIntegral.Section2.VF M) G]
  {A : SpecialTransformations.DefinableGeometry.DefSet (SpecialTransformations.Section4.rawMixedSpace (n + 1) r) S}
  (ω :
    SpecialTransformations.DefinableGeometry.Map A
      (SpecialTransformations.DefinableGeometry.DefSet.univ DiamondIntegral.Section6.rawGammaPresentation S))
  (a : DiamondIntegral.Section2.VF M),
  (∀ (u : (SpecialTransformations.Section4.rawRVSpace r).Carrier) (γ : DiamondIntegral.Section2.Gamma M),
      IsOpen {x | (x, u) ∈ A.carrier ∧ DiamondIntegral.Section6.gammaFormExtension ω (x, u) = γ}) →
    ∀ (u : (SpecialTransformations.Section4.rawRVSpace r).Carrier) (γ : DiamondIntegral.Section2.Gamma M),
      IsOpen
        {x |
          (x, u) ∈ ((DiamondIntegral.Section6.headFibreTemplate A).fibre fun x => ↑a).carrier ∧
            DiamondIntegral.Section6.gammaFormExtension (DiamondIntegral.Section6.headGammaFormMap ω a) (x, u) = γ} :=
fun {M} [SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M] [M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {S}
    {n r} {G} [LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero G] [Valued (DiamondIntegral.Section2.VF M) G] {A} ω a hLevels u γ =>
  have he :=
    Set.ext fun x =>
      {
        mp := fun a_1 =>
          And.casesOn a_1 fun hx hγ =>
            have hAx := (DiamondIntegral.Section6.mem_headFibreTemplate_iff A a (x, u)).mp hx;
            ⟨hAx,
              Eq.mpr
                (id
                  (congrArg (fun _a => _a = γ)
                    (DiamondIntegral.Section6.gammaFormExtension_at ω ⟨(Fin.cons a (x, u).1, (x, u).2), hAx⟩)))
                (Eq.mp (congrArg (fun _a => _a = γ) (DiamondIntegral.Section6.headGammaFormMap_value ω a ⟨(x, u), hx⟩))
                  (Eq.mp
                    (congrArg (fun _a => _a = γ)
                      (DiamondIntegral.Section6.gammaFormExtension_at (DiamondIntegral.Section6.headGammaFormMap ω a)
                        ⟨(x, u), hx⟩))
                    hγ))⟩,
        mpr := fun a_1 =>
          And.casesOn a_1 fun hx hγ =>
            have hCx := (DiamondIntegral.Section6.mem_headFibreTemplate_iff A a (x, u)).mpr hx;
            ⟨hCx,
              Eq.mpr
                (id
                  (congrArg (fun _a => _a = γ)
                    (DiamondIntegral.Section6.gammaFormExtension_at (DiamondIntegral.Section6.headGammaFormMap ω a)
                      ⟨(x, u), hCx⟩)))
                (Eq.mpr
                  (id (congrArg (fun _a => _a = γ) (DiamondIntegral.Section6.headGammaFormMap_value ω a ⟨(x, u), hCx⟩)))
                  (Eq.mp
                    (congrArg (fun _a => _a = γ)
                      (DiamondIntegral.Section6.gammaFormExtension_at ω ⟨((fun x => Fin.cons a x) x, u), hx⟩))

  Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => IsOpen _a) he))
    (IsOpen.preimage (Continuous.finCons continuous_const continuous_id') (hLevels u γ))

theorem DiamondIntegral.Section6.identity_source_iff : ∀ {M : Type}
  [inst : SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M] [M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF]
  {n r : ℕ} {S : Set M}
  (A : SpecialTransformations.DefinableGeometry.DefSet (SpecialTransformations.Section4.rawMixedSpace n r) S)
  (u v : Fin r → DiamondIntegral.Section2.RVInfinity M) (a : Fin n → DiamondIntegral.Section2.VF M),
  a ∈ DiamondIntegral.Section6.graphFibreSource (SpecialTransformations.DefinableGeometry.Map.id A) u v ↔
    (a, u) ∈ A.carrier ∧ u = v :=
fun {M} [SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M] [M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {n r}
    {S} A u v a =>
  {
    mp := fun a_1 =>
      Exists.casesOn a_1 fun b h =>
        Exists.casesOn h fun p h =>
          And.casesOn h fun hp hfp =>
            ⟨hp ▸ p.property, Eq.trans (Eq.symm (congrArg Prod.snd hp)) (congrArg Prod.snd hfp)⟩,
    mpr := fun a_1 => And.casesOn a_1 fun ha right => right ▸ Exists.intro a (Exists.intro ⟨(a, u), ha⟩ ⟨rfl, rfl⟩) }

theorem DiamondIntegral.Section6.identity_range_eq_source : ∀ {M : Type}
  [inst : SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M] [M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF]
  {n r : ℕ} {S : Set M}
  (A : SpecialTransformations.DefinableGeometry.DefSet (SpecialTransformations.Section4.rawMixedSpace n r) S)
  (u v : Fin r → DiamondIntegral.Section2.RVInfinity M),
  DiamondIntegral.Section6.graphFibreRange (SpecialTransformations.DefinableGeometry.Map.id A) u v =
    DiamondIntegral.Section6.graphFibreSource (SpecialTransformations.DefinableGeometry.Map.id A) u v :=
fun {M} [SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M] [M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {n r}
    {S} A u v =>
  Set.ext fun a =>
    {
      mp := fun a_1 =>
        Exists.casesOn a_1 fun b h =>
          Exists.casesOn h fun p h =>
            And.casesOn h fun hp hfp =>
              have he := Eq.trans (Eq.symm (congrArg Prod.fst hp)) (congrArg Prod.fst hfp);
              Eq.ndrec (motive := fun b =>
                ↑p = (b, u) →
                  a ∈ DiamondIntegral.Section6.graphFibreSource (SpecialTransformations.DefinableGeometry.Map.id A) u v)
                (fun hp => Exists.intro a (Exists.intro p ⟨hp, hfp⟩)) (Eq.symm he) hp,
      mpr := fun a_1 =>
        Exists.casesOn a_1 fun b h =>
          Exists.casesOn h fun p h =>
            And.casesOn h fun hp hfp =>
              have he := Eq.trans (Eq.symm (congrArg Prod.fst hfp)) (congrArg Prod.fst hp);
              Eq.ndrec (motive := fun b =>
                ↑((SpecialTransformations.DefinableGeometry.Map.id A).toFun p) = (b, v) →
                  a ∈ DiamondIntegral.Section6.graphFibreRange (SpecialTransformations.DefinableGeometry.Map.id A) u v)
                (fun hfp => Exists.intro a (Exists.intro p ⟨hp, hfp⟩)) (Eq.symm he) hfp }

theorem DiamondIntegral.Section6.identity_properHomeomorphism : ∀ {M : Type}
  [inst : SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M]
  [inst_1 : M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {n r : ℕ} {S : Set M}
  {A : SpecialTransformations.DefinableGeometry.DefSet (SpecialTransformations.Section4.rawMixedSpace n r) S} {G : Type}
  [inst_2 : LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero G] [inst_3 : Valued (DiamondIntegral.Section2.VF M) G],
  M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF00 →
    CanonicalStructure.IsCanonical →
      DiamondIntegral.Section2.GammaPiecewiseRationalAffineInput →
        ∀ {κ : Cardinal.{0}},
          Cardinal.aleph0 < κ →
            SpecialTransformations.Section3.Saturated M κ →
              (∀ (x y : DiamondIntegral.Section2.VF M),
                  SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.VFValued.predV x y ↔ Valued.v x ≤ Valued.v y) →
                Cardinal.mk ↑S < κ →
                  DiamondIntegral.Section2.NontrivialDefinableGamma { real := S, gamma := ∅ } →
                    DiamondIntegral.Section6.ProperInvariant S A.carrier →
                      DiamondIntegral.Section6.ProperCovariantHomeomorphism
                        (SpecialTransformations.DefinableGeometry.Map.id A) :=
fun {M} [SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M] [M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {n r}
    {S} {A} {G} [LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero G] [Valued (DiamondIntegral.Section2.VF M) G] h00 hc linear {κ} hκ hs hv
    hsmall hΓ hA =>
  have hD := fun u v =>
    if he : u = v then
      have heq := Set.ext fun a => Iff.trans (DiamondIntegral.Section6.identity_source_iff A u v a) (and_iff_left he);
      Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => IsClopen _a) heq))
        (DiamondIntegral.Section6.ProperInvariant.clopen_fibres hv hA u)
    else
      have heq :=
        Set.ext fun a =>
          { mp := fun ha => False.elim (he ((DiamondIntegral.Section6.identity_source_iff A u v a).mp ha).right),
            mpr := False.elim };
      Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => IsClopen _a) heq)) isClopen_empty;
  have hcont := fun u v =>
    ContinuousOn.congr (Continuous.continuousOn continuous_id) fun ⦃a⦄ ha =>
      Exists.casesOn
        (DiamondIntegral.Section6.graphFibreMap_graph (SpecialTransformations.DefinableGeometry.Map.id A) u v ha)
        fun p h => And.casesOn h fun hp hfp => Eq.trans (Eq.symm (congrArg Prod.fst hfp)) (congrArg Prod.fst hp);
  have hcov :=
    DiamondIntegral.Section6.properCovariant_of_clopen_ranges h00 hc hκ hs hv
      (SpecialTransformations.DefinableGeometry.Map.id A) hA hA hcont (fun u v => IsClopen.isOpen (hD u v)) fun u v =>
      Eq.symm (DiamondIntegral.Section6.identity_range_eq_source A u v) ▸ hD u v;
  DiamondIntegral.Section6.properHomeomorphism_of_properCovariant h00 hc linear hκ hs hv hsmall hΓ
    (SpecialTransformations.DefinableGeometry.Map.id A) hcov Function.bijective_id hcont

@DiamondIntegral.Section6.exists_interalgebraic_tuple_pivot : ∀ {E : Type u_1} (N : Matroid E) {n : ℕ},
  0 < n →
    ∀ (a b : Fin n → E),
      Set.range a ⊆ N.E →
        Set.range b ⊆ N.E →
          N.closure (Set.range a) = N.closure (Set.range b) →
            ∃ i j, N.closure (Set.range (Function.update a i (b j))) = N.closure (Set.range a)
theorem DiamondIntegral.Section6.exists_interalgebraic_tuple_pivot.{u_1} : ∀ {E : Type u_1} (N : Matroid E) {n : ℕ},
  0 < n →
    ∀ (a b : Fin n → E),
      Set.range a ⊆ N.E →
        Set.range b ⊆ N.E →
          N.closure (Set.range a) = N.closure (Set.range b) →
            ∃ i j, N.closure (Set.range (Function.update a i (b j))) = N.closure (Set.range a) :=
fun {E} N {n} hn a b ha hb he =>
  if h : ∃ j, b j ∉ N.closure ∅ then
    Exists.casesOn h fun j hj =>
      have hjA := Eq.symm he ▸ Matroid.mem_closure_of_mem' N (Exists.intro j rfl) (hb (Exists.intro j rfl));
      Exists.casesOn (DiamondIntegral.Section6.exists_generating_tuple_exchange N a (b j) ha hjA hj) fun i hi =>
        Exists.intro i (Exists.intro j hi)
  else
    have hB :=
      Eq.mp
        (Eq.trans DiamondIntegral.Section6.exists_interalgebraic_tuple_pivot._simp_1_1
          (forall_congr fun x => DiamondIntegral.Section6.exists_interalgebraic_tuple_pivot._simp_1_2))
        h;
    have hBE := Matroid.closure_subset_closure_of_subset_closure fun ⦃x⦄ a => Exists.casesOn a fun j h => h ▸ hB j;
    have hA := fun i => hBE (he ▸ Matroid.mem_closure_of_mem' N (Exists.intro i rfl) (ha (Exists.intro i rfl)));
    let i := ⟨0, hn⟩;
    let c := Function.update a i (b i);
    have hEmptyC := Matroid.closure_subset_closure N (Set.empty_subset (Set.range c));
    have hEmptyA := Matroid.closure_subset_closure N (Set.empty_subset (Set.range a));
    Exists.intro i
      (Exists.intro i
        (Set.Subset.antisymm
          (Matroid.closure_subset_closure_of_subset_closure fun ⦃x⦄ a_1 =>
            Exists.casesOn a_1 fun k h =>
              h ▸
                if hk : k = i then
                  Eq.symm hk ▸
                    Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (Membership.mem (N.closure (Set.range a))) (Function.update_self i (b i) a)))
                      (hEmptyA (hB i))
                else
                  Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => _a ∈ N.closure (Set.range a)) (Function.update_of_ne hk (b i) a)))
                    (hEmptyA (hA k)))
          (Matroid.closure_subset_closure_of_subset_closure fun ⦃x⦄ a_1 =>
            Exists.casesOn a_1 fun k h => h ▸ hEmptyC (hA k))))
