@DiamondIntegral.Section6.AlphaInvariant.rvSaturation : ∀ {M : Type}
  [inst : SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M] [hM : M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF]
  {n : ℕ} {α : Fin n → DiamondIntegral.Section2.Gamma M} {A : Set (Fin n → DiamondIntegral.Section2.VF M)},
  DiamondIntegral.Section6.AlphaInvariant α A →
    DiamondIntegral.Section6.AlphaInvariant α
      (DiamondIntegral.Section2.tupleRV M ⁻¹' DiamondIntegral.Section2.tupleRV M '' A)
theorem DiamondIntegral.Section6.AlphaInvariant.rvSaturation : ∀ {M : Type}
  [inst : SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M] [hM : M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF]
  {n : ℕ} {α : Fin n → DiamondIntegral.Section2.Gamma M} {A : Set (Fin n → DiamondIntegral.Section2.VF M)},
  DiamondIntegral.Section6.AlphaInvariant α A →
    DiamondIntegral.Section6.AlphaInvariant α
      (DiamondIntegral.Section2.tupleRV M ⁻¹' DiamondIntegral.Section2.tupleRV M '' A) :=
fun {M} [SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M] [M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {n} {α}
    {A} hA =>
  have step := fun x y hxy hx =>
    Exists.casesOn hx fun a h =>
      And.casesOn h fun ha harv =>
        let b := fun i => if ↑(α i) < DiamondIntegral.Section2.vfValue (x i) then y i else a i;
        have hax := fun i => congrArg SpecialTransformations.Section3.Values.vrv (congrFun harv i);
        have hab := fun i =>
          if hi : ↑(α i) < DiamondIntegral.Section2.vfValue (x i) then
            have haabove := Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => ↑(α i) < _a) (hax i))) hi;
            have haxnear :=
              LT.lt.trans_le (lt_min haabove hi) (SpecialTransformations.Section9.vfValue_min_le_sub (a i) (x i));

  {n : ℕ} (a : Fin n → DiamondIntegral.Section2.VF M), DiamondIntegral.Section6.HasUnitJacobianAt id a :=
fun {M} [inst : SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M]
    [hM : M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {n} a =>
  Exists.intro LinearMap.id
    ⟨(DiamondIntegral.Section2.hasDerivativeAt_iff_companion id a LinearMap.id).mpr
        (Eq.mpr
          (eq_of_heq
            ((fun M inst inst_1 n m f f' e'_6 a L =>
                Eq.casesOn (motive := fun a_1 x =>
                  f' = a_1 →
                    e'_6 ≍ x →
                      SpecialTransformations.Section9.HasVFDerivativeAt f a L ≍
                        SpecialTransformations.Section9.HasVFDerivativeAt f' a L)
                  e'_6
                  (fun h =>
                    Eq.ndrec (motive := fun f' =>
                      ∀ (e_6 : f = f'),
                        e_6 ≍ Eq.refl f →
                          SpecialTransformations.Section9.HasVFDerivativeAt f a L ≍
                            SpecialTransformations.Section9.HasVFDerivativeAt f' a L)
                      (fun e_6 h => HEq.refl (SpecialTransformations.Section9.HasVFDerivativeAt f a L)) (Eq.symm h)
                      e'_6)
                  (Eq.refl f') (HEq.refl e'_6))
              M inst hM n n id (fun x => LinearMap.id x + 0)
              (funext fun x => of_eq_true (Eq.trans (congrArg (Eq x) (add_zero x)) (eq_self x))) a LinearMap.id))
          (SpecialTransformations.Section9.hasVFDerivativeAt_affine LinearMap.id 0 a)),
      of_eq_true
        (Eq.trans
          (congrFun'
            (congrArg Eq
              (Eq.trans (Matrix.det.congr_simp (LinearMap.toMatrix' LinearMap.id) 1 LinearMap.toMatrix'_id)
                Matrix.det_one))
            1)
          (eq_self 1))⟩

  [inst : SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M] [hM : M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF]

    DiamondIntegral.Section6.UnitJacobianOff Set.univ (DiamondIntegral.Section6.stageExceptions stages)
      (DiamondIntegral.Section6.stageComposite stages) :=
fun {M} [SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M] [M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {n}
    stages hstage =>

      DiamondIntegral.Section6.UnitJacobianOff Set.univ (DiamondIntegral.Section6.stageExceptions stages)
        (DiamondIntegral.Section6.stageComposite stages))
    (fun hstage a x => DiamondIntegral.Section6.hasUnitJacobianAt_id a)
    (fun stage rest ih hstage =>
      DiamondIntegral.Section6.UnitJacobianOff.comp
        (hstage stage

              (Eq.trans (congrFun' (congrArg Or (eq_self stage)) (stage ∈ rest)) (true_or (stage ∈ rest))))))
        (ih fun s hs => hstage s (Eq.mpr (id DiamondIntegral.Section6.stageComposite_unit_off._simp_1_1) (Or.inr hs)))
        fun x x_1 => Set.mem_univ (stage.1 x))
    stages hstage

theorem DiamondIntegral.Section6.unaryIndexedBasePoint_update : ∀ {M : Type}
  [inst : SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M] [M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF]

fun {M} [SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M] [M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {n r s}
    p j x =>
  Prod.ext
    (funext fun i =>
      List.Mem.casesOn (motive := fun a x_1 =>
        List.finRange 1 = a →
          Fintype.complete i ≍ x_1 →
            (DiamondIntegral.Section6.unaryFamilyBasePoint (Function.update p.1 j.succ x, p.2)).1 i =
              (DiamondIntegral.Section6.unaryFamilyBasePoint p).1 i)
        (Fintype.complete i)
        (fun as h =>
          List.cons.noConfusion h fun head_eq =>
            Eq.ndrec (motive := fun i =>
              ∀ (this : i ∈ Fintype.elems),
                [] ≍ as →
                  this ≍ List.Mem.head as →
                    (DiamondIntegral.Section6.unaryFamilyBasePoint (Function.update p.1 j.succ x, p.2)).1 i =
                      (DiamondIntegral.Section6.unaryFamilyBasePoint p).1 i)
              (fun this tail_eq =>
                Eq.ndrec (motive := fun as =>
                  this ≍ List.Mem.head as →
                    (DiamondIntegral.Section6.unaryFamilyBasePoint (Function.update p.1 j.succ x, p.2)).1

                  (fun h => id (Function.update_of_ne (Ne.symm (Fin.succ_ne_zero j)) x p.1)) (eq_of_heq tail_eq))
              (eq_of_heq head_eq) (Fintype.complete i))
        (fun b {as} a h =>
          List.cons.noConfusion h fun head_eq =>
            Eq.ndrec (motive := fun b =>
              [] ≍ as →
                Fintype.complete i ≍ List.Mem.tail b a →
                  (DiamondIntegral.Section6.unaryFamilyBasePoint (Function.update p.1 j.succ x, p.2)).1 i =
                    (DiamondIntegral.Section6.unaryFamilyBasePoint p).1 i)
              (fun tail_eq =>
                Eq.ndrec (motive := fun {as} =>
                  ∀ (a : List.Mem i as),
                    Fintype.complete i ≍ List.Mem.tail ((fun i => i) ⟨0, Nat.le_refl 1⟩) a →
                      (DiamondIntegral.Section6.unaryFamilyBasePoint (Function.update p.1 j.succ x, p.2)).1 i =
                        (DiamondIntegral.Section6.unaryFamilyBasePoint p).1 i)
                  (fun a h =>
                    List.Mem.casesOn (motive := fun a_1 x_1 =>
                      [] = a_1 →
                        a ≍ x_1 →
                          (DiamondIntegral.Section6.unaryFamilyBasePoint (Function.update p.1 j.succ x, p.2)).1 i =
                            (DiamondIntegral.Section6.unaryFamilyBasePoint p).1 i)

                      (fun b {as} a_1 h => False.elim (noConfusion_of_Nat List.ctorIdx h)) (Eq.refl []) (HEq.refl a))

    {
      mp := fun a =>
        And.casesOn a fun hz hLive =>
          Eq.mpr
            (id
              (congrArg (fun _a => z ∈ _a)
                (DiamondIntegral.Section6.regularization_carrier
                  (DiamondIntegral.Section6.focusActive X.current X.liveLabels))))
            (Exists.casesOn
              (Eq.mp (congrArg (fun _a => z ∈ _a) (DiamondIntegral.Section6.regularization_carrier X.current)) hz)

                  z.2 ∈ X.canonicalLiveLabels.carrier →
                    z ∈
                      DiamondIntegral.Section6.regularize ''
                        (DiamondIntegral.Section6.focusActive X.current X.liveLabels).carrier)

                          id

                              Eq.mp

                                  (funext fun x => Fin.append_right (DiamondIntegral.Section2.tupleRV M a.1) a.2 x))

                        rfl⟩)
                  right hLive),
      mpr := fun hz =>
        Exists.casesOn
          (Eq.mp
            (congrArg (fun _a => z ∈ _a)
              (DiamondIntegral.Section6.regularization_carrier
                (DiamondIntegral.Section6.focusActive X.current X.liveLabels)))
            hz)
          fun a h =>
          And.casesOn h fun ha right =>
            right ▸

                  (id

theorem DiamondIntegral.Section6.LiveOrdinaryUnaryFrame.canonical_frozen_rvPullback : ∀ {M : Type}
  [inst : SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M]
  [inst_1 : M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {S R : Set M} {r q : ℕ}
  {hc : CanonicalStructure.IsCanonical} {A : SpecialTransformations.Section5.DefSet R 1 r}
  {hA :
    SpecialTransformations.Section5.GammaSetDefinable (DiamondIntegral.Section6.ordinaryNamedGammaBase S)
      (SpecialTransformations.Section5.carrier A)}
  (X : DiamondIntegral.Section6.LiveOrdinaryUnaryFrame hc A hA q),
  DiamondIntegral.Section2.IsRVPullback
    {p | p ∈ (DiamondIntegral.Section6.regularizeMap X.current).image.carrier ∧ p.2 ∉ X.canonicalLiveLabels.carrier} :=
fun {M} [SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M] [M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {S R}
    {r q} {hc} {A} {hA} X =>
  Set.Subset.antisymm
    (fun ⦃z⦄ hz =>
      Exists.casesOn
        ((DiamondIntegral.Section2.mem_rvHull_iff
              {p |
                p ∈ (DiamondIntegral.Section6.regularizeMap X.current).image.carrier ∧
                  p.2 ∉ X.canonicalLiveLabels.carrier}
              z).mp
          hz)
        fun p h =>
        And.casesOn h fun left right =>
          And.casesOn left fun hp hLive =>
            And.casesOn right fun hVF hRV =>
              Exists.casesOn
                (Eq.mp (congrArg (fun _a => p ∈ _a) (DiamondIntegral.Section6.regularization_carrier X.current)) hp)
                fun a h =>
                And.casesOn h fun ha right =>
                  Eq.ndrec (motive := fun p =>
                    p.2 ∉ X.canonicalLiveLabels.carrier →
                      DiamondIntegral.Section2.tupleRV M p.1 = DiamondIntegral.Section2.tupleRV M z.1 →
                        p.2 = z.2 →
                          z ∈
                            {p |
                              p ∈ (DiamondIntegral.Section6.regularizeMap X.current).image.carrier ∧
                                p.2 ∉ X.canonicalLiveLabels.carrier})
                    (fun hLive hVF hRV =>
                      have haLive :=
                        id
                          (fun hLive =>
                            Eq.mp
                              (congrArg Not
                                (congrArg (Membership.mem X.liveLabels.carrier)
                                  (funext fun x => Fin.append_right (DiamondIntegral.Section2.tupleRV M a.1) a.2 x)))
                              hLive)
                          hLive;
                      id
                        (fun hVF =>
                          let b := (z.1, a.2);
                          have hb :=
                            DiamondIntegral.Section6.rvPullback_mem_of_sameRV X.frozenPullback ⟨ha, haLive⟩ hVF rfl;
                          have he :=
                            Prod.ext (Eq.refl (DiamondIntegral.Section6.regularize b).1)
                              (id
                                (Eq.mpr
                                  (id
                                    (congrArg (fun _a => Fin.append (DiamondIntegral.Section2.tupleRV M z.1) a.2 = _a)
                                      (Eq.symm hRV)))
                                  (id
                                    (Eq.mpr
                                      (id
                                        (congrArg
                                          (fun _a =>
                                            Fin.append (DiamondIntegral.Section2.tupleRV M z.1) a.2 = Fin.append _a a.2)
                                          hVF))
                                      (Eq.refl (Fin.append (DiamondIntegral.Section2.tupleRV M z.1) a.2))))));
                          ⟨Eq.mpr
                              (id
                                (congrArg (fun _a => z ∈ _a)
                                  (DiamondIntegral.Section6.regularization_carrier X.current)))
                              (Exists.intro b ⟨hb.left, he⟩),
                            have hTail :=
                              Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => _a ∘ Fin.natAdd 1 = a.2) (Eq.symm hRV)))
                                (funext fun i => Fin.append_right (DiamondIntegral.Section2.tupleRV M a.1) a.2 i);
                            id (Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => _a ∉ X.liveLabels.carrier) hTail)) haLive)⟩)
                        hVF)
                    right hLive hVF hRV)
    (DiamondIntegral.Section2.subset_rvHull
      {p | p ∈ (DiamondIntegral.Section6.regularizeMap X.current).image.carrier ∧ p.2 ∉ X.canonicalLiveLabels.carrier})

  [inst : SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M]
  [inst_1 : M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {S R : Set M} {r q : ℕ}

      (SpecialTransformations.Section5.carrier A)}
  (X : DiamondIntegral.Section6.LiveOrdinaryUnaryFrame hc A hA q) {j : Fin r}

        E.focusData.focus u = (X.liveFrame.focusData D hD).focus u) →
      ∀ (p : ↑(DiamondIntegral.Section6.focusActive X.current X.liveLabels).carrier),
        E.core ↑p = false → (E.point ↑p).1 = (D.eta ↑(X.oldMap.toFun p)).1 :=
fun {M} [SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M] [M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {S R}
    {r q} {hc} {A} {hA} X {j} D hD E hActive hFocus p hCore =>
  if hu : (↑p).2 ∈ (X.liveFrame.activeTags D hD).carrier then
    have hEA := Eq.symm hActive ▸ hu;
    have hLocus := (DiamondIntegral.Section6.OrdinaryUnaryFocusFrame.activeTags_at X.liveFrame D hD p).mp hu;
    have hFE :=
      Eq.trans (DiamondIntegral.Section6.UnaryRelativeApertureData.extendedFocus_active E ⟨↑p, ⟨p.property.left, hEA⟩⟩)
        (Eq.trans (hFocus (↑⟨↑p, ⟨p.property.left, hEA⟩⟩).2)
          (DiamondIntegral.Section6.OrdinaryUnaryFocusFrame.focusData_value X.liveFrame D hD p hu));
    have hLeft :=
      of_eq_true
        (Eq.trans
          (congrFun'
            (congrArg Eq
              (Eq.trans
                (congrFun'
                  (congrArg Prod.fst
                    (congr
                      (congrArg Prod.mk
                        (congrArg (Function.update (↑p).1 0)
                          (Eq.trans
                            (congr (congrArg HAdd.hAdd (congrArg (HSub.hSub ((↑p).1 0)) hFE))
                              (Eq.trans
                                (ite_congr (Eq.trans (congrFun' (congrArg Eq hCore) true) Bool.false_eq_true)
                                  (fun a => Eq.refl (E.extendedEndpoint ↑p)) fun a => Eq.refl 0)
                                (ite_false (E.extendedEndpoint ↑p) 0)))
                            (add_zero ((↑p).1 0 - D.center ↑(X.oldMap.toFun p))))))
                      (congrFun'
                        (congrArg Fin.append
                          (funext fun x => DiamondIntegral.Section6.branchTag.congr_simp (E.core ↑p) false hCore))
                        (↑p).2)))

                (Function.update_self 0 ((↑p).1 0 - D.center ↑(X.oldMap.toFun p)) (↑p).1)))
            ((↑p).1 0 - D.center ↑(X.oldMap.toFun p)))
          (eq_self ((↑p).1 0 - D.center ↑(X.oldMap.toFun p))));
    have hRight :=
      of_eq_true
        (Eq.trans
          (congrFun'
            (congrArg Eq
              (Eq.trans
                (congrFun'
                  (congrArg Prod.fst
                    (Eq.trans
                      (ite_congr (Eq.refl (↑(X.oldMap.toFun p) ∈ D.locus))
                        (fun a =>
                          Eq.refl
                            (Function.update (↑(X.oldMap.toFun p)).1 0

                              (↑(X.oldMap.toFun p)).2))
                        fun a => Eq.refl ↑(X.oldMap.toFun p))
                      ((fun x_0 x_1 x_2 x_3 => (fun x_0 x_1 x_2 x_3 => if_pos hLocus) x_0 x_1 x_2 x_3)
                        (Classical.propDecidable (↑(X.oldMap.toFun p) ∈ D.locus))
                        (SpecialTransformations.Section5.Point 1 r)
                        (Function.update (↑(X.oldMap.toFun p)).1 0
                            ((↑(X.oldMap.toFun p)).1 0 - D.center ↑(X.oldMap.toFun p)),
                          (↑(X.oldMap.toFun p)).2)
                        ↑(X.oldMap.toFun p))))
                  0)
                (Function.update_self 0 ((↑(X.oldMap.toFun p)).1 0 - D.center ↑(X.oldMap.toFun p))

            ((↑(X.oldMap.toFun p)).1 0 - D.center ↑(X.oldMap.toFun p)))
          (eq_self ((↑(X.oldMap.toFun p)).1 0 - D.center ↑(X.oldMap.toFun p))));
    have hHead :=
      Eq.trans hLeft
        (Eq.trans
          (congrArg (fun x => x - D.center ↑(X.oldMap.toFun p)) (Eq.symm (congrArg (fun z => z.1 0) (X.point p))))
          (Eq.symm hRight));
    funext fun i =>
      List.Mem.casesOn (motive := fun a x =>
        List.finRange 1 = a → Fintype.complete i ≍ x → (E.point ↑p).1 i = (D.eta ↑(X.oldMap.toFun p)).1 i)
        (Fintype.complete i)
        (fun as h =>
          List.cons.noConfusion h fun head_eq =>
            Eq.ndrec (motive := fun i =>
              ∀ (this : i ∈ Fintype.elems),
                [] ≍ as → this ≍ List.Mem.head as → (E.point ↑p).1 i = (D.eta ↑(X.oldMap.toFun p)).1 i)

        ((DiamondIntegral.Section2.mem_rvHull_iff (DiamondIntegral.Section6.focusActive X.current X.liveLabels).carrier
              z).mp

          And.casesOn right fun hVF hRV =>
            let a := ⟨p, hp⟩;

            have hOldVF :=
              Eq.mpr
                (id
                  (congrArg
                    (fun _a => DiamondIntegral.Section2.tupleRV M _a.1 = DiamondIntegral.Section2.tupleRV M oldZ.1)

            have hzOld := DiamondIntegral.Section6.rvPullback_mem_of_sameRV hOld (Set.mem_range_self a) hOldVF hOldRV;

                                _a.2 = (↑(X.oldMap.toFun a)).2)

theorem DiamondIntegral.Section6.gammaTransitionConstantParameterLocus_codes_iff : ∀ {M : Type}
  [inst : SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M]
  [inst_1 : M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {p n r s : ℕ}
  (R : Set (Fin p ⊕ (Fin n ⊕ Fin r) ⊕ Fin n ⊕ Fin s → M))
  (W : Set (Fin p ⊕ (Fin n ⊕ Fin r) ⊕ DiamondIntegral.Section6.rawGammaPresentation.Index → M)) (a : Fin p → M),
  a ∈ DiamondIntegral.Section6.gammaTransitionConstantParameterLocus R W ↔
    ∀ (x : Fin n ⊕ Fin r → M) (y : Fin n ⊕ Fin s → M) (c : DiamondIntegral.Section6.rawGammaPresentation.Index → M)
      (x' : Fin n ⊕ Fin r → M) (y' : Fin n ⊕ Fin s → M) (c' : DiamondIntegral.Section6.rawGammaPresentation.Index → M),
      Sum.elim a (Sum.elim x y) ∈ R →
        Sum.elim a (Sum.elim x c) ∈ W →
          Sum.elim a (Sum.elim x' y') ∈ R →
            Sum.elim a (Sum.elim x' c') ∈ W →
              (∀ (j : Fin s), y (Sum.inr j) = y' (Sum.inr j)) →
                Sum.elim c c' ∈
                  DiamondIntegral.Section6.rawGammaPresentation.relation DiamondIntegral.Section6.rawGammaPresentation
                    Eq :=
fun {M} [SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M] [M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF]
    {p n r s} R W a =>
  {
    mp := fun h x y c x' y' c' hR hW hR' hW' hTags =>
      h (Sum.elim x (Sum.elim y c)) (Sum.elim x' (Sum.elim y' c')) ⟨hR, hW⟩ ⟨hR', hW'⟩ hTags,
    mpr := fun h z z' hz hz' hTags =>
      h (z ∘ Sum.inl) (fun i => z (Sum.inr (Sum.inl i))) (fun i => z (Sum.inr (Sum.inr i))) (z' ∘ Sum.inl)
        (fun i => z' (Sum.inr (Sum.inl i))) (fun i => z' (Sum.inr (Sum.inr i))) hz.left hz.right hz'.left hz'.right
        hTags }

  [inst : SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M]

      (hR : R.carrier ⊆ U.object.domain.carrier),

theorem DiamondIntegral.Section6.exists_measured_rv_cover_extension_step : ∀ {M : Type}
  [inst : SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M]
  [inst_1 : M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {S : Set M} {n : ℕ}
  (hc : CanonicalStructure.IsCanonical),
  0 < n →
    ∀ {U V : DiamondIntegral.Section6.MeasuredRVObject S n} (e : DiamondIntegral.Section6.MeasuredRVIso U V)
      (P Q R :
        SpecialTransformations.DefinableGeometry.DefSet (SpecialTransformations.Section4.rawRVSpace U.object.arity) S)
      (hP : P.carrier ⊆ U.object.domain.carrier) (hQ : Q.carrier ⊆ U.object.domain.carrier)
      (hR : R.carrier ⊆ U.object.domain.carrier),
      (∀ (u : ↑U.object.domain.carrier), ↑u ∈ R.carrier ↔ ↑u ∈ P.carrier ∨ ↑u ∈ Q.carrier) →
        ∀
          (T :
            DiamondIntegral.Section6.MeasuredRVUnaryChain S n (U.restrict Q hQ)
              (V.restrict (e.iso.hom.map.restrict hQ).image ⋯)),
          T.iso.iso.hom.map = (e.restrict Q hQ).iso.hom.map →
            ∃ H,
              (∀ (u : ↑(DiamondIntegral.Section6.measuredRVLabelReplacement hc e P hP).object.domain.carrier),
                  H.iso.iso.hom.map.toFun u = u) ∧
                (U.doublyBounded ∧ V.doublyBounded ∧ T.doublyBounded → H.doublyBounded) :=
fun {M} [SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M] [M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {S} {n}
    hc hn {U V} e P Q R hP hQ hR hUnion T hT =>
  let A := DiamondIntegral.Section6.measuredRVLabelReplacement hc e P hP;
  let B :=
    V.restrict (e.iso.hom.map.restrict hQ).image (SpecialTransformations.Section9.rvLabelImage_subset e.iso Q hQ);
  let D := Q.sdiff P;
  have hD := fun x hu => hQ hu.left;
  let χ := SpecialTransformations.DefinableGeometry.Map.inclusion fun x hu => hu.left;
  have hχ := fun ⦃u v⦄ he => Subtype.ext (congrArg (fun x => ↑x) he);
  have hVol := fun u =>
    Eq.symm
      (DiamondIntegral.Section6.measuredRVLabelReplacement_of_not_mem hc e P hP ⟨↑u, hQ u.property.left⟩
        u.property.right);
  Exists.casesOn (DiamondIntegral.Section6.exists_measured_rvChain_extension_from_source hc hn A T D hD χ hχ hVol)
    fun L h =>
    And.casesOn h fun hL hLB =>
      let ι := T.iso.iso.hom.map.comp χ;
      have hι := Function.Injective.comp (DiamondIntegral.Section6.rvIso_map_bijective T.iso.iso).left hχ;
      let G := DiamondIntegral.Section6.measuredRVVolumeExtension hc A B D ι hι;
      have hNew := fun u hu =>
        Eq.mpr
          (id
            (congrArg (fun _a => _a = V.object.value (e.iso.hom.map.toFun u))
              (DiamondIntegral.Section6.measuredRVVolumeExtension_of_mem hc A B D ι hι u hu)))
          (id
            (Eq.mpr
              (id
                (congrArg
                  (fun _a => B.object.value (_a.toFun (χ.toFun ⟨↑u, hu⟩)) = V.object.value (e.iso.hom.map.toFun u)) hT))
              (Eq.refl (B.object.value ((e.restrict Q hQ).iso.hom.map.toFun (χ.toFun ⟨↑u, hu⟩))))));
      have hValue := fun u =>
        if huP : ↑u ∈ P.carrier then
          have huD := fun h => h.right huP;
          Eq.mpr
            (id
              (congrArg (fun _a => _a = G.object.value u)
                (DiamondIntegral.Section6.measuredRVLabelReplacement_of_mem hc e R hR u ((hUnion u).mpr (Or.inl huP)))))
            (Eq.mpr
              (id
                (congrArg (fun _a => V.object.value (e.iso.hom.map.toFun u) = _a)
                  (DiamondIntegral.Section6.measuredRVVolumeExtension_of_not_mem hc A B D ι hι u huD)))
              (Eq.mpr
                (id
                  (congrArg (fun _a => V.object.value (e.iso.hom.map.toFun u) = _a)
                    (DiamondIntegral.Section6.measuredRVLabelReplacement_of_mem hc e P hP u huP)))
                (Eq.refl (V.object.value (e.iso.hom.map.toFun u)))))
        else
          if huQ : ↑u ∈ Q.carrier then
            have huD := ⟨huQ, huP⟩;
            Eq.mpr
              (id
                (congrArg (fun _a => _a = G.object.value u)
                  (DiamondIntegral.Section6.measuredRVLabelReplacement_of_mem hc e R hR u
                    ((hUnion u).mpr (Or.inr huQ)))))
              (Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => V.object.value (e.iso.hom.map.toFun u) = _a) (hNew u huD)))
                (Eq.refl (V.object.value (e.iso.hom.map.toFun u))))
          else
            have huD := fun h => huQ h.left;
            have huR := fun h => Or.casesOn ((hUnion u).mp h) (fun h => huP h) fun h => huQ h;
            Eq.mpr
              (id
                (congrArg (fun _a => _a = G.object.value u)
                  (DiamondIntegral.Section6.measuredRVLabelReplacement_of_not_mem hc e R hR u huR)))
              (Eq.mpr

  [inst_1 : M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {S : Set M} {n k : ℕ}
  (hc : CanonicalStructure.IsCanonical) (U : DiamondIntegral.Section6.MeasuredRVObject S n) (v : Fin k → Fin n)
  (hv : (SpecialTransformations.Section9.rvHeadVolume U.object v).FiniteFibres) (u : ↑U.object.domain.carrier),
  (DiamondIntegral.Section6.measuredRVHead hc U v hv).totalWeight u = U.totalWeight u :=
fun {M} [SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M] [M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {S}
    {n k} hc U v hv u =>
  let W := DiamondIntegral.Section6.measuredRVHead hc U v hv;
  id
    (Eq.mpr
      (id
        (congrArg
          (fun _a =>
            DiamondIntegral.Section6.gammaMapValue U.form u * _a /
                  DiamondIntegral.Section6.gammaMapValue (DiamondIntegral.Section6.rvVolumeGammaMap hc W.object) u *
                W.volumeGamma u =
              U.totalWeight u)
          (DiamondIntegral.Section6.rvVolumeGammaMap_value hc U.object U.nonzero u)))
      (Eq.mpr
        (id
          (congrArg
            (fun _a =>
              DiamondIntegral.Section6.gammaMapValue U.form u *
                      SpecialTransformations.Section9.rvVolumeGamma (U.object.value u) (U.nonzero u) /
                    _a *
                  W.volumeGamma u =
                U.totalWeight u)
            (DiamondIntegral.Section6.rvVolumeGammaMap_value hc W.object W.nonzero u)))
        (div_mul_cancel
          (DiamondIntegral.Section6.gammaMapValue U.form u *
            SpecialTransformations.Section9.rvVolumeGamma (U.object.value u) (U.nonzero u))
          (SpecialTransformations.Section9.rvVolumeGamma (W.object.value u) (W.nonzero u)))))

@DiamondIntegral.Section6.mixedDerivative_of_label_restriction : ∀ {M : Type}
  [inst : SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M]
  [inst_1 : M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {S : Set M} {n : ℕ}
  {U V : SpecialTransformations.Section4.RVObject S n}
  (A : SpecialTransformations.DefinableGeometry.DefSet (SpecialTransformations.Section4.rawRVSpace U.arity) S)
  (hA : A.carrier ⊆ U.domain.carrier)
  {B : SpecialTransformations.DefinableGeometry.DefSet (SpecialTransformations.Section4.rawMixedSpace n V.arity) S}
  (f : SpecialTransformations.DefinableGeometry.Map (SpecialTransformations.Section4.rvLift (U.restrict A hA)) B)
  (g :
    SpecialTransformations.DefinableGeometry.Map (SpecialTransformations.Section4.rvLift U)
      (SpecialTransformations.Section4.rvLift V))
  (p : ↑(SpecialTransformations.Section4.rvLift (U.restrict A hA)).carrier)
  (q : ↑(SpecialTransformations.Section4.rvLift U).carrier),
  ↑p = ↑q →
    (∀ (p' : ↑(SpecialTransformations.Section4.rvLift (U.restrict A hA)).carrier)
        (q' : ↑(SpecialTransformations.Section4.rvLift U).carrier), ↑p' = ↑q' → ↑(f.toFun p') = ↑(g.toFun q')) →
      ∀
        {L :
          (Fin n → DiamondIntegral.Section2.VF M) →ₗ[DiamondIntegral.Section2.VF M]
            Fin n → DiamondIntegral.Section2.VF M},
        SpecialTransformations.Section9.HasMixedVFDerivativeAt f.toFun p L →
          SpecialTransformations.Section9.HasMixedVFDerivativeAt g.toFun q L
theorem DiamondIntegral.Section6.mixedDerivative_of_label_restriction : ∀ {M : Type}
  [inst : SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M]
  [inst_1 : M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {S : Set M} {n : ℕ}
  {U V : SpecialTransformations.Section4.RVObject S n}
  (A : SpecialTransformations.DefinableGeometry.DefSet (SpecialTransformations.Section4.rawRVSpace U.arity) S)
  (hA : A.carrier ⊆ U.domain.carrier)
  {B : SpecialTransformations.DefinableGeometry.DefSet (SpecialTransformations.Section4.rawMixedSpace n V.arity) S}
  (f : SpecialTransformations.DefinableGeometry.Map (SpecialTransformations.Section4.rvLift (U.restrict A hA)) B)
  (g :
    SpecialTransformations.DefinableGeometry.Map (SpecialTransformations.Section4.rvLift U)
      (SpecialTransformations.Section4.rvLift V))
  (p : ↑(SpecialTransformations.Section4.rvLift (U.restrict A hA)).carrier)
  (q : ↑(SpecialTransformations.Section4.rvLift U).carrier),
  ↑p = ↑q →
    (∀ (p' : ↑(SpecialTransformations.Section4.rvLift (U.restrict A hA)).carrier)
        (q' : ↑(SpecialTransformations.Section4.rvLift U).carrier), ↑p' = ↑q' → ↑(f.toFun p') = ↑(g.toFun q')) →
      ∀
        {L :
          (Fin n → DiamondIntegral.Section2.VF M) →ₗ[DiamondIntegral.Section2.VF M]
            Fin n → DiamondIntegral.Section2.VF M},
        SpecialTransformations.Section9.HasMixedVFDerivativeAt f.toFun p L →
          SpecialTransformations.Section9.HasMixedVFDerivativeAt g.toFun q L :=
fun {M} [SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M] [M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {S} {n}
    {U V} A hA {B} f g p q hpq hagree {L} hL =>
  Exists.casesOn hL fun F h =>
    And.casesOn h fun left hD =>
      Exists.casesOn left fun ρ hρ =>
        have h₁ := congrArg Prod.fst hpq;
        have h₂ := congrArg Prod.snd hpq;
        Exists.intro F
          ⟨Exists.intro ρ fun x hx =>
              Exists.casesOn (hρ x (Eq.symm h₁ ▸ hx)) fun hxA hxF =>
                let a := ⟨(x, (↑p).2), hxA⟩;
                have hxU :=
                  h₂ ▸ ((SpecialTransformations.Section7.rvLift_restrict_mem_iff U A hA (x, (↑p).2)).mp hxA).left;
                let b := ⟨(x, (↑q).2), hxU⟩;
                have hab := hagree a b (Prod.ext rfl h₂);
                have he := hagree p q hpq;
                Exists.intro hxU
                  (id
                    (Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => _a = (F x, (↑(g.toFun q)).2)) (Eq.symm hab)))
                      (Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => _a = (F x, (↑(g.toFun q)).2)) hxF))

theorem DiamondIntegral.Section6.exists_measured_rvRoute_permutation_chain : ∀ {M : Type}
  [inst : SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M]
  [inst_1 : M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {S : Set M} {n p : ℕ}
  (hc : CanonicalStructure.IsCanonical),
  0 < n →
    ∀ (U : DiamondIntegral.Section6.MeasuredRVObject S n)
      (pool :
        SpecialTransformations.DefinableGeometry.Map U.object.domain
          (SpecialTransformations.DefinableGeometry.DefSet.univ (SpecialTransformations.Section4.rawRVSpace p) S))
      {a b : Fin n → Fin p} (C : DiamondIntegral.Section6.RVRouteFiniteData S n p U.object.arity a b)
      (hPool :
        ∀ (u : ↑U.object.domain.carrier) (k : Fin p), ↑(↑(pool.toFun u) k) ≠ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.iRVZero)
      (v : Fin n → Fin p) (e : Equiv.Perm (Fin n)) (hv : v ∈ C.route.vertices) (hw : v ∘ ⇑e ∈ C.route.vertices),
      ∃ L,
        (∀ (u : ↑(DiamondIntegral.Section6.measuredRVRouteVertex hc U pool C hPool v hv).object.domain.carrier),
            L.iso.iso.hom.map.toFun u = u) ∧
          (U.doublyBounded ∧ DiamondIntegral.Section2.RVValueDoublyBounded (Set.range fun u => ↑(pool.toFun u)) →
            L.doublyBounded) :=
fun {M} [SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M] [M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {S}
    {n p} hc hn U pool {a b} C hPool v e hv hw =>
  let A := DiamondIntegral.Section6.measuredRVRouteVertex hc U pool C hPool v hv;
  let B := DiamondIntegral.Section6.measuredRVRouteVertex hc U pool C hPool (v ∘ ⇑e) hw;
  Exists.casesOn (DiamondIntegral.Section6.exists_measured_rv_permutation_chain hc hn A e) fun T h =>
    And.casesOn h fun hT hTB =>
      let d :=
        {
          iso :=
            SpecialTransformations.Section4.rvIsoOfVolumePreservingBijection
              (SpecialTransformations.DefinableGeometry.Map.id (C.domain pool)) Function.bijective_id fun x => rfl,
          balance := fun u =>
            Eq.trans (DiamondIntegral.Section6.MeasuredRVObject.reindexVolume_totalWeight A e u)
              (Eq.trans (DiamondIntegral.Section6.measuredRVRouteVertex_totalWeight hc U pool C hPool v hv u)
                (Eq.symm
                  (DiamondIntegral.Section6.measuredRVRouteVertex_totalWeight hc U pool C hPool (v ∘ ⇑e) hw u))) };
      let i := ⟨0, hn⟩;
      have hd := fun u k hk => Eq.refl (B.object.value (d.iso.hom.map.toFun u) k);
      let H :=
        DiamondIntegral.Section6.MeasuredRVUnaryChain.step i d hd
          (DiamondIntegral.Section6.MeasuredRVUnaryChain.identity B);
      Exists.intro (T.comp H)
        ⟨fun u =>
          Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => _a = u) (DiamondIntegral.Section6.MeasuredRVUnaryChain.comp_map T H u)))
            (Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => H.iso.iso.hom.map.toFun _a = u) (hT u)))
              (Eq.refl (H.iso.iso.hom.map.toFun u))),
          fun hB =>
          have hA :=
            DiamondIntegral.Section6.measuredRVRouteVertex_doublyBounded hc U pool C hPool v hv hB.left hB.right;
          DiamondIntegral.Section6.MeasuredRVUnaryChain.comp_doublyBounded T H (hTB hA)
            ⟨DiamondIntegral.Section6.rvReindexVolume_doublyBounded A.object e hA,
              DiamondIntegral.Section6.measuredRVRouteVertex_doublyBounded hc U pool C hPool (v ∘ ⇑e) hw hB.left
                hB.right⟩⟩

theorem DiamondIntegral.Section6.tail_mem_tailReplacementIndices : ∀ {k m : ℕ} (J : Finset (Fin m)) (j : Fin m),
  (SpecialTransformations.Section7.productRight k m) j ∈ DiamondIntegral.Section6.tailReplacementIndices k J ↔ j ∈ J :=

    (of_eq_true
      (Eq.trans
        (congrFun'
          (congrArg Iff
            (Eq.trans
              (congrArg Exists
                (funext fun a =>
                  congrArg (And (a ∈ J))

                        propext
                          ((fun x_0 x_1 =>
                              Function.Injective.eq_iff
                                (Function.Embedding.injective (SpecialTransformations.Section7.productRight k m)))
                            x_0 x_1))
                      a j)))
              DiamondIntegral.Section6.tail_mem_tailReplacementIndices._simp_1_1))
          (j ∈ J))
        (iff_self (j ∈ J))))

                this))));

fun {M} [SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M] [M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {S}
    {n r k} {G} [LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero G] [Valued (DiamondIntegral.Section2.VF M) G] h00 hc {κ} hκ hs hv {A}
    {P} {hPA} F ω hConst =>
  let U := DiamondIntegral.Section6.PreparedSynchronizedFamily.taggedTarget h00 hc hκ hs hv F;
  have hSpecial :=
    DiamondIntegral.Section6.CentripetalChain.toSpecial
      (DiamondIntegral.Section6.SynchronizedCentripetalChain.toChain U.chain);
  let η := ω.comp (U.map.inverse (DiamondIntegral.Section6.SpecialCovariantChain.bijective hSpecial h00));
  have hConstU := fun p q hpq =>
    hConst p q
      (funext fun j =>
        Subtype.ext
          (have h := congrArg (fun v => ↑(v (Fin.natAdd (n + 1) j))) hpq;
          id
            (fun h =>
              Eq.mp
                (congr
                  (congrArg Eq
                    (congrArg Subtype.val
                      (Fin.append_right (DiamondIntegral.Section2.tupleRV M (↑(F.map.toFun p)).1) (↑(F.map.toFun p)).2
                        j)))
                  (congrArg Subtype.val
                    (Fin.append_right (DiamondIntegral.Section2.tupleRV M (↑(F.map.toFun q)).1) (↑(F.map.toFun q)).2
                      j)))
                h)
            h));
  Exists.intro
    { arity := U.arity, target := U.target, map := U.map, special := hSpecial, proper := U.proper,
      doublyBounded := U.doublyBounded, prepared := U.pullback,

      transport := fun p =>
        id
          (Eq.mpr
            (id
              (congrArg (fun _a => ↑(ω.toFun _a) = ↑(ω.toFun p))

        Eq.mpr
          (id
            (congrArg (fun _a => _a = DiamondIntegral.Section6.gammaFormExtension η y)

            (hConstU
              ((U.map.inverse (DiamondIntegral.Section6.SpecialCovariantChain.bijective hSpecial h00)).toFun ⟨x, hx⟩)
              ((U.map.inverse (DiamondIntegral.Section6.SpecialCovariantChain.bijective hSpecial h00)).toFun ⟨y, hy⟩)

                (id
                  (congrArg
                    (fun _a =>
                      (↑_a).2 =
                        (↑(U.map.toFun
                              ((U.map.inverse
                                    (DiamondIntegral.Section6.SpecialCovariantChain.bijective hSpecial h00)).toFun
                                ⟨y, hy⟩))).2)
                    (SpecialTransformations.DefinableGeometry.Map.apply_inverse U.map
                      (DiamondIntegral.Section6.SpecialCovariantChain.bijective hSpecial h00) ⟨x, hx⟩)))
                (Eq.mpr
                  (id
                    (congrArg (fun _a => (↑⟨x, hx⟩).2 = (↑_a).2)
                      (SpecialTransformations.DefinableGeometry.Map.apply_inverse U.map
                        (DiamondIntegral.Section6.SpecialCovariantChain.bijective hSpecial h00) ⟨y, hy⟩)))
                  hxy)))),

        ⟨DiamondIntegral.Section6.CompatibleCentripetalChain.literal_restriction h00

  [inst : CommGroupWithZero K] (op : DiamondIntegral.Section6.RVCoordinateOperation) (i j : Fin n) (x : Fin n → K),

  have hP := Eq.symm (Finset.mul_prod_erase Finset.univ x (Finset.mem_univ i));

theorem DiamondIntegral.Section6.coordinateArithmetic_slope_value : ∀ {M : Type}
  [inst : SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M]
  [inst_1 : M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] (op : DiamondIntegral.Section6.RVCoordinateOperation)
  (x y : DiamondIntegral.Section2.VF M),
  x ≠ 0 →
    y ≠ 0 →
      DiamondIntegral.Section2.vfValue (op.vfSlope x y) = DiamondIntegral.Section2.vfValue (op.fieldValue x y / x) :=

    hx hy =>
  DiamondIntegral.Section6.RVCoordinateOperation.casesOn (motive := fun t =>
    op = t →
      DiamondIntegral.Section2.vfValue (op.vfSlope x y) = DiamondIntegral.Section2.vfValue (op.fieldValue x y / x))
    op

      Eq.symm h ▸
        id

                        y⁻¹))))
                (eq_self y⁻¹)))))
    (fun h =>
      Eq.symm h ▸
        id

                (have this := SpecialTransformations.Section9.vfValue_neg (y * x⁻¹ ^ 2);

fun {M} [inst : SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M] [M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF]
    {n r} {S} {A} {B} {G} [LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero G] [Valued (DiamondIntegral.Section2.VF M) G] hv f γ hA hf
    u =>
  let first := fun x => x ∘ Fin.castAdd n;
  let second := fun x => x ∘ Fin.natAdd n;
  let E :=
    first ⁻¹' DiamondIntegral.Section2.vfFibre A.carrier u ∩ second ⁻¹' DiamondIntegral.Section2.vfFibre A.carrier u;
  have hFirst := continuous_pi fun x => continuous_apply (Fin.castAdd n x);
  have hSecond := continuous_pi fun x => continuous_apply (Fin.natAdd n x);
  have hE :=
    IsClopen.inter (IsClopen.preimage (DiamondIntegral.Section6.ProperInvariant.clopen_fibres hv hA u) hFirst)
      (IsClopen.preimage (DiamondIntegral.Section6.ProperInvariant.clopen_fibres hv hA u) hSecond);
  have hScalar :=
    Continuous.comp_continuousOn (continuous_apply 0)
      (DiamondIntegral.Section6.totalFocusFibre_continuousOn f u (hf u));
  let difference := fun x =>
    DiamondIntegral.Section6.totalFocusFibre f u (first x) 0 -
      DiamondIntegral.Section6.totalFocusFibre f u (second x) 0;
  have hDiff :=
    ContinuousOn.sub (ContinuousOn.comp hScalar (Continuous.continuousOn hFirst) fun x h => h.left)
      (ContinuousOn.comp hScalar (Continuous.continuousOn hSecond) fun x h => h.right);
  have hBall := DiamondIntegral.Section6.scalarBall_isClopen hv γ;
  have hRel :=
    ⟨ContinuousOn.preimage_isClosed_of_isClosed hDiff (IsClopen.isClosed hE) (IsClopen.isClosed hBall),
      ContinuousOn.isOpen_inter_preimage hDiff (IsClopen.isOpen hE) (IsClopen.isOpen hBall)⟩;
  Eq.mpr
    (eq_of_heq
      ((fun X inst s s' e'_3 =>
          Eq.casesOn (motive := fun a x => s' = a → e'_3 ≍ x → IsClopen s ≍ IsClopen s') e'_3

              Eq.ndrec (motive := fun s' => ∀ (e_3 : s = s'), e_3 ≍ Eq.refl s → IsClopen s ≍ IsClopen s')

            (Eq.refl s') (HEq.refl e'_3))
        (Fin (n + n) → DiamondIntegral.Section2.VF M) Pi.topologicalSpace
        (DiamondIntegral.Section2.vfFibre (DiamondIntegral.Section6.focusCongruenceRelation f γ) u)
        (E ∩ difference ⁻¹' {x | ↑γ < DiamondIntegral.Section2.vfValue x})
        (Set.ext fun x =>
          id
            (Eq.mpr

theorem DiamondIntegral.Section6.exists_mixed_unit_derivative_exception : ∀ {M : Type}
  [inst : SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M] [hM : M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF]

  {A : SpecialTransformations.DefinableGeometry.DefSet (SpecialTransformations.Section4.rawMixedSpace n r) S}
  {B : SpecialTransformations.DefinableGeometry.DefSet (SpecialTransformations.Section4.rawMixedSpace n s) S},

    ∀ {κ : Cardinal.{0}},
      SpecialTransformations.Section3.Saturated M κ →
        Cardinal.mk ↑S < κ →
          0 < n →
            ∀ (f : SpecialTransformations.DefinableGeometry.Map A B),

                  AlgebraicIndependent (↥(SpecialTransformations.Section3.vfParameterField S)) (↑p).1 →
                    DiamondIntegral.Section6.HasMixedUnitDerivativeAt f p) →
                ∃ E,
                  E.carrier ⊆ A.carrier ∧
                    SpecialTransformations.Section4.vfDim (SpecialTransformations.Section4.rawRVSpace 1) E < n ∧
                      ∀ (p : ↑A.carrier), ↑p ∉ E.carrier → DiamondIntegral.Section6.HasMixedUnitDerivativeAt f p :=
fun {M} [SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M] [M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {n r s}
    {S} {A} {B} hc {κ} hs hsmall hn f hgeneric =>
  let P := SpecialTransformations.Section4.rawMixedSpace n r;
  let D := SpecialTransformations.Section9.mixedDerivativeLocus f fun D => D.det = 1;
  let E :=
    { carrier := A.carrier \ D,
      definable :=
        SpecialTransformations.DefinableGeometry.Space.Definable.sdiff P A.definable
          (SpecialTransformations.Section9.mixedJacobianOneLocus_definable hn f) };
  Exists.intro E
    ⟨Set.sdiff_subset,
      ⟨SpecialTransformations.Section9.mixed_vfDim_lt_of_no_independent hc hs hsmall
          (SpecialTransformations.Section4.rawRVSpace 1) (SpecialTransformations.Section4.rawRVSpace_rvCoded 1) hn E

              p.property.right

                  ⟨rfl,
                    Exists.intro (LinearMap.toMatrix' L)
                      ⟨hdet,
                        Eq.mpr
                          (id
                            (congrArg (SpecialTransformations.Section9.HasMixedVFDerivativeAt f.toFun q)
                              (Matrix.toLin'_toMatrix' L)))
                          hL⟩⟩),
        fun p hp =>
        have hgood := Classical.byContradiction fun h => hp ⟨p.property, h⟩;
        Exists.casesOn hgood fun q h =>
          And.casesOn h fun hq right =>
            Exists.casesOn right fun L h =>
              And.casesOn h fun hdet hL =>
                have he := Subtype.ext hq;
                Eq.ndrec (motive := fun q =>
                  ↑q = ↑p →
                    SpecialTransformations.Section9.HasMixedVFDerivativeAt f.toFun q (Matrix.toLin' L) →
                      DiamondIntegral.Section6.HasMixedUnitDerivativeAt f p)
                  (fun hq hL =>
                    Exists.intro (Matrix.toLin' L)
                      ⟨hL, Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => _a.det = 1) (LinearMap.toMatrix'_toLin' L))) hdet⟩)
                  (Eq.symm he) hq hL⟩⟩

  Exists.casesOn hL fun F h =>
    And.casesOn h fun left hF =>
      Exists.casesOn left fun ρ hρ =>
        let D := LinearMap.pi fun x => LinearMap.proj i ∘ₗ L;
        Exists.intro D
          (Exists.intro (fun x x_1 => F x i)
            ⟨Exists.intro ρ fun x hx =>
                Exists.casesOn (hρ x hx) fun hxA hxF =>
                  Exists.intro hxA
                    (have h := congrArg (fun z => z.1 i) hxF;
                    id
                      (fun h =>
                        funext fun j =>
                          List.Mem.casesOn (motive := fun a x_1 =>

                                          h)

                                  (eq_of_heq head_eq) (Fintype.complete j))
                            (fun b {as} a h =>
                              List.cons.noConfusion h fun head_eq =>
                                Eq.ndrec (motive := fun b =>
                                  [] ≍ as →
                                    Fintype.complete j ≍ List.Mem.tail b a →
                                      ↑(f.toFun ⟨(x, (↑p).2), hxA⟩) j = (fun x x_1 => F x i) x j)

                                    Eq.ndrec (motive := fun {as} =>
                                      ∀ (a : List.Mem j as),
                                        Fintype.complete j ≍ List.Mem.tail ((fun i => i) ⟨0, Nat.le_refl 1⟩) a →

                                      (fun a h =>
                                        List.Mem.casesOn (motive := fun a_1 x_1 =>
                                          [] = a_1 →
                                            a ≍ x_1 → ↑(f.toFun ⟨(x, (↑p).2), hxA⟩) j = (fun x x_2 => F x i) x j)

                                      (eq_of_heq tail_eq) a)

  [inst : SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M]

    SpecialTransformations.DefinableGeometry.Map A

  (∃ ρ, ∀ x ∈ SpecialTransformations.Section9.vfBall (↑p).1 ρ, (x, (↑p).2) ∈ A.carrier) →
    (∀ (j : Fin m),
        ∃ L,

  (fun L hL =>
      (fun F x =>
          (fun ρ hρ =>
              Exists.casesOn hOpen fun ρ₀ hρ₀ =>
                let R := insert ρ₀ (Finset.image ρ Finset.univ);
                have hR := Exists.intro ρ₀ (Finset.mem_insert_self ρ₀ (Finset.image ρ Finset.univ));
                let δ := R.max' hR;
                have hδ₀ := Finset.le_max' R ρ₀ (Finset.mem_insert_self ρ₀ (Finset.image ρ Finset.univ));
                have hδ := fun j =>
                  Finset.le_max' R (ρ j)
                    (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem (Finset.mem_image.mpr (Exists.intro j ⟨Finset.mem_univ j, rfl⟩)));
                let D := LinearMap.pi fun j => LinearMap.proj 0 ∘ₗ L j;

                  (Exists.intro (fun x j => F j x 0)
                    ⟨Exists.intro δ fun x hx =>
                        have hxA := hρ₀ x (SpecialTransformations.Section9.vfBall_anti hδ₀ hx);
                        Exists.intro hxA
                          (funext fun j =>
                            Exists.casesOn (hρ j x (SpecialTransformations.Section9.vfBall_anti (hδ j) hx))
                              fun hxA' hval => congrFun hval 0),
                      SpecialTransformations.Section9.hasVFDerivativeAt_of_components D fun j =>
                        SpecialTransformations.Section9.HasVFDerivativeAt.component ((fun j => (x j).right) j) 0⟩))
            (fun j => Classical.choose ((fun j => (x j).left) j)) fun j =>
            Classical.choose_spec ((fun j => (x j).left) j))
        (fun j => Classical.choose (hL j)) fun j => Classical.choose_spec (hL j))
    (fun j => Classical.choose (hScalar j)) fun j => Classical.choose_spec (hScalar j)

  [inst : SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M]
  [inst_1 : M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {G : Type} [inst_2 : LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero G]
  [inst_3 : Valued (DiamondIntegral.Section2.VF M) G],

      IsClopen (DiamondIntegral.Section6.FMT.vfOpenBall D) :=
fun {M} [inst : SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M] [M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF]
    {G} [LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero G] [inst_3 : Valued (DiamondIntegral.Section2.VF M) G] hv D =>
  Exists.casesOn (Quotient.exists_rep D) fun q h =>
    h ▸
      id
        (Eq.mpr
          (id
            (congrArg (fun _a => IsClopen _a)
              (SpecialTransformations.Section3.OpenBallCodes.ball_eq_open Valued.v hv (↑q) q.property)))
          (let a := ⟨↑q 0, q.property.left 0⟩;
          let r := ⟨↑q 1, q.property.left 1⟩;
          id
            (have hcl :=
              IsClopen.preimage (Valued.isClopen_ball (DiamondIntegral.Section2.VF M) (Valued.v.restrict r))
                (Continuous.sub continuous_id continuous_const);
            Eq.mpr
              (eq_of_heq
                ((fun X inst s s' e'_3 =>
                    Eq.casesOn (motive := fun a x => s' = a → e'_3 ≍ x → IsClopen s ≍ IsClopen s') e'_3
                      (fun h =>
                        Eq.ndrec (motive := fun s' => ∀ (e_3 : s = s'), e_3 ≍ Eq.refl s → IsClopen s ≍ IsClopen s')
                          (fun e_3 h => HEq.refl (IsClopen s)) (Eq.symm h) e'_3)
                      (Eq.refl s') (HEq.refl e'_3))
                  (DiamondIntegral.Section2.VF M) inst_3.toTopologicalSpace {x | Valued.v (x - a) < Valued.v r}
                  ((id - fun x => a) ⁻¹' {x | Valued.v.restrict x < Valued.v.restrict r})
                  (Set.ext fun x => Iff.symm (Valuation.restrict_lt_iff Valued.v))))
              hcl)))

theorem DiamondIntegral.Section6.FMT.sameOpenRadius_separated : ∀ {M : Type}
  [inst : SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M]
  [inst_1 : M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {G : Type} [inst_2 : LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero G]
  [inst_3 : Valued (DiamondIntegral.Section2.VF M) G]
  (A : Set (SpecialTransformations.Section3.OpenBallCodes.OpenBall M)) (r : DiamondIntegral.Section2.VF M),
  DiamondIntegral.Section6.FMT.SameOpenRadius A r →
    ∀ (D E : ↑A),
      ∀ x ∈ SpecialTransformations.Section3.OpenBallCodes.underlying ↑D,
        x ∈ SpecialTransformations.Section3.OpenBallCodes.underlying ↑E → D = E :=
fun {M} [SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M] [M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {G}
    [LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero G] [Valued (DiamondIntegral.Section2.VF M) G] A r hR D E x hx hE =>
  Exists.casesOn (hR (↑D) D.property) fun a ha =>
    Exists.casesOn (hR (↑E) E.property) fun b hb =>
      let z := ⟨x, SpecialTransformations.Section3.OpenBallCodes.underlying_subset_vf (↑D) hx⟩;
      have hza := (Set.ext_iff.mp ha z).mp hx;
      have hzb := (Set.ext_iff.mp hb z).mp hE;
      have he :=
        Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => _a = DiamondIntegral.Section6.FMT.vfOpenBall ↑E) ha))
          (Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => {x | Valued.v (x - a) < Valued.v r} = _a) hb))
            (Set.ext fun y =>
              Iff.trans (Iff.symm (SpecialTransformations.Section3.Balls.strictDisc_recenter_iff Valued.v a z y r hza))
                (SpecialTransformations.Section3.Balls.strictDisc_recenter_iff Valued.v b z y r hzb)));
      Subtype.ext
        (SpecialTransformations.Section3.OpenBallCodes.underlying_injective
          (Set.ext fun y =>
            if hy : SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.iVF y then Set.ext_iff.mp he ⟨y, hy⟩
            else
              iff_of_false (fun h => hy (SpecialTransformations.Section3.OpenBallCodes.underlying_subset_vf (↑D) h))
                fun h => hy (SpecialTransformations.Section3.OpenBallCodes.underlying_subset_vf (↑E) h)))

@DiamondIntegral.Section6.relation_interior_radius_family_definable : ∀ {M : Type}

theorem DiamondIntegral.Section6.relation_interior_radius_family_definable : ∀ {M : Type}
  [inst : SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M]
  [inst_1 : M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {n : ℕ},
  CanonicalStructure.IsCanonical →
    ∀ {S : Set M} (D : Set (Fin n → DiamondIntegral.Section2.VF M)),
      S.Definable SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV (SpecialTransformations.Section4.vfValues '' D) →
        ∀ (R : (Fin n → DiamondIntegral.Section2.VF M) → (Fin n → DiamondIntegral.Section2.VF M) → Prop),
          S.Definable SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV (DiamondIntegral.Section6.rawVFRelation R) →
            S.Definable SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV
              (DiamondIntegral.Section6.vfGammaFamilyCodes D fun a =>
                DiamondIntegral.Section6.InteriorRadii {b | R a b} a) :=
fun {M} [inst : SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M] [M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF]
    {n} hc {S} D hD R hR =>
  let C :=
    {z |
      z ∘ Sum.inl ∈ SpecialTransformations.Section4.vfValues '' D ∧
        SpecialTransformations.Section3.GammaParameters.NonzeroRV (z (Sum.inr 0)) ∧
          1 ≤ SpecialTransformations.Section3.GammaParameters.codeValue (z (Sum.inr 0)) ∧
            ∀ (y : Fin n → M),
              Sum.elim z y ∘ DiamondIntegral.Section6.relationBallIndex✝ n ∈
                  DiamondIntegral.Section2.rawGammaBallRelation n →
                Sum.elim z y ∘ DiamondIntegral.Section6.relationPairIndex✝ n ∈
                  DiamondIntegral.Section6.rawVFRelation R};
  have hbad :=
    Set.Definable.exists_of_finite
      (Set.Definable.inter
        (Set.Definable.preimage_comp (DiamondIntegral.Section6.relationBallIndex✝ n)
          (DiamondIntegral.Section2.rawGammaBallRelation_definable S n))
        (Set.Definable.compl (Set.Definable.preimage_comp (DiamondIntegral.Section6.relationPairIndex✝ n) hR)));
  have hbound := Set.Definable.preimage_comp Sum.inr (DiamondIntegral.Section6.gamma_ge_one_codes_definable hc S);
  have hC :=
    Eq.mpr
      (eq_of_heq
        ((fun M A L inst α s s' e'_6 =>
            Eq.casesOn (motive := fun a x => s' = a → e'_6 ≍ x → A.Definable L s ≍ A.Definable L s') e'_6
              (fun h =>
                Eq.ndrec (motive := fun s' => ∀ (e_6 : s = s'), e_6 ≍ Eq.refl s → A.Definable L s ≍ A.Definable L s')
                  (fun e_6 h => HEq.refl (A.Definable L s)) (Eq.symm h) e'_6)
              (Eq.refl s') (HEq.refl e'_6))
          M S SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV inst (Fin n ⊕ Fin 1) C
          ((fun g => g ∘ Sum.inl) ⁻¹' SpecialTransformations.Section4.vfValues '' D ∩
            ((fun g => g ∘ Sum.inr) ⁻¹'
                {z |
                  SpecialTransformations.Section3.GammaParameters.NonzeroRV (z 0) ∧
                    1 ≤ SpecialTransformations.Section3.GammaParameters.codeValue (z 0)} ∩
              {v |
                  ∃ u,
                    Sum.elim v u ∈
                      (fun g => g ∘ DiamondIntegral.Section6.relationBallIndex✝ n) ⁻¹'
                          DiamondIntegral.Section2.rawGammaBallRelation n ∩
                        ((fun g => g ∘ DiamondIntegral.Section6.relationPairIndex✝ n) ⁻¹'
                            DiamondIntegral.Section6.rawVFRelation R)ᶜ}ᶜ))
          (Set.ext fun z =>
            {
              mp := fun a =>
                And.casesOn a fun ha right =>
                  And.casesOn right fun ht right =>
                    And.casesOn right fun hb hall =>
                      ⟨ha,
                        ⟨⟨ht, hb⟩, fun a => Exists.casesOn a fun y h => And.casesOn h fun hy hno => hno (hall y hy)⟩⟩,
              mpr := fun a =>
                And.casesOn a fun ha right =>
                  And.casesOn right fun left hno =>
                    And.casesOn left fun ht hb =>
                      ⟨ha,
                        ⟨ht, ⟨hb, fun y hy => Classical.byContradiction fun hn => hno (Exists.intro y ⟨hy, hn⟩)⟩⟩⟩ })))
      (Set.Definable.inter (Set.Definable.preimage_comp Sum.inl hD)
        (Set.Definable.inter hbound (Set.Definable.compl hbad)));
  Eq.mpr
    (eq_of_heq
      ((fun M A L inst α s s' e'_6 =>
          Eq.casesOn (motive := fun a x => s' = a → e'_6 ≍ x → A.Definable L s ≍ A.Definable L s') e'_6
            (fun h =>
              Eq.ndrec (motive := fun s' => ∀ (e_6 : s = s'), e_6 ≍ Eq.refl s → A.Definable L s ≍ A.Definable L s')
                (fun e_6 h => HEq.refl (A.Definable L s)) (Eq.symm h) e'_6)
            (Eq.refl s') (HEq.refl e'_6))
        M S SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV inst (Fin n ⊕ Fin 1)
        (DiamondIntegral.Section6.vfGammaFamilyCodes D fun a => DiamondIntegral.Section6.InteriorRadii {b | R a b} a) C
        (Set.ext fun z =>
          {
            mp := fun a =>
              And.casesOn a fun ht right =>
                Exists.casesOn right fun a h =>
                  And.casesOn h fun ha right =>
                    And.casesOn right fun he right =>
                      And.casesOn right fun hbound hall =>
                        ⟨Exists.intro a ⟨ha, he⟩,
                          ⟨ht,
                            ⟨hbound, fun y hy =>
                              let b := fun i => ⟨y i, hy.right.right.left i⟩;
                              have hball :=
                                (DiamondIntegral.Section2.rawGammaBallRelation_iff a b (z (Sum.inr 0)) ht).mp
                                  (let b := fun i => ⟨y i, hy.right.right.left i⟩;
                                  Eq.mp
                                    (congrArg (fun _a => _a ∈ DiamondIntegral.Section2.rawGammaBallRelation n)
                                      (DiamondIntegral.Section6.relationBallIndex_at✝ a z he y))
                                    hy);
                              have hR' := (DiamondIntegral.Section6.rawVFRelation_at R a b).mpr (hall hball);
                              Eq.mpr
                                (id
                                  (congrArg (fun _a => _a ∈ DiamondIntegral.Section6.rawVFRelation R)
                                    (DiamondIntegral.Section6.relationPairIndex_at✝ a z he y)))
                                hR'⟩⟩⟩,
            mpr := fun a =>
              And.casesOn a fun left right =>
                Exists.casesOn left fun a h =>
                  And.casesOn h fun ha he =>
                    And.casesOn right fun ht right =>
                      And.casesOn right fun hbound hall =>
                        ⟨ht,
                          Exists.intro a
                            ⟨ha,
                              ⟨he,
                                ⟨hbound, fun b hb =>
                                  have hball :=
                                    (DiamondIntegral.Section2.rawGammaBallRelation_iff a b (z (Sum.inr 0)) ht).mpr hb;
                                  have hR' :=
                                    hall (SpecialTransformations.Section4.vfValues b)
                                      (Eq.mpr
                                        (id
                                          (congrArg (fun _a => _a ∈ DiamondIntegral.Section2.rawGammaBallRelation n)
                                            (DiamondIntegral.Section6.relationBallIndex_at✝ a z he
                                              (SpecialTransformations.Section4.vfValues b))))
                                        hball);
                                  (DiamondIntegral.Section6.rawVFRelation_at R a b).mp
                                    (Eq.mp
                                      (congrArg (fun _a => _a ∈ DiamondIntegral.Section6.rawVFRelation R)

@DiamondIntegral.Section6.open_partition_piece_isClopen : ∀ {X : Type u_1} {I : Type u_2} [inst : TopologicalSpace X]
  (D : Set X),
  IsClopen D →
    ∀ (P : I → Set X),
      (∀ (i : I), P i ⊆ D) →
        (∀ (i : I), IsOpen (P i)) →
          (∀ x ∈ D, ∃ i, x ∈ P i) → (∀ (i j : I), i ≠ j → Disjoint (P i) (P j)) → ∀ (i : I), IsClopen (P i)
theorem DiamondIntegral.Section6.open_partition_piece_isClopen.{u_1, u_2} : ∀ {X : Type u_1} {I : Type u_2}
  [inst : TopologicalSpace X] (D : Set X),
  IsClopen D →
    ∀ (P : I → Set X),
      (∀ (i : I), P i ⊆ D) →
        (∀ (i : I), IsOpen (P i)) →
          (∀ x ∈ D, ∃ i, x ∈ P i) → (∀ (i j : I), i ≠ j → Disjoint (P i) (P j)) → ∀ (i : I), IsClopen (P i) :=
fun {X} {I} [TopologicalSpace X] D hD P hsub hopen hcover hdisjoint i =>
  have he :=
    Set.ext fun x =>
      {
        mp := fun hx =>
          if hxD : x ∈ D then
            Exists.casesOn (hcover x hxD) fun j hj =>
              have hji := fun he => hx (he ▸ hj);
              Or.inr (Set.mem_iUnion.mpr (Exists.intro ⟨j, hji⟩ hj))
          else Or.inl hxD,
        mpr := fun a =>
          Or.casesOn a (fun hx hxi => hx (hsub i hxi)) fun hx =>
            Exists.casesOn (Set.mem_iUnion.mp hx) fun j hj hxi =>
              Set.disjoint_left.mp (hdisjoint (↑j) i j.property) hj hxi };
  ⟨isOpen_compl_iff.mp
      (Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => IsOpen _a) he))
        (IsOpen.union IsClosed.isOpen_compl (isOpen_iUnion fun j => hopen ↑j))),
    hopen i⟩

theorem DiamondIntegral.Section6.unary_zero_projection_finite : ∀ {M : Type}
  [inst : SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M]
  [inst_1 : M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {r : ℕ} (A : Set (DiamondIntegral.Section2.Mixed M 1 r)),
  (Prod.fst '' {p | p ∈ A ∧ p.1 0 = 0}).Finite :=
fun {M} [SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M] [M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {r} A =>
  Set.Finite.subset (Set.finite_singleton 0) fun ⦃x⦄ a =>
    Exists.casesOn a fun p h =>
      And.casesOn h fun hp right =>
        right ▸
          Set.mem_singleton_iff.mpr
            (funext fun i =>
              List.Mem.casesOn (motive := fun a x => List.finRange 1 = a → Fintype.complete i ≍ x → p.1 i = 0 i)
                (Fintype.complete i)
                (fun as h =>
                  List.cons.noConfusion h fun head_eq =>
                    Eq.ndrec (motive := fun i =>
                      ∀ (this : i ∈ Fintype.elems), [] ≍ as → this ≍ List.Mem.head as → p.1 i = 0 i)
                      (fun this tail_eq =>
                        Eq.ndrec (motive := fun as =>

theorem DiamondIntegral.Section6.OrdinaryUnaryFocusFrame.activeTags_at : ∀ {M : Type}
  [inst : SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M]
  [inst_1 : M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {S R : Set M} {r q : ℕ}
  {hc : CanonicalStructure.IsCanonical} {A : SpecialTransformations.Section5.DefSet R 1 r}
  {hA :
    SpecialTransformations.Section5.GammaSetDefinable (DiamondIntegral.Section6.ordinaryNamedGammaBase S)
      (SpecialTransformations.Section5.carrier A)}
  (X : DiamondIntegral.Section6.OrdinaryUnaryFocusFrame hc A hA q) {j : Fin r}
  (D : SpecialTransformations.Section5.Focus A 0 j)
  (hD : SpecialTransformations.Section5.GammaFocusDefinable (DiamondIntegral.Section6.ordinaryNamedGammaBase S) D)
  (p : ↑X.source.carrier), (↑p).2 ∈ (X.activeTags D hD).carrier ↔ ↑(X.oldMap.toFun p) ∈ D.locus :=
fun {M} [SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M] [M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {S R}
    {r q} {hc} {A} {hA} X {j} D hD p =>
  {
    mp := fun a =>
      Exists.casesOn a fun a ha =>
        Exists.casesOn a.property fun b h =>
          And.casesOn h fun hb hLocus =>
            id
              (fun ha =>
                have hTags := Eq.trans (congrArg Prod.snd hb) ha;
                have hVF :=
                  Eq.mpr
                    (id
                      (congrArg
                        (fun _a =>
                          DiamondIntegral.Section2.tupleRV M _a.1 =
                            DiamondIntegral.Section2.tupleRV M (↑(X.oldMap.toFun p)).1)
                        (X.point b)))
                    (Eq.mpr
                      (id
                        (congrArg
                          (fun _a =>
                            DiamondIntegral.Section2.tupleRV M ((↑b).1, (↑b).2 ∘ X.labels).1 =
                              DiamondIntegral.Section2.tupleRV M _a.1)
                          (X.point p)))
                      (X.tagged (↑b) b.property (↑p) p.property hTags));
                have hRV :=
                  Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => _a.2 = (↑(X.oldMap.toFun p)).2) (X.point b)))
                    (Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => ((↑b).1, (↑b).2 ∘ X.labels).2 = _a.2) (X.point p)))
                      (Eq.mpr
                        (id (congrArg (fun _a => ((↑b).1, _a ∘ X.labels).2 = ((↑p).1, (↑p).2 ∘ X.labels).2) hTags))
                        (Eq.refl ((↑b).1, (↑p).2 ∘ X.labels).2)));
                DiamondIntegral.Section6.rvPullback_mem_of_sameRV
                  ((DiamondIntegral.Section6.ordinary_pullback_iff D.locus).mp D.locus_pullback) hLocus hVF hRV)
              ha,
    mpr := fun hp => Exists.intro ⟨↑p, Exists.intro p ⟨rfl, hp⟩⟩ rfl }

@DiamondIntegral.Section6.rawMixed_relation_values : ∀ {M : Type}
  [inst : SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M] [M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF]
  {n m r s : ℕ} (R : DiamondIntegral.Section2.Mixed M n r → DiamondIntegral.Section2.Mixed M m s → Prop),
  (SpecialTransformations.Section4.rawMixedSpace n r).relation (SpecialTransformations.Section4.rawMixedSpace m s) R =
    {z |
      ∃ p q,
        R p q ∧
          Sum.elim (SpecialTransformations.Section4.mixedValues p) (SpecialTransformations.Section4.mixedValues q) = z}
theorem DiamondIntegral.Section6.rawMixed_relation_values : ∀ {M : Type}
  [inst : SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M] [M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF]
  {n m r s : ℕ} (R : DiamondIntegral.Section2.Mixed M n r → DiamondIntegral.Section2.Mixed M m s → Prop),
  (SpecialTransformations.Section4.rawMixedSpace n r).relation (SpecialTransformations.Section4.rawMixedSpace m s) R =
    {z |
      ∃ p q,
        R p q ∧
          Sum.elim (SpecialTransformations.Section4.mixedValues p) (SpecialTransformations.Section4.mixedValues q) =
            z} :=
fun {M} [SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M] [M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF]
    {n m r s} R =>
  Set.ext fun z =>
    {
      mp := fun a =>
        Exists.casesOn a fun hp h =>
          Exists.casesOn h fun hq hR =>
            let p := (SpecialTransformations.Section4.rawMixedSpace n r).decode ⟨z ∘ Sum.inl, hp⟩;
            let q := (SpecialTransformations.Section4.rawMixedSpace m s).decode ⟨z ∘ Sum.inr, hq⟩;
            Exists.intro p
              (Exists.intro q
                ⟨hR,
                  funext fun i =>
                    Sum.casesOn (motive := fun t =>
                      i = t →
                        Sum.elim (SpecialTransformations.Section4.mixedValues p)
                            (SpecialTransformations.Section4.mixedValues q) i =
                          z i)
                      i
                      (fun i_1 h =>
                        Eq.symm h ▸ congrFun (SpecialTransformations.Section4.mixedValues_decode ⟨z ∘ Sum.inl, hp⟩) i_1)
                      (fun i_1 h =>
                        Eq.symm h ▸ congrFun (SpecialTransformations.Section4.mixedValues_decode ⟨z ∘ Sum.inr, hq⟩) i_1)
                      (Eq.refl i)⟩),
      mpr := fun a =>
        Exists.casesOn a fun p h =>
          Exists.casesOn h fun q h =>
            And.casesOn h fun hR right =>
              right ▸
                have h :=
                  SpecialTransformations.DefinableGeometry.Space.relation_decode
                    (SpecialTransformations.Section4.rawMixedSpace n r)
                    (SpecialTransformations.Section4.rawMixedSpace m s) R
                    ⟨SpecialTransformations.Section4.mixedValues p,
                      SpecialTransformations.Section4.mixedValues_mem_domain p⟩
                    ⟨SpecialTransformations.Section4.mixedValues q,
                      SpecialTransformations.Section4.mixedValues_mem_domain q⟩;
                (Eq.mp
                      (congrArg
                        (fun _a =>
                          Sum.elim
                                ↑⟨SpecialTransformations.Section4.mixedValues p,
                                    SpecialTransformations.Section4.mixedValues_mem_domain p⟩
                                ↑⟨SpecialTransformations.Section4.mixedValues q,
                                    SpecialTransformations.Section4.mixedValues_mem_domain q⟩ ∈
                              (SpecialTransformations.Section4.rawMixedSpace n r).relation
                                (SpecialTransformations.Section4.rawMixedSpace m s) R ↔
                            R p _a)
                        (SpecialTransformations.Section4.decode_mixedValues q))
                      (Eq.mp
                        (congrArg
                          (fun _a =>
                            Sum.elim
                                  ↑⟨SpecialTransformations.Section4.mixedValues p,
                                      SpecialTransformations.Section4.mixedValues_mem_domain p⟩
                                  ↑⟨SpecialTransformations.Section4.mixedValues q,
                                      SpecialTransformations.Section4.mixedValues_mem_domain q⟩ ∈
                                (SpecialTransformations.Section4.rawMixedSpace n r).relation
                                  (SpecialTransformations.Section4.rawMixedSpace m s) R ↔
                              R _a
                                ((SpecialTransformations.Section4.rawMixedSpace m s).decode
                                  ⟨SpecialTransformations.Section4.mixedValues q,
                                    SpecialTransformations.Section4.mixedValues_mem_domain q⟩))
                          (SpecialTransformations.Section4.decode_mixedValues p))
                        h)).mpr
                  hR }

    {n m r s} R =>
  Set.ext fun z =>
    {
      mp := fun a =>
        Exists.casesOn a fun hx h =>

                          Sum.elim

                                  SpecialTransformations.Section4.mixedValues_mem_domain q⟩))
                        (SpecialTransformations.Section4.decode_mixedValues p))

                hR),
      mpr := fun a =>
        Exists.casesOn a fun hx h =>
          Exists.casesOn h fun hy hR =>
            let p := (SpecialTransformations.Section4.rawMixedSpace n r).decode ⟨z ∘ Sum.inl, hx⟩;

              ∀ (this : i ∈ Fintype.elems), [] ≍ as → this ≍ List.Mem.head as → p.1 i = q.1 i)

    hCoord hActive hFocus hCore p =>
  if hu : (↑p).2 ∈ (X.activeTags D hD).carrier then
    have hEA := Eq.symm hActive ▸ hu;

  [inst : SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M]
  [inst_1 : M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {R : Set M} {r s : ℕ}
  {A : SpecialTransformations.Section5.DefSet R 1 r} {B : SpecialTransformations.Section5.DefSet R 1 s}
  (T : SpecialTransformations.Section5.Chain R 1 A B) (E : Set ↑A.carrier)
  (ρ : ↑A.carrier → DiamondIntegral.Section2.Gamma M),
  DiamondIntegral.Section6.ordinaryOutsideCoreImage T E ρ =
    SpecialTransformations.Section5.carrier B \ DiamondIntegral.Section6.ordinaryTargetCoreUnion T E ρ :=
fun {M} [SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M] [M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {R}
    {r s} {A} {B} T E ρ =>
  Set.ext fun q =>
    {
      mp := fun a =>
        Exists.casesOn a fun a h =>
          And.casesOn h fun haOut haMap =>
            ⟨haMap ▸ (T.toMap.toFun a).property, fun a_1 =>
              Exists.casesOn a_1 fun p h =>
                And.casesOn h fun hp right =>
                  Exists.casesOn right fun b h =>
                    And.casesOn h fun hbDisc right =>
                      And.casesOn right fun hbTags hbMap =>
                        have hba :=
                          Function.Bijective.injective (SpecialTransformations.Section5.Chain.bijective T)
                            (Subtype.ext (Eq.trans hbMap (Eq.symm haMap)));
                        haOut
                          ⟨a.property,
                            Exists.intro p
                              ⟨hp,
                                ⟨Eq.mp
                                    (congrArg
                                      (fun _a =>
                                        (↑_a).1 0 ∈ DiamondIntegral.Section6.centeredGammaDisc ((↑p).1 0) (ρ p))
                                      hba)
                                    hbDisc,
                                  Eq.mp (congrArg (fun _a => (↑_a).2 = (↑p).2) hba) hbTags⟩⟩⟩⟩,
      mpr := fun a =>
        And.casesOn a fun hqB hqOut =>
          Exists.casesOn (Function.Bijective.surjective (SpecialTransformations.Section5.Chain.bijective T) ⟨q, hqB⟩)
            fun a ha =>
            have haMap := congrArg Subtype.val ha;

              ⟨fun a_1 =>
                And.casesOn a_1 fun haA right =>
                  Exists.casesOn right fun p h =>
                    And.casesOn h fun hp right =>
                      And.casesOn right fun haDisc haTags =>
                        hqOut (Exists.intro p ⟨hp, Exists.intro a ⟨haDisc, ⟨haTags, haMap⟩⟩⟩),
                haMap⟩ }

theorem DiamondIntegral.Section6.ordinary_point_preimage : ∀ {M : Type}
  [inst : SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M]
  [inst_1 : M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {n r : ℕ}
  (H : Set (DiamondIntegral.Section2.Mixed M n r)),
  SpecialTransformations.DefinableGeometry.Space.preimage (SpecialTransformations.Section5.pointSpace n r) H =
    SpecialTransformations.Section4.mixedValues '' H :=
fun {M} [SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M] [M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {n r}
    H =>
  Set.ext fun z =>
    {
      mp := fun a =>
        Exists.casesOn a fun hz hH =>
          Exists.intro ((SpecialTransformations.Section5.pointSpace n r).decode ⟨z, hz⟩)
            ⟨hH,
              funext fun i =>
                Sum.casesOn (motive := fun t =>
                  i = t →
                    SpecialTransformations.Section4.mixedValues
                        ((SpecialTransformations.Section5.pointSpace n r).decode ⟨z, hz⟩) i =
                      z i)
                  i
                  (fun val h =>
                    Eq.symm h ▸
                      Eq.refl
                        (SpecialTransformations.Section4.mixedValues
                          ((SpecialTransformations.Section5.pointSpace n r).decode ⟨z, hz⟩) (Sum.inl val)))
                  (fun val h =>
                    Eq.symm h ▸
                      Eq.refl
                        (SpecialTransformations.Section4.mixedValues
                          ((SpecialTransformations.Section5.pointSpace n r).decode ⟨z, hz⟩) (Sum.inr val)))
                  (Eq.refl i)⟩,
      mpr := fun a =>
        Exists.casesOn a fun p h =>
          And.casesOn h fun hp right =>
            right ▸
              Exists.intro ⟨fun i => (p.1 i).property, fun i => (p.2 i).property⟩
                (let q :=
                  (SpecialTransformations.Section5.pointSpace n r).decode
                    ⟨SpecialTransformations.Section4.mixedValues p,
                      ⟨fun i => (p.1 i).property, fun i => (p.2 i).property⟩⟩;
                have hq :=
                  funext fun i =>
                    Sum.casesOn (motive := fun t =>
                      i = t →
                        SpecialTransformations.Section4.mixedValues q i =
                          SpecialTransformations.Section4.mixedValues p i)
                      i (fun val h => Eq.symm h ▸ Eq.refl (SpecialTransformations.Section4.mixedValues q (Sum.inl val)))
                      (fun val h => Eq.symm h ▸ Eq.refl (SpecialTransformations.Section4.mixedValues q (Sum.inr val)))
                      (Eq.refl i);
                Eq.symm (Eq.symm (SpecialTransformations.Section4.mixedValues_injective hq)) ▸ hp) }

                          List.finRange 1 = a → Fintype.complete i ≍ x → q.1 0 = q.1 i) (Fintype.complete i)

theorem DiamondIntegral.Section6.ordinaryChainPointRadius_lt_of_orbit_bound : ∀ {M : Type}
  [inst : SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M]
  [inst_1 : M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {S R : Set M} (hc : CanonicalStructure.IsCanonical)
  {r s : ℕ} {A : SpecialTransformations.Section5.DefSet R 1 r} {B : SpecialTransformations.Section5.DefSet R 1 s}

  1 < η →
    (∀ x ∈ (DiamondIntegral.Section6.ordinaryChainOrbitValues hc T hT E hEA).carrier,
        x 0 ≠ 0 → DiamondIntegral.Section2.vfValue (x 0) < ↑η) →
      ∀ (p : ↑E.carrier), DiamondIntegral.Section6.ordinaryChainPointRadius T ⟨↑p, ⋯⟩ < η :=

    {r s} {A} {B} T hT =>
  SpecialTransformations.Section5.Chain.rec (motive := fun {r s} {A} {B} T =>
    ∀ (hT : SpecialTransformations.Section5.GammaChainDefinable (DiamondIntegral.Section6.ordinaryNamedGammaBase S) T)

      (hEA : E.carrier ⊆ SpecialTransformations.Section5.carrier A) (η : DiamondIntegral.Section2.Gamma M),
      1 < η →
        (∀ x ∈ (DiamondIntegral.Section6.ordinaryChainOrbitValues hc T hT E hEA).carrier,
            x 0 ≠ 0 → DiamondIntegral.Section2.vfValue (x 0) < ↑η) →
          ∀ (p : ↑E.carrier), DiamondIntegral.Section6.ordinaryChainPointRadius T ⟨↑p, hEA p.property⟩ < η)

      have hHead :=

          Eq.mpr
            (id
              (congrFun'
                (congrArg LT.lt
                  ((fun x_0 x_1 x_2 x_3 => (fun x_0 x_1 x_2 x_3 => dif_pos hn) x_0 x_1 x_2 x_3) instDecidableNot

                    (DiamondIntegral.Section2.Gamma M) (fun hx => DiamondIntegral.Section2.finiteValue ((↑p).1 0) hx)
                    fun hx => 1))

          (SpecialTransformations.Section5.Chain.cons step tail) hT;
      let hTarget := SpecialTransformations.Section5.GammaChainDefinable.source P tail hT.right;

        (DiamondIntegral.Section6.originalBaseOrdinaryMap hc hSource hTarget step.toMap
              (SpecialTransformations.Section5.GammaPrimitiveDefinable.graph L step hT.left)).comp

        if hn : (↑p).1 0 ≠ 0 then

  [inst_1 : M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {R : Set M} {r : ℕ}
