theorem DiamondIntegral.Section6.OriginalBaseOrdinaryFocus.center_same_labels : ∀ {M : Type}
  [inst : SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M]
  [inst_1 : M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {R : Set M} {r : ℕ}
  {A : SpecialTransformations.Section5.DefSet R 1 r} {j : Fin r} (D : SpecialTransformations.Section5.Focus A 0 j)
  (p q : DiamondIntegral.Section2.Mixed M 1 r),
  p ∈ SpecialTransformations.Section5.carrier A ∩ D.locus →
    q ∈ SpecialTransformations.Section5.carrier A ∩ D.locus → p.2 = q.2 → D.center p = D.center q :=
fun {M} [SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M] [M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {R} {r}
    {A} {j} D p q hp hq hu =>
  D.independent p hp q hq
    (Prod.ext
      (funext fun i =>
        List.Mem.casesOn (motive := fun a x =>
          List.finRange 1 = a →
            Fintype.complete i ≍ x →
              (SpecialTransformations.Section5.erase 0 p).1 i = (SpecialTransformations.Section5.erase 0 q).1 i)
          (Fintype.complete i)
          (fun as h =>
            List.cons.noConfusion h fun head_eq =>
              Eq.ndrec (motive := fun i =>
                ∀ (this : i ∈ Fintype.elems),
                  [] ≍ as →
                    this ≍ List.Mem.head as →
                      (SpecialTransformations.Section5.erase 0 p).1 i = (SpecialTransformations.Section5.erase 0 q).1 i)
                (fun this tail_eq =>
                  Eq.ndrec (motive := fun as =>
                    this ≍ List.Mem.head as →
                      (SpecialTransformations.Section5.erase 0 p).1 ((fun i => i) ⟨0, Nat.le_refl 1⟩) =
                        (SpecialTransformations.Section5.erase 0 q).1 ((fun i => i) ⟨0, Nat.le_refl 1⟩))
                    (fun h =>
                      id
                        (Eq.mpr
                          (id (congrArg (fun _a => _a = Function.update q.1 0 0 0) (Function.update_self 0 0 p.1)))
                          (Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => 0 = _a) (Function.update_self 0 0 q.1))) (Eq.refl 0))))
                    (eq_of_heq tail_eq))
                (eq_of_heq head_eq) (Fintype.complete i))
          (fun b {as} a h =>
            List.cons.noConfusion h fun head_eq =>
              Eq.ndrec (motive := fun b =>
                [] ≍ as →
                  Fintype.complete i ≍ List.Mem.tail b a →
                    (SpecialTransformations.Section5.erase 0 p).1 i = (SpecialTransformations.Section5.erase 0 q).1 i)
                (fun tail_eq =>
                  Eq.ndrec (motive := fun {as} =>
                    ∀ (a : List.Mem i as),
                      Fintype.complete i ≍ List.Mem.tail ((fun i => i) ⟨0, Nat.le_refl 1⟩) a →
                        (SpecialTransformations.Section5.erase 0 p).1 i =
                          (SpecialTransformations.Section5.erase 0 q).1 i)
                    (fun a h =>
                      List.Mem.casesOn (motive := fun a_1 x =>
                        [] = a_1 →
                          a ≍ x →
                            (SpecialTransformations.Section5.erase 0 p).1 i =
                              (SpecialTransformations.Section5.erase 0 q).1 i)
                        a (fun as h => False.elim (noConfusion_of_Nat List.ctorIdx h))
                        (fun b {as} a_1 h => False.elim (noConfusion_of_Nat List.ctorIdx h)) (Eq.refl []) (HEq.refl a))
                    (eq_of_heq tail_eq) a)
                (eq_of_heq head_eq))
          (Eq.refl (List.finRange 1)) (HEq.refl (Fintype.complete i)))
      hu)

  [inst : SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M]
  [inst_1 : M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {S : Set M} {p n r k : ℕ} {arity : Fin k → ℕ} {G : Type}

  (∀ (x y : DiamondIntegral.Section2.VF M),
      SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.VFValued.predV x y ↔ Valued.v x ≤ Valued.v y) →
    ∀ (T : (i : Fin k) → DiamondIntegral.Section6.BranchedShearChartTemplate S p n r (arity i)) (i : Fin k)
      (a : Fin p → M) (ha : a ∈ (T i).goodFunctions)
      (hNew : a ∈ (DiamondIntegral.Section6.paddedShearTemplate T i).goodFunctions)
      (u : Fin r → DiamondIntegral.Section2.RVInfinity M)
      (v : Fin (DiamondIntegral.Section6.packedBranchArity r arity) → DiamondIntegral.Section2.RVInfinity M)
      (x : Fin (n + 1) → DiamondIntegral.Section2.VF M),
      (DiamondIntegral.Section6.paddedShearTemplate T i).indicator.value a ⋯ (Fin.append u v) x 0 = 1 ↔

              (DiamondIntegral.Section6.packedBranchDecode arity i v) ∧

    {p n r k} {arity} {G} [LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero G] [Valued (DiamondIntegral.Section2.VF M) G] hv T i a ha hNew

  Eq.mpr

@DiamondIntegral.Section6.UniformFinitePairedCores.source_core_iff_target : ∀ {M : Type}
  [inst : SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M]

theorem DiamondIntegral.Section6.UniformFinitePairedCores.source_core_iff_target : ∀ {M : Type}
  [inst : SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M]
  [inst_1 : M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {S : Set M} {r s : ℕ}
  {A : SpecialTransformations.DefinableGeometry.DefSet (SpecialTransformations.Section4.rawMixedSpace 1 r) S}
  {B : SpecialTransformations.DefinableGeometry.DefSet (SpecialTransformations.Section4.rawMixedSpace 1 s) S}
  {f : SpecialTransformations.DefinableGeometry.Map A B}
  {E : SpecialTransformations.DefinableGeometry.DefSet (SpecialTransformations.Section4.rawMixedSpace 1 r) S}
  {hEA : E.carrier ⊆ A.carrier} {α β : DiamondIntegral.Section2.Gamma M}
  (D : DiamondIntegral.Section6.UniformFinitePairedCores f E hEA α β),
  Function.Injective f.toFun → ∀ (x : ↑A.carrier), ↑x ∈ D.sourceCoreSet ↔ ↑(f.toFun x) ∈ D.targetCoreSet :=
fun {M} [SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M] [M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {S}
    {r s} {A} {B} {f} {E} {hEA} {α β} D hf x =>
  {
    mp := fun a =>
      And.casesOn a fun hx right =>
        Exists.casesOn right fun p h =>
          And.casesOn h fun hpu hClose =>
            have hDisc :=
              (DiamondIntegral.Section6.mem_centeredGammaDisc ((↑p).1 0) ((↑x).1 0)
                    (DiamondIntegral.Section2.finiteValue (↑(D.sourceOffset.toFun p) 0) (D.sourceNonzero p))).mpr
                hClose;
            And.casesOn
              ((DiamondIntegral.Section6.UniformFinitePairedCores.mixed_image_iff f E hEA α β D p (f.toFun x)).mpr
                (Exists.intro x ⟨hDisc, ⟨Eq.symm hpu, rfl⟩⟩))
              fun hTarget hLabels =>
              ⟨(f.toFun x).property,
                Exists.intro p
                  ⟨Eq.symm hLabels,
                    (DiamondIntegral.Section6.mem_centeredGammaDisc ((↑(f.toFun ⟨↑p, hEA p.property⟩)).1 0)
                          ((↑(f.toFun x)).1 0)
                          (DiamondIntegral.Section2.finiteValue (↑(D.targetOffset.toFun p) 0) (D.targetNonzero p))).mp
                      hTarget⟩⟩,
    mpr := fun a =>
      And.casesOn a fun hy right =>
        Exists.casesOn right fun p h =>
          And.casesOn h fun hpu hClose =>
            have hDisc :=
              (DiamondIntegral.Section6.mem_centeredGammaDisc ((↑(f.toFun ⟨↑p, hEA p.property⟩)).1 0)
                    ((↑(f.toFun x)).1 0)
                    (DiamondIntegral.Section2.finiteValue (↑(D.targetOffset.toFun p) 0) (D.targetNonzero p))).mpr
                hClose;
            Exists.casesOn
              ((DiamondIntegral.Section6.UniformFinitePairedCores.mixed_image_iff f E hEA α β D p (f.toFun x)).mp
                ⟨hDisc, Eq.symm hpu⟩)
              fun a h =>
              And.casesOn h fun ha right =>
                And.casesOn right fun hau haMap =>
                  have hEq := hf haMap;
                  Eq.ndrec (motive := fun a =>
                    (↑a).1 0 ∈
                        DiamondIntegral.Section6.centeredGammaDisc ((↑p).1 0)
                          (DiamondIntegral.Section2.finiteValue (↑(D.sourceOffset.toFun p) 0) (D.sourceNonzero p)) →
                      (↑a).2 = (↑p).2 → f.toFun a = f.toFun x → ↑x ∈ D.sourceCoreSet)
                    (fun ha hau haMap =>
                      ⟨x.property,
                        Exists.intro p
                          ⟨Eq.symm hau,
                            (DiamondIntegral.Section6.mem_centeredGammaDisc ((↑p).1 0) ((↑x).1 0)
                                  (DiamondIntegral.Section2.finiteValue (↑(D.sourceOffset.toFun p) 0)
                                    (D.sourceNonzero p))).mp
                              ha⟩⟩)
                    (Eq.symm hEq) ha hau haMap }

 Quot.sound]

@DiamondIntegral.Section6.exists_paired_core_matching : ∀ {M : Type}
  [inst : SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M]
  [inst_1 : M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {S : Set M} {r s : ℕ}
  {A C : SpecialTransformations.DefinableGeometry.DefSet (SpecialTransformations.Section4.rawMixedSpace 1 r) S}
  {B T : SpecialTransformations.DefinableGeometry.DefSet (SpecialTransformations.Section4.rawMixedSpace 1 s) S}
  {f : SpecialTransformations.DefinableGeometry.Map A B}
  {E : SpecialTransformations.DefinableGeometry.DefSet (SpecialTransformations.Section4.rawMixedSpace 1 r) S}

theorem DiamondIntegral.Section6.exists_paired_core_matching : ∀ {M : Type}
  [inst : SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M]
  [inst_1 : M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {S : Set M} {r s : ℕ}
  {A C : SpecialTransformations.DefinableGeometry.DefSet (SpecialTransformations.Section4.rawMixedSpace 1 r) S}
  {B T : SpecialTransformations.DefinableGeometry.DefSet (SpecialTransformations.Section4.rawMixedSpace 1 s) S}
  {f : SpecialTransformations.DefinableGeometry.Map A B}
  {E : SpecialTransformations.DefinableGeometry.DefSet (SpecialTransformations.Section4.rawMixedSpace 1 r) S}
  {hEA : E.carrier ⊆ A.carrier} {α β : DiamondIntegral.Section2.Gamma M},
  Function.Bijective f.toFun →
    ∀ (D : DiamondIntegral.Section6.UniformFinitePairedCores f E hEA α β),
      C.carrier = D.sourceCoreSet →
        T.carrier = D.targetCoreSet →
          (∀ (p q : ↑E.carrier), (↑p).2 = (↑q).2 → p = q) →
            (∀ (p q : ↑E.carrier), (↑(f.toFun ⟨↑p, ⋯⟩)).2 = (↑(f.toFun ⟨↑q, ⋯⟩)).2 → p = q) →
              ∃ g,
                Function.Bijective g.toFun ∧
                  DiamondIntegral.Section6.MapsWholeTagFibres g ∧
                    ∀ (p : ↑C.carrier), ∃ (hp : ↑p ∈ A.carrier), ↑(g.toFun p) = ↑(f.toFun ⟨↑p, hp⟩) :=
fun {M} [SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M] [M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {S}
    {r s} {A C} {B T} {f} {E} {hEA} {α β} hf D hC hT hSourceUnique hTargetUnique =>
  have hCA := fun x hx =>
    (have this := hC ▸ hx;
      this).left;
  have hTB := fun y hy =>
    (have this := hT ▸ hy;
      this).left;
  let g :=
    {
      toFun := fun p =>
        ⟨↑(f.toFun ⟨↑p, hCA p.property⟩),
          Eq.symm hT ▸
            (DiamondIntegral.Section6.UniformFinitePairedCores.source_core_iff_target D
                  (Function.Bijective.injective hf) ⟨↑p, hCA p.property⟩).mp
              (hC ▸ p.property)⟩,
      graph_definable := (f.restrict hCA).graph_definable };
  have hBij :=
    ⟨fun ⦃p q⦄ he =>
      have hVal := congrArg (fun z => ↑z) he;
      have hEq := Function.Bijective.injective hf (Subtype.ext hVal);
      have hEqVal := congrArg (fun z => ↑z) hEq;
      Subtype.ext hEqVal,
      fun q =>
      Exists.casesOn (Function.Bijective.surjective hf ⟨↑q, hTB q.property⟩) fun a ha =>
        have hTarget := Eq.symm (congrArg Subtype.val ha) ▸ hT ▸ q.property;
        have hSource :=
          Eq.symm hC ▸
            (DiamondIntegral.Section6.UniformFinitePairedCores.source_core_iff_target D
                  (Function.Bijective.injective hf) a).mpr
              hTarget;
        have haVal := congrArg (fun z => ↑z) ha;
        Exists.intro ⟨↑a, hSource⟩ (Subtype.ext haVal)⟩;
  have hLabel := fun x p hpx hClose =>
    let a := ⟨↑x, hCA x.property⟩;
    have hDisc :=
      (DiamondIntegral.Section6.mem_centeredGammaDisc ((↑p).1 0) ((↑a).1 0)
            (DiamondIntegral.Section2.finiteValue (↑(D.sourceOffset.toFun p) 0) (D.sourceNonzero p))).mpr
        hClose;
    ((DiamondIntegral.Section6.UniformFinitePairedCores.mixed_image_iff f E hEA α β D p (f.toFun a)).mpr
        (Exists.intro a ⟨hDisc, ⟨Eq.symm hpx, rfl⟩⟩)).right;
  have hTags := fun x y =>
    And.casesOn
      (have this := hC ▸ x.property;
      this)
      fun hx right =>
      Exists.casesOn right fun p h =>
        And.casesOn h fun hpu hpClose =>
          And.casesOn
            (have this := hC ▸ y.property;
            this)
            fun hy right =>
            Exists.casesOn right fun q h =>
              And.casesOn h fun hqu hqClose =>
                have hpx := hLabel x p hpu hpClose;
                have hqy := hLabel y q hqu hqClose;
                {
                  mp := fun he =>
                    have hpq := hTargetUnique p q (Eq.trans (Eq.symm hpx) (Eq.trans he hqy));
                    Eq.trans (Eq.symm hpu) (Eq.trans (congrArg (fun z => (↑z).2) hpq) hqu),
                  mpr := fun he =>
                    have hpq := hSourceUnique p q (Eq.trans hpu (Eq.trans he (Eq.symm hqu)));
                    Eq.trans hpx
                      (Eq.trans (congrArg (fun z => (↑(f.toFun ⟨↑z, hEA z.property⟩)).2) hpq) (Eq.symm hqy)) };
  Exists.intro g
    ⟨hBij,
      ⟨DiamondIntegral.Section6.mapsWholeTagFibres_of_tag_equivalence g (Function.Bijective.surjective hBij) hTags,
        fun p => Exists.intro (hCA p.property) rfl⟩⟩

  [inst : SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M]

                  (Exists.intro ⟨↑q, hBA q.property⟩ ⟨Eq.symm hc, hq⟩);
              have hC :=
                (SpecialTransformations.DefinableGeometry.Space.preimage_decode P B.carrier c).mpr
                  (Eq.symm hc ▸ q.property);
              Exists.intro ↑c
                ⟨(Set.ext_iff.mp hGraph (Sum.elim (↑c) (Sum.elim a z ∘ Sum.inr))).mpr hRel,
                  (Set.ext_iff.mp hSource ↑c).mpr hC⟩ }

  [inst : SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M]
  [inst_1 : M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {S : Set M} {p q n r k : ℕ}
  (T : DiamondIntegral.Section6.FocusComponentParameterTemplate S p n r)
  (h : DiamondIntegral.Section6.DefinableParameterSubstitution S p q)
  (A : DiamondIntegral.Section6.MixedSetParameterTemplate S p n r)
  (P : Fin k → DiamondIntegral.Section6.MixedSetParameterTemplate S p n r),
  ((T.substitute h).good (A.substitute h) fun i => (P i).substitute h) = h.value ⁻¹' T.good A P
theorem DiamondIntegral.Section6.FocusComponentParameterTemplate.substitute_good : ∀ {M : Type}
  [inst : SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M]
  [inst_1 : M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {S : Set M} {p q n r k : ℕ}
  (T : DiamondIntegral.Section6.FocusComponentParameterTemplate S p n r)
  (h : DiamondIntegral.Section6.DefinableParameterSubstitution S p q)
  (A : DiamondIntegral.Section6.MixedSetParameterTemplate S p n r)
  (P : Fin k → DiamondIntegral.Section6.MixedSetParameterTemplate S p n r),
  ((T.substitute h).good (A.substitute h) fun i => (P i).substitute h) = h.value ⁻¹' T.good A P :=
fun {M} [SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M] [M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {S}
    {p q n r k} T h A P =>
  Set.ext fun a =>
    Eq.mpr
      (id
        (congr
          (congrArg Iff
            (Eq.trans
              (Eq.trans
                (congrFun'
                  (congrArg Membership.mem
                    (congrArg
                      (Inter.inter
                        ((T.focus.substitute h).good ∩ (T.coefficient.substitute h).good ∩
                          (T.radius.substitute h).good))
                      (congrArg
                        (Inter.inter
                          (DiamondIntegral.Section6.taggedSourceParameterLocus (A.substitute h).typedGraph ∩
                              DiamondIntegral.Section6.focusIndependentParameterLocus
                                (DiamondIntegral.Section6.focusGraphParameterCode (A.substitute h)
                                  (T.active.substitute h) (T.focus.substitute h))
                                T.coordinate ∩
                            DiamondIntegral.Section6.focusLeadingTermParameterLocus
                              (DiamondIntegral.Section6.focusGraphParameterCode (A.substitute h) (T.active.substitute h)
                                (T.focus.substitute h))
                              T.coordinate))
                        (congrArg Set.ofPred
                          (funext fun a =>
                            forall_congr fun c =>
                              forall_congr fun b =>
                                implies_congr
                                  (Eq.refl (Sum.elim a (Sum.elim Fin.elim0 c) ∈ (T.coefficient.substitute h).graph))
                                  (implies_congr (Eq.refl (Sum.elim a b ∈ (T.radius.substitute h).graph))
                                    (Eq.trans
                                      (DiamondIntegral.Section6.FocusComponentParameterTemplate.substitute_good._simp_1_5
                                        (Sum.elim (Sum.elim a c) b)
                                        (DiamondIntegral.Section6.coefficientCodeCondition (Fin q) ∩
                                          (DiamondIntegral.Section6.focusSourceInvariantParameterLocus

    f hAt =>
  Set.ext fun z =>
    {
      mp := fun a =>
        Exists.casesOn a fun u h =>
          Exists.casesOn h fun x h => h ▸ ⟨⟨fun i => (u i).property, fun i => (x i).property⟩, hAt u x⟩,
      mpr := fun a =>
        And.casesOn a fun left hValue =>
          And.casesOn left fun hRV hVF =>
            let u := fun i => ⟨z (Sum.inl i), hRV i⟩;
            let x := fun i => ⟨z (Sum.inr (Sum.inl i)), hVF i⟩;

                  (fun val h => Eq.symm h ▸ Eq.refl (DiamondIntegral.Section6.rvFunctionFamilyArgs z (Sum.inr val)))

            Exists.intro u
              (Exists.intro x
                (funext fun i =>
                  Sum.casesOn i

                    fun val =>
                    Sum.casesOn val
                      (fun i =>
                        Eq.refl
                          (Sum.elim (SpecialTransformations.Section4.rvValues u)
                            (Sum.elim (SpecialTransformations.Section4.vfValues x)
                              (SpecialTransformations.Section4.vfValues (f u x)))
                            (Sum.inr (Sum.inl i))))
                      fun i =>
                      List.Mem.casesOn (motive := fun a x_1 =>
                        List.finRange 1 = a →
                          Fintype.complete i ≍ x_1 →
                            Sum.elim (SpecialTransformations.Section4.rvValues u)

                              z (Sum.inr (Sum.inr i)))

                                      z (Sum.inr (Sum.inr ((fun i => i) ⟨0, Nat.le_refl 1⟩))))
                                  (fun h =>
                                    Eq.mp (congrArg (fun _a => _a = z (Sum.inr (Sum.inr 0))) (hAt u x))
                                      (Eq.mp (congrArg (fun _a => F _a = z (Sum.inr (Sum.inr 0))) hArgs) hValue))

  [inst : SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M]

  (V : DiamondIntegral.Section6.OrderedStandardContractionLift T) (p : DiamondIntegral.Section2.Mixed M n q),

    (Fin.elim0, p.2) ∈ U.carrier ∧
      ∀ (i : Fin n), DiamondIntegral.Section2.rv M (p.1 i) = p.2 (T.volumeIndex ((Equiv.symm e) i)) :=

  Eq.mpr
    (id
      (congrArg
        (fun _a =>
          p ∈ _a.carrier ↔
            (Fin.elim0, p.2) ∈ U.carrier ∧
              ∀ (i : Fin n), DiamondIntegral.Section2.rv M (p.1 i) = p.2 (T.volumeIndex ((Equiv.symm e) i)))

    (Eq.mpr
      (id
        (congrArg
          (fun _a =>
            _a ↔
              (Fin.elim0, p.2) ∈ U.carrier ∧
                ∀ (i : Fin n), DiamondIntegral.Section2.rv M (p.1 i) = p.2 (T.volumeIndex ((Equiv.symm e) i)))
          (propext (DiamondIntegral.Section6.mem_reindexedVFSet V.target (Equiv.symm e) p))))
      (id
        (Eq.mpr
          (id
            (congrArg
              (fun _a =>
                _a ↔
                  (Fin.elim0, p.2) ∈ U.carrier ∧
                    ∀ (i : Fin n), DiamondIntegral.Section2.rv M (p.1 i) = p.2 (T.volumeIndex ((Equiv.symm e) i)))
              (propext (V.recover (p.1 ∘ ⇑e, p.2)))))
          {
            mp := fun a =>
              And.casesOn a fun h hVolume =>
                ⟨h, fun i =>
                  Eq.mp
                    (congrFun'
                      (congrArg Eq
                        (DiamondIntegral.Section2.rv.congr_simp M ((p.1 ∘ ⇑e, p.2).1 ((Equiv.symm e) i)) (p.1 i)
                          (congrArg p.1 (Equiv.apply_symm_apply e i))))
                      (p.2 (T.volumeIndex ((Equiv.symm e) i))))
                    (hVolume ((Equiv.symm e) i))⟩,
            mpr := fun a =>
              And.casesOn a fun h hVolume =>

                  id

                      (congrArg (Eq (DiamondIntegral.Section2.rv M (p.1 (e i))))

      List.finRange 1 = a →
        Fintype.complete i ≍ x → DiamondIntegral.Section2.tupleRV M p.1 i = DiamondIntegral.Section2.tupleRV M q.1 i)

      (fun b {as} a h =>
        List.cons.noConfusion h fun head_eq =>
          Eq.ndrec (motive := fun b =>

              Fintype.complete i ≍ List.Mem.tail b a →
                DiamondIntegral.Section2.tupleRV M p.1 i = DiamondIntegral.Section2.tupleRV M q.1 i)

    DiamondIntegral.Section6.parameterRelationImage (DiamondIntegral.Section6.parameterRelationImage A F) H :=

theorem DiamondIntegral.Section6.rvVFGraph_section : ∀ {M : Type}

    f u =>
  Set.ext fun z =>
    {

        Exists.casesOn a fun v h =>
          Exists.casesOn h fun x h =>
            have hvu := SpecialTransformations.Section4.rvValues_injective (funext fun i => congrFun h (Sum.inl i));

        Exists.casesOn a fun x h =>
          Exists.intro u (Exists.intro x (congrArg (Sum.elim (SpecialTransformations.Section4.rvValues u)) h)) }

theorem DiamondIntegral.Section6.GammaNameParameterTemplate.good_of_name : ∀ {M : Type}
  [inst : SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M]
  [inst_1 : M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {S : Set M} {p : ℕ}
  (T : DiamondIntegral.Section6.GammaNameParameterTemplate S p) (a : Fin p → M) (γ : DiamondIntegral.Section2.Gamma M),
  {z | Sum.elim a z ∈ T.graph} = {z | z 0 ∈ SpecialTransformations.Section3.Values.gammaPullback {γ}} → a ∈ T.good :=
fun {M} [SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M] [M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {S} {p}
    T a γ hSection =>
  Exists.casesOn (SpecialTransformations.Section3.GammaParameters.EndpointLogic.codeValue_surjective γ) fun t h =>
    And.casesOn h fun ht hγ =>
      ⟨Exists.intro (fun x => t)
          ((Set.ext_iff.mp hSection fun x => t).mpr
            ((SpecialTransformations.Section3.GammaParameters.gammaPullback_mem_codeValue_iff {γ} t ht).mpr hγ)),
        fun x y hx hy =>
        have hx' := (Set.ext_iff.mp hSection x).mp hx;
        have hy' := (Set.ext_iff.mp hSection y).mp hy;
        have hxnz := T.proper (Sum.elim a x) hx;
        have hynz := T.proper (Sum.elim a y) hy;
        have hEq :=
          Eq.trans
            ((SpecialTransformations.Section3.GammaParameters.gammaPullback_mem_codeValue_iff {γ}
                  (Sum.elim a x (Sum.inr 0)) hxnz).mp
              hx')
            (Eq.symm
              ((SpecialTransformations.Section3.GammaParameters.gammaPullback_mem_codeValue_iff {γ}
                    (Sum.elim a y (Sum.inr 0)) hynz).mp
                hy'));
        ⟨hxnz,
          ⟨hynz,
            ⟨(SpecialTransformations.Section3.GammaParameters.original_le_codeValue_iff (Sum.elim a x (Sum.inr 0))
                    (Sum.elim a y (Sum.inr 0)) hxnz hynz).mpr
                (Eq.le hEq),
              (SpecialTransformations.Section3.GammaParameters.original_le_codeValue_iff (Sum.elim a y (Sum.inr 0))
                    (Sum.elim a x (Sum.inr 0)) hynz hxnz).mpr
                (Eq.ge hEq)⟩⟩⟩⟩

  [inst : SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M]

theorem DiamondIntegral.Section6.indicator_continuous_of_clopen : ∀ {M : Type}
  [inst : SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M]
  [inst_1 : M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {G : Type} [inst_2 : LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero G]
  [inst_3 : Valued (DiamondIntegral.Section2.VF M) G] {X : Type} [inst_4 : TopologicalSpace X] (D : Set X),
  IsClopen D → Continuous fun x => if x ∈ D then 1 else 0 :=
fun {M} [SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M] [M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {G}
    [LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero G] [Valued (DiamondIntegral.Section2.VF M) G] {X} [TopologicalSpace X] D hD =>
  continuous_iff_continuousAt.mpr fun a =>
    if ha : a ∈ D then
      ContinuousAt.congr_of_eventuallyEq continuousAt_const
        (Filter.mp_mem (IsOpen.mem_nhds (IsClopen.isOpen hD) ha) (Filter.univ_mem' (id fun x hx => if_pos hx)))

      ContinuousAt.congr_of_eventuallyEq continuousAt_const
        (Filter.mp_mem (IsOpen.mem_nhds IsClosed.isOpen_compl ha) (Filter.univ_mem' (id fun x hx => if_neg hx)))

      if hx : x ∈ D then
        of_eq_true

            (congr
              (congrArg Iff
                (congrFun'
                  (congrArg Eq
                    (DiamondIntegral.Section6.branchTag.congr_simp (decide (x ∈ D)) true
                      (Eq.trans (Decidable.decide.congr_simp (x ∈ D) True (eq_true hx))
                        (decide_true instDecidableTrue))))
                  t))
              (Eq.trans
                (Set.mem_union._simp_1 x (if DiamondIntegral.Section6.branchTag true = t then D else ∅)
                  (if DiamondIntegral.Section6.branchTag false = t then Dᶜ else ∅))

                          (Eq.trans (Set.mem_compl_iff._simp_1 D x)
                            (Eq.trans (congrArg Not (eq_true hx)) not_true_eq_false)))
                        (and_false (DiamondIntegral.Section6.branchTag false = t)))))
                  (or_false (DiamondIntegral.Section6.branchTag true = t)))))

          (Eq.trans

              (congrArg Iff

                      (Eq.trans (Decidable.decide.congr_simp (x ∈ D) False (eq_false hx))

                  (false_or (DiamondIntegral.Section6.branchTag false = t)))))

@DiamondIntegral.Section6.covariantOn_iff_contracts : ∀ {X : Type u_1} {Y : Type u_2} (s : Setoid X) (t : Setoid Y)

theorem DiamondIntegral.Section6.covariantOn_iff_contracts.{u_1, u_2} : ∀ {X : Type u_1} {Y : Type u_2} (s : Setoid X)
  (t : Setoid Y) (A : Set X) (f : X → Y),
  DiamondIntegral.Section6.CovariantOn s t A f ↔ ∃ down, ∀ (a : ↑A), down ⟦a⟧ = ⟦f ↑a⟧ :=

  {
    mp := fun h =>
      Exists.intro
        (Quotient.lift (fun a => ⟦f ↑a⟧) fun a b hab => Quotient.sound (h (↑a) a.property (↑b) b.property hab)) fun x =>
        rfl,
    mpr := fun a =>
      Exists.casesOn a fun down hd a ha b hb hab =>
        Quotient.exact
          (Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => _a = ⟦f b⟧) (Eq.symm (hd ⟨a, ha⟩))))
            (Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => down ⟦⟨a, ha⟩⟧ = _a) (Eq.symm (hd ⟨b, hb⟩))))
              (congrArg down (Quotient.sound hab)))) }

  [inst : SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M]
  [inst_1 : M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {δ a b : DiamondIntegral.Section2.Gamma M},

  [inst : SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M]
  [inst_1 : M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] (op : DiamondIntegral.Section6.RVCoordinateOperation)
  {δ a b : DiamondIntegral.Section2.Gamma M},
  δ⁻¹ ≤ a ∧ a ≤ δ → δ⁻¹ ≤ b ∧ b ≤ δ → (δ * δ)⁻¹ ≤ op.gammaValue a b ∧ op.gammaValue a b ≤ δ * δ :=

    {δ a b} ha hb =>
  DiamondIntegral.Section6.RVCoordinateOperation.casesOn (motive := fun t =>
    op = t → (δ * δ)⁻¹ ≤ op.gammaValue a b ∧ op.gammaValue a b ≤ δ * δ) op
    (fun h => Eq.symm h ▸ DiamondIntegral.Section6.gamma_square_interval_mul ha hb)
    (fun h =>
      Eq.symm h ▸
        Eq.mpr
          (id
            (congr (congrArg And (congrArg (LE.le (δ * δ)⁻¹) (div_eq_mul_inv a b)))
              (congrFun' (congrArg LE.le (div_eq_mul_inv a b)) (δ * δ))))
          (DiamondIntegral.Section6.gamma_square_interval_mul ha (DiamondIntegral.Section6.gamma_interval_inv hb)))
    (fun h =>
      Eq.symm h ▸
        Eq.mpr
          (id
            (congr (congrArg And (congrArg (LE.le (δ * δ)⁻¹) (div_eq_mul_inv b a)))
              (congrFun' (congrArg LE.le (div_eq_mul_inv b a)) (δ * δ))))
          (DiamondIntegral.Section6.gamma_square_interval_mul hb (DiamondIntegral.Section6.gamma_interval_inv ha)))
    (Eq.refl op)

  (U : SpecialTransformations.Section4.RVObject S n) (op : DiamondIntegral.Section6.RVCoordinateOperation)
  (i j : Fin n),
  (∀ (u : ↑U.domain.carrier) (k : Fin n), ↑(U.value u k) ≠ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.iRVZero) →
    DiamondIntegral.Section6.RVObjectDoublyBounded U →
      DiamondIntegral.Section6.RVObjectDoublyBounded (DiamondIntegral.Section6.rvCoordinateArithmeticObject U op i j)
theorem DiamondIntegral.Section6.rvCoordinateArithmeticObject_doublyBounded : ∀ {M : Type}
  [inst : SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M]
  [inst_1 : M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {S : Set M} {n : ℕ}
  (U : SpecialTransformations.Section4.RVObject S n) (op : DiamondIntegral.Section6.RVCoordinateOperation)
  (i j : Fin n),
  (∀ (u : ↑U.domain.carrier) (k : Fin n), ↑(U.value u k) ≠ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.iRVZero) →
    DiamondIntegral.Section6.RVObjectDoublyBounded U →
      DiamondIntegral.Section6.RVObjectDoublyBounded (DiamondIntegral.Section6.rvCoordinateArithmeticObject U op i j) :=
fun {M} [SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M] [M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {S} {n}
    U op i j hU hB =>
  ⟨hB.left,
    Exists.casesOn hB.right fun γ hγ =>
      let δ := max γ 1;
      have hδ :=
        Eq.mp (congrFun' (congrArg LE.le (mul_one δ)) (δ * max γ 1)) (mul_le_mul' (le_refl δ) (le_max_right γ 1));
      have hγδ := le_max_left γ 1;
      have hOld := fun u k =>
        have h := hγ (U.value u) (Exists.intro u rfl) k;
        ⟨LE.le.trans (inv_le_inv' hγδ) h.left, LE.le.trans h.right hγδ⟩;
      Exists.intro (δ * δ) fun t a =>
        Exists.casesOn (motive := fun x =>
          ∀ (i : Fin n),
            ↑(δ * δ)⁻¹ ≤ SpecialTransformations.Section3.Values.vrv (t i) ∧
              SpecialTransformations.Section3.Values.vrv (t i) ≤ ↑(δ * δ))
          a fun u h =>
          Eq.ndrec (motive := fun t =>
            ∀ (i : Fin n),
              ↑(δ * δ)⁻¹ ≤ SpecialTransformations.Section3.Values.vrv (t i) ∧
                SpecialTransformations.Section3.Values.vrv (t i) ≤ ↑(δ * δ))
            (fun k =>
              Eq.mpr
                (id
                  (congrArg
                    (fun _a =>
                      ↑(δ * δ)⁻¹ ≤ SpecialTransformations.Section3.Values.vrv (_a k) ∧
                        SpecialTransformations.Section3.Values.vrv (_a k) ≤ ↑(δ * δ))
                    (DiamondIntegral.Section6.rvCoordinateArithmeticObject_value U op i j u)))
                (if hk : k = i then
                  Eq.symm hk ▸
                    Eq.mpr
                      (id
                        (congrArg
                          (fun _a =>
                            ↑(δ * δ)⁻¹ ≤ SpecialTransformations.Section3.Values.vrv _a ∧
                              SpecialTransformations.Section3.Values.vrv _a ≤ ↑(δ * δ))
                          (Function.update_self i (op.value (U.value u i) (U.value u j)) (U.value u))))
                      (Eq.mpr
                        (id
                          (congrArg (fun _a => ↑(δ * δ)⁻¹ ≤ _a ∧ _a ≤ ↑(δ * δ))
                            (DiamondIntegral.Section6.RVCoordinateOperation.value_gamma op (U.value u i) (U.value u j)
                              (hU u i) (hU u j))))
                        (DiamondIntegral.Section6.RVCoordinateOperation.gammaValue_bounds op (hOld u i) (hOld u j)))
                else
                  Eq.mpr
                    (id
                      (congrArg
                        (fun _a =>
                          ↑(δ * δ)⁻¹ ≤ SpecialTransformations.Section3.Values.vrv _a ∧
                            SpecialTransformations.Section3.Values.vrv _a ≤ ↑(δ * δ))
                        (Function.update_of_ne hk (op.value (U.value u i) (U.value u j)) (U.value u))))
                    ⟨LE.le.trans (inv_le_inv' hδ) (hOld u k).left, LE.le.trans (hOld u k).right hδ⟩))
            h⟩

    DiamondIntegral.Section6.RVCoordinateDisplacement g i →

    funext fun j => Eq.trans (Eq.symm (hRetain (f.toFun p) j)) (Eq.trans (congrFun he (π j)) (hRetain (f.toFun z) j));
  have hF := hf p z hTags;
  have hG := hg (f.toFun p) (f.toFun z) he;

      (Trans.trans (DiamondIntegral.Section6.RVCoordinateDisplacement.comp._abel_1_1 p)

fun {M} [SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M] [M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {S}
    {n r} {A} {G} [LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero G] [Valued (DiamondIntegral.Section2.VF M) G] h00 D hFocus i p z he =>
  id
    (fun he =>
      have hOld :=
        funext fun j =>
          Eq.mp
            (congr (congrArg Eq (Fin.append_right (fun x => DiamondIntegral.Section6.branchTag (D.core ↑p)) (↑p).2 j))
              (Fin.append_right (fun x => DiamondIntegral.Section6.branchTag (D.core ↑z)) (↑z).2 j))
            (congrFun he (Fin.natAdd 1 j));
      have hCore :=
        DiamondIntegral.Section6.branchTag_injective h00
          (Eq.mp
            (congr (congrArg Eq (Fin.append_left (fun x => DiamondIntegral.Section6.branchTag (D.core ↑p)) (↑p).2 0))
              (Fin.append_left (fun x => DiamondIntegral.Section6.branchTag (D.core ↑z)) (↑z).2 0))
            (congrFun he (Fin.castAdd r 0)));
      have hF := hFocus p z hOld;
      id
        (if hi : i = D.coordinate then
          Eq.symm hi ▸
            Eq.mpr
              (id
                (congr
                  (congrArg Eq
                    (congrFun'
                      (congrArg HSub.hSub
                        (Function.update_self D.coordinate
                          ((↑p).1 D.coordinate - D.extendedFocus ↑p +
                            if D.core ↑p = true then D.coefficient * D.extendedFocus ↑p else 0)
                          (↑p).1))
                      ((↑p).1 D.coordinate)))
                  (congrFun'
                    (congrArg HSub.hSub
                      (Function.update_self D.coordinate
                        ((↑z).1 D.coordinate - D.extendedFocus ↑z +
                          if D.core ↑z = true then D.coefficient * D.extendedFocus ↑z else 0)
                        (↑z).1))
                    ((↑z).1 D.coordinate))))
              (Eq.mpr
                (id
                  (congrArg
                    (fun _a =>
                      ((↑p).1 D.coordinate - D.extendedFocus ↑p +

                            if D.core ↑z = true then D.coefficient * D.extendedFocus ↑z else 0) -
                          (↑z).1 D.coordinate)

                (Eq.mpr
                  (id
                    (congrArg
                      (fun _a =>
                        ((↑p).1 D.coordinate - _a + if D.core ↑z = true then D.coefficient * _a else 0) -
                            (↑p).1 D.coordinate =
                          ((↑z).1 D.coordinate - D.extendedFocus ↑z +
                              if D.core ↑z = true then D.coefficient * D.extendedFocus ↑z else 0) -
                            (↑z).1 D.coordinate)
                      hF))
                  (DiamondIntegral.Section6.CentripetalData.rv_displacement_of_rv_focus._abel_1_1 D p z)))
        else
          of_eq_true
            (Eq.trans
              (congr
                (congrArg Eq
                  (Eq.trans
                    (congrFun'
                      (congrArg HSub.hSub
                        ((fun x_0 v f => (fun x_0 => Function.update_of_ne hi) x_0 v f)
                          (fun a => DiamondIntegral.Section2.VF M)
                          ((↑p).1 D.coordinate - D.extendedFocus ↑p +
                            if D.core ↑p = true then D.coefficient * D.extendedFocus ↑p else 0)
                          (↑p).1))
                      ((↑p).1 i))
                    (sub_self ((↑p).1 i))))
                (Eq.trans
                  (congrFun'
                    (congrArg HSub.hSub
                      ((fun x_0 v f => (fun x_0 => Function.update_of_ne hi) x_0 v f)
                        (fun a => DiamondIntegral.Section2.VF M)
                        ((↑z).1 D.coordinate - D.extendedFocus ↑z +
                          if D.core ↑z = true then D.coefficient * D.extendedFocus ↑z else 0)
                        (↑z).1))
                    ((↑z).1 i))
                  (sub_self ((↑z).1 i))))
              (eq_self 0))))
    he

  [inst : SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M] [M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF]

  SpecialTransformations.Section3.RawClosure.Tuple.RelationDefinable S
    (DiamondIntegral.Section6.rvCoordinateRelation F j) :=

  have h := DiamondIntegral.Section6.rvPairMap_code_image_definable U.volume g;
  id
    (Eq.mpr
      (eq_of_heq
        ((fun M A L inst α s s' e'_6 =>
            Eq.casesOn (motive := fun a x => s' = a → e'_6 ≍ x → A.Definable L s ≍ A.Definable L s') e'_6
              (fun h =>
                Eq.ndrec (motive := fun s' => ∀ (e_6 : s = s'), e_6 ≍ Eq.refl s → A.Definable L s ≍ A.Definable L s')
                  (fun e_6 h => HEq.refl (A.Definable L s)) (Eq.symm h) e'_6)
              (Eq.refl s') (HEq.refl e'_6))
          M S SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV inst (Fin (n + 1) ⊕ Fin 1)
          {z |
            ∃ u,
              SpecialTransformations.Section4.rvValues (U.value u) = z ∘ Sum.inl ∧
                ↑(V.value (F.map.toFun u) j) = z (Sum.inr 0)}

            ∃ a,
              SpecialTransformations.Section4.rvValues ↑(U.volume.toFun a) = z ∘ Sum.inl ∧
                SpecialTransformations.Section4.rvValues ↑(g.toFun a) = z ∘ Sum.inr}
          (Set.ext fun z =>
            {
              mp := fun a =>
                Exists.casesOn a fun u h =>
                  And.casesOn h fun hu hv =>
                    Exists.intro u
                      ⟨hu,
                        funext fun i =>

                                  ∀ (this : i ∈ Fintype.elems),

                                        SpecialTransformations.Section4.rvValues (↑(g.toFun u))

@DiamondIntegral.Section6.rv_coordinate_swap_arithmetic : ∀ {M : Type}
  [inst : SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M]
  [inst_1 : M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {n : ℕ}

  i ≠ j →

theorem DiamondIntegral.Section6.rv_coordinate_swap_arithmetic : ∀ {M : Type}
  [inst : SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M]
  [inst_1 : M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {n : ℕ}
  (t : Fin n → DiamondIntegral.Section2.RVInfinity M) (i j : Fin n),
  i ≠ j →
    t i ≠ 0 →
      t j ≠ 0 →
        have a := Function.update t i (t i * t j);
        have b := Function.update a j (a i / a j);
        Function.update b i (b i / b j) = t ∘ ⇑(Equiv.swap i j) :=
fun {M} [SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M] [M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {n} t i
    j hij hi hj =>
  id
    (funext fun k =>
      if hki : k = i then
        Eq.symm hki ▸
          Eq.mpr
            (id
              (congr
                (congrArg Eq
                  (Eq.trans
                    (Function.update_congr
                      (congrArg (Function.update (Function.update t i (t i * t j)) j)
                        (congr (congrArg HDiv.hDiv (Function.update_self i (t i * t j) t))
                          ((fun x_0 v f => (fun x_0 => Function.update_of_ne (Ne.symm hij)) x_0 v f)
                            (fun a => DiamondIntegral.Section2.RVInfinity M) (t i * t j) t)))
                      (Eq.refl i)
                      (congr
                        (congrArg HDiv.hDiv
                          (Eq.trans
                            (Eq.trans

                                (congr (congrArg HDiv.hDiv (Function.update_self i (t i * t j) t))
                                  ((fun x_0 v f => (fun x_0 => Function.update_of_ne (Ne.symm hij)) x_0 v f)
                                    (fun a => DiamondIntegral.Section2.RVInfinity M) (t i * t j) t))
                                (Eq.refl i))
                              ((fun x_0 v f => (fun x_0 => Function.update_of_ne hij) x_0 v f)
                                (fun a => DiamondIntegral.Section2.RVInfinity M) (t i * t j / t j)
                                (Function.update t i (t i * t j))))
                            (Function.update_self i (t i * t j) t)))
                        (Eq.trans
                          (Function.update_congr (Eq.refl (Function.update t i (t i * t j))) (Eq.refl j)
                            (congr (congrArg HDiv.hDiv (Function.update_self i (t i * t j) t))
                              ((fun x_0 v f => (fun x_0 => Function.update_of_ne (Ne.symm hij)) x_0 v f)
                                (fun a => DiamondIntegral.Section2.RVInfinity M) (t i * t j) t))
                            (Eq.refl j))
                          (Function.update_self j (t i * t j / t j) (Function.update t i (t i * t j)))))
                      (Eq.refl i))
                    (Function.update_self i (t i * t j / (t i * t j / t j))
                      (Function.update (Function.update t i (t i * t j)) j (t i * t j / t j)))))
                (congrArg t (Equiv.swap_apply_left i j))))
            (Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => t i * t j / _a = t j) (mul_div_cancel_right₀ (t i) hj)))
              (Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => _a = t j) (mul_div_cancel_left₀ (t j) hi))) (Eq.refl (t j))))
      else
        if hkj : k = j then
          Eq.ndrec (motive := fun k =>
            ¬k = i →
              Function.update
                  (Function.update (Function.update t i (t i * t j)) j
                    (Function.update t i (t i * t j) i / Function.update t i (t i * t j) j))
                  i
                  (Function.update (Function.update t i (t i * t j)) j
                      (Function.update t i (t i * t j) i / Function.update t i (t i * t j) j) i /
                    Function.update (Function.update t i (t i * t j)) j
                      (Function.update t i (t i * t j) i / Function.update t i (t i * t j) j) j)
                  k =
                (t ∘ ⇑(Equiv.swap i j)) k)
            (fun hki =>
              Eq.mpr
                (id

                    (congrArg Eq
                      (Eq.trans
                        (Eq.trans

                              (congr (congrArg HDiv.hDiv (Function.update_self i (t i * t j) t))
                                ((fun x_0 v f => (fun x_0 => Function.update_of_ne (Ne.symm hij)) x_0 v f)

                            (Eq.refl i)
                            (congr
                              (congrArg HDiv.hDiv
                                (Function.update_congr (Eq.refl (Function.update t i (t i * t j))) (Eq.refl j)
                                  (congr (congrArg HDiv.hDiv (Function.update_self i (t i * t j) t))
                                    ((fun x_0 v f => (fun x_0 => Function.update_of_ne (Ne.symm hij)) x_0 v f)
                                      (fun a => DiamondIntegral.Section2.RVInfinity M) (t i * t j) t))
                                  (Eq.refl i)))
                              (Eq.trans
                                (Function.update_congr (Eq.refl (Function.update t i (t i * t j))) (Eq.refl j)
                                  (congr (congrArg HDiv.hDiv (Function.update_self i (t i * t j) t))
                                    ((fun x_0 v f => (fun x_0 => Function.update_of_ne (Ne.symm hij)) x_0 v f)
                                      (fun a => DiamondIntegral.Section2.RVInfinity M) (t i * t j) t))
                                  (Eq.refl j))

                (mul_div_cancel_right₀ (t i) hj))
            (Eq.symm hkj) hki

          of_eq_true
            (Eq.trans
              (congr
                (congrArg Eq
                  (Eq.trans
                    ((fun x_0 v f => (fun x_0 => Function.update_of_ne hki) x_0 v f)

                      ((fun x_0 v f => (fun x_0 => Function.update_of_ne hkj) x_0 v f)
                        (fun a => DiamondIntegral.Section2.RVInfinity M)
                        (Function.update t i (t i * t j) i / Function.update t i (t i * t j) j)

                      ((fun x_0 v f => (fun x_0 => Function.update_of_ne hki) x_0 v f)

                (congrArg t (Equiv.swap_apply_of_ne_of_ne hki hkj)))

@DiamondIntegral.Section6.exists_rv_transposition_chain : ∀ {M : Type}
  [inst : SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M] [M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF]

  i ≠ j →

theorem DiamondIntegral.Section6.exists_rv_transposition_chain : ∀ {M : Type}
  [inst : SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M] [M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF]
  {S : Set M} {n : ℕ} (U : SpecialTransformations.Section4.RVObject S n) (i j : Fin n),
  i ≠ j →
    U.volume.FiniteFibres →
      (∀ (u : ↑U.domain.carrier) (k : Fin n), ↑(U.value u k) ≠ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.iRVZero) →
        ∃ T, (∀ (u : ↑U.domain.carrier), T.iso.hom.map.toFun u = u) ∧ T.finiteVolume :=
fun {M} [SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M] [M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {S} {n}
    U i j hij hUF hU =>
  let A :=
    DiamondIntegral.Section6.rvCoordinateArithmeticObject U DiamondIntegral.Section6.RVCoordinateOperation.multiply i j;
  have hAF :=
    DiamondIntegral.Section6.rvCoordinateArithmeticObject_finiteVolume U
      DiamondIntegral.Section6.RVCoordinateOperation.multiply i j hij hUF hU;
  have hA :=
    DiamondIntegral.Section6.rvCoordinateArithmeticObject_nonzero U
      DiamondIntegral.Section6.RVCoordinateOperation.multiply i j hU;
  let B :=
    DiamondIntegral.Section6.rvCoordinateArithmeticObject A DiamondIntegral.Section6.RVCoordinateOperation.divideFrom j
      i;
  have hBF :=
    DiamondIntegral.Section6.rvCoordinateArithmeticObject_finiteVolume A
      DiamondIntegral.Section6.RVCoordinateOperation.divideFrom j i (Ne.symm hij) hAF hA;
  have hB :=
    DiamondIntegral.Section6.rvCoordinateArithmeticObject_nonzero A
      DiamondIntegral.Section6.RVCoordinateOperation.divideFrom j i hA;
  let C :=
    DiamondIntegral.Section6.rvCoordinateArithmeticObject B DiamondIntegral.Section6.RVCoordinateOperation.divide i j;
  have hCF :=
    DiamondIntegral.Section6.rvCoordinateArithmeticObject_finiteVolume B
      DiamondIntegral.Section6.RVCoordinateOperation.divide i j hij hBF hB;
  have hC :=
    DiamondIntegral.Section6.rvCoordinateArithmeticObject_nonzero B
      DiamondIntegral.Section6.RVCoordinateOperation.divide i j hB;
  have hValue := fun u =>
    id
      (Eq.mpr
        (id
          (congrArg (fun _a => _a = (U.reindexVolume (Equiv.swap i j)).value u)
            (DiamondIntegral.Section6.rvCoordinateArithmeticObject_value B
              DiamondIntegral.Section6.RVCoordinateOperation.divide i j u)))
        (id
          (id
            (Eq.mpr
              (id
                (congrArg (fun _a => Function.update _a i (_a i / _a j) = (U.reindexVolume (Equiv.swap i j)).value u)
                  (DiamondIntegral.Section6.rvCoordinateArithmeticObject_value A
                    DiamondIntegral.Section6.RVCoordinateOperation.divideFrom j i u)))
              (id
                (id
                  (Eq.mpr
                    (id
                      (congrArg
                        (fun _a =>
                          Function.update (Function.update _a j (_a i / _a j)) i
                              (Function.update _a j (_a i / _a j) i / Function.update _a j (_a i / _a j) j) =
                            (U.reindexVolume (Equiv.swap i j)).value u)
                        (DiamondIntegral.Section6.rvCoordinateArithmeticObject_value U
                          DiamondIntegral.Section6.RVCoordinateOperation.multiply i j u)))
                    (DiamondIntegral.Section6.rv_coordinate_swap_arithmetic (U.value u) i j hij
                      ((DiamondIntegral.Section6.rv_nonzero_code_iff (U.value u i)).mp (hU u i))
                      ((DiamondIntegral.Section6.rv_nonzero_code_iff (U.value u j)).mp (hU u j))))))))));
  let a :=
    DiamondIntegral.Section6.rvCoordinateArithmeticIso U DiamondIntegral.Section6.RVCoordinateOperation.multiply i j hij
      hUF hU;
  let b :=
    DiamondIntegral.Section6.rvCoordinateArithmeticIso A DiamondIntegral.Section6.RVCoordinateOperation.divideFrom j i
      (Ne.symm hij) hAF hA;
  let c :=
    DiamondIntegral.Section6.rvCoordinateArithmeticIso B DiamondIntegral.Section6.RVCoordinateOperation.divide i j hij
      hBF hB;
  let d :=
    SpecialTransformations.Section4.rvIsoOfVolumePreservingBijection
      (SpecialTransformations.DefinableGeometry.Map.id C.domain) Function.bijective_id fun u => Eq.symm (hValue u);
  have hd := fun u k hk => Eq.symm (congrFun (hValue u) k);
  let T :=
    DiamondIntegral.Section6.RVUnaryChain.step i a
      (DiamondIntegral.Section6.rvCoordinateArithmeticIso_unary U
        DiamondIntegral.Section6.RVCoordinateOperation.multiply i j hij hUF hU)
      (DiamondIntegral.Section6.RVUnaryChain.step j b
        (DiamondIntegral.Section6.rvCoordinateArithmeticIso_unary A
          DiamondIntegral.Section6.RVCoordinateOperation.divideFrom j i (Ne.symm hij) hAF hA)
        (DiamondIntegral.Section6.RVUnaryChain.step i c
          (DiamondIntegral.Section6.rvCoordinateArithmeticIso_unary B
            DiamondIntegral.Section6.RVCoordinateOperation.divide i j hij hBF hB)
          (DiamondIntegral.Section6.RVUnaryChain.step i d hd
            (DiamondIntegral.Section6.RVUnaryChain.identity (U.reindexVolume (Equiv.swap i j))))));
  Exists.intro T

@DiamondIntegral.Section6.value_mul_lt_mul : ∀ {M : Type} [inst : SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M]
  [inst_1 : M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {c x y : DiamondIntegral.Section2.VF M},
  c ≠ 0 →
    DiamondIntegral.Section2.vfValue x < DiamondIntegral.Section2.vfValue y →
      DiamondIntegral.Section2.vfValue (c * x) < DiamondIntegral.Section2.vfValue (c * y)
theorem DiamondIntegral.Section6.value_mul_lt_mul : ∀ {M : Type}
  [inst : SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M]
  [inst_1 : M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {c x y : DiamondIntegral.Section2.VF M},
  c ≠ 0 →
    DiamondIntegral.Section2.vfValue x < DiamondIntegral.Section2.vfValue y →
      DiamondIntegral.Section2.vfValue (c * x) < DiamondIntegral.Section2.vfValue (c * y) :=
fun {M} [SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M] [M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {c x y}
    hc hxy =>
  id
    (Eq.mpr
      (id
        (congrArg (fun _a => _a < SpecialTransformations.Section3.Values.vfValueHom (c * y))
          (map_mul SpecialTransformations.Section3.Values.vfValueHom c x)))
      (Eq.mpr
        (id
          (congrArg
            (fun _a =>
              SpecialTransformations.Section3.Values.vfValueHom c *
                  SpecialTransformations.Section3.Values.vfValueHom x <
                _a)
            (map_mul SpecialTransformations.Section3.Values.vfValueHom c y)))
        (id
          (Decidable.byContradiction fun h =>
            have h' := mul_le_mul' (le_refl (DiamondIntegral.Section2.vfValue c⁻¹)) (le_of_not_gt h);
            have hinv :=
              id
                (Eq.mpr
                  (id
                    (congrArg (fun _a => _a = 1)
                      (Eq.symm (map_mul SpecialTransformations.Section3.Values.vfValueHom c⁻¹ c))))
                  (Eq.mpr
                    (id
                      (congrArg (fun _a => SpecialTransformations.Section3.Values.vfValueHom _a = 1)
                        (inv_mul_cancel₀ hc)))
                    (Eq.mpr
                      (id (congrArg (fun _a => _a = 1) (map_one SpecialTransformations.Section3.Values.vfValueHom)))
                      (Eq.refl 1))));
            not_le.mpr hxy
              (Eq.mp
                (congrArg (fun _a => DiamondIntegral.Section2.vfValue y ≤ _a)
                  (one_mul (DiamondIntegral.Section2.vfValue x)))
                (Eq.mp
                  (congrArg (fun _a => _a ≤ 1 * DiamondIntegral.Section2.vfValue x)
                    (one_mul (DiamondIntegral.Section2.vfValue y)))
                  (Eq.mp
                    (congrArg
                      (fun _a => _a * DiamondIntegral.Section2.vfValue y ≤ _a * DiamondIntegral.Section2.vfValue x)
                      hinv)
                    (Eq.mp
                      (congrArg
                        (fun _a =>
                          DiamondIntegral.Section2.vfValue c⁻¹ * DiamondIntegral.Section2.vfValue c *
                              DiamondIntegral.Section2.vfValue y ≤
                            _a)
                        (Eq.symm
                          (mul_assoc (DiamondIntegral.Section2.vfValue c⁻¹) (DiamondIntegral.Section2.vfValue c)
                            (DiamondIntegral.Section2.vfValue x))))
                      (Eq.mp
                        (congrArg
                          (fun _a =>
                            _a ≤
                              DiamondIntegral.Section2.vfValue c⁻¹ *
                                (DiamondIntegral.Section2.vfValue c * DiamondIntegral.Section2.vfValue x))
                          (Eq.symm
                            (mul_assoc (DiamondIntegral.Section2.vfValue c⁻¹) (DiamondIntegral.Section2.vfValue c)
                              (DiamondIntegral.Section2.vfValue y))))
                        h')))))))))

theorem DiamondIntegral.Section6.remark_6_32 : ∀ {M : Type} [inst : SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M]

    a ≠ 0 →
      b ≠ 0 →

@DiamondIntegral.Section6.continuous_of_clopen_zero_complement : ∀ {X : Type u_1} {Y : Type u_2}
  [inst : TopologicalSpace X] [inst_1 : TopologicalSpace Y] [inst_2 : Zero Y] (D : Set X),
  IsClopen D → ∀ (g : X → Y), ContinuousOn g D → (∀ x ∉ D, g x = 0) → Continuous g
theorem DiamondIntegral.Section6.continuous_of_clopen_zero_complement.{u_1, u_2} : ∀ {X : Type u_1} {Y : Type u_2}
  [inst : TopologicalSpace X] [inst_1 : TopologicalSpace Y] [inst_2 : Zero Y] (D : Set X),
  IsClopen D → ∀ (g : X → Y), ContinuousOn g D → (∀ x ∉ D, g x = 0) → Continuous g :=
fun {X} {Y} [TopologicalSpace X] [TopologicalSpace Y] [Zero Y] D hD g hg hz =>
  continuous_iff_continuousAt.mpr fun x =>
    if hx : x ∈ D then ContinuousOn.continuousAt hg (IsOpen.mem_nhds (IsClopen.isOpen hD) hx)

      ContinuousAt.congr continuousAt_const
        (Filter.mp_mem (IsOpen.mem_nhds IsClosed.isOpen_compl hx) (Filter.univ_mem' (id fun y hy => Eq.symm (hz y hy))))

          Eq.casesOn (motive := fun a x => s' = a → e'_6 ≍ x → A.Definable L s ≍ A.Definable L s') e'_6

        (DiamondIntegral.Section6.rvPullbackCodeCondition R)
        (((fun g => g ∘ fun i => Sum.inr (Sum.inr i)) ⁻¹' (SpecialTransformations.Section4.rawMixedSpace n r).domain)ᶜ ∪

                  Or.casesOn h (fun h => False.elim (h he)) fun h => h })))

@DiamondIntegral.Section6.graft_source_iff : ∀ {M : Type} [inst : SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M]
  [inst_1 : M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {n r q : ℕ} {S : Set M}

  a ∈ DiamondIntegral.Section6.graphFibreSource (DiamondIntegral.Section6.graft hc τ) u v ↔

theorem DiamondIntegral.Section6.graft_source_iff : ∀ {M : Type}
  [inst : SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M]
  [inst_1 : M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {n r q : ℕ} {S : Set M}
  {A : SpecialTransformations.DefinableGeometry.DefSet (SpecialTransformations.Section4.rawMixedSpace n r) S}
  {D : SpecialTransformations.DefinableGeometry.DefSet (SpecialTransformations.Section4.rawMixedSpace 0 q) S}
  (hc : CanonicalStructure.IsCanonical) (τ : SpecialTransformations.DefinableGeometry.Map A D)
  (u : Fin r → DiamondIntegral.Section2.RVInfinity M) (v : Fin (r + q) → DiamondIntegral.Section2.RVInfinity M)
  (a : Fin n → DiamondIntegral.Section2.VF M),
  a ∈ DiamondIntegral.Section6.graphFibreSource (DiamondIntegral.Section6.graft hc τ) u v ↔
    u = v ∘ Fin.castAdd q ∧ a ∈ DiamondIntegral.Section6.graphFibreSource τ u (v ∘ Fin.natAdd r) :=
fun {M} [SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M] [M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {n r q}
    {S} {A} {D} hc τ u v a =>
  {
    mp := fun a_1 =>
      Exists.casesOn a_1 fun b h =>
        Exists.casesOn h fun p h =>
          And.casesOn h fun hp hgp =>
            have hOld := congrArg Prod.snd hp;
            have htags :=
              congrArg Prod.snd
                (Eq.mp (congrArg (fun _a => _a = (b, v)) (DiamondIntegral.Section6.graft_apply hc τ p)) hgp);
            have hu :=
              funext fun i =>
                id
                  (Eq.mp
                    (congrFun'
                      (congrArg Eq
                        (Eq.trans (congrFun' (congrFun' (congrArg Fin.append hOld) (↑(τ.toFun p)).2) (Fin.castAdd q i))
                          (Fin.append_left u (↑(τ.toFun p)).2 i)))
                      (v (Fin.castAdd q i)))
                    (congrFun htags (Fin.castAdd q i)));
            have hnew :=
              funext fun i =>
                id
                  (Eq.mp (congrFun' (congrArg Eq (Fin.append_right (↑p).2 (↑(τ.toFun p)).2 i)) (v (Fin.natAdd r i)))
                    (congrFun htags (Fin.natAdd r i)));
            ⟨hu, Exists.intro (↑(τ.toFun p)).1 (Exists.intro p ⟨hp, Prod.ext rfl hnew⟩)⟩,
    mpr := fun a_1 =>
      And.casesOn a_1 fun hu right =>
        Exists.casesOn right fun b h =>
          Exists.casesOn h fun p h =>
            And.casesOn h fun hp hτp =>
              Exists.intro a
                (Exists.intro p
                  ⟨hp,
                    Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => _a = (a, v)) (DiamondIntegral.Section6.graft_apply hc τ p)))
                      (Prod.ext (congrArg (fun x => x.1) hp)
                        (funext fun i =>
                          Fin.addCases
                            (fun i =>
                              have hOld := congrArg (fun x => x.2 i) hp;
                              Eq.mpr
                                (id
                                  (congrFun' (congrArg Eq (Fin.append_left (↑p).2 (↑(τ.toFun p)).2 i))
                                    (v (Fin.castAdd q i))))
                                (Eq.trans hOld (congrFun hu i)))
                            (fun i =>
                              have hNew := congrArg (fun x => x.2 i) hτp;
                              Eq.mpr
                                (id
                                  (congrFun' (congrArg Eq (Fin.append_right (↑p).2 (↑(τ.toFun p)).2 i))
                                    (v (Fin.natAdd r i))))
                                hNew)
                            i))⟩) }

  [inst : SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M]

theorem DiamondIntegral.Section6.graft_rvBounded : ∀ {M : Type}
  [inst : SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M]
  [inst_1 : M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {n r q : ℕ} {S : Set M}
  {A : SpecialTransformations.DefinableGeometry.DefSet (SpecialTransformations.Section4.rawMixedSpace n r) S}
  {D : SpecialTransformations.DefinableGeometry.DefSet (SpecialTransformations.Section4.rawMixedSpace 0 q) S}
  (hc : CanonicalStructure.IsCanonical) (τ : SpecialTransformations.DefinableGeometry.Map A D),
  DiamondIntegral.Section6.RVSupportDoublyBounded A.carrier →
    DiamondIntegral.Section6.RVSupportDoublyBounded (DiamondIntegral.Section6.mixedMapRange τ) →
      DiamondIntegral.Section6.RVSupportDoublyBounded (DiamondIntegral.Section6.graftMap hc τ).image.carrier :=
fun {M} [SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M] [M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {n r q}
    {S} {A} {D} hc τ hA hτ =>
  Exists.casesOn hA fun γ hγ =>
    Exists.casesOn hτ fun δ hδ =>
      let ε := max γ δ;
      have hlowγ :=
        have this := inv_le_inv' (le_max_left γ δ);
        this;
      have hlowδ :=
        have this := inv_le_inv' (le_max_right γ δ);
        this;
      have hhighγ := le_max_left ↑γ ↑δ;
      have hhighδ := le_max_right ↑γ ↑δ;
      Exists.intro ε fun p a =>
        Exists.casesOn (motive := fun x =>
          ∀ (i : Fin (r + q)),
            ↑ε⁻¹ ≤ SpecialTransformations.Section3.Values.vrv (p.2 i) ∧
              SpecialTransformations.Section3.Values.vrv (p.2 i) ≤ ↑ε)
          a fun p_1 h =>
          Eq.ndrec (motive := fun p =>
            ∀ (i : Fin (r + q)),
              ↑ε⁻¹ ≤ SpecialTransformations.Section3.Values.vrv (p.2 i) ∧
                SpecialTransformations.Section3.Values.vrv (p.2 i) ≤ ↑ε)
            (fun i =>
              id
                (Fin.addCases
                  (fun i =>
                    Eq.mpr
                      (id
                        (congr
                          (congrArg And
                            (congrArg (LE.le ↑ε⁻¹)

theorem DiamondIntegral.Section6.rvRowScalarRelation_at : ∀ {M : Type}
  [inst : SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M] [M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF]
  {n m : ℕ} (R : Set (Fin n ⊕ Fin m → M)) (x : Fin n → M) (y : M),
  (Sum.elim x fun x => y) ∈ DiamondIntegral.Section6.rvRowScalarRelation R ↔
    ∃ u, Sum.elim x (SpecialTransformations.Section4.rvValues u) ∈ R ∧ ∃ j, ↑(u j) = y :=

    x y =>
  {
    mp := fun h =>
      Exists.casesOn (Set.mem_iUnion.mp h) fun j hj =>
        have hImage := hj;

          (Eq.mp
            (congrArg (fun _a => (fun x => y) ∈ _a)
              (DiamondIntegral.Section6.parameterCodeImage_at (DiamondIntegral.Section6.typedRVRowRelation R)
                (DiamondIntegral.Section6.rvRowCoordinateCode j) x))
            hImage)
          fun w h =>
          And.casesOn h fun left hwOut =>
            And.casesOn left fun hwR hwDom =>
              let u := (SpecialTransformations.Section4.rawRVSpace m).decode ⟨w, hwDom⟩;
              have hu := SpecialTransformations.Section4.rvValues_decode ⟨w, hwDom⟩;

      Exists.casesOn a fun u h =>

                      (DiamondIntegral.Section6.parameterCodeImage_at (DiamondIntegral.Section6.typedRVRowRelation R)
                        (DiamondIntegral.Section6.rvRowCoordinateCode j) x)

      Exists.casesOn ((DiamondIntegral.Section2.mem_rvHull_iff C.carrier p).mp hp) fun q h =>

theorem DiamondIntegral.Section6.rvLabelTranslation_image_fibre : ∀ {M : Type}
  [inst : SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M]
  [inst_1 : M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {S : Set M} {n r : ℕ}
  {A : SpecialTransformations.DefinableGeometry.DefSet (SpecialTransformations.Section4.rawMixedSpace n r) S}
  (δ :
    SpecialTransformations.DefinableGeometry.Map A
      (SpecialTransformations.DefinableGeometry.DefSet.univ (SpecialTransformations.Section4.rawVFSpace n) S)),
  (∀ (p z : ↑A.carrier), (↑p).2 = (↑z).2 → δ.toFun p = δ.toFun z) →
    ∀ (p : ↑A.carrier),
      DiamondIntegral.Section2.vfFibre (DiamondIntegral.Section6.rvLabelTranslationMap δ).image.carrier (↑p).2 =
        {x | (x - DiamondIntegral.Section6.rvTranslationVector δ p, (↑p).2) ∈ A.carrier} :=
fun {M} [SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M] [M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {S}
    {n r} {A} δ hδ p =>
  Set.ext fun x =>
    {
      mp := fun a =>
        Exists.casesOn a fun z hz =>
          id
            (fun hz =>
              have hTags := congrArg (fun w => w.2) hz;
              id
                (fun hTags =>
                  have hValues := congrArg (fun w => w.1) hz;
                  have hShift := congrArg Subtype.val (hδ z p hTags);
                  have hSource :=
                    eq_sub_iff_add_eq.mpr
                      (Eq.mp (congrArg (fun _a => DiamondIntegral.Section6.rvTranslationHead z + _a = x) hShift)
                        hValues);
                  have hPoint := Prod.ext hSource hTags;
                  id (hPoint ▸ z.property))
                hTags)
            hz,
      mpr := fun hx =>
        let z := ⟨(x - DiamondIntegral.Section6.rvTranslationVector δ p, (↑p).2), hx⟩;
        Exists.intro z
          (id
            (have hShift := congrArg Subtype.val (hδ z p rfl);
            Eq.mpr
              (id
                (congrArg (fun _a => (DiamondIntegral.Section6.rvTranslationHead z + _a, (↑z).2) = (x, (↑p).2)) hShift))
              (id
                (Eq.mpr
                  (id
                    (congrArg (fun _a => (_a, (↑p).2) = (x, (↑p).2))
                      (sub_add_cancel x (DiamondIntegral.Section6.rvTranslationVector δ p))))
                  (Eq.refl (x, (↑p).2)))))) }

  [inst : SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M]
  [inst_1 : M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {S : Set M} {n : ℕ}
  {U V : SpecialTransformations.Section4.RVObject S (n + 1)} (F : SpecialTransformations.Section4.RVHom U V)
  (j : Fin (n + 1)) (E : SpecialTransformations.Section3.RawClosure.Tuple.GoodRelation S) (u : ↑U.domain.carrier),

    (Fin.init (SpecialTransformations.Section4.rvValues (U.value u)), ↑(V.value (F.map.toFun u) j)) ∉ ↑E :=

    {U V} F j E u =>
  have hmem :=
    id
      (Eq.mpr
        (id
          (congrArg
            (fun _a =>
              _a ∈ DiamondIntegral.Section6.finiteRelationGraph E ↔
                (Fin.init (SpecialTransformations.Section4.rvValues (U.value u)), ↑(V.value (F.map.toFun u) j)) ∈ ↑E)

            (congrFun'
              (congrArg Iff
                (Eq.trans Set.mem_setOf_eq
                  (congrArg (Membership.mem ↑E)

                      (congrArg Prod.mk
                        (Fin.init_snoc (↑(V.value (F.map.toFun u) j))
                          (Fin.init (SpecialTransformations.Section4.rvValues (U.value u)))))

                        (Fin.init (SpecialTransformations.Section4.rvValues (U.value u))))))))
              ((Fin.init (SpecialTransformations.Section4.rvValues (U.value u)), ↑(V.value (F.map.toFun u) j)) ∈ ↑E))
            (iff_self
              ((Fin.init (SpecialTransformations.Section4.rvValues (U.value u)), ↑(V.value (F.map.toFun u) j)) ∈
                ↑E)))));

    mp := fun a =>
      Exists.casesOn a fun v h =>
        And.casesOn h fun hv hnot =>
          have he := Subtype.ext hv;
          (Iff.not hmem).mp (he ▸ hnot),
    mpr := fun hnot => Exists.intro u ⟨rfl, (Iff.not hmem).mpr hnot⟩ }

  [inst_1 : M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {T : Set M} {n r : ℕ} {ι : Type} [Finite ι]
  (R : Set (ι ⊕ Fin n ⊕ Fin r → M)) (a : ι → M)
  (A : SpecialTransformations.DefinableGeometry.DefSet (SpecialTransformations.Section4.rawMixedSpace n r) T),
  {z | Sum.elim a z ∈ R} = (SpecialTransformations.Section4.rawMixedSpace n r).preimage A.carrier →
    (a ∈ DiamondIntegral.Section6.rvPullbackParameterLocus R ↔ DiamondIntegral.Section2.IsRVPullback A.carrier) :=
fun {M} [SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M] [M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {T}
    {n r} {ι} [Finite ι] R a A hSource =>
  let P := SpecialTransformations.Section4.rawMixedSpace n r;
  have hAt := fun p =>
    have h :=
      SpecialTransformations.DefinableGeometry.Space.preimage_decode P A.carrier
        ⟨SpecialTransformations.Section4.mixedValues p, SpecialTransformations.Section4.mixedValues_mem_domain p⟩;
    Iff.trans (Set.ext_iff.mp hSource (SpecialTransformations.Section4.mixedValues p))
      (Eq.mp
        (congrArg
          (fun _a =>
            ↑⟨SpecialTransformations.Section4.mixedValues p, SpecialTransformations.Section4.mixedValues_mem_domain p⟩ ∈
                P.preimage A.carrier ↔
              _a ∈ A.carrier)
          (SpecialTransformations.Section4.decode_mixedValues p))
        h);
  {
    mp := fun h =>
      Set.Subset.antisymm
        (fun ⦃q⦄ hq =>
          Exists.casesOn ((DiamondIntegral.Section2.mem_rvHull_iff A.carrier q).mp hq) fun p h_1 =>
            And.casesOn h_1 fun hp right =>
              And.casesOn right fun hVF hRV =>
                have hCode :=
                  h (SpecialTransformations.Section4.mixedValues p) ((hAt p).mpr hp)
                    (SpecialTransformations.Section4.mixedValues q);
                have hTarget :=
                  hCode (SpecialTransformations.Section4.mixedValues_mem_domain q)
                    ((DiamondIntegral.Section6.rawMixedRVEqual_at p q).mpr ⟨hVF, hRV⟩);
                (hAt q).mp hTarget)
        (DiamondIntegral.Section2.subset_rvHull A.carrier),
    mpr := fun h x hx y hy hEqual =>
      Exists.casesOn ((Set.ext_iff.mp hSource x).mp hx) fun hxDom hxA =>
        let p := P.decode ⟨x, hxDom⟩;
        let q := P.decode ⟨y, hy⟩;
        have hP := SpecialTransformations.Section4.mixedValues_decode ⟨x, hxDom⟩;
        have hQ := SpecialTransformations.Section4.mixedValues_decode ⟨y, hy⟩;
        have hPair :=
          Eq.mpr
            (id
              (congrArg
                (fun _a =>
                  Sum.elim _a (SpecialTransformations.Section4.mixedValues q) ∈
                    DiamondIntegral.Section6.rawMixedRVEqual n r)
                hP))
            (Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => Sum.elim x _a ∈ DiamondIntegral.Section6.rawMixedRVEqual n r) hQ)) hEqual);
        And.casesOn ((DiamondIntegral.Section6.rawMixedRVEqual_at p q).mp hPair) fun hVF hRV =>
          have hq := DiamondIntegral.Section6.rvPullback_mem_of_sameRV h hxA hVF hRV;
          have hCode := (hAt q).mpr hq;
          Eq.mp (congrArg (fun _a => Sum.elim a _a ∈ R) hQ) hCode }

    {n r s} {I} {G} [LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero G] [Valued (DiamondIntegral.Section2.VF M) G] {A} {B} {X} {f} {P}
    h00 F hinj i hPA =>
  DiamondIntegral.Section6.defSet_eq_of_carrier_eq
    (Set.ext fun q =>
      {
        mp := fun a =>
          Exists.casesOn a fun p h =>
            h ▸
              let p' := ⟨↑p, DiamondIntegral.Section6.RVRefinementFrame.selectedPiece_subset X (P i) p.property⟩;
              (DiamondIntegral.Section6.RVRefinementFrame.mem_selectedPiece F.target (f.restrict hPA).image
                    ↑(F.map.toFun p')).mpr
                (have hOld :=
                  ((DiamondIntegral.Section6.RVRefinementFrame.mem_selectedPiece X (P i) ↑p).mp p.property).right;
                ⟨(F.map.toFun p').property, Exists.intro ⟨↑(X.oldPoint p'), hOld⟩ (Eq.symm (F.commutes p'))⟩),
        mpr := fun hq =>
          And.casesOn
            ((DiamondIntegral.Section6.RVRefinementFrame.mem_selectedPiece F.target (f.restrict hPA).image q).mp hq)
            fun hqT hqOld =>
            Exists.casesOn
              (Function.Bijective.surjective
                (DiamondIntegral.Section6.SpecialCovariantChain.bijective
                  (DiamondIntegral.Section6.CentripetalChain.toSpecial
                    (DiamondIntegral.Section6.SynchronizedCentripetalChain.toChain F.chain))
                  h00)
                ⟨q, hqT⟩)
              fun p hp =>
              have hpoint := congrArg Subtype.val hp;
              have hComm := F.commutes p;
              Exists.casesOn hqOld fun a ha =>
                have hEq :=
                  Subtype.ext
                    (Eq.trans ha
                      (Eq.mp (congrArg (fun _a => (_a.1, _a.2 ∘ F.target.labels) = ↑(f.toFun (X.oldPoint p))) hpoint)
                        hComm));
                have hOld := congrArg Subtype.val (hinj hEq) ▸ a.property;
                Exists.intro
                  ⟨↑p, (DiamondIntegral.Section6.RVRefinementFrame.mem_selectedPiece X (P i) ↑p).mpr ⟨p.property, hOld⟩⟩
                  hpoint })

    {n r} {G} [LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero G] [Valued (DiamondIntegral.Section2.VF M) G] {A} X ω hSame hLevels u γ =>
  if hFibre : (DiamondIntegral.Section2.vfFibre X.coveredBase.carrier u).Nonempty then
    Exists.casesOn hFibre fun x hx =>
      Exists.casesOn (DiamondIntegral.Section6.map_toImage_surjective X.oldMap ⟨(x, u), hx⟩) fun p hp =>

        (DiamondIntegral.Section6.RVRefinementFrame.selectedPiece_fibre X P u)))
    (Or.casesOn (motive := fun t =>
      X.fibres u = t →
        DiamondIntegral.Section2.vfFibre X.base.carrier u ∩ DiamondIntegral.Section2.vfFibre P.carrier (u ∘ X.labels) =
            ∅ ∨
          DiamondIntegral.Section2.vfFibre X.base.carrier u ∩
              DiamondIntegral.Section2.vfFibre P.carrier (u ∘ X.labels) =
            DiamondIntegral.Section2.vfFibre P.carrier (u ∘ X.labels))

          (Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => _a ∩ DiamondIntegral.Section2.vfFibre P.carrier (u ∘ X.labels) = ∅) he))

                (fun _a =>
                  _a ∩ DiamondIntegral.Section2.vfFibre P.carrier (u ∘ X.labels) =
                    DiamondIntegral.Section2.vfFibre P.carrier (u ∘ X.labels))

                      IntegrationInACVF.Section3ACVF.NamedBallSetup.gamma_scalar_of_code h00 C α tα htα0 htα

                    have hβ :=
                      IntegrationInACVF.Section3ACVF.NamedBallSetup.gamma_scalar_of_code h00 C β tβ htβ0 htβ
                        (Or.inr (Exists.intro 2 rfl));
                    have hδ :=

                      IntegrationInACVF.Section3ACVF.FullBaseAtomicity.OverBase.of_real

theorem DiamondIntegral.Section6.ramified_relative_aperture_values_ne : ∀ {M : Type}
  [inst : SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M]
  [inst_1 : M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] (ρ γ : DiamondIntegral.Section2.Gamma M),
  1 < ρ → γ ^ 2 = ρ → ∀ (m n : ℤ), ρ ^ m * γ ≠ ρ ^ n :=
fun {M} [SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M] [M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] ρ γ hρ
    hγ m n he =>
  have hPow :=
    Trans.trans
      (Trans.trans
        (of_eq_true
          (Eq.trans
            (congr
              (congrArg Eq
                (Eq.trans (zpow_add ρ (m * 2) 1)
                  (congr (congrArg HMul.hMul (Eq.trans (zpow_mul ρ m 2) (zpow_ofNat (ρ ^ m) 2)))
                    (Eq.trans (zpow_ofNat ρ 1) (pow_one ρ)))))
              (Eq.trans (mul_pow (ρ ^ m) γ 2) (congrArg (HMul.hMul ((ρ ^ m) ^ 2)) hγ)))
            (eq_self ((ρ ^ m) ^ 2 * ρ))))
        (congrArg (fun x => x ^ 2) he))
      (of_eq_true
        (Eq.trans (congrArg (Eq ((ρ ^ n) ^ 2)) (Eq.trans (zpow_mul ρ n 2) (zpow_ofNat (ρ ^ n) 2)))
          (eq_self ((ρ ^ n) ^ 2))));
  have hExp := (zpow_right_inj hρ).mp hPow;
  DiamondIntegral.Section6.ramified_relative_aperture_values_ne._proof_1_1 m n hExp

theorem DiamondIntegral.Section6.CentripetalData.refineLabels_point_commutes : ∀ {M : Type}
  [inst : SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M]
  [inst_1 : M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {n r s : ℕ} {S : Set M} {G : Type}
  [inst_2 : LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero G] [inst_3 : Valued (DiamondIntegral.Section2.VF M) G]
  {A : SpecialTransformations.DefinableGeometry.DefSet (SpecialTransformations.Section4.rawMixedSpace n r) S}
  {C : SpecialTransformations.DefinableGeometry.DefSet (SpecialTransformations.Section4.rawMixedSpace n s) S}
  (D : DiamondIntegral.Section6.CentripetalData A) (π : Fin r → Fin s)
  (hC : DiamondIntegral.Section6.ProperInvariant S C.carrier)
  (hDouble : DiamondIntegral.Section6.VFDoublyBounded C.carrier)
  (hTagged :
    ∀ p ∈ C.carrier,
      ∀ q ∈ C.carrier, p.2 = q.2 → DiamondIntegral.Section2.tupleRV M p.1 = DiamondIntegral.Section2.tupleRV M q.1)
  (hFibres :
    ∀ (u : Fin s → DiamondIntegral.Section2.RVInfinity M),
      DiamondIntegral.Section2.vfFibre C.carrier u = ∅ ∨
        DiamondIntegral.Section2.vfFibre C.carrier u = DiamondIntegral.Section2.vfFibre A.carrier (u ∘ π)),
  ∀ p ∈ C.carrier,
    have E := D.refineLabels π hC hDouble hTagged hFibres;
    ((E.point p).1, (E.point p).2 ∘ DiamondIntegral.Section6.prefixLabelSelection π) = D.point (p.1, p.2 ∘ π) :=
fun {M} [SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M] [M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {n r s}
    {S} {G} [LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero G] [Valued (DiamondIntegral.Section2.VF M) G] {A} {C} D π hC hDouble hTagged
    hFibres p hp =>
  let E := D.refineLabels π hC hDouble hTagged hFibres;
  have hFocus :=
    DiamondIntegral.Section6.CentripetalData.refineLabels_extendedFocus D π hC hDouble hTagged hFibres p hp;
  have hCore := DiamondIntegral.Section6.CentripetalData.refineLabels_core D π hC hDouble hTagged hFibres p hp;
  Prod.ext
    (id
      (Eq.mpr
        (id
          (congrArg
            (fun _a =>
              Function.update p.1 D.coordinate
                  (p.1 D.coordinate - _a + if E.core p = true then D.coefficient * _a else 0) =
                (D.point (p.1, p.2 ∘ π)).1)
            hFocus))
        (Eq.mpr
          (id
            (congrArg
              (fun _a =>
                Function.update p.1 D.coordinate
                    (p.1 D.coordinate - D.extendedFocus (p.1, p.2 ∘ π) +
                      if _a = true then D.coefficient * D.extendedFocus (p.1, p.2 ∘ π) else 0) =
                  (D.point (p.1, p.2 ∘ π)).1)
              hCore))
          (Eq.refl
            (Function.update p.1 D.coordinate
              (p.1 D.coordinate - D.extendedFocus (p.1, p.2 ∘ π) +
                if D.core (p.1, p.2 ∘ π) = true then D.coefficient * D.extendedFocus (p.1, p.2 ∘ π) else 0))))))
    (id
      (Eq.mpr
        (id
          (congrArg
            (fun _a =>
              Fin.append (fun x => DiamondIntegral.Section6.branchTag _a) p.2 ∘
                  DiamondIntegral.Section6.prefixLabelSelection π =
                Fin.append (fun x => DiamondIntegral.Section6.branchTag (D.core (p.1, p.2 ∘ π))) (p.2 ∘ π))
            hCore))
        (Eq.mpr
          (id
            (congrArg
              (fun _a =>
                _a = Fin.append (fun x => DiamondIntegral.Section6.branchTag (D.core (p.1, p.2 ∘ π))) (p.2 ∘ π))
              (DiamondIntegral.Section6.append_prefixLabelSelection π
                (fun x => DiamondIntegral.Section6.branchTag (D.core (p.1, p.2 ∘ π))) p.2)))
          (Eq.refl (Fin.append (fun x => DiamondIntegral.Section6.branchTag (D.core (p.1, p.2 ∘ π))) (p.2 ∘ π))))))

        DiamondIntegral.Section2.vfFibre C.carrier u = DiamondIntegral.Section2.vfFibre A.carrier (u ∘ π)),

    {S} {G} [LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero G] [Valued (DiamondIntegral.Section2.VF M) G] {A} {C} D π hC hDouble hTagged
    hFibres hCover =>
  Set.Subset.antisymm
    (fun ⦃q⦄ a =>
      Exists.casesOn a fun z h =>
        And.casesOn h fun left right =>
          Exists.casesOn left fun p h =>
            And.casesOn h fun hp right_1 =>

                (fun q => (q.1, q.2 ∘ DiamondIntegral.Section6.prefixLabelSelection π)) z = q →

                right_1 right)

@DiamondIntegral.Section6.RVRefinementFrame.port_source_iff : ∀ {M : Type}
  [inst : SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M]
  [inst_1 : M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {S : Set M} {n m r s : ℕ}
  {A : SpecialTransformations.DefinableGeometry.DefSet (SpecialTransformations.Section4.rawMixedSpace n r) S}
