theorem DiamondIntegral.Section6.RVRefinementFrame.port_source_iff : ∀ {M : Type}
  [inst : SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M]
  [inst_1 : M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {S : Set M} {n m r s : ℕ}
  {A : SpecialTransformations.DefinableGeometry.DefSet (SpecialTransformations.Section4.rawMixedSpace n r) S}
  {B : SpecialTransformations.DefinableGeometry.DefSet (SpecialTransformations.Section4.rawMixedSpace m s) S}
  (hc : CanonicalStructure.IsCanonical) (X : DiamondIntegral.Section6.RVRefinementFrame A)
  (f : SpecialTransformations.DefinableGeometry.Map A B) (u : Fin X.arity → DiamondIntegral.Section2.RVInfinity M)
  (v : Fin (s + X.arity) → DiamondIntegral.Section2.RVInfinity M) (a : Fin n → DiamondIntegral.Section2.VF M),
  a ∈ DiamondIntegral.Section6.graphFibreSource (DiamondIntegral.Section6.RVRefinementFrame.portMap hc X f) u v ↔
    u = v ∘ Fin.natAdd s ∧
      (a, u) ∈ X.base.carrier ∧
        a ∈ DiamondIntegral.Section6.graphFibreSource f (u ∘ X.labels) (v ∘ Fin.castAdd X.arity) :=
fun {M} [SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M] [M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {S}
    {n m r s} {A} {B} hc X f u v a =>
  {
    mp := fun a_1 =>
      Exists.casesOn a_1 fun b h =>
        Exists.casesOn h fun p h =>
          And.casesOn h fun hp hfp =>
            have hTail :=
              funext fun i =>
                have h := congrArg (fun q => q.2 (Fin.natAdd s i)) hfp;
                id
                  (Eq.mp
                    (congrFun'
                      (congrArg Eq
                        (Eq.trans (Fin.append_right (↑(f.toFun (X.oldPoint p))).2 (↑p).2 i)
                          (congrArg (fun q => q.2 i) hp)))
                      (v (Fin.natAdd s i)))
                    h);
            ⟨hTail,
              ⟨hp ▸ p.property,
                Exists.intro b
                  (DiamondIntegral.Section6.RVRefinementFrame.port_graph_lies_over hc X f u v a b
                    (Exists.intro p ⟨hp, hfp⟩))⟩⟩,
    mpr := fun a_1 =>
      And.casesOn a_1 fun hTail right =>
        And.casesOn right fun hx right =>
          Exists.casesOn right fun y h =>
            Exists.casesOn h fun b h =>
              And.casesOn h fun hb hfb =>
                let p := ⟨(a, u), hx⟩;
                have hOld := Subtype.ext hb;
                have hTags :=
                  Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => (↑(f.toFun _a)).2 = v ∘ Fin.castAdd X.arity) (Eq.symm hOld)))
                    (congrArg Prod.snd hfb);
                Exists.intro (↑(f.toFun (X.oldPoint p))).1
                  (Exists.intro p
                    ⟨rfl,
                      Prod.ext (Eq.refl (↑((DiamondIntegral.Section6.RVRefinementFrame.portMap hc X f).toFun p)).1)
                        (funext fun i =>
                          Fin.addCases
                            (fun j =>
                              Eq.mpr
                                (id
                                  (congrFun' (congrArg Eq (Fin.append_left (↑(f.toFun (X.oldPoint p))).2 (↑p).2 j))
                                    (v (Fin.castAdd X.arity j))))
                                (congrFun hTags j))
                            (fun j =>
                              Eq.mpr
                                (id
                                  (congrFun' (congrArg Eq (Fin.append_right (↑(f.toFun (X.oldPoint p))).2 (↑p).2 j))
                                    (v (Fin.natAdd s j))))
                                (congrFun hTail j))
                            i)⟩) }

@DiamondIntegral.Section6.RVRefinementFrame.port_graph_source : ∀ {M : Type}
  [inst : SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M]
  [inst_1 : M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {S : Set M} {n m r s : ℕ}
  {A : SpecialTransformations.DefinableGeometry.DefSet (SpecialTransformations.Section4.rawMixedSpace n r) S}
  {B : SpecialTransformations.DefinableGeometry.DefSet (SpecialTransformations.Section4.rawMixedSpace m s) S}
  (hc : CanonicalStructure.IsCanonical) (X : DiamondIntegral.Section6.RVRefinementFrame A)
  (f : SpecialTransformations.DefinableGeometry.Map A B) (u : Fin X.arity → DiamondIntegral.Section2.RVInfinity M)
  (v : Fin (s + X.arity) → DiamondIntegral.Section2.RVInfinity M),
  DiamondIntegral.Section6.graphFibreSource (DiamondIntegral.Section6.RVRefinementFrame.portMap hc X f) u v =
    if u = v ∘ Fin.natAdd s then
      DiamondIntegral.Section2.vfFibre X.base.carrier u ∩
        DiamondIntegral.Section6.graphFibreSource f (u ∘ X.labels) (v ∘ Fin.castAdd X.arity)
    else ∅
theorem DiamondIntegral.Section6.RVRefinementFrame.port_graph_source : ∀ {M : Type}
  [inst : SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M]
  [inst_1 : M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {S : Set M} {n m r s : ℕ}
  {A : SpecialTransformations.DefinableGeometry.DefSet (SpecialTransformations.Section4.rawMixedSpace n r) S}
  {B : SpecialTransformations.DefinableGeometry.DefSet (SpecialTransformations.Section4.rawMixedSpace m s) S}
  (hc : CanonicalStructure.IsCanonical) (X : DiamondIntegral.Section6.RVRefinementFrame A)
  (f : SpecialTransformations.DefinableGeometry.Map A B) (u : Fin X.arity → DiamondIntegral.Section2.RVInfinity M)
  (v : Fin (s + X.arity) → DiamondIntegral.Section2.RVInfinity M),
  DiamondIntegral.Section6.graphFibreSource (DiamondIntegral.Section6.RVRefinementFrame.portMap hc X f) u v =
    if u = v ∘ Fin.natAdd s then
      DiamondIntegral.Section2.vfFibre X.base.carrier u ∩
        DiamondIntegral.Section6.graphFibreSource f (u ∘ X.labels) (v ∘ Fin.castAdd X.arity)
    else ∅ :=
fun {M} [SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M] [M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {S}
    {n m r s} {A} {B} hc X f u v =>
  Set.ext fun a =>
    Eq.mpr
      (id
        (congrArg
          (fun _a =>
            _a ↔
              a ∈
                if u = v ∘ Fin.natAdd s then
                  DiamondIntegral.Section2.vfFibre X.base.carrier u ∩
                    DiamondIntegral.Section6.graphFibreSource f (u ∘ X.labels) (v ∘ Fin.castAdd X.arity)
                else ∅)
          (propext (DiamondIntegral.Section6.RVRefinementFrame.port_source_iff hc X f u v a))))
      (if h : u = v ∘ Fin.natAdd s then
        Eq.mpr
          (id
            (congrArg
              (Iff
                (u = v ∘ Fin.natAdd s ∧
                  (a, u) ∈ X.base.carrier ∧
                    a ∈ DiamondIntegral.Section6.graphFibreSource f (u ∘ X.labels) (v ∘ Fin.castAdd X.arity)))
              (congrFun' (congrArg Membership.mem (ite_eq_left h)) a)))
          (and_iff_right h)
      else
        Eq.mpr
          (id
            (congrArg
              (Iff
                (u = v ∘ Fin.natAdd s ∧
                  (a, u) ∈ X.base.carrier ∧
                    a ∈ DiamondIntegral.Section6.graphFibreSource f (u ∘ X.labels) (v ∘ Fin.castAdd X.arity)))
              (congrFun' (congrArg Membership.mem (ite_eq_right h)) a)))
          (of_eq_true
            (Eq.trans
              (congr
                (congrArg Iff
                  (Eq.trans
                    (congrFun' (congrArg And (eq_false h))
                      ((a, u) ∈ X.base.carrier ∧
                        a ∈ DiamondIntegral.Section6.graphFibreSource f (u ∘ X.labels) (v ∘ Fin.castAdd X.arity)))
                    (false_and
                      ((a, u) ∈ X.base.carrier ∧
                        a ∈ DiamondIntegral.Section6.graphFibreSource f (u ∘ X.labels) (v ∘ Fin.castAdd X.arity)))))
                (DiamondIntegral.Section6.RVRefinementFrame.port_graph_source._simp_1_1 a))
              (iff_self False))))

 Quot.sound]

theorem DiamondIntegral.Section6.RVRefinementFrame.port_graph_range : ∀ {M : Type}
  [inst : SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M]
  [inst_1 : M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {S : Set M} {n m r s : ℕ}
  {A : SpecialTransformations.DefinableGeometry.DefSet (SpecialTransformations.Section4.rawMixedSpace n r) S}
  {B : SpecialTransformations.DefinableGeometry.DefSet (SpecialTransformations.Section4.rawMixedSpace m s) S}
  (hc : CanonicalStructure.IsCanonical) (X : DiamondIntegral.Section6.RVRefinementFrame A)
  (f : SpecialTransformations.DefinableGeometry.Map A B) (u : Fin X.arity → DiamondIntegral.Section2.RVInfinity M)
  (v : Fin (s + X.arity) → DiamondIntegral.Section2.RVInfinity M),
  DiamondIntegral.Section6.graphFibreRange (DiamondIntegral.Section6.RVRefinementFrame.portMap hc X f) u v =
    if u = v ∘ Fin.natAdd s then
      DiamondIntegral.Section2.vfFibre (DiamondIntegral.Section6.retainedRVOutputMap hc (f.comp X.oldMap)).image.carrier
        v
    else ∅ :=
fun {M} [SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M] [M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {S}
    {n m r s} {A} {B} hc X f u v =>
  Set.ext fun b =>
    {
      mp := fun a =>
        Exists.casesOn a fun a h =>
          Exists.casesOn h fun p h =>
            And.casesOn h fun hp hfp =>
              have hLabels :=
                funext fun i =>
                  have hInput := congrArg (fun q => q.2 i) hp;
                  have hOutput := congrArg (fun q => q.2 (Fin.natAdd s i)) hfp;
                  Eq.trans (Eq.symm hInput)
                    (Eq.trans (Eq.symm (DiamondIntegral.Section6.RVRefinementFrame.port_retained hc X f p i)) hOutput);
              Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => b ∈ _a) (if_pos hLabels))) (Exists.intro p hfp),
      mpr := fun hb =>
        if hLabels : u = v ∘ Fin.natAdd s then
          Exists.casesOn (Eq.mp (congrFun' (congrArg Membership.mem (ite_eq_left hLabels)) b) hb) fun p hp =>
            have hInput :=
              funext fun i =>
                have hOutput := congrArg (fun q => q.2 (Fin.natAdd s i)) hp;
                Eq.trans (Eq.symm (DiamondIntegral.Section6.RVRefinementFrame.port_retained hc X f p i))
                  (Eq.trans hOutput (Eq.symm (congrFun hLabels i)));
            Exists.intro (↑p).1 (Exists.intro p ⟨Prod.ext rfl hInput, hp⟩)
        else False.elim (Eq.mp (congrFun' (congrArg Membership.mem (ite_eq_right hLabels)) b) hb) }

      (∀ (p : ↑A.carrier) (i : Fin r), (↑(f.toFun p)).2 (π i) = (↑p).2 i) →

              DiamondIntegral.Section2.vfFibre B.carrier (v ∘ Fin.castAdd X.arity) :=

  if hNE :
      (DiamondIntegral.Section2.vfFibre
          (DiamondIntegral.Section6.retainedRVOutputMap hc (f.comp X.oldMap)).image.carrier v).Nonempty then
    Or.inr
      (Exists.casesOn hNE fun b h =>
        Exists.casesOn h fun p hp =>
          id
            (fun hp =>
              have hOldTags :=
                have h := DiamondIntegral.Section6.retainedRVOutput_selected hc (f.comp X.oldMap) p;
                id
                  (fun h =>
                    Eq.symm
                      (congrArg Prod.snd
                        (Eq.mp (congrArg (fun _a => (_a.1, _a.2 ∘ Fin.castAdd X.arity) = ↑(f.toFun (X.oldPoint p))) hp)
                          h)))

                  Exists.casesOn a fun z hz =>

                      (fun hz =>
                        have h := DiamondIntegral.Section6.retainedRVOutput_selected hc (f.comp X.oldMap) z;

                            id

                                Eq.symm

                Exists.casesOn (Function.Bijective.surjective hf ⟨(y, v ∘ Fin.castAdd X.arity), hy⟩) fun a ha =>

      have hloA := inv_le_inv' (le_max_left α β);

        Exists.casesOn (motive := fun x =>

@DiamondIntegral.Section6.regularization_source_iff : ∀ {M : Type}
  [inst : SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M]
  [inst_1 : M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {n r : ℕ} {S : Set M}
  (A : SpecialTransformations.DefinableGeometry.DefSet (SpecialTransformations.Section4.rawMixedSpace n r) S)
  (u : Fin r → DiamondIntegral.Section2.RVInfinity M) (v : Fin (n + r) → DiamondIntegral.Section2.RVInfinity M)
  (a : Fin n → DiamondIntegral.Section2.VF M),
  a ∈ DiamondIntegral.Section6.graphFibreSource (DiamondIntegral.Section6.regularization A) u v ↔
    u = v ∘ Fin.natAdd n ∧
      a ∈ DiamondIntegral.Section2.vfFibre (DiamondIntegral.Section6.regularizeMap A).image.carrier v
theorem DiamondIntegral.Section6.regularization_source_iff : ∀ {M : Type}
  [inst : SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M]
  [inst_1 : M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {n r : ℕ} {S : Set M}
  (A : SpecialTransformations.DefinableGeometry.DefSet (SpecialTransformations.Section4.rawMixedSpace n r) S)
  (u : Fin r → DiamondIntegral.Section2.RVInfinity M) (v : Fin (n + r) → DiamondIntegral.Section2.RVInfinity M)
  (a : Fin n → DiamondIntegral.Section2.VF M),
  a ∈ DiamondIntegral.Section6.graphFibreSource (DiamondIntegral.Section6.regularization A) u v ↔
    u = v ∘ Fin.natAdd n ∧
      a ∈ DiamondIntegral.Section2.vfFibre (DiamondIntegral.Section6.regularizeMap A).image.carrier v :=
fun {M} [SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M] [M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {n r}
    {S} A u v a =>
  {
    mp := fun a_1 =>
      Exists.casesOn a_1 fun b h =>
        Exists.casesOn h fun p h =>
          And.casesOn h fun hp hfp =>
            have hVF := Eq.trans (Eq.symm (congrArg Prod.fst hfp)) (congrArg Prod.fst hp);
            Eq.ndrec (motive := fun b =>
              ↑((DiamondIntegral.Section6.regularization A).toFun p) = (b, v) →
                u = v ∘ Fin.natAdd n ∧
                  a ∈ DiamondIntegral.Section2.vfFibre (DiamondIntegral.Section6.regularizeMap A).image.carrier v)
              (fun hfp =>
                have hOld :=
                  funext fun i =>
                    id
                      (Eq.mp
                        (congrFun' (congrArg Eq (Fin.append_right (DiamondIntegral.Section2.tupleRV M (↑p).1) (↑p).2 i))
                          (v (Fin.natAdd n i)))
                        (congrArg (fun q => q.2 (Fin.natAdd n i)) hfp));
                ⟨Eq.trans (Eq.symm (congrArg Prod.snd hp)) hOld, Exists.intro p hfp⟩)
              (Eq.symm hVF) hfp,
    mpr := fun a_1 =>
      And.casesOn a_1 fun hu right =>
        Exists.casesOn right fun p hp =>
          have hVF := congrArg Prod.fst hp;
          have hOld :=
            funext fun i =>
              id
                (Eq.mp
                  (congrFun' (congrArg Eq (Fin.append_right (DiamondIntegral.Section2.tupleRV M (↑p).1) (↑p).2 i))
                    (v (Fin.natAdd n i)))
                  (congrArg (fun q => q.2 (Fin.natAdd n i)) hp));
          Exists.intro a (Exists.intro p ⟨Prod.ext hVF (Eq.trans hOld (Eq.symm hu)), hp⟩) }

  [inst : SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M]
  [inst_1 : M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {n r : ℕ} {S : Set M}

theorem DiamondIntegral.Section6.regularize_injective : ∀ {M : Type}
  [inst : SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M]
  [inst_1 : M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {n r : ℕ},
  Function.Injective DiamondIntegral.Section6.regularize :=
fun {M} [SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M] [M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {n r}
    ⦃a b⦄ he =>

  Prod.ext hVF hRV

@DiamondIntegral.Section6.regularized_fibre : ∀ {M : Type} [inst : SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M]
  [inst_1 : M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {n r : ℕ}
  (A : Set (DiamondIntegral.Section2.Mixed M n r)) (v : Fin (n + r) → DiamondIntegral.Section2.RVInfinity M),
  DiamondIntegral.Section2.vfFibre (DiamondIntegral.Section6.regularize '' A) v =
    DiamondIntegral.Section2.vfFibre A (v ∘ Fin.natAdd n) ∩
      {a | DiamondIntegral.Section2.tupleRV M a = v ∘ Fin.castAdd r}
theorem DiamondIntegral.Section6.regularized_fibre : ∀ {M : Type}
  [inst : SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M]
  [inst_1 : M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {n r : ℕ}
  (A : Set (DiamondIntegral.Section2.Mixed M n r)) (v : Fin (n + r) → DiamondIntegral.Section2.RVInfinity M),
  DiamondIntegral.Section2.vfFibre (DiamondIntegral.Section6.regularize '' A) v =
    DiamondIntegral.Section2.vfFibre A (v ∘ Fin.natAdd n) ∩
      {a | DiamondIntegral.Section2.tupleRV M a = v ∘ Fin.castAdd r} :=
fun {M} [SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M] [M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {n r} A
    v =>
  Set.ext fun a =>
    {
      mp := fun a_1 =>
        Exists.casesOn a_1 fun p h =>
          And.casesOn h fun hp he =>
            have hVF := congrArg Prod.fst he;
            have hOld :=
              funext fun i =>
                id
                  (Eq.mp
                    (congrFun' (congrArg Eq (Fin.append_right (DiamondIntegral.Section2.tupleRV M p.1) p.2 i))
                      (v (Fin.natAdd n i)))
                    (congrArg (fun q => q.2 (Fin.natAdd n i)) he));
            have hNew :=
              funext fun i =>
                id
                  (Eq.mp
                    (congrFun' (congrArg Eq (Fin.append_left (DiamondIntegral.Section2.tupleRV M p.1) p.2 i))
                      (v (Fin.castAdd r i)))
                    (congrArg (fun q => q.2 (Fin.castAdd r i)) he));
            ⟨id
                (Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => (_a, v ∘ Fin.natAdd n) ∈ A) (Eq.symm hVF)))
                  (Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => (p.1, _a) ∈ A) (Eq.symm hOld))) hp)),
              hVF ▸ hNew⟩,
      mpr := fun a_1 =>
        And.casesOn a_1 fun ha hRV =>
          Exists.intro (a, v ∘ Fin.natAdd n)
            ⟨ha,
              Prod.ext rfl
                (funext fun i =>
                  Fin.addCases
                    (fun i =>
                      Eq.mpr
                        (id
                          (congrFun'
                            (congrArg Eq (Fin.append_left (DiamondIntegral.Section2.tupleRV M a) (v ∘ Fin.natAdd n) i))
                            (v (Fin.castAdd r i))))
                        (congrFun hRV i))
                    (fun i =>
                      of_eq_true
                        (Eq.trans
                          (congrFun'
                            (congrArg Eq (Fin.append_right (DiamondIntegral.Section2.tupleRV M a) (v ∘ Fin.natAdd n) i))
                            (v (Fin.natAdd n i)))
                          (eq_self (v (Fin.natAdd n i)))))
                    i)⟩ }

  [inst : SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M]
  [inst_1 : M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {n : ℕ} {α : Fin n → DiamondIntegral.Section2.Gamma M}

      (∀ a ∈ A, ∀ (i : Fin n), DiamondIntegral.Section2.vfValue (a i) ≤ ↑γ) →
        ∀ (t : Fin n → DiamondIntegral.Section2.RVInfinity M),
          DiamondIntegral.Section6.AlphaInvariant (fun i => max (α i) γ)
            (A ∩ {a | DiamondIntegral.Section2.tupleRV M a = t}) :=

    {A} hA γ hbound t =>
  have step := fun a b hab ha =>
    ⟨(hA a b (DiamondIntegral.Section6.Congruent.of_larger_radius (fun i => le_max_left (α i) γ) hab)).mp ha.left,
      have he :=
        funext fun i =>
          DiamondIntegral.Section6.rv_eq_of_close_at_radius γ (hbound a ha.left i)

              (have this := le_max_right ↑(α i) ↑γ;
              this)
              (DiamondIntegral.Section6.Congruent.symm hab i));
      Eq.trans he ha.right⟩;
  fun a b hab => { mp := step a b hab, mpr := step b a (DiamondIntegral.Section6.Congruent.symm hab) }

          ∀ (i : Fin (n + r)),
            ↑(max γ δ)⁻¹ ≤ SpecialTransformations.Section3.Values.vrv (p.2 i) ∧
              SpecialTransformations.Section3.Values.vrv (p.2 i) ≤ ↑(max γ δ))

            ∀ (i : Fin (n + r)),

                SpecialTransformations.Section3.Values.vrv (p.2 i) ≤ ↑(max γ δ))

              ∀ (i : Fin (n + r)),

                have hhighδ := le_max_right γ δ;
                Fin.addCases
                  (fun i =>
                    id
                      (Eq.mpr
                        (id
                          (congr
                            (congrArg And

                                  (Fin.append_left (DiamondIntegral.Section2.tupleRV M p_1.1) p_1.2 i))))

                                (congrArg SpecialTransformations.Section3.Values.vrv
                                  (Fin.append_left (DiamondIntegral.Section2.tupleRV M p_1.1) p_1.2 i)))
                              ↑(max γ δ))))
                        ⟨LE.le.trans hlowγ (hγ p_1 hp i).left, LE.le.trans (hγ p_1 hp i).right hhighγ⟩))
                  (fun i =>
                    id
                      (Eq.mpr
                        (id
                          (congr
                            (congrArg And
                              (congrArg (LE.le ↑(max γ δ)⁻¹)
                                (congrArg SpecialTransformations.Section3.Values.vrv
                                  (Fin.append_right (DiamondIntegral.Section2.tupleRV M p_1.1) p_1.2 i))))

  [inst : SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M] →

  [inst : SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M]

      DiamondIntegral.Section6.reindexVFPoint e (D.point p) :=

            DiamondIntegral.Section2.vfValue (D.extendedEndpoint (x, u)) :=

  have hV := congrArg SpecialTransformations.Section3.Values.vrv h;

    (fun hV =>
      Eq.mpr

    if he : (DiamondIntegral.Section2.vfFibre A.carrier u).Nonempty then

        let δ :=

            (DiamondIntegral.Section6.RelativeApertureData.endpoint_nonzero_at D ha hu);
        let F := fun x => x D.coordinate - D.focus (Function.update x D.coordinate 0) u;
        have hF := ContinuousOn.sub (Continuous.continuousOn (continuous_apply D.coordinate)) (D.continuous u hu);
        have hBall := DiamondIntegral.Section6.scalarBall_isClopen hv δ;
        have hpre :=

                        id

          hpre

  [inst : SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M]
  [inst_1 : M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {n r : ℕ} {S : Set M} {G : Type}

theorem DiamondIntegral.Section6.RelativeApertureData.core_membership_iff_focus : ∀ {M : Type}
  [inst : SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M]
  [inst_1 : M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {n r : ℕ} {S : Set M} {G : Type}
  [inst_2 : LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero G] [inst_3 : Valued (DiamondIntegral.Section2.VF M) G]
  {A : SpecialTransformations.DefinableGeometry.DefSet (SpecialTransformations.Section4.rawMixedSpace n r) S}
  (D : DiamondIntegral.Section6.RelativeApertureData A) (p : DiamondIntegral.Section2.Mixed M n r),
  p.2 ∈ D.activeTags.carrier →
    DiamondIntegral.Section2.vfValue (D.endpoint (Function.update p.1 D.coordinate 0) p.2) <
        DiamondIntegral.Section2.vfValue (p.1 D.coordinate - D.focus (Function.update p.1 D.coordinate 0) p.2) →
      (p ∈ A.carrier ↔ D.focusPoint p ∈ A.carrier) :=
fun {M} [SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M] [M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {n r}
    {S} {G} [LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero G] [Valued (DiamondIntegral.Section2.VF M) G] {A} D p hu hclose =>
  Exists.casesOn (D.covariance p.2 hu) fun α h =>
    Exists.casesOn h fun β h =>
      And.casesOn h fun left right =>
        And.casesOn right fun left right =>
          And.casesOn right fun hInv right =>
            And.casesOn right fun left hdom =>
              have hCong := fun hbound i =>
                if hi : i = D.coordinate then
                  Eq.symm hi ▸
                    Eq.mpr
                      (id
                        (congr
                          (congrArg LT.lt
                            (congrArg Subtype.val
                              (Eq.trans
                                (ite_congr (eq_self D.coordinate) (fun a => Eq.refl α) fun a =>
                                  Eq.refl (β D.coordinate))
                                (ite_true α (β D.coordinate)))))
                          (congrArg DiamondIntegral.Section2.vfValue
                            (congrArg (HSub.hSub (p.1 D.coordinate))
                              (Function.update_self D.coordinate (D.focus (Function.update p.1 D.coordinate 0) p.2)
                                p.1)))))
                      (LE.le.trans_lt hbound hclose)
                else
                  Eq.mpr
                    (id
                      (congr
                        (congrArg LT.lt
                          (congrArg Subtype.val
                            (Eq.trans (ite_congr (eq_false hi) (fun a => Eq.refl α) fun a => Eq.refl (β i))
                              (ite_false α (β i)))))
                        (congrArg DiamondIntegral.Section2.vfValue
                          (Eq.trans
                            (congrArg (HSub.hSub (p.1 i))
                              ((fun x_0 v f => (fun x_0 => Function.update_of_ne hi) x_0 v f)
                                (fun a => DiamondIntegral.Section2.VF M)
                                (D.focus (Function.update p.1 D.coordinate 0) p.2) p.1))
                            (sub_self (p.1 i))))))
                    (SpecialTransformations.Section9.gamma_lt_value_zero (β i));
              { mp := fun hp => (hInv p.1 (D.focusPoint p).1 (hCong (hdom p.1 hp))).mp hp,
                mpr := fun hp =>
                  have hbound :=
                    have hh := hdom (D.focusPoint p).1 hp;
                    Eq.mp
                      (congrArg (fun _a => ↑α ≤ DiamondIntegral.Section2.vfValue (D.endpoint _a p.2))
                        (DiamondIntegral.Section6.RelativeApertureData.focusPoint_erase D p))

  [inst : SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M]

theorem DiamondIntegral.Section6.RelativeApertureData.extendedFocus_same_other : ∀ {M : Type}
  [inst : SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M]
  [inst_1 : M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {n r : ℕ} {S : Set M} {G : Type}
  [inst_2 : LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero G] [inst_3 : Valued (DiamondIntegral.Section2.VF M) G]
  {A : SpecialTransformations.DefinableGeometry.DefSet (SpecialTransformations.Section4.rawMixedSpace n r) S}
  (D : DiamondIntegral.Section6.RelativeApertureData A) {p q : DiamondIntegral.Section2.Mixed M n r},
  p ∈ A.carrier →
    q ∈ A.carrier →
      p.2 = q.2 → (∀ (i : Fin n), i ≠ D.coordinate → p.1 i = q.1 i) → D.extendedFocus p = D.extendedFocus q :=
fun {M} [SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M] [M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {n r}
    {S} {G} [LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero G] [Valued (DiamondIntegral.Section2.VF M) G] {A} D {p q} hp hq hu hother =>
  if hact : p.2 ∈ D.activeTags.carrier then
    have hactq := hu ▸ hact;
    Eq.mpr
      (id
        (congrArg (fun _a => _a = D.extendedFocus q)
          (DiamondIntegral.Section6.RelativeApertureData.extendedFocus_active D hp hact)))
      (Eq.mpr
        (id
          (congrArg (fun _a => D.focus (Function.update p.1 D.coordinate 0) p.2 = _a)
            (DiamondIntegral.Section6.RelativeApertureData.extendedFocus_active D hq hactq)))
        (have he :=
          funext fun i =>
            if hi : i = D.coordinate then
              Eq.symm hi ▸
                of_eq_true
                  (Eq.trans
                    (congr (congrArg Eq (Function.update_self D.coordinate 0 p.1))
                      (Function.update_self D.coordinate 0 q.1))
                    (eq_self 0))
            else
              Eq.mpr
                (id
                  (congr
                    (congrArg Eq
                      ((fun x_0 v f => (fun x_0 => Function.update_of_ne hi) x_0 v f)
                        (fun a => DiamondIntegral.Section2.VF M) 0 p.1))
                    ((fun x_0 v f => (fun x_0 => Function.update_of_ne hi) x_0 v f)
                      (fun a => DiamondIntegral.Section2.VF M) 0 q.1)))
                (hother i hi);
        Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => D.focus _a p.2 = D.focus (Function.update q.1 D.coordinate 0) q.2) he))
          (Eq.mpr
            (id
              (congrArg
                (fun _a =>
                  D.focus (Function.update q.1 D.coordinate 0) _a = D.focus (Function.update q.1 D.coordinate 0) q.2)
                hu))
            (Eq.refl (D.focus (Function.update q.1 D.coordinate 0) q.2)))))
  else
    Eq.mpr
      (id
        (congrArg (fun _a => _a = D.extendedFocus q)
          (DiamondIntegral.Section6.RelativeApertureData.extendedFocus_inactive D hact)))
      (Eq.mpr
        (id
          (congrArg (fun _a => 0 = _a)
            (DiamondIntegral.Section6.RelativeApertureData.extendedFocus_inactive D (hu ▸ hact))))
        (Eq.refl 0))

 Quot.sound]

@DiamondIntegral.Section6.RelativeApertureData.point_injective_on : ∀ {M : Type}
  [inst : SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M]
  [inst_1 : M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {n r : ℕ} {S : Set M} {G : Type}

  M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF00 → Set.InjOn D.point A.carrier
theorem DiamondIntegral.Section6.RelativeApertureData.point_injective_on : ∀ {M : Type}
  [inst : SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M]
  [inst_1 : M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {n r : ℕ} {S : Set M} {G : Type}
  [inst_2 : LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero G] [inst_3 : Valued (DiamondIntegral.Section2.VF M) G]
  {A : SpecialTransformations.DefinableGeometry.DefSet (SpecialTransformations.Section4.rawMixedSpace n r) S}
  (D : DiamondIntegral.Section6.RelativeApertureData A),
  M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF00 → Set.InjOn D.point A.carrier :=
fun {M} [SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M] [M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {n r}
    {S} {G} [LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero G] [Valued (DiamondIntegral.Section2.VF M) G] {A} D h00 ⦃p⦄ hp ⦃q⦄ hq he =>
  have hOld :=
    funext fun i =>
      Eq.mp
        (congr (congrArg Eq (Fin.append_right (fun x => DiamondIntegral.Section6.branchTag (D.core p)) p.2 i))
          (Fin.append_right (fun x => DiamondIntegral.Section6.branchTag (D.core q)) q.2 i))
        (congrArg (fun z => z.2 (Fin.natAdd 1 i)) he);
  have hTag :=
    Eq.mp
      (congr (congrArg Eq (Fin.append_left (fun x => DiamondIntegral.Section6.branchTag (D.core p)) p.2 0))
        (Fin.append_left (fun x => DiamondIntegral.Section6.branchTag (D.core q)) q.2 0))
      (congrArg (fun z => z.2 (Fin.castAdd r 0)) he);
  have hCore := DiamondIntegral.Section6.branchTag_injective h00 hTag;
  have hOther := fun i hi =>
    Eq.mp
      (congr
        (congrArg Eq
          ((fun x_0 v f => (fun x_0 => Function.update_of_ne hi) x_0 v f) (fun a => DiamondIntegral.Section2.VF M)
            (p.1 D.coordinate - D.extendedFocus p + if D.core p = true then D.extendedEndpoint p else 0) p.1))
        ((fun x_0 v f => (fun x_0 => Function.update_of_ne hi) x_0 v f) (fun a => DiamondIntegral.Section2.VF M)
          (q.1 D.coordinate - D.extendedFocus q + if D.core q = true then D.extendedEndpoint q else 0) q.1))
      (congrArg (fun z => z.1 i) he);
  have hFocus := DiamondIntegral.Section6.RelativeApertureData.extendedFocus_same_other D hp hq hOld hOther;
  have hEnd := DiamondIntegral.Section6.RelativeApertureData.extendedEndpoint_same_other D hp hq hOld hOther;
  have hJ := congrArg (fun z => z.1 D.coordinate) he;
  have hJ' :=
    have hsub :=
      add_right_cancel
        (Eq.mp
          (congrArg
            (fun _a =>
              (p.1 D.coordinate - D.extendedFocus q + if _a = true then D.extendedEndpoint q else 0) =
                q.1 D.coordinate - D.extendedFocus q + if D.core q = true then D.extendedEndpoint q else 0)
            hCore)
          (Eq.mp
            (congrArg
              (fun _a =>
                (p.1 D.coordinate - D.extendedFocus q + if D.core p = true then _a else 0) =
                  q.1 D.coordinate - D.extendedFocus q + if D.core q = true then D.extendedEndpoint q else 0)
              hEnd)
            (Eq.mp
              (congrArg
                (fun _a =>
                  (p.1 D.coordinate - _a + if D.core p = true then D.extendedEndpoint p else 0) =
                    q.1 D.coordinate - D.extendedFocus q + if D.core q = true then D.extendedEndpoint q else 0)
                hFocus)
              (Eq.mp
                (congr
                  (congrArg Eq
                    (Function.update_self D.coordinate
                      (p.1 D.coordinate - D.extendedFocus p + if D.core p = true then D.extendedEndpoint p else 0) p.1))
                  (Function.update_self D.coordinate
                    (q.1 D.coordinate - D.extendedFocus q + if D.core q = true then D.extendedEndpoint q else 0) q.1))
                hJ))));
    Trans.trans
      (Trans.trans (Eq.symm (sub_add_cancel (p.1 D.coordinate) (D.extendedFocus q)))
        (congrArg (fun x => x + D.extendedFocus q) hsub))
      (sub_add_cancel (q.1 D.coordinate) (D.extendedFocus q));
  Prod.ext (funext fun i => if hi : i = D.coordinate then Eq.symm hi ▸ hJ' else hOther i hi) hOld

theorem DiamondIntegral.Section6.exists_relative_coordinate_polynomial_systems : ∀ {M G : Type}

  [inst : SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M]
  [inst_1 : M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {n : ℕ} {E : Subfield (DiamondIntegral.Section2.VF M)}

        (SpecialTransformations.Section7.rawVF b) ∈

    (∀ (j : Fin n),
        (MvPolynomial.eval (SpecialTransformations.Section7.productTuple a b)) ((MvPolynomial.map E.subtype) (H j)) =
          0) ∧

    SpecialTransformations.Section7.productTuple_ext

              (fun _a =>
                _a =
                  SpecialTransformations.Section7.rawVF (SpecialTransformations.Section7.productTuple a b)

          (id

        (id
          (congrArg
            (fun _a =>

              (SpecialTransformations.Section7.rawVF b) j)))

      (congrArg
        (fun _a =>

                (fun _a =>
                  SpecialTransformations.Section7.rawVF (SpecialTransformations.Section7.productTuple a b) ∈

          mp := fun h j hj =>
            Subtype.ext
              (have he := h j hj;
              id
                (fun he =>
                  Eq.mp
                    (congr
                      (congrArg Eq (congrArg Subtype.val (SpecialTransformations.Section7.productTuple_right a b j)))

def DiamondIntegral.Section6.graphShearFocus : {M : Type} →
  [inst : SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M] →
    [M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] →
      {S : Set M} →
        {n r s : ℕ} →
          {A : SpecialTransformations.DefinableGeometry.DefSet (SpecialTransformations.Section4.rawMixedSpace n r) S} →
            {B :
                SpecialTransformations.DefinableGeometry.DefSet (SpecialTransformations.Section4.rawMixedSpace n s) S} →
              SpecialTransformations.DefinableGeometry.Map A B →
                Fin n →
                  (Fin r → DiamondIntegral.Section2.RVInfinity M) →
                    (Fin s → DiamondIntegral.Section2.RVInfinity M) →
                      (Fin n → DiamondIntegral.Section2.VF M) → DiamondIntegral.Section2.VF M :=

fun {M} [SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M] [M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {S}
    {n r} {A C} hCA hC ω γ hLevel =>
  have he :=
    Set.ext fun p =>
      {
        mp := fun a =>
          And.casesOn a fun hp hγ =>
            ⟨hp,
              ⟨hCA hp,
                Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => _a = γ) (DiamondIntegral.Section6.gammaFormExtension_at ω ⟨p, hCA hp⟩)))
                  (Eq.mp
                    (congrArg (fun _a => _a = γ)
                      (DiamondIntegral.Section6.gammaFormExtension_at
                        (ω.comp (SpecialTransformations.DefinableGeometry.Map.inclusion hCA)) ⟨p, hp⟩))
                    hγ)⟩⟩,
        mpr := fun a =>
          And.casesOn a fun hp right =>
            And.casesOn right fun hpA hγ =>
              ⟨hp,
                Eq.mpr
                  (id
                    (congrArg (fun _a => _a = γ)
                      (DiamondIntegral.Section6.gammaFormExtension_at
                        (ω.comp (SpecialTransformations.DefinableGeometry.Map.inclusion hCA)) ⟨p, hp⟩)))
                  (Eq.mp (congrArg (fun _a => _a = γ) (DiamondIntegral.Section6.gammaFormExtension_at ω ⟨p, hpA⟩))
                    hγ)⟩ };
  Eq.symm he ▸ DiamondIntegral.Section6.ProperInvariantGeometry.inter hC hLevel

fun {M} [SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M] [M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {n r}
    {S} {G} [LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero G] [Valued (DiamondIntegral.Section2.VF M) G] {A P} {D} {E} h00 h c hc0
    hcdef hval =>
  let D' := D.refineCoefficient c hc0 hcdef hval;
  let E' :=
    E.refineCoefficient c hc0 hcdef
      (Eq.mpr
        (id
          (congrArg (fun _a => DiamondIntegral.Section2.vfValue _a ≤ DiamondIntegral.Section2.vfValue c) h.coefficient))
        hval);
  have h' := DiamondIntegral.Section6.ApertureRestrictionData.refine h c hc0 hcdef hval;
  Set.ext fun q =>
    {
      mp := fun hq =>
        Exists.casesOn ((DiamondIntegral.Section6.CentripetalData.mem_releasedRegularizedImage E E' q).mp hq)
          fun a h_1 =>
          And.casesOn h_1 fun ha right =>
            And.casesOn right fun hOld right =>
              And.casesOn right fun hNew he =>
                ⟨(DiamondIntegral.Section6.CentripetalData.mem_releasedRegularizedImage D D' q).mpr
                    (Exists.intro a
                      ⟨h.subset ha,
                        ⟨DiamondIntegral.Section6.ApertureRestrictionData.core h a ha ▸ hOld,
                          ⟨DiamondIntegral.Section6.ApertureRestrictionData.core h' a ha ▸ hNew,
                            Eq.trans
                              (Eq.symm
                                (congrArg DiamondIntegral.Section6.regularize
                                  (DiamondIntegral.Section6.ApertureRestrictionData.point h' a ha)))
                              he⟩⟩⟩),
                  DiamondIntegral.Section6.CentripetalData.releasedRegularizedImage_subset E E' hq⟩,
      mpr := fun a =>
        And.casesOn a fun hq hqP =>
          Exists.casesOn ((DiamondIntegral.Section6.CentripetalData.mem_releasedRegularizedImage D D' q).mp hq)
            fun a h_1 =>
            And.casesOn h_1 fun ha right =>
              And.casesOn right fun hOld right =>
                And.casesOn right fun hNew he =>
                  Exists.casesOn hqP fun z hz =>
                    Exists.casesOn z.property fun p hp =>
                      have hpq :=
                        Trans.trans
                          (Trans.trans
                            (congrArg DiamondIntegral.Section6.regularize
                              (Eq.symm (DiamondIntegral.Section6.ApertureRestrictionData.point h' (↑p) p.property)))
                            (congrArg DiamondIntegral.Section6.regularize hp))
                          hz;
                      have hap :=
                        DiamondIntegral.Section6.CentripetalData.point_injective_on D' h00 ha (h.subset p.property)
                          (DiamondIntegral.Section6.regularize_injective (Eq.trans he (Eq.symm hpq)));
                      Eq.ndrec (motive := fun a =>
                        a ∈ A.carrier →
                          D.core a = true →
                            D'.core a = false →
                              DiamondIntegral.Section6.regularize (D'.point a) = q →
                                q ∈
                                  (E.releasedRegularizedImage
                                      (E.refineCoefficient c hc0 hcdef
                                        (Eq.mpr
                                          (id
                                            (congrArg
                                              (fun _a =>
                                                DiamondIntegral.Section2.vfValue _a ≤
                                                  DiamondIntegral.Section2.vfValue c)
                                              h.coefficient))
                                          hval))).carrier)
                        (fun ha hOld hNew he =>
                          (DiamondIntegral.Section6.CentripetalData.mem_releasedRegularizedImage E E' q).mpr
                            (Exists.intro ↑p
                              ⟨p.property,
                                ⟨Eq.symm (DiamondIntegral.Section6.ApertureRestrictionData.core h (↑p) p.property) ▸
                                    hOld,
                                  ⟨Eq.symm (DiamondIntegral.Section6.ApertureRestrictionData.core h' (↑p) p.property) ▸
                                      hNew,
                                    Eq.trans
                                      (congrArg DiamondIntegral.Section6.regularize
                                        (DiamondIntegral.Section6.ApertureRestrictionData.point h' (↑p) p.property))
                                      he⟩⟩⟩))
                        (Eq.symm hap) ha hOld hNew he }

            SpecialTransformations.Section3.Saturated M κ →
              (∀ (x y : DiamondIntegral.Section2.VF M),

fun {M} [SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M] [M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {S}
    {n r s} {G} [LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero G] [Valued (DiamondIntegral.Section2.VF M) G] h00 hc linear {κ} hκ hs hv
    hsmall hΓ {A} {B} {f} H hAD hBD hBRP k hLeading δ hδ hZero hRestore =>
  And.casesOn (DiamondIntegral.Section6.lemma_6_14 h00 hc linear hκ hs hv hsmall hΓ H) fun hHome right =>
    And.casesOn right fun left hJac =>
      have hB :=
        DiamondIntegral.Section6.ProperCovariant.target_properInvariant h00 hc linear hκ hs hv hsmall hΓ hHome.covariant
          (Function.Bijective.surjective hHome.bijective);
      let C := (DiamondIntegral.Section6.rvLabelTranslationMap δ).image;
      let R := DiamondIntegral.Section6.rvLabelTranslation δ;
      have hCD :=
        Exists.casesOn hAD fun α hα =>
          Exists.casesOn hBD fun β hβ =>
            have hloA := inv_le_inv' (le_max_left α β);
            have hloB := inv_le_inv' (le_max_right α β);
            have hhiA := le_max_left α β;
            have hhiB := le_max_right α β;
            Exists.intro (max α β) fun q a =>
              Exists.casesOn (motive := fun x =>
                ∀ (i : Fin (n + 1)),
                  ↑(max α β)⁻¹ ≤ DiamondIntegral.Section2.vfValue (q.1 i) ∧
                    DiamondIntegral.Section2.vfValue (q.1 i) ≤ ↑(max α β))
                a fun b h =>
                Eq.ndrec (motive := fun q =>
                  ∀ (i : Fin (n + 1)),
                    ↑(max α β)⁻¹ ≤ DiamondIntegral.Section2.vfValue (q.1 i) ∧
                      DiamondIntegral.Section2.vfValue (q.1 i) ≤ ↑(max α β))
                  (fun i =>
                    Exists.casesOn (Function.Bijective.surjective hHome.bijective b) fun p hp =>
                      id
                        (Fin.lastCases
                          (Eq.mpr
                            (id
                              (congrArg
                                (fun _a =>
                                  ↑(max α β)⁻¹ ≤ DiamondIntegral.Section2.vfValue _a ∧
                                    DiamondIntegral.Section2.vfValue _a ≤ ↑(max α β))
                                (DiamondIntegral.Section6.rvLabelTranslation_last_fixed δ hZero b)))
                            ⟨LE.le.trans hloB (hβ (↑b) b.property (Fin.last n)).left,
                              LE.le.trans (hβ (↑b) b.property (Fin.last n)).right hhiB⟩)
                          (fun j =>
                            have hCoordinate :=
                              have h := hRestore p j;
                              Eq.mp
                                (congrArg
                                  (fun _a =>
                                    (↑_a).1 j.castSucc + DiamondIntegral.Section6.rvTranslationVector δ _a j.castSucc =
                                      (↑p).1 j.castSucc)
                                  hp)
                                h;
                            Eq.mpr
                              (id
                                (congrArg
                                  (fun _a =>
                                    ↑(max α β)⁻¹ ≤ DiamondIntegral.Section2.vfValue _a ∧
                                      DiamondIntegral.Section2.vfValue _a ≤ ↑(max α β))
                                  hCoordinate))
                              ⟨LE.le.trans hloA (hα (↑p) p.property j.castSucc).left,
                                LE.le.trans (hα (↑p) p.property j.castSucc).right hhiA⟩)
                          i))
                  h;
      have hCBound := Exists.casesOn hCD fun γ hγ => Exists.intro γ⁻¹ fun p hp i => (hγ p hp i).left;
      have hC := DiamondIntegral.Section6.rvLabelTranslation_image_proper δ hδ h00 hc hκ hs hv hB hCBound;
      have hR :=
        DiamondIntegral.Section6.rvLabelTranslation_properHomeomorphism δ hδ h00 hc linear hκ hs hv hsmall hΓ hB
          hCBound;
      Exists.casesOn (hJac (Nat.zero_lt_succ n)) fun E h =>
        And.casesOn h fun hEA right =>
          And.casesOn right fun hDim hUnit =>
            Exists.casesOn (DiamondIntegral.Section6.SpecialCovariantChain.retainsRV H) fun hrs hRetain =>
              Nonempty.intro
                { arity := s, target := C, lift := R.comp f,
                  home := DiamondIntegral.Section6.lemma_6_9 h00 hc linear hκ hs hv hsmall hΓ hHome hR, proper := hC,
                  doublyBounded := hCD, relative := hRestore, oldLabels := DiamondIntegral.Section6.rvTailIndex hrs,
                  oldLabels_injective := fun ⦃i j⦄ he =>
                    Fin.ext
                      (have he' := congrArg Fin.val he;
                      id
                        (fun he' =>
                          Decidable.byContradiction fun a =>
                            DiamondIntegral.Section6.contraction_stage_of_restored_complement._proof_1_1 E hrs he' a)
                        he'),
                  retained := hRetain, leading := k,
                  bundle := DiamondIntegral.Section6.rvLabelTranslation_coordinate_bundle δ hδ hZero hBRP k hLeading,
                  exceptional := E, exceptional_subset := hEA, exceptional_dim := hDim,
                  unitDerivative := fun p hp =>
                    DiamondIntegral.Section6.HasMixedUnitDerivativeAt.comp
                      (DiamondIntegral.Section6.rvLabelTranslation_unit_derivative δ hδ hB hv (f.toFun p))
                      (hUnit p hp) }

@DiamondIntegral.Section6.FMT.mixedFamilyFreeze_mem_iff : ∀ {M : Type}
  [inst : SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M]
  [inst_1 : M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {n r : ℕ}
  (balls : Set (SpecialTransformations.Section3.OpenBallCodes.OpenBall M))
  (centers : ↑balls → DiamondIntegral.Section2.VF M) (j : Fin n),
  (∀ (D E : ↑balls),
      ∀ x ∈ SpecialTransformations.Section3.OpenBallCodes.underlying ↑D,
        x ∈ SpecialTransformations.Section3.OpenBallCodes.underlying ↑E → D = E) →
    ∀ (C : Set (DiamondIntegral.Section2.Mixed M n r)),
      (∀ (D : ↑balls),
          DiamondIntegral.Section6.FMT.CoordinateProductDomain C (DiamondIntegral.Section6.FMT.vfOpenBall ↑D)
            (centers D) j) →
        ∀ (p : DiamondIntegral.Section2.Mixed M n r),
          DiamondIntegral.Section6.FMT.mixedFamilyFreeze balls centers j p ∈ C ↔ p ∈ C
theorem DiamondIntegral.Section6.FMT.mixedFamilyFreeze_mem_iff : ∀ {M : Type}
  [inst : SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M]
  [inst_1 : M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {n r : ℕ}
  (balls : Set (SpecialTransformations.Section3.OpenBallCodes.OpenBall M))
  (centers : ↑balls → DiamondIntegral.Section2.VF M) (j : Fin n),
  (∀ (D E : ↑balls),
      ∀ x ∈ SpecialTransformations.Section3.OpenBallCodes.underlying ↑D,
        x ∈ SpecialTransformations.Section3.OpenBallCodes.underlying ↑E → D = E) →
    ∀ (C : Set (DiamondIntegral.Section2.Mixed M n r)),
      (∀ (D : ↑balls),
          DiamondIntegral.Section6.FMT.CoordinateProductDomain C (DiamondIntegral.Section6.FMT.vfOpenBall ↑D)
            (centers D) j) →
        ∀ (p : DiamondIntegral.Section2.Mixed M n r),
          DiamondIntegral.Section6.FMT.mixedFamilyFreeze balls centers j p ∈ C ↔ p ∈ C :=
fun {M} [SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M] [M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {n r}
    balls centers j hsep C hprod p =>
  if hx : ∃ D, p.1 j ∈ DiamondIntegral.Section6.FMT.vfOpenBall ↑D then
    Exists.casesOn hx fun D hD =>
      have hf :=
        Eq.mpr
          (id
            (congrArg (fun _a => _a = centers D)
              (DiamondIntegral.Section6.FMT.vfFamilyFreeze_eq balls centers hsep (p.1 j))))
          (DiamondIntegral.Section6.FMT.familyFreeze_inside
            (fun D => {y | ↑y ∈ SpecialTransformations.Section3.OpenBallCodes.underlying ↑D}) centers
            (fun D E x hx hE => hsep D E (↑x) hx hE) D (p.1 j) hD);
      Eq.mpr
        (id
          (congrFun'
            (congrArg Iff
              (congrArg (Membership.mem C) (congrFun' (congrArg Prod.mk (congrArg (Function.update p.1 j) hf)) p.2)))
            (p ∈ C)))
        (Iff.symm (hprod D p hD))
  else
    have hf :=
      Eq.mpr
        (id
          (congrArg (fun _a => _a = p.1 j) (DiamondIntegral.Section6.FMT.vfFamilyFreeze_eq balls centers hsep (p.1 j))))
        (DiamondIntegral.Section6.FMT.familyFreeze_outside
          (fun D => {y | ↑y ∈ SpecialTransformations.Section3.OpenBallCodes.underlying ↑D}) centers (p.1 j)
          (not_exists.mp hx));
    of_eq_true
      (Eq.trans
        (congrFun'
          (congrArg Iff
            (congrArg (Membership.mem C)
              (Eq.trans
                (congrFun'
                  (congrArg Prod.mk (Eq.trans (congrArg (Function.update p.1 j) hf) (Function.update_eq_self j p.1)))
                  p.2)
                Prod.mk.eta)))
          (p ∈ C))
        (iff_self (p ∈ C)))

  [inst : SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M]
  [inst_1 : M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {n r : ℕ}
  (balls : Set (SpecialTransformations.Section3.OpenBallCodes.OpenBall M))
  (centers : ↑balls → DiamondIntegral.Section2.VF M) (j : Fin n) (b : Fin n → DiamondIntegral.Section2.VF M)
  (x : DiamondIntegral.Section2.VF M) (u : Fin r → DiamondIntegral.Section2.RVInfinity M),
  DiamondIntegral.Section6.FMT.mixedFamilyFreeze balls centers j.castSucc (Fin.snoc b x, u) =
    (Fin.snoc (DiamondIntegral.Section6.FMT.mixedFamilyFreeze balls centers j (b, u)).1 x, u)
theorem DiamondIntegral.Section6.FMT.mixedFamilyFreeze_snoc : ∀ {M : Type}
  [inst : SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M]
  [inst_1 : M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {n r : ℕ}
  (balls : Set (SpecialTransformations.Section3.OpenBallCodes.OpenBall M))
  (centers : ↑balls → DiamondIntegral.Section2.VF M) (j : Fin n) (b : Fin n → DiamondIntegral.Section2.VF M)
  (x : DiamondIntegral.Section2.VF M) (u : Fin r → DiamondIntegral.Section2.RVInfinity M),
  DiamondIntegral.Section6.FMT.mixedFamilyFreeze balls centers j.castSucc (Fin.snoc b x, u) =
    (Fin.snoc (DiamondIntegral.Section6.FMT.mixedFamilyFreeze balls centers j (b, u)).1 x, u) :=
fun {M} [SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M] [M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {n r}
    balls centers j b x u =>
  Prod.ext
    (id
      (Eq.mpr
        (id
          (congrArg
            (fun _a =>
              Function.update (Fin.snoc b x) j.castSucc (DiamondIntegral.Section6.FMT.vfFamilyFreeze balls centers _a) =
                Fin.snoc (Function.update b j (DiamondIntegral.Section6.FMT.vfFamilyFreeze balls centers (b j))) x)
            (Fin.snoc_castSucc x b j)))
        (funext fun i =>
          Fin.lastCases
            (of_eq_true
              (Eq.trans
                (congr
                  (congrArg Eq
                    (Eq.trans
                      ((fun x_0 v f => (fun x_0 => Function.update_of_ne (Ne.symm (Fin.castSucc_ne_last j))) x_0 v f)
                        (fun i => DiamondIntegral.Section2.VF M)
                        (DiamondIntegral.Section6.FMT.vfFamilyFreeze balls centers (b j)) (Fin.snoc b x))
                      (Fin.snoc_last x b)))
                  (Fin.snoc_last x
                    (Function.update b j (DiamondIntegral.Section6.FMT.vfFamilyFreeze balls centers (b j)))))
                (eq_self x)))
            (fun k =>
              if hk : k = j then
                Eq.symm hk ▸
                  of_eq_true
                    (Eq.trans
                      (congr
                        (congrArg Eq
                          (Function.update_self j.castSucc
                            (DiamondIntegral.Section6.FMT.vfFamilyFreeze balls centers (b j)) (Fin.snoc b x)))
                        (Eq.trans
                          (Fin.snoc_castSucc x
                            (Function.update b j (DiamondIntegral.Section6.FMT.vfFamilyFreeze balls centers (b j))) j)
                          (Function.update_self j (DiamondIntegral.Section6.FMT.vfFamilyFreeze balls centers (b j)) b)))
                      (eq_self (DiamondIntegral.Section6.FMT.vfFamilyFreeze balls centers (b j))))
              else
                have hkj := fun h => hk (Fin.castSucc_inj.mp h);
                of_eq_true
                  (Eq.trans
                    (congr
                      (congrArg Eq
                        (Eq.trans
                          ((fun x_0 v f => (fun x_0 => Function.update_of_ne hkj) x_0 v f)
                            (fun i => DiamondIntegral.Section2.VF M)
                            (DiamondIntegral.Section6.FMT.vfFamilyFreeze balls centers (b j)) (Fin.snoc b x))
                          (Fin.snoc_castSucc x b k)))
                      (Eq.trans
                        (Fin.snoc_castSucc x
                          (Function.update b j (DiamondIntegral.Section6.FMT.vfFamilyFreeze balls centers (b j))) k)
                        ((fun x_0 v f => (fun x_0 => Function.update_of_ne hk) x_0 v f)
                          (fun i => DiamondIntegral.Section2.VF M)
                          (DiamondIntegral.Section6.FMT.vfFamilyFreeze balls centers (b j)) b)))
                    (eq_self (b k))))
            i)))
    (Eq.refl (DiamondIntegral.Section6.FMT.mixedFamilyFreeze balls centers j.castSucc (Fin.snoc b x, u)).2)

    DiamondIntegral.Section6.CoordinateGammaConstantRow D.coordinate (D.coreGammaFormRow h00 ω) :=

        Exists.casesOn ((DiamondIntegral.Section6.CentripetalData.mem_coreRegularizedImage D h00 ↑q').mp q'.property)

theorem DiamondIntegral.Section6.descended_gamma_level_fibre_row : ∀ {qR : ℕ} [NeZero qR] {M : Type}
  [inst : SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M]
  [inst_1 : M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {n r : ℕ} {S : Set M}
  {A : SpecialTransformations.DefinableGeometry.DefSet (SpecialTransformations.Section4.rawMixedSpace (n + 1) r) S}
  (ω : DiamondIntegral.Section6.RowFormOn A qR)
  (η : DiamondIntegral.Section6.RowFormOn (DiamondIntegral.Section6.vfDropLast A).image qR),
  (∀ (p : ↑A.carrier), η.toFun ((DiamondIntegral.Section6.vfDropLast A).toImage.toFun p) = ω.toFun p) →
    ∀ (u : Fin r → DiamondIntegral.Section2.RVInfinity M)
      (γ : Set (SpecialTransformations.Section4.rawRVSpace qR).Carrier),
      {b |
          (b, u) ∈ (DiamondIntegral.Section6.vfDropLast A).image.carrier ∧
            DiamondIntegral.Section6.rowFormExtension η (b, u) = γ} =
        Fin.init '' {a | (a, u) ∈ A.carrier ∧ DiamondIntegral.Section6.rowFormExtension ω (a, u) = γ} :=
fun {qR} [NeZero qR] {M} [SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M]
    [M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {n r} {S} {A} ω η hη u γ =>
  Set.ext fun b =>
    {
      mp := fun a =>
        And.casesOn a fun hb hγ =>
          Exists.casesOn hb fun p hp =>
            have hTags := congrArg (fun z => z.2) hp;
            have hInit := congrArg (fun z => z.1) hp;
            have hVal :=
              have hAt :=
                Eq.mpr
                  (id
                    (congrArg (fun _a => _a = DiamondIntegral.Section6.rowFormExtension ω ↑p)
                      (DiamondIntegral.Section6.rowFormExtension_at η
                        ((DiamondIntegral.Section6.vfDropLast A).toImage.toFun p))))
                  (Eq.mpr
                    (id
                      (congrArg (fun _a => ↑(η.toFun ((DiamondIntegral.Section6.vfDropLast A).toImage.toFun p)) = _a)
                        (DiamondIntegral.Section6.rowFormExtension_at ω p)))
                    (congrArg Subtype.val (hη p)));
              have he := hp;
              Eq.mp
                (congrArg
                  (fun _a =>
                    DiamondIntegral.Section6.rowFormExtension η _a = DiamondIntegral.Section6.rowFormExtension ω ↑p)
                  he)
                hAt;
            Exists.intro (↑p).1
              ⟨⟨hTags ▸ p.property,
                  Eq.mpr
                    (id
                      (congrArg (fun _a => DiamondIntegral.Section6.rowFormExtension ω ((↑p).1, _a) = γ)
                        (Eq.symm hTags)))
                    (Eq.trans (Eq.symm hVal) hγ)⟩,
                hInit⟩,
      mpr := fun a =>
        Exists.casesOn a fun a h =>
          And.casesOn h fun left right =>
            And.casesOn left fun ha hγ =>
              right ▸
                let p := ⟨(a, u), ha⟩;
                ⟨Exists.intro p rfl,
                  have hVal := congrArg Subtype.val (hη p);
                  have hAt :=
                    Eq.mpr
                      (id
                        (congrArg (fun _a => _a = DiamondIntegral.Section6.rowFormExtension ω ↑p)
                          (DiamondIntegral.Section6.rowFormExtension_at η
                            ((DiamondIntegral.Section6.vfDropLast A).toImage.toFun p))))
                      (Eq.mpr
                        (id
                          (congrArg
                            (fun _a => ↑(η.toFun ((DiamondIntegral.Section6.vfDropLast A).toImage.toFun p)) = _a)
                            (DiamondIntegral.Section6.rowFormExtension_at ω p)))
                        hVal);
                  Eq.trans hAt hγ⟩ }

  [inst : NeZero qR] {M : Type} [inst_1 : SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M]

  [inst : SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M] [M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF]

  have hQ := Set.Definable.preimage_comp Sum.inr (SpecialTransformations.DefinableGeometry.Space.definable_domain Q S);

        ((fun M A L inst α s s' e'_6 =>

@DiamondIntegral.Section6.rowLevelRelation_definable : ∀ {M : Type}
  [inst : SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M] [M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF]

  (SpecialTransformations.Section4.rawMixedSpace n r).Definable S A →
    ∀ (f : DiamondIntegral.Section2.Mixed M n r → Set (SpecialTransformations.Section4.rawRVSpace q).Carrier),
      DiamondIntegral.Section6.MixedRowGraphDefinable S A f →
        (SpecialTransformations.Section4.rawMixedSpace (n + n) r).Definable S
          (DiamondIntegral.Section6.rowLevelRelation A f)
theorem DiamondIntegral.Section6.rowLevelRelation_definable : ∀ {M : Type}
  [inst : SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M] [M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF]
  {n r q : ℕ} {S : Set M} (A : Set (DiamondIntegral.Section2.Mixed M n r)),
  (SpecialTransformations.Section4.rawMixedSpace n r).Definable S A →
    ∀ (f : DiamondIntegral.Section2.Mixed M n r → Set (SpecialTransformations.Section4.rawRVSpace q).Carrier),
      DiamondIntegral.Section6.MixedRowGraphDefinable S A f →
        (SpecialTransformations.Section4.rawMixedSpace (n + n) r).Definable S
          (DiamondIntegral.Section6.rowLevelRelation A f) :=
fun {M} [inst : SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M] [M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF]
    {n r q} {S} A hAdef f hf =>
  let P := SpecialTransformations.Section4.rawMixedSpace (n + n) r;
  let Q := SpecialTransformations.Section4.rawMixedSpace n r;
  let R := SpecialTransformations.Section4.rawRVSpace q;
  let fst := DiamondIntegral.Section6.vfBlockMap (Fin.castAdd n);
  let snd := DiamondIntegral.Section6.vfBlockMap (Fin.natAdd n);
  have hA1 :=
    SpecialTransformations.DefinableGeometry.Space.RelationDefinable.exists_right P Q
      (SpecialTransformations.DefinableGeometry.Space.RelationDefinable.inter P Q fst.graph_definable
        (SpecialTransformations.DefinableGeometry.Space.Definable.right_relation P Q hAdef));
  have hA2 :=
    SpecialTransformations.DefinableGeometry.Space.RelationDefinable.exists_right P Q
      (SpecialTransformations.DefinableGeometry.Space.RelationDefinable.inter P Q snd.graph_definable
        (SpecialTransformations.DefinableGeometry.Space.Definable.right_relation P Q hAdef));
  have hD1 := SpecialTransformations.DefinableGeometry.Space.RelationDefinable.comp P Q R fst.graph_definable hf;
  have hD2 := SpecialTransformations.DefinableGeometry.Space.RelationDefinable.comp P Q R snd.graph_definable hf;
  have hBad :=
    SpecialTransformations.DefinableGeometry.Space.RelationDefinable.union P R
      (SpecialTransformations.DefinableGeometry.Space.RelationDefinable.inter P R hD1
        (DiamondIntegral.Section6.relationDefinable_not hD2))
      (SpecialTransformations.DefinableGeometry.Space.RelationDefinable.inter P R
        (DiamondIntegral.Section6.relationDefinable_not hD1) hD2);
  have h :=
    SpecialTransformations.DefinableGeometry.Space.Definable.inter P
      (SpecialTransformations.DefinableGeometry.Space.Definable.inter P hA1 hA2)
      (SpecialTransformations.DefinableGeometry.Space.Definable.compl P
        (SpecialTransformations.DefinableGeometry.Space.RelationDefinable.exists_right P R hBad));
  Eq.mpr
    (eq_of_heq
      ((fun L M inst P S A A' e'_6 =>
          Eq.casesOn (motive := fun a x => A' = a → e'_6 ≍ x → P.Definable S A ≍ P.Definable S A') e'_6
            (fun h =>
              Eq.ndrec (motive := fun A' => ∀ (e_6 : A = A'), e_6 ≍ Eq.refl A → P.Definable S A ≍ P.Definable S A')
                (fun e_6 h => HEq.refl (P.Definable S A)) (Eq.symm h) e'_6)
            (Eq.refl A') (HEq.refl e'_6))
        SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV M inst (SpecialTransformations.Section4.rawMixedSpace (n + n) r) S
        (DiamondIntegral.Section6.rowLevelRelation A f)
        ({p | ∃ x, fst.graph p x ∧ x ∈ A} ∩ {p | ∃ x, snd.graph p x ∧ x ∈ A} ∩
          {x |
              ∃ y,
                ((∃ x_1, fst.graph x x_1 ∧ x_1 ∈ A ∧ y ∈ f x_1) ∧ ¬∃ x_1, snd.graph x x_1 ∧ x_1 ∈ A ∧ y ∈ f x_1) ∨
                  (¬∃ x_1, fst.graph x x_1 ∧ x_1 ∈ A ∧ y ∈ f x_1) ∧ ∃ x_1, snd.graph x x_1 ∧ x_1 ∈ A ∧ y ∈ f x_1}ᶜ)
        (Set.ext fun p =>
          have hfst := fun x => DiamondIntegral.Section6.vfBlockMap_graph_iff (Fin.castAdd n) p x;
          have hsnd := fun x => DiamondIntegral.Section6.vfBlockMap_graph_iff (Fin.natAdd n) p x;
          {
            mp := fun hp =>
              And.casesOn hp fun h1 right =>
                And.casesOn right fun h2 he =>
                  ⟨⟨Exists.intro (DiamondIntegral.Section6.firstVFBlock p)
                        ⟨(hfst (DiamondIntegral.Section6.firstVFBlock p)).mpr rfl, h1⟩,
                      Exists.intro (DiamondIntegral.Section6.secondVFBlock p)
                        ⟨(hsnd (DiamondIntegral.Section6.secondVFBlock p)).mpr rfl, h2⟩⟩,
                    fun a =>
                    Exists.casesOn a fun v hv =>
                      Or.casesOn hv
                        (fun h =>
                          And.casesOn h fun left hn =>
                            Exists.casesOn left fun x h =>
                              And.casesOn h fun hx right =>
                                And.casesOn right fun left hvx =>
                                  hn
                                    (Exists.intro (DiamondIntegral.Section6.secondVFBlock p)
                                      ⟨(hsnd (DiamondIntegral.Section6.secondVFBlock p)).mpr rfl,
                                        ⟨h2, he ▸ Eq.mp (congrArg (fun _a => v ∈ f _a) ((hfst x).mp hx)) hvx⟩⟩))
                        fun h =>
                        And.casesOn h fun hn right =>
                          Exists.casesOn right fun x h =>
                            And.casesOn h fun hx right =>
                              And.casesOn right fun left hvx =>
                                hn
                                  (Exists.intro (DiamondIntegral.Section6.firstVFBlock p)
                                    ⟨(hfst (DiamondIntegral.Section6.firstVFBlock p)).mpr rfl,
                                      ⟨h1, Eq.symm he ▸ Eq.mp (congrArg (fun _a => v ∈ f _a) ((hsnd x).mp hx)) hvx⟩⟩)⟩,
            mpr := fun a =>
              And.casesOn a fun left hno =>
                And.casesOn left fun left right =>
                  Exists.casesOn left fun x1 h =>
                    And.casesOn h fun hx1 h1 =>
                      Exists.casesOn right fun x2 h =>
                        And.casesOn h fun hx2 h2 =>
                          ⟨Eq.mp (congrArg (fun _a => _a ∈ A) ((hfst x1).mp hx1)) h1,
                            ⟨Eq.mp (congrArg (fun _a => _a ∈ A) ((hsnd x2).mp hx2)) h2,
                              Set.ext fun v =>
                                {
                                  mp := fun hv =>
                                    Decidable.byContradiction fun hn =>
                                      hno
                                        (Exists.intro v
                                          (Or.inl
                                            ⟨Exists.intro (DiamondIntegral.Section6.firstVFBlock p)
                                                ⟨(hfst (DiamondIntegral.Section6.firstVFBlock p)).mpr rfl,
                                                  ⟨Eq.mp (congrArg (fun _a => _a ∈ A) ((hfst x1).mp hx1)) h1, hv⟩⟩,
                                              fun x =>
                                              match x with
                                              | Exists.intro x ⟨hx, ⟨left, hvx⟩⟩ => hn ((hsnd x).mp hx ▸ hvx)⟩)),
                                  mpr := fun hv =>
                                    Decidable.byContradiction fun hn =>
                                      hno
                                        (Exists.intro v
                                          (Or.inr
                                            ⟨fun x =>
                                              match x with
                                              | Exists.intro x ⟨hx, ⟨left, hvx⟩⟩ => hn ((hfst x).mp hx ▸ hvx),
                                              Exists.intro (DiamondIntegral.Section6.secondVFBlock p)
                                                ⟨(hsnd (DiamondIntegral.Section6.secondVFBlock p)).mpr rfl,
                                                  ⟨Eq.mp (congrArg (fun _a => _a ∈ A) ((hsnd x2).mp hx2)) h2,
                                                    hv⟩⟩⟩)) }⟩⟩ })))
    h

@DiamondIntegral.Section6.mixed_rv_relation_iff : ∀ {M : Type}
  [inst : SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M] [M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF]
  {n r q : ℕ}
  (R :
    (SpecialTransformations.Section4.rawMixedSpace n r).Carrier →
      (SpecialTransformations.Section4.rawRVSpace q).Carrier → Prop)
  (z : (Fin n ⊕ Fin r) ⊕ Fin q → M),
  z ∈ (SpecialTransformations.Section4.rawMixedSpace n r).relation (SpecialTransformations.Section4.rawRVSpace q) R ↔
    ∃ x v,
      Sum.elim (SpecialTransformations.Section4.mixedValues x) (SpecialTransformations.Section4.rvValues v) = z ∧ R x v
theorem DiamondIntegral.Section6.mixed_rv_relation_iff : ∀ {M : Type}
  [inst : SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M] [M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF]
  {n r q : ℕ}
  (R :
    (SpecialTransformations.Section4.rawMixedSpace n r).Carrier →
      (SpecialTransformations.Section4.rawRVSpace q).Carrier → Prop)
  (z : (Fin n ⊕ Fin r) ⊕ Fin q → M),
  z ∈ (SpecialTransformations.Section4.rawMixedSpace n r).relation (SpecialTransformations.Section4.rawRVSpace q) R ↔
    ∃ x v,
      Sum.elim (SpecialTransformations.Section4.mixedValues x) (SpecialTransformations.Section4.rvValues v) = z ∧
        R x v :=
fun {M} [SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M] [M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {n r q}
    R z =>
  {
    mp := fun a =>
      Exists.casesOn a fun hx h =>
        Exists.casesOn h fun hy h =>
          Exists.intro ((SpecialTransformations.Section4.rawMixedSpace n r).decode ⟨z ∘ Sum.inl, hx⟩)
            (Exists.intro ((SpecialTransformations.Section4.rawRVSpace q).decode ⟨z ∘ Sum.inr, hy⟩)
              ⟨funext fun i =>
                  Sum.casesOn (motive := fun t =>
                    i = t →
                      Sum.elim
                          (SpecialTransformations.Section4.mixedValues
                            ((SpecialTransformations.Section4.rawMixedSpace n r).decode ⟨z ∘ Sum.inl, hx⟩))
                          (SpecialTransformations.Section4.rvValues
                            ((SpecialTransformations.Section4.rawRVSpace q).decode ⟨z ∘ Sum.inr, hy⟩))
                          i =
                        z i)
                    i
                    (fun i_1 h =>
                      Eq.symm h ▸ congrFun (SpecialTransformations.Section4.mixedValues_decode ⟨z ∘ Sum.inl, hx⟩) i_1)
                    (fun i_1 h => Eq.symm h ▸ congrFun (DiamondIntegral.Section6.rvValues_decode ⟨z ∘ Sum.inr, hy⟩) i_1)
                    (Eq.refl i),
                h⟩),
    mpr := fun a =>
      Exists.casesOn a fun x h =>
        Exists.casesOn h fun v h =>
          And.casesOn h fun left h =>
            left ▸
              Exists.intro (SpecialTransformations.Section4.mixedValues_mem_domain x)
                (Exists.intro (Exists.intro v rfl)
                  (have e1 := SpecialTransformations.Section4.decode_mixedValues x;
                  have e2 := SpecialTransformations.Section4.decode_rvValues v;
                  Eq.mpr
                    (id
                      (congrArg
                        (fun _a =>
                          R _a
                            ((SpecialTransformations.Section4.rawRVSpace q).decode
                              ⟨Sum.elim (SpecialTransformations.Section4.mixedValues x)
                                    (SpecialTransformations.Section4.rvValues v) ∘
                                  Sum.inr,
                                Exists.intro v rfl⟩))
                        e1))
                    (Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => R x _a) e2)) h))) }

        (Eq.symm h) hAC η hForm)

  (hSame : ∀ (p q : ↑X.base.carrier), ↑(X.oldPoint p) = ↑(X.oldPoint q) → ↑(ω.toFun p) = ↑(ω.toFun q)),
  (∀ (u : (SpecialTransformations.Section4.rawRVSpace X.arity).Carrier)
      (γ : Set (SpecialTransformations.Section4.rawRVSpace qR).Carrier),
      IsOpen {x | (x, u) ∈ X.base.carrier ∧ DiamondIntegral.Section6.rowFormExtension ω (x, u) = γ}) →

      IsOpen
        {x |
          (x, u) ∈ X.coveredBase.carrier ∧
            DiamondIntegral.Section6.rowFormExtension (X.descendedGammaFormRow ω hSame) (x, u) = γ} :=
fun {qR} [NeZero qR] {M} [SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M]
    [M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {S} {n r} {G} [LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero G]
    [Valued (DiamondIntegral.Section2.VF M) G] {A} X ω hSame hLevels u γ =>
  if hFibre : (DiamondIntegral.Section2.vfFibre X.coveredBase.carrier u).Nonempty then
    Exists.casesOn hFibre fun x hx =>
      Exists.casesOn (DiamondIntegral.Section6.map_toImage_surjective X.oldMap ⟨(x, u), hx⟩) fun p hp =>
        have hTags := congrArg (fun q => (↑q).2) hp;
        have hFibres :=
          have h :=
            Eq.trans (DiamondIntegral.Section6.RVRefinementFrame.fibre_eq_of_mem X p)
              (Eq.symm (DiamondIntegral.Section6.RVRefinementFrame.coveredBase_fibre_of_mem X p));
          Eq.mp
            (congrArg
              (fun _a =>
                DiamondIntegral.Section2.vfFibre X.base.carrier (↑p).2 =
                  DiamondIntegral.Section2.vfFibre X.coveredBase.carrier _a)
              hTags)
            h;
        have hValue := fun z hz =>
          let a := ⟨(z, (↑p).2), hz⟩;
          have hMap := Prod.ext rfl hTags;
          have hAt :=
            congrArg Subtype.val (DiamondIntegral.Section6.RVRefinementFrame.descendedGammaForm_at_row X ω hSame a);
          Eq.trans
            (Eq.symm (congrArg (DiamondIntegral.Section6.rowFormExtension (X.descendedGammaFormRow ω hSame)) hMap))
            (Eq.trans
              (DiamondIntegral.Section6.rowFormExtension_at (X.descendedGammaFormRow ω hSame)
                (X.oldMap.toImage.toFun a))
              (Eq.trans hAt (Eq.symm (DiamondIntegral.Section6.rowFormExtension_at ω a))));
        have hSet :=
          Set.ext fun z =>
            have hMem := Iff.symm (Set.ext_iff.mp hFibres z);
            { mp := fun a => And.casesOn a fun hz hγ => ⟨hMem.mp hz, Eq.trans (Eq.symm (hValue z (hMem.mp hz))) hγ⟩,
              mpr := fun a => And.casesOn a fun hz hγ => ⟨hMem.mpr hz, Eq.trans (hValue z hz) hγ⟩ };
        Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => IsOpen _a) hSet)) (hLevels (↑p).2 γ)
  else
    have hEmpty := Set.ext fun z => { mp := fun hz => False.elim (hFibre (Exists.intro z hz.left)), mpr := False.elim };
    Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => IsOpen _a) hEmpty)) isOpen_empty

theorem DiamondIntegral.Section6.RVRefinementFrame.gamma_level_fibre_eq_row : ∀ {qR : ℕ} [NeZero qR] {M : Type}
  [inst : SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M]
  [inst_1 : M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {S : Set M} {n r : ℕ}

  (X : DiamondIntegral.Section6.RVRefinementFrame A) (ω : DiamondIntegral.Section6.RowFormOn X.base qR)
  (hSame : ∀ (p q : ↑X.base.carrier), ↑(X.oldPoint p) = ↑(X.oldPoint q) → ↑(ω.toFun p) = ↑(ω.toFun q))
  (p : ↑X.base.carrier) (γ : Set (SpecialTransformations.Section4.rawRVSpace qR).Carrier),
  DiamondIntegral.Section2.vfFibre {q | q ∈ X.base.carrier ∧ DiamondIntegral.Section6.rowFormExtension ω q = γ} (↑p).2 =
    DiamondIntegral.Section2.vfFibre
      {q |
        q ∈ X.coveredBase.carrier ∧ DiamondIntegral.Section6.rowFormExtension (X.descendedGammaFormRow ω hSame) q = γ}
      ((↑p).2 ∘ X.labels) :=

    [M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {S} {n r} {A} X ω hSame p γ =>
  have hFibres :=
    Eq.trans (DiamondIntegral.Section6.RVRefinementFrame.fibre_eq_of_mem X p)
      (Eq.symm (DiamondIntegral.Section6.RVRefinementFrame.coveredBase_fibre_of_mem X p));
  have hValue := fun z hz =>
    let a := ⟨(z, (↑p).2), hz⟩;
    have hAt := congrArg Subtype.val (DiamondIntegral.Section6.RVRefinementFrame.descendedGammaForm_at_row X ω hSame a);
    Eq.trans (DiamondIntegral.Section6.rowFormExtension_at (X.descendedGammaFormRow ω hSame) (X.oldMap.toImage.toFun a))
      (Eq.trans hAt (Eq.symm (DiamondIntegral.Section6.rowFormExtension_at ω a)));
  Set.ext fun z =>
    have hMem := Set.ext_iff.mp hFibres z;
    { mp := fun a => And.casesOn a fun hz hγ => ⟨hMem.mp hz, Eq.trans (hValue z hz) hγ⟩,
      mpr := fun a => And.casesOn a fun hz hγ => ⟨hMem.mpr hz, Eq.trans (Eq.symm (hValue z (hMem.mpr hz))) hγ⟩ }

      DiamondIntegral.Section6.rowFormExtension (ζ (X.baseMap.toFun p)) (Fin.tail (↑p).1, (↑p).2 ∘ σ) = ↑(ω.toFun p)) →

      DiamondIntegral.Section6.selectedJointPoint π σ ↑p = DiamondIntegral.Section6.selectedJointPoint π σ ↑z →

    he =>
  have hBase := DiamondIntegral.Section6.SelectedProgramContext.baseMap_eq_of_selected_joint_eq_row X p z he;
  have hLocal :=
    have h := congrArg (fun w => (Fin.tail w.1, w.2 ∘ Fin.natAdd r)) he;
    Eq.mp
      (congrArg
        (fun _a =>
          (Fin.tail (DiamondIntegral.Section6.selectedJointPoint π σ ↑p).1, (↑p).2 ∘ σ) =
            (Fin.tail (DiamondIntegral.Section6.selectedJointPoint π σ ↑z).1, _a))
        (DiamondIntegral.Section6.selectedJointPoint_local π σ ↑z))
      (Eq.mp
        (congrArg
          (fun _a =>
            (Fin.tail (DiamondIntegral.Section6.selectedJointPoint π σ ↑p).1, _a) =
              (Fin.tail (DiamondIntegral.Section6.selectedJointPoint π σ ↑z).1,
                (DiamondIntegral.Section6.selectedJointPoint π σ ↑z).2 ∘ Fin.natAdd r))
          (DiamondIntegral.Section6.selectedJointPoint_local π σ ↑p))
        h);
  have hp := hForm p;
  Eq.trans
    (Eq.symm
      (Eq.mp
        (congrArg (fun _a => DiamondIntegral.Section6.rowFormExtension (ζ (X.baseMap.toFun z)) _a = ↑(ω.toFun p))
          hLocal)
        (Eq.mp
          (congrArg
            (fun _a => DiamondIntegral.Section6.rowFormExtension (ζ _a) (Fin.tail (↑p).1, (↑p).2 ∘ σ) = ↑(ω.toFun p))

      hc;

    have hp := ((f.inverse hf).toFun ⟨(x, v), hx⟩).property;

            DiamondIntegral.Section6.rowFormExtension ω _a)

      { mp := fun a => And.casesOn a fun hx hγ => ⟨hx, ⟨hInput x hx, Eq.trans (Eq.symm (hValue x hx)) hγ⟩⟩,
