                                                ↑(DiamondIntegral.Section6.gammaMapValue ω a /
                                                    DiamondIntegral.Section6.gammaMapValue σ (f.toFun a))) →
                                      ∃ H,
                                        DiamondIntegral.Section6.RelativeApertureChain A H.geometry.source
                                            H.geometry.sourceMap ∧
                                          DiamondIntegral.Section6.RelativeApertureChain B H.geometry.target
                                              H.geometry.targetMap ∧
                                            (∀ p ∈ H.geometry.source.carrier,
                                                ∀ q ∈ H.geometry.source.carrier,
                                                  p.2 = q.2 →
                                                    DiamondIntegral.Section6.gammaFormExtension
                                                        (H.geometry.sourceForm h00 ω) p =
                                                      DiamondIntegral.Section6.gammaFormExtension
                                                        (H.geometry.sourceForm h00 ω) q) ∧
                                              (∀ p ∈ H.geometry.target.carrier,
                                                  ∀ q ∈ H.geometry.target.carrier,
                                                    p.2 = q.2 →
                                                      DiamondIntegral.Section6.gammaFormExtension
                                                          (H.geometry.targetForm h00 σ) p =
                                                        DiamondIntegral.Section6.gammaFormExtension
                                                          (H.geometry.targetForm h00 σ) q) ∧
                                                ∃ (hA' :
                                                  ∀ (a : Fin 1 → DiamondIntegral.Section2.VF M),
                                                    {u | (a, u) ∈ H.geometry.source.carrier}.Finite)
                                                  (hB' :
                                                  ∀ (b : Fin 1 → DiamondIntegral.Section2.VF M),
                                                    {v | (b, v) ∈ H.geometry.target.carrier}.Finite),
                                                  (H.sourceRV hA').doublyBounded ∧
                                                    (H.targetRV hB').doublyBounded ∧
                                                      (∀ (u : ↑(H.sourceRV hA').object.domain.carrier),
                                                          (H.sourceRV hA').object.value u = fun x => ↑u H.sourceIndex) ∧
                                                        (∀ (v : ↑(H.targetRV hB').object.domain.carrier),
                                                            (H.targetRV hB').object.value v = fun x =>
                                                              ↑v H.targetIndex) ∧
                                                          ∃ e,
                                                            ∀ (p : ↑H.geometry.source.carrier),
                                                              e.iso.hom.map.toFun
                                                                  ((DiamondIntegral.Section6.pureRVTagQuotient
                                                                        H.geometry.source).toFun
                                                                    p) =
                                                                (DiamondIntegral.Section6.pureRVTagQuotient
                                                                      H.geometry.target).toFun
                                                                  (H.geometry.map.toFun p)

  [inst : SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M]
  [inst_1 : M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {G : Type} [inst_2 : LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero G]

theorem DiamondIntegral.Section6.FiniteBranchedShearCover.selectedTemplate_good : ∀ {M : Type}
  [inst : SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M]
  [inst_1 : M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {S : Set M} {p n r : ℕ}
  {A : DiamondIntegral.Section6.MixedSetParameterTemplate S p (n + 1) r} {U : Set (Fin p → M)} {G : Type}
  [inst_2 : LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero G] [inst_3 : Valued (DiamondIntegral.Section2.VF M) G],
  (∀ (x y : DiamondIntegral.Section2.VF M),
      SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.VFValued.predV x y ↔ Valued.v x ≤ Valued.v y) →
    ∀ (F : DiamondIntegral.Section6.FiniteBranchedShearCover A U)
      (hU : S.Definable SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV U), ∀ a ∈ U, a ∈ (F.selectedTemplate hU).good A :=
fun {M} [SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M] [M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {S}
    {p n r} {A} {U} {G} [LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero G] [Valued (DiamondIntegral.Section2.VF M) G] hv F hU a ha =>
  Exists.casesOn (F.cover a ha) fun i hi =>
    have hGood := (F.choices_good i hi).right;
    have hF := DiamondIntegral.Section6.FiniteBranchedShearCover.selectedTemplate_goodFunctions hv F hU a;
    have hI :=
      DiamondIntegral.Section6.finiteRVTemplateChoice_value_at (fun j => (F.templates j).indicator) U hU F.choices
        F.choices_definable (fun j x hj => (F.choices_good j hj).left) F.disjoint a i hi hGood.left.left hF.left;
    have hO :=
      DiamondIntegral.Section6.finiteRVTemplateChoice_value_at (fun j => (F.templates j).offset) U hU F.choices
        F.choices_definable (fun j x hj => (F.choices_good j hj).left) F.disjoint a i hi hGood.left.right hF.right;
    id
      (fun hI =>
        id
          (fun hO =>
            let D := DiamondIntegral.Section6.BranchedShearChartTemplate.toData hv (F.templates i) A a hGood;
            (DiamondIntegral.Section6.BranchedShearChartTemplate.good_iff_semantics hv (F.selectedTemplate hU) A a
                  hF).mpr
              (Eq.mpr
                (id
                  (congrArg
                    (fun _a =>
                      (∀ (w : Fin (r + F.arity) → DiamondIntegral.Section2.RVInfinity M)
                          (x : Fin (n + 1) → DiamondIntegral.Section2.VF M), _a w x 0 = 0 ∨ _a w x 0 = 1) ∧
                        (∀ (x : (SpecialTransformations.Section4.rawVFSpace (n + 1)).Carrier)
                            (u : (SpecialTransformations.Section4.rawRVSpace r).Carrier),
                            (x, u) ∈ (A.fibre a).carrier ↔ ∃ v, _a (Fin.append u v) x 0 = 1) ∧
                          (∀ (x : Fin (n + 1) → DiamondIntegral.Section2.VF M)
                              (u : Fin r → DiamondIntegral.Section2.RVInfinity M)
                              (v w : Fin F.arity → DiamondIntegral.Section2.RVInfinity M),
                              _a (Fin.append u v) x 0 = 1 → _a (Fin.append u w) x 0 = 1 → v = w) ∧
                            (∀ (x : Fin (n + 1) → DiamondIntegral.Section2.VF M)
                                (u : Fin r → DiamondIntegral.Section2.RVInfinity M)

theorem DiamondIntegral.Section6.enlarged_aperture_noncore : ∀ {M : Type}
  [inst : SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M]
  [inst_1 : M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {S V : Set M} {n s q : ℕ} {G : Type}

  {C : SpecialTransformations.DefinableGeometry.DefSet (SpecialTransformations.Section4.rawMixedSpace (n + 1) q) S}
  {A : SpecialTransformations.DefinableGeometry.DefSet (SpecialTransformations.Section4.rawMixedSpace n s) V}
  (D : DiamondIntegral.Section6.CentripetalData C) (E : DiamondIntegral.Section6.CentripetalData A) (σ : Fin s → Fin q)

  D.coordinate = E.coordinate.succ →
    D.extendedFocus p = E.extendedFocus (Fin.tail p.1, p.2 ∘ σ) →
      DiamondIntegral.Section2.vfValue E.coefficient ≤ DiamondIntegral.Section2.vfValue D.coefficient →
        E.core (Fin.tail p.1, p.2 ∘ σ) = false → D.core p = false :=
fun {M} [SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M] [M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {S V}
    {n s q} {G} [LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero G] [Valued (DiamondIntegral.Section2.VF M) G] {C} {A} D E σ p hCoord
    hFocus hCoeff hOld =>
  have hCut :=
    Eq.mpr
      (id
        (congrArg
          (fun _a =>
            DiamondIntegral.Section2.vfValue (E.coefficient * E.extendedFocus (Fin.tail p.1, p.2 ∘ σ)) ≤
              DiamondIntegral.Section2.vfValue (D.coefficient * _a))
          hFocus))
      (id
        (Eq.mpr
          (id
            (congrArg
              (fun _a =>
                _a ≤
                  SpecialTransformations.Section3.Values.vfValueHom
                    (D.coefficient * E.extendedFocus (Fin.tail p.1, p.2 ∘ σ)))
              (map_mul SpecialTransformations.Section3.Values.vfValueHom E.coefficient
                (E.extendedFocus (Fin.tail p.1, p.2 ∘ σ)))))
          (Eq.mpr
            (id
              (congrArg
                (fun _a =>
                  SpecialTransformations.Section3.Values.vfValueHom E.coefficient *
                      SpecialTransformations.Section3.Values.vfValueHom (E.extendedFocus (Fin.tail p.1, p.2 ∘ σ)) ≤
                    _a)
                (map_mul SpecialTransformations.Section3.Values.vfValueHom D.coefficient
                  (E.extendedFocus (Fin.tail p.1, p.2 ∘ σ)))))
            (mul_le_mul' hCoeff le_rfl))));
  decide_eq_false_iff_not.mpr fun hNew =>
    have hOldCut := le_of_not_gt (of_decide_eq_false hOld);
    have hDelta :=
      Eq.mpr
        (id
          (congrArg
            (fun _a => p.1 _a - D.extendedFocus p = Fin.tail p.1 E.coordinate - E.extendedFocus (Fin.tail p.1, p.2 ∘ σ))
            hCoord))
        (Eq.mpr
          (id
            (congrArg
              (fun _a =>
                p.1 E.coordinate.succ - _a = Fin.tail p.1 E.coordinate - E.extendedFocus (Fin.tail p.1, p.2 ∘ σ))
              hFocus))
          (Eq.refl (p.1 E.coordinate.succ - E.extendedFocus (Fin.tail p.1, p.2 ∘ σ))));
    not_lt_of_ge (LE.le.trans hOldCut hCut)
      (Eq.mp
        (congrArg
          (fun _a =>
            DiamondIntegral.Section2.vfValue (D.coefficient * D.extendedFocus p) < DiamondIntegral.Section2.vfValue _a)
          hDelta)
        hNew)

              IsOpen
                {b |
                  (b, v) ∈ B.carrier ∧
                    DiamondIntegral.Section6.gammaFormExtension (ω.comp (f.inverse hf)) (b, v) = γ} :=
fun {M} [SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M] [M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF]
    {n m r s} {S} {A} {B} {G} [LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero G] [Valued (DiamondIntegral.Section2.VF M) G] f hf π
    hRetain hCont hBOpen ω hLevels v γ =>
  let u := fun i => v (π i);
  let g := DiamondIntegral.Section6.graphFibreMap (f.inverse hf) v u;
  have hg :=
    have hc := hCont v u;
    Eq.mp
      (congrArg (fun _a => ContinuousOn (DiamondIntegral.Section6.graphFibreMap (f.inverse hf) v u) _a)
        (DiamondIntegral.Section6.selected_inverse_fiber_source f hf π hRetain v))
      hc;
  have hInput := fun x hx =>
    have hp := ((f.inverse hf).toFun ⟨(x, v), hx⟩).property;

      hp;
  have hValue := fun x hx =>
    have hc := DiamondIntegral.Section6.gammaFormExtension_comp_at ω (f.inverse hf) ⟨(x, v), hx⟩;

      (congrArg
        (fun _a =>
          DiamondIntegral.Section6.gammaFormExtension (ω.comp (f.inverse hf)) ↑⟨(x, v), hx⟩ =
            DiamondIntegral.Section6.gammaFormExtension ω _a)
        (DiamondIntegral.Section6.selected_inverse_point f hf π hRetain v x hx))
      hc;
  have hEq :=
    Set.ext fun x =>
      { mp := fun a => And.casesOn a fun hx hγ => ⟨hx, ⟨hInput x hx, Eq.trans (Eq.symm (hValue x hx)) hγ⟩⟩,
        mpr := fun a =>
          And.casesOn a fun hx right => And.casesOn right fun left hγ => ⟨hx, Eq.trans (hValue x hx) hγ⟩ };

  [inst : SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M]
  [inst_1 : M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {S : Set M} {n r s : ℕ}
  {B : SpecialTransformations.DefinableGeometry.DefSet (SpecialTransformations.Section4.rawMixedSpace 1 r) S}
  (η :
    SpecialTransformations.DefinableGeometry.Map B
      (SpecialTransformations.DefinableGeometry.DefSet.univ (SpecialTransformations.Section4.rawVFSpace 1) S))
  (A D : DiamondIntegral.Section6.MixedSetParameterTemplate S 1 n s),
  (∀ (b : ↑B.carrier),
      A.fibre (DiamondIntegral.Section6.unaryFamilyParameter η b) =
        D.fibre (DiamondIntegral.Section6.unaryFamilyParameter η b)) →
    DiamondIntegral.Section6.unaryIndexedMixedFamily η A = DiamondIntegral.Section6.unaryIndexedMixedFamily η D :=
fun {M} [SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M] [M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {S}
    {n r s} {B} η A D h =>
  DiamondIntegral.Section6.defSet_eq_of_carrier_eq
    (Set.ext fun p =>
      Eq.mpr
        (id
          (congrArg (fun _a => _a ↔ p ∈ (DiamondIntegral.Section6.unaryIndexedMixedFamily η D).carrier)
            (propext (DiamondIntegral.Section6.mem_unaryIndexedMixedFamily η A p))))
        (Eq.mpr
          (id
            (congrArg
              (fun _a =>
                (∃ b,
                    DiamondIntegral.Section6.unaryFamilyBasePoint p = ↑b ∧
                      (Fin.tail p.1, p.2 ∘ Fin.natAdd r) ∈
                        (A.fibre (DiamondIntegral.Section6.unaryFamilyParameter η b)).carrier) ↔
                  _a)
              (propext (DiamondIntegral.Section6.mem_unaryIndexedMixedFamily η D p))))
          { mp := fun a => Exists.casesOn a fun b h_1 => And.casesOn h_1 fun hb hA => Exists.intro b ⟨hb, h b ▸ hA⟩,
            mpr := fun a =>
              Exists.casesOn a fun b h_1 => And.casesOn h_1 fun hb hD => Exists.intro b ⟨hb, Eq.symm (h b) ▸ hD⟩ }))

    {n r} {G} [LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero G] [Valued (DiamondIntegral.Section2.VF M) G] {A} D h00 hj ω hSafe q q'
    hInit hTags hCore =>
  let f := DiamondIntegral.Section6.centripetalStepMap D;
  have hf := DiamondIntegral.Section6.centripetalStepMap_bijective D h00;

            _a =

    hs hv V hsmall hΓ hV hVS hSV hnt f hf hA hAD hARV hATag hB hBD hBRV hBTag E hEA hUS hUT α β D hSmallS hSmallT =>
  let E' := DiamondIntegral.Section6.matchedCenterImage f E hEA;

  let e := DiamondIntegral.Section6.unaryLabelScalar E' hU' eMap;

fun {M} [SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M] [M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {S}

    (id
      (congrArg (fun _a => ↑a ∈ (D.sourcePlan hE hSource).disc p ↔ ↑(f.toFun a) ∈ _a)
        (DiamondIntegral.Section6.SeparatedUnaryOffsetCores.targetPlan_disc_at D hE hTarget hf p)))

      (have h :=
        DiamondIntegral.Section6.UniformFinitePairedCores.mixed_image_iff f E hEA α β D.toUniformFinitePairedCores p
          (f.toFun a);

        mp := fun a_1 =>
          And.casesOn a_1 fun hTags hClose =>
            have hImage :=
              h.mpr
                (Exists.intro a
                  ⟨(DiamondIntegral.Section6.mem_centeredGammaDisc ((↑p).1 0) ((↑a).1 0)
                          (DiamondIntegral.Section2.finiteValue (↑(D.sourceOffset.toFun p) 0) (D.sourceNonzero p))).mpr
                      hClose,

                    (DiamondIntegral.Section2.finiteValue (↑(D.targetOffset.toFun p) 0) (D.targetNonzero p))).mp
                hImage.left⟩,

          And.casesOn a_1 fun hTags hClose =>

              (h.mp
                ⟨(DiamondIntegral.Section6.mem_centeredGammaDisc ((↑(f.toFun ⟨↑p, hEA p.property⟩)).1 0)

                        (DiamondIntegral.Section2.finiteValue (↑(D.targetOffset.toFun p) 0) (D.targetNonzero p))).mpr
                    hClose,
                  hTags⟩)
              fun b h =>
              And.casesOn h fun hb right =>
                And.casesOn right fun hbTags hba =>
                  have he := hf hba;
                  Eq.ndrec (motive := fun b =>

                          hb⟩)

@DiamondIntegral.Section6.unaryTaggedDisc_disjoint_of_separated_scalar_discs : ∀ {M : Type}
  [inst : SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M]
  [inst_1 : M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {r : ℕ} (p q : DiamondIntegral.Section2.Mixed M 1 r)
  (γ δ ρ : DiamondIntegral.Section2.Gamma M),
  p ≠ q →
    ρ ≤ γ →
      ρ ≤ δ →
        (p.1 0 ≠ q.1 0 →
            Disjoint (DiamondIntegral.Section6.centeredGammaDisc (p.1 0) ρ)
              (DiamondIntegral.Section6.centeredGammaDisc (q.1 0) ρ)) →
          Disjoint (DiamondIntegral.Section6.unaryTaggedDisc p γ) (DiamondIntegral.Section6.unaryTaggedDisc q δ)
theorem DiamondIntegral.Section6.unaryTaggedDisc_disjoint_of_separated_scalar_discs : ∀ {M : Type}
  [inst : SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M]
  [inst_1 : M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {r : ℕ} (p q : DiamondIntegral.Section2.Mixed M 1 r)
  (γ δ ρ : DiamondIntegral.Section2.Gamma M),
  p ≠ q →
    ρ ≤ γ →
      ρ ≤ δ →
        (p.1 0 ≠ q.1 0 →
            Disjoint (DiamondIntegral.Section6.centeredGammaDisc (p.1 0) ρ)
              (DiamondIntegral.Section6.centeredGammaDisc (q.1 0) ρ)) →
          Disjoint (DiamondIntegral.Section6.unaryTaggedDisc p γ) (DiamondIntegral.Section6.unaryTaggedDisc q δ) :=
fun {M} [SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M] [M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {r} p q
    γ δ ρ hne hγ hδ hSep =>
  Set.disjoint_left.mpr fun ⦃a⦄ a_1 =>
    And.casesOn a_1 fun hap hp a_2 =>
      And.casesOn a_2 fun haq hq =>
        have hScalar := fun he =>
          hne
            (Prod.ext
              (funext fun i =>
                List.Mem.casesOn (motive := fun a x => List.finRange 1 = a → Fintype.complete i ≍ x → p.1 i = q.1 i)
                  (Fintype.complete i)
                  (fun as h =>
                    List.cons.noConfusion h fun head_eq =>
                      Eq.ndrec (motive := fun i =>
                        ∀ (this : i ∈ Fintype.elems), [] ≍ as → this ≍ List.Mem.head as → p.1 i = q.1 i)
                        (fun this tail_eq =>
                          Eq.ndrec (motive := fun as =>
                            this ≍ List.Mem.head as →
                              p.1 ((fun i => i) ⟨0, Nat.le_refl 1⟩) = q.1 ((fun i => i) ⟨0, Nat.le_refl 1⟩))
                            (fun h => he) (eq_of_heq tail_eq))
                        (eq_of_heq head_eq) (Fintype.complete i))
                  (fun b {as} a h =>
                    List.cons.noConfusion h fun head_eq =>
                      Eq.ndrec (motive := fun b => [] ≍ as → Fintype.complete i ≍ List.Mem.tail b a → p.1 i = q.1 i)
                        (fun tail_eq =>
                          Eq.ndrec (motive := fun {as} =>
                            ∀ (a : List.Mem i as),
                              Fintype.complete i ≍ List.Mem.tail ((fun i => i) ⟨0, Nat.le_refl 1⟩) a → p.1 i = q.1 i)
                            (fun a h =>
                              List.Mem.casesOn (motive := fun a_3 x => [] = a_3 → a ≍ x → p.1 i = q.1 i) a
                                (fun as h => False.elim (noConfusion_of_Nat List.ctorIdx h))
                                (fun b {as} a_3 h => False.elim (noConfusion_of_Nat List.ctorIdx h)) (Eq.refl [])
                                (HEq.refl a))
                            (eq_of_heq tail_eq) a)
                        (eq_of_heq head_eq))
                  (Eq.refl (List.finRange 1)) (HEq.refl (Fintype.complete i)))
              (Eq.trans (Eq.symm hap) haq));
        Set.disjoint_left.mp (hSep hScalar)
          ((DiamondIntegral.Section6.mem_centeredGammaDisc (p.1 0) (a.1 0) ρ).mpr
            (LE.le.trans_lt
              (have this := hγ;
              this)
              hp))
          ((DiamondIntegral.Section6.mem_centeredGammaDisc (q.1 0) (a.1 0) ρ).mpr
            (LE.le.trans_lt
              (have this := hδ;
              this)
              hq))

theorem DiamondIntegral.Section6.CentripetalProgramSequence.steps_pos : ∀ {M : Type}
  [inst : SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M] [M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF]
  {S : Set M} {p n r s : ℕ} (F : DiamondIntegral.Section6.CentripetalProgramSequence S p n r s), 0 < F.steps :=
fun {M} [SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M] [M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {S}
    {p n r s} F =>
  DiamondIntegral.Section6.CentripetalProgramSequence.casesOn (motive := fun a a_1 t =>
    r = a → s = a_1 → F ≍ t → 0 < F.steps) F
    (fun {r_1 s_1} F_1 h =>
      Eq.ndrec (motive := fun {r_2} =>
        ∀ (F_2 : DiamondIntegral.Section6.CentripetalProgramPrimitive S p n r_2 s_1),
          s = s_1 → F ≍ DiamondIntegral.Section6.CentripetalProgramSequence.single F_2 → 0 < F.steps)
        (fun F_2 h =>
          Eq.ndrec (motive := fun {s_2} =>
            ∀ (F_3 : DiamondIntegral.Section6.CentripetalProgramPrimitive S p n r s_2),
              F ≍ DiamondIntegral.Section6.CentripetalProgramSequence.single F_3 → 0 < F.steps)
            (fun F_3 h =>
              Eq.symm (eq_of_heq h) ▸
                id
                  (Decidable.byContradiction fun a =>
                    DiamondIntegral.Section6.CentripetalProgramSequence.steps_pos._proof_1_4 a))
            h F_2)
        h F_1)
    (fun {r_1 s_1 t} F_1 H h =>
      Eq.ndrec (motive := fun {r_2} =>
        ∀ (F_2 : DiamondIntegral.Section6.CentripetalProgramPrimitive S p n r_2 s_1),
          s = t → F ≍ DiamondIntegral.Section6.CentripetalProgramSequence.cons F_2 H → 0 < F.steps)
        (fun F_2 h =>
          Eq.ndrec (motive := fun {t} =>
            ∀ (H : DiamondIntegral.Section6.CentripetalProgramSequence S p n s_1 t),
              F ≍ DiamondIntegral.Section6.CentripetalProgramSequence.cons F_2 H → 0 < F.steps)
            (fun H h =>
              Eq.symm (eq_of_heq h) ▸
                id
                  (Decidable.byContradiction fun a =>
                    DiamondIntegral.Section6.CentripetalProgramSequence.steps_pos._proof_1_5 H a))
            h H)
        h F_1)
    (Eq.refl r) (Eq.refl s) (HEq.refl F)

  [inst : SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M] [M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF]

    {p n r s t} F H =>
  DiamondIntegral.Section6.CentripetalProgramSequence.rec (motive := fun {r s} F =>
    ∀ (H : DiamondIntegral.Section6.CentripetalProgramSequence S p n s t), (F.append H).steps = F.steps + H.steps)
    (fun {r s} F H =>
      Eq.mpr
        (id
          (congrFun' (congrArg Eq (DiamondIntegral.Section6.CentripetalProgramSequence.steps.eq_2 r t s F H))

  [inst : SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M]
  [inst_1 : M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {S : Set M} {n r s : ℕ}
  {A : SpecialTransformations.DefinableGeometry.DefSet (SpecialTransformations.Section4.rawMixedSpace (n + 1) r) S}
  {B : SpecialTransformations.DefinableGeometry.DefSet (SpecialTransformations.Section4.rawMixedSpace (n + 1) s) S}

  (u : Fin r → DiamondIntegral.Section2.RVInfinity M) (v : Fin s → DiamondIntegral.Section2.RVInfinity M)

  DiamondIntegral.Section6.graphFibre f u v x y →
    DiamondIntegral.Section6.totalFocusFibre (DiamondIntegral.Section6.graphShearBaseDisplacement hc f hStable)

      y (Fin.last n) - x (Fin.last n) :=

    {n r s} {A} {B} hc f hStable u v x y hGraph =>
  Exists.casesOn hGraph fun p h =>
    And.casesOn h fun hp hfp =>
      let q := (DiamondIntegral.Section6.graft hc (DiamondIntegral.Section6.rvProjection f)).toFun p;
      let C := (DiamondIntegral.Section6.vfDropLast (DiamondIntegral.Section6.graphChartDomain hc f)).image;
      let δ := DiamondIntegral.Section6.graphShearBaseDisplacement hc f hStable;
      have hBase := Exists.intro q rfl;
      have hT :=
        Eq.mpr
          (id
            (congrArg
              (fun _a =>
                _a 0 =
                  ↑(δ.toFun
                        ((DiamondIntegral.Section6.vfDropLast
                                (DiamondIntegral.Section6.graphChartDomain hc f)).toImage.toFun
                          q))
                    0)
              (DiamondIntegral.Section6.totalFocusFibre_at δ (↑q).2 (Fin.init (↑q).1) hBase)))
          (Eq.refl (↑(δ.toFun ⟨(Fin.init (↑q).1, (↑q).2), hBase⟩) 0));
      have hD := congrArg (fun z => ↑z 0) (DiamondIntegral.Section6.graphShearBaseDisplacement_factor hc f hStable q);
      have h := Eq.trans hT hD;
      id
        (fun h =>
          have hInput := congrArg Prod.snd hp;

@DiamondIntegral.Section6.SameLabelShearDisplacement.comp : ∀ {M : Type}
  [inst : SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M]
  [inst_1 : M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {S : Set M} {n r s t : ℕ}

  {f : SpecialTransformations.DefinableGeometry.Map A B} {g : SpecialTransformations.DefinableGeometry.Map B C}

theorem DiamondIntegral.Section6.SameLabelShearDisplacement.comp : ∀ {M : Type}
  [inst : SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M]
  [inst_1 : M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {S : Set M} {n r s t : ℕ}
  {A : SpecialTransformations.DefinableGeometry.DefSet (SpecialTransformations.Section4.rawMixedSpace n r) S}
  {B : SpecialTransformations.DefinableGeometry.DefSet (SpecialTransformations.Section4.rawMixedSpace n s) S}
  {C : SpecialTransformations.DefinableGeometry.DefSet (SpecialTransformations.Section4.rawMixedSpace n t) S}
  {f : SpecialTransformations.DefinableGeometry.Map A B} {g : SpecialTransformations.DefinableGeometry.Map B C}
  {j : Fin n},
  DiamondIntegral.Section6.SameLabelShearDisplacement f j →
    DiamondIntegral.Section6.SameLabelShearDisplacement g j →
      (∀ (p : ↑A.carrier) (i : Fin n), i ≠ j → (↑(f.toFun p)).1 i = (↑p).1 i) →
        ∀ (π : Fin s → Fin t),
          (∀ (p : ↑B.carrier) (i : Fin s), (↑(g.toFun p)).2 (π i) = (↑p).2 i) →
            DiamondIntegral.Section6.SameLabelShearDisplacement (g.comp f) j :=
fun {M} [SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M] [M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {S}
    {n r s t} {A} {B} {C} {f} {g} {j} hF hG hRelative π hRetain p q hInput hOutput hInactive =>
  have hMiddle :=
    funext fun i =>
      Eq.trans (Eq.symm (hRetain (f.toFun p) i)) (Eq.trans (congrFun hOutput (π i)) (hRetain (f.toFun q) i));
  have hOther := fun i hi =>
    Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => _a = (↑(f.toFun q)).1 i) (hRelative p i hi)))
      (Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => (↑p).1 i = _a) (hRelative q i hi)))
        (Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => _a = (↑q).1 i) (hInactive i hi))) (Eq.refl ((↑q).1 i))));

fun {M} [SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M] [M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {n r}
    {S} {I} {G} [LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero G] [Valued (DiamondIntegral.Section2.VF M) G] {A} h00 hc {κ} hκ hs hv D
    P E hRestr =>
  let hPA := fun i => (hRestr i).subset;
  let Q := fun i => (D.bijection.restrict (hPA i)).image;
  have hQsub := fun i ⦃q⦄ a => Exists.casesOn a fun p hp => hp ▸ (D.bijection.toFun ⟨↑p, hPA i p.property⟩).property;
  have hQeq := fun i =>
    DiamondIntegral.Section6.image_eq_of_surjective_liesOver D.bijection (E i).bijection
      (Function.Bijective.surjective (DiamondIntegral.Section6.CentripetalData.bijective (E i) h00)) (hPA i) fun p =>
      DiamondIntegral.Section6.ApertureRestrictionData.point (hRestr i) (↑p) p.property;
  have hQproper := fun i =>
    Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => DiamondIntegral.Section6.ProperInvariant S _a.carrier) (Eq.symm (hQeq i))))
      (DiamondIntegral.Section6.CentripetalData.image_properInvariant (E i) h00 hc hκ hs hv);
  have hQdouble := fun i =>
    Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => DiamondIntegral.Section6.VFDoublyBounded _a.carrier) (Eq.symm (hQeq i))))
      (DiamondIntegral.Section6.CentripetalData.image_vfDoublyBounded (E i));
  DiamondIntegral.Section6.SimultaneousCentripetalChain.comp P hPA
    (DiamondIntegral.Section6.SimultaneousCentripetalChain.centripetal A D P hPA E fun i p hp =>
      DiamondIntegral.Section6.ApertureRestrictionData.point (hRestr i) p hp)
    (DiamondIntegral.Section6.SimultaneousCentripetalChain.regularize D.map.image
      (DiamondIntegral.Section6.CentripetalData.image_properInvariant D h00 hc hκ hs hv)
      (DiamondIntegral.Section6.CentripetalData.image_vfDoublyBounded D) Q hQsub hQproper hQdouble)

@DiamondIntegral.Section6.defSet_eq_of_carrier_eq : ∀ {M : Type}
  [inst : SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M] [M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF]
  {S : Set M} {P : SpecialTransformations.DefinableGeometry.Space SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV M}
  {A B : SpecialTransformations.DefinableGeometry.DefSet P S}, A.carrier = B.carrier → A = B
theorem DiamondIntegral.Section6.defSet_eq_of_carrier_eq : ∀ {M : Type}
  [inst : SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M] [M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF]
  {S : Set M} {P : SpecialTransformations.DefinableGeometry.Space SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV M}
  {A B : SpecialTransformations.DefinableGeometry.DefSet P S}, A.carrier = B.carrier → A = B :=
fun {M} [SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M] [M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {S} {P}
    {A B} h =>
  SpecialTransformations.DefinableGeometry.DefSet.casesOn (motive := fun t => A = t → A = B) A
    (fun carrier definable h_1 =>
      Eq.ndrec (motive := fun {A} => A.carrier = B.carrier → A = B)
        (fun h =>
          SpecialTransformations.DefinableGeometry.DefSet.casesOn (motive := fun t =>
            B = t → { carrier := carrier, definable := definable } = B) B
            (fun carrier_1 definable_1 h_2 =>
              Eq.ndrec (motive := fun {B} =>
                { carrier := carrier, definable := definable }.carrier = B.carrier →
                  { carrier := carrier, definable := definable } = B)
                (fun h =>
                  Eq.casesOn (motive := fun a t =>
                    { carrier := carrier_1, definable := definable_1 }.carrier = a →
                      h ≍ t →
                        { carrier := carrier, definable := definable } =
                          { carrier := carrier_1, definable := definable_1 })
                    h
                    (fun h_3 =>
                      Eq.ndrec (motive := fun carrier_2 =>
                        ∀ (definable_2 : P.Definable S carrier_2)
                          (h :
                            { carrier := carrier, definable := definable }.carrier =
                              { carrier := carrier_2, definable := definable_2 }.carrier),
                          h ≍ Eq.refl { carrier := carrier, definable := definable }.carrier →
                            { carrier := carrier, definable := definable } =
                              { carrier := carrier_2, definable := definable_2 })
                        (fun definable_2 h h_4 => Eq.refl { carrier := carrier, definable := definable }) (Eq.symm h_3)
                        definable_1 h)
                    (Eq.refl { carrier := carrier_1, definable := definable_1 }.carrier) (HEq.refl h))
                (Eq.symm h_2) h)
            (Eq.refl B))
        (Eq.symm h_1) h)
    (Eq.refl A)

                      ∃ δ,

        And.casesOn h fun hEA right =>

              Exists.casesOn hp fun q h =>

                (Eq.symm haV)))

                  (fun _a =>
                    DiamondIntegral.Section2.tupleRV M (↑(g.toFun a)).1 = DiamondIntegral.Section2.tupleRV M _a.1)

                    (fun _a =>

                (Eq.mpr
                  (id

                      (fun _a => DiamondIntegral.Section2.tupleRV M (↑a).1 = DiamondIntegral.Section2.tupleRV M _a)
                      (hOutside b hbu)))
                  (X.outside_tagged (↑a) a.property (↑b) b.property hOld hau))));

      { ambient := A, pieces := fun i => (g.restrict (X.pieces_subset i)).image, tags := V,
        proper :=

  [inst : SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M]
  [inst_1 : M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {S : Set M} {n r s : ℕ}
  {A P C : SpecialTransformations.DefinableGeometry.DefSet (SpecialTransformations.Section4.rawMixedSpace n r) S}
  {B : SpecialTransformations.DefinableGeometry.DefSet (SpecialTransformations.Section4.rawMixedSpace n s) S}
  (f : SpecialTransformations.DefinableGeometry.Map A B)
  (U : SpecialTransformations.DefinableGeometry.DefSet (SpecialTransformations.Section4.rawRVSpace r) S)
  (σ : Fin r → Fin s),
  (∀ (x : ↑A.carrier), (↑(f.toFun x)).2 ∘ σ = (↑x).2) →
    ∀ (hPA : P.carrier ⊆ A.carrier) (hCA : C.carrier ⊆ A.carrier),
      C.carrier = (DiamondIntegral.Section6.focusActive P U).carrier →
        (f.restrict hCA).image =
          DiamondIntegral.Section6.focusActive (f.restrict hPA).image (DiamondIntegral.Section6.selectedRVTagSet U σ) :=
fun {M} [SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M] [M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {S}
    {n r s} {A P C} {B} f U σ hRV hPA hCA hC =>
  DiamondIntegral.Section6.defSet_eq_of_carrier_eq
    (Set.ext fun y =>
      {
        mp := fun a =>
          Exists.casesOn a fun x hx =>
            have hSlice := hC ▸ x.property;
            have hxP := hSlice.left;
            have hxU := hSlice.right;
            ⟨Exists.intro ⟨↑x, hxP⟩ hx,
              id
                (Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => _a.2 ∘ σ ∈ U.carrier) (Eq.symm hx)))
                  (Eq.symm (hRV ⟨↑x, hCA x.property⟩) ▸ hxU))⟩,
        mpr := fun a =>
          And.casesOn a fun left hy =>
            Exists.casesOn left fun x hx =>
              have hxU :=
                id
                  (fun hy =>
                    hRV ⟨↑x, hPA x.property⟩ ▸ Eq.mp (congrArg (fun _a => _a.2 ∘ σ ∈ U.carrier) (Eq.symm hx)) hy)
                  hy;
              have hxC := Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => ↑x ∈ _a) hC)) ⟨x.property, hxU⟩;
              Exists.intro ⟨↑x, hxC⟩ hx })

    {n r} {ι} [Finite ι] R a A hSource =>
  let P := SpecialTransformations.Section4.rawMixedSpace n r;
  have hAt := fun p =>
    have h :=
      SpecialTransformations.DefinableGeometry.Space.preimage_decode P A.carrier
        ⟨SpecialTransformations.Section4.mixedValues p, SpecialTransformations.Section4.mixedValues_mem_domain p⟩;
    Iff.trans (Set.ext_iff.mp hSource (SpecialTransformations.Section4.mixedValues p))
      (Eq.mp
        (congrArg
          (fun _a =>
            ↑⟨SpecialTransformations.Section4.mixedValues p, SpecialTransformations.Section4.mixedValues_mem_domain p⟩ ∈
                P.preimage A.carrier ↔
              _a ∈ A.carrier)
          (SpecialTransformations.Section4.decode_mixedValues p))
        h);
  {
    mp := fun h p hp q hq hu =>
      have hCode :=
        h (SpecialTransformations.Section4.mixedValues p) (SpecialTransformations.Section4.mixedValues q)
          ((hAt p).mpr hp) ((hAt q).mpr hq) fun j => congrArg (fun u => ↑(u j)) hu;
      funext fun i => Subtype.ext (hCode i),
    mpr := fun h x y hx hy hTags =>
      Exists.casesOn (motive := fun x_1 =>
        ∀ (i : Fin n),
          SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.iRv (Sum.elim a (Sum.elim x y) (Sum.inr (Sum.inl (Sum.inl i)))) =
            SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.iRv (Sum.elim a (Sum.elim x y) (Sum.inr (Sum.inr (Sum.inl i)))))
        ((Set.ext_iff.mp hSource x).mp hx) fun hxDom hxA =>

          let q := P.decode ⟨y, hyDom⟩;

          have hQ := SpecialTransformations.Section4.mixedValues_decode ⟨y, hyDom⟩;
          have hRV :=
            funext fun j =>

              (fun hVF =>
                Eq.mpr

  [inst_1 : M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {S : Set M} {n r : ℕ}

    SpecialTransformations.DefinableGeometry.Map B
      (SpecialTransformations.DefinableGeometry.DefSet.univ (SpecialTransformations.Section4.rawVFSpace (n + 1)) S)),

    (∀ (p : ↑B.carrier), DiamondIntegral.Section6.rvTranslationVector δ p (Fin.last n) = 0) →
      DiamondIntegral.Section2.IsRVPullback B.carrier →
        ∀ (k : Fin r),

fun {M} [SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M] [M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {S}
    {n r} {B} δ hδ hZero hB k hLeading =>
  DiamondIntegral.Section6.coordinate_bundle_of_replacement (DiamondIntegral.Section6.rvLabelTranslationMap δ).image k
    (fun p a =>
      Exists.casesOn a fun b hb =>
        have hEq := hb;
        Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => DiamondIntegral.Section2.rv M (_a.1 (Fin.last n)) = _a.2 k) (Eq.symm hEq)))
          (Eq.mpr
            (id
              (congrArg
                (fun _a =>
                  DiamondIntegral.Section2.rv M _a = (↑((DiamondIntegral.Section6.rvLabelTranslation δ).toFun b)).2 k)
                (DiamondIntegral.Section6.rvLabelTranslation_last_fixed δ hZero b)))
            (hLeading (↑b) b.property)))
    fun p a =>
    Exists.casesOn (motive := fun x =>
      ∀ (d : DiamondIntegral.Section2.VF M),
        DiamondIntegral.Section2.rv M d = DiamondIntegral.Section2.rv M (p.1 (Fin.last n)) →
          (Function.update p.1 (Fin.last n) d, p.2) ∈ (DiamondIntegral.Section6.rvLabelTranslationMap δ).image.carrier)
      a fun b hb d hd =>
      have hEq := hb;
      have hRV :=
        Eq.mp
          (congrArg (fun _a => DiamondIntegral.Section2.rv M d = DiamondIntegral.Section2.rv M _a)
            (DiamondIntegral.Section6.rvLabelTranslation_last_fixed δ hZero b))
          (Eq.mp
            (congrArg (fun _a => DiamondIntegral.Section2.rv M d = DiamondIntegral.Section2.rv M (_a.1 (Fin.last n)))
              (Eq.symm hEq))
            hd);
      let b' :=
        ⟨(Function.update (↑b).1 (Fin.last n) d, (↑b).2),
          DiamondIntegral.Section6.rvPullback_mem_of_sameRV hB b.property
            (funext fun i =>
              if hi : i = Fin.last n then
                Eq.symm hi ▸
                  id
                    (Eq.mpr
                      (id
                        (congrArg
                          (fun _a =>
                            DiamondIntegral.Section2.rv M ((↑b).1 (Fin.last n)) = DiamondIntegral.Section2.rv M _a)
                          (Function.update_self (Fin.last n) d (↑b).1)))
                      (Eq.symm hRV))
              else
                id
                  (Eq.mpr
                    (id
                      (congrArg (fun _a => DiamondIntegral.Section2.rv M ((↑b).1 i) = DiamondIntegral.Section2.rv M _a)
                        (Function.update_of_ne hi d (↑b).1)))
                    (Eq.refl (DiamondIntegral.Section2.rv M ((↑b).1 i)))))
            rfl⟩;
      have hShift := congrArg Subtype.val (hδ b' b rfl);
      Exists.intro b'
        (id
          (Eq.mpr
            (id
              (congrArg
                (fun _a =>
                  (DiamondIntegral.Section6.rvTranslationHead b' + _a, (↑b').2) =
                    (Function.update p.1 (Fin.last n) d, p.2))
                hShift))
            (Prod.ext
              (funext fun i =>
                if hi : i = Fin.last n then
                  Eq.symm hi ▸
                    of_eq_true
                      (Eq.trans
                        (congr
                          (congrArg Eq
                            (Eq.trans
                              (congr (congrArg HAdd.hAdd (Function.update_self (Fin.last n) d (↑b).1))
                                ((fun p => hZero p) b))
                              (add_zero d)))
                          (Function.update_self (Fin.last n) d p.1))
                        (eq_self d))
                else
                  have h := congrArg (fun w => w.1 i) hEq;
                  id
                    (fun h =>
                      Eq.mpr
                        (id
                          (congr
                            (congrArg Eq
                              (congrFun'
                                (congrArg HAdd.hAdd
                                  ((fun x_0 v f => (fun x_0 => Function.update_of_ne hi) x_0 v f)
                                    (fun a => SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Transfer.VFType) d (↑b).1))
                                (DiamondIntegral.Section6.rvTranslationVector δ b i)))
                            ((fun x_0 v f => (fun x_0 => Function.update_of_ne hi) x_0 v f)
                              (fun a => SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Transfer.VFType) d p.1)))
                        h)
                    h)
              (have hTags := congrArg (fun w => w.2) hEq;
              hTags))))

  [inst : SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M]
  [inst_1 : M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {S : Set M} {n s : ℕ}

    SpecialTransformations.DefinableGeometry.Map B
      (SpecialTransformations.DefinableGeometry.DefSet.univ DiamondIntegral.Section6.rawGammaPresentation S)),

          DiamondIntegral.Section6.gammaMapValue ω ⟨(p.1 ∘ Fin.natAdd n, p.2), h2⟩} :=
fun {M} [inst : SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M] [M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF]
    {S} {n s} B ω =>

  let U := SpecialTransformations.DefinableGeometry.DefSet.univ P S;
  have hL :=
    SpecialTransformations.DefinableGeometry.Map.definable_preimage
      (DiamondIntegral.Section6.TransportedForms.vfSelectMap (Fin.castAdd n) U) B.definable;
  have hR :=
    SpecialTransformations.DefinableGeometry.Map.definable_preimage
      (DiamondIntegral.Section6.TransportedForms.vfSelectMap (Fin.natAdd n) U) B.definable;
  have hL' :=
    Eq.mpr
      (eq_of_heq
        ((fun L M inst P S A A' e'_6 =>
            Eq.casesOn (motive := fun a x => A' = a → e'_6 ≍ x → P.Definable S A ≍ P.Definable S A') e'_6

              (Eq.refl A') (HEq.refl e'_6))
          SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV M inst P S {p | (p.1 ∘ Fin.castAdd n, p.2) ∈ B.carrier}
          {x |
            ∃ a,
              ↑a = x ∧ ↑((DiamondIntegral.Section6.TransportedForms.vfSelectMap (Fin.castAdd n) U).toFun a) ∈ B.carrier}
          (Set.ext fun p =>
            { mp := fun h => Exists.intro ⟨p, Set.mem_univ p⟩ ⟨rfl, h⟩,
              mpr := fun x =>
                match x with
                | Exists.intro a ⟨ha, h⟩ => ha ▸ h })))
      hL;
  have hR' :=
    Eq.mpr
      (eq_of_heq
        ((fun L M inst P S A A' e'_6 =>

theorem DiamondIntegral.Section6.FinitaryRVRelation.codes_iff : ∀ {M : Type}
  [inst : SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M]
  [inst_1 : M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {S : Set M} {N m : ℕ}
  (R : DiamondIntegral.Section6.FinitaryRVRelation S N m) (z : Fin N ⊕ Fin m → M)
  (t : Fin N → DiamondIntegral.Section2.RVInfinity M) (v : Fin m → DiamondIntegral.Section2.RVInfinity M),
  SpecialTransformations.Section4.rvValues t = z ∘ Sum.inl →
    SpecialTransformations.Section4.rvValues v = z ∘ Sum.inr →
      ((∃ t' v',
          R.rel t' v' ∧
            SpecialTransformations.Section4.rvValues t' = z ∘ Sum.inl ∧
              SpecialTransformations.Section4.rvValues v' = z ∘ Sum.inr) ↔
        R.rel t v) :=
fun {M} [SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M] [M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {S}
    {N m} R z t v ht hv =>
  {
    mp := fun a =>
      Exists.casesOn a fun t' h =>
        Exists.casesOn h fun v' h =>
          And.casesOn h fun h right =>
            And.casesOn right fun ht' hv' =>
              have h1 := SpecialTransformations.Section4.rvValues_injective (Eq.trans ht' (Eq.symm ht));
              have h2 := SpecialTransformations.Section4.rvValues_injective (Eq.trans hv' (Eq.symm hv));
              Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => R.rel _a v) (Eq.symm h1)))
                (Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => R.rel t' _a) (Eq.symm h2))) h),
    mpr := fun h => Exists.intro t (Exists.intro v ⟨h, ⟨ht, hv⟩⟩) }

theorem DiamondIntegral.Section6.glue_lift : ∀ {M : Type} [inst : SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M]

  (L₂ : DiamondIntegral.Section6.TupleFinitaryLift (R.restrictSource X false)),
  Nonempty (DiamondIntegral.Section6.TupleFinitaryLift R) :=
fun {M} [SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M] [M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {S}
    {N m} R X L₁ L₂ =>
  let cond := fun z =>
    (fun i => SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.iRv (z (Sum.inl i))) ∈
      (SpecialTransformations.Section4.rawRVSpace N).preimage X.carrier;
  have hcond :=
    have hX := X.definable;
    id
      (fun hX =>
        Set.Definable.preimage_map
          (fun i =>
            DiamondIntegral.Section6.rv_scalarCode_definable
              (Set.DefinableFun.proj SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV))
          hX)
      hX;
  have hlift := fun a v =>
    DiamondIntegral.Section6.rvValues_mem_preimage_iff X (SpecialTransformations.Section4.tupleRV a);
  let center := fun z j => if cond z then L₁.center z j else L₂.center z j;
  Nonempty.intro
    { center := center,
      definable := fun j =>
        have he :=
          funext fun z =>
            if hz : cond z then
              of_eq_true
                (Eq.trans
                  (congr
                    (congrArg Eq
                      (congrArg Subtype.val
                        (Eq.trans
                          (ite_congr (eq_true hz) (fun a => Eq.refl (L₁.center z j)) fun a => Eq.refl (L₂.center z j))
                          (ite_true (L₁.center z j) (L₂.center z j)))))
                    (Eq.trans
                      (ite_congr (eq_true hz) (fun a => Eq.refl ↑(L₁.center z j)) fun a => Eq.refl ↑(L₂.center z j))
                      (ite_true ↑(L₁.center z j) ↑(L₂.center z j))))
                  (eq_self ↑(L₁.center z j)))
            else
              of_eq_true
                (Eq.trans
                  (congr
                    (congrArg Eq
                      (congrArg Subtype.val
                        (Eq.trans
                          (ite_congr (eq_false hz) (fun a => Eq.refl (L₁.center z j)) fun a => Eq.refl (L₂.center z j))
                          (ite_false (L₁.center z j) (L₂.center z j)))))
                    (Eq.trans
                      (ite_congr (eq_false hz) (fun a => Eq.refl ↑(L₁.center z j)) fun a => Eq.refl ↑(L₂.center z j))
                      (ite_false ↑(L₁.center z j) ↑(L₂.center z j))))
                  (eq_self ↑(L₂.center z j)));
        Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => Set.DefinableFun SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV S _a) he))
          (Set.DefinableFun.ite hcond (L₁.definable j) (L₂.definable j)),
      prescribed := fun a v h j =>
        if hx : SpecialTransformations.Section4.tupleRV a ∈ X.carrier then
          have hz := (hlift a v).mpr hx;
          Eq.mpr
            (id
              (congrFun'
                (congrArg Eq
                  (DiamondIntegral.Section2.rv.congr_simp M (center (DiamondIntegral.Section6.liftCode a v) j)
                    (L₁.center (DiamondIntegral.Section6.liftCode a v) j)
                    (Eq.trans
                      (ite_congr (eq_true hz) (fun a_1 => Eq.refl (L₁.center (DiamondIntegral.Section6.liftCode a v) j))
                        fun a_1 => Eq.refl (L₂.center (DiamondIntegral.Section6.liftCode a v) j))
                      (ite_true (L₁.center (DiamondIntegral.Section6.liftCode a v) j)
                        (L₂.center (DiamondIntegral.Section6.liftCode a v) j)))))
                (v j)))
            (L₁.prescribed a v
              ⟨h,
                Eq.mpr
                  (id
                    (Eq.trans (congrArg (Iff (SpecialTransformations.Section4.tupleRV a ∈ X.carrier)) (eq_self true))
                      (iff_true (SpecialTransformations.Section4.tupleRV a ∈ X.carrier))))
                  hx⟩
              j)
        else
          have hz := fun hz => hx ((hlift a v).mp hz);
          Eq.mpr
            (id
              (congrFun'
                (congrArg Eq
                  (DiamondIntegral.Section2.rv.congr_simp M (center (DiamondIntegral.Section6.liftCode a v) j)
                    (L₂.center (DiamondIntegral.Section6.liftCode a v) j)

                      (ite_congr (eq_false hz)
                        (fun a_1 => Eq.refl (L₁.center (DiamondIntegral.Section6.liftCode a v) j)) fun a_1 =>
                        Eq.refl (L₂.center (DiamondIntegral.Section6.liftCode a v) j))
                      (ite_false (L₁.center (DiamondIntegral.Section6.liftCode a v) j)
                        (L₂.center (DiamondIntegral.Section6.liftCode a v) j)))))
                (v j)))
            (L₂.prescribed a v
              ⟨h,
                Eq.mpr
                  (id
                    (Eq.trans
                      (congrArg (Iff (SpecialTransformations.Section4.tupleRV a ∈ X.carrier)) Bool.false_eq_true)
                      (iff_false (SpecialTransformations.Section4.tupleRV a ∈ X.carrier))))
                  hx⟩
              j),
      differentiable := fun a v h =>
        have ha0 := fun i hi =>
          R.source (SpecialTransformations.Section4.tupleRV a) v h i
            (Eq.mpr
              (id
                (congrArg (fun _a => _a = DiamondIntegral.Section2.rvZero M)

                  this)))

        Exists.casesOn (DiamondIntegral.Section6.nonzero_tuple_rv_ball a ha0) fun ρ hρ =>
          have hball := fun x hx =>
            Eq.mpr
              (id

              (Eq.mpr
                (id
                  (congrArg (fun _a => _a ∈ X.carrier ↔ SpecialTransformations.Section4.tupleRV a ∈ X.carrier)
                    (hρ x hx)))
                Iff.rfl);
          if hx : SpecialTransformations.Section4.tupleRV a ∈ X.carrier then
            Exists.casesOn
              (L₁.differentiable a v
                ⟨h,
                  Eq.mpr
                    (id
                      (Eq.trans (congrArg (Iff (SpecialTransformations.Section4.tupleRV a ∈ X.carrier)) (eq_self true))

  let c := ↑(b.toFun (e.hom.map.toFun u)) 0 / ↑(a.toFun u) 0;

        List.finRange 1 = a →

              ∀ (this : i ∈ Fintype.elems),

                Eq.ndrec (motive := fun as =>
                  this ≍ List.Mem.head as →
                    (SpecialTransformations.Section9.vfDiagonalLinear fun x => c) x ((fun i => i) ⟨0, Nat.le_refl 1⟩) =
                      c * x 0)

  [inst : SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M]
  [inst_1 : M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {a b x : DiamondIntegral.Section2.VF M},

    DiamondIntegral.Section2.rv M x = DiamondIntegral.Section2.rv M a →
      DiamondIntegral.Section2.rv M (b / a * x) = DiamondIntegral.Section2.rv M b :=

      (fun hx =>
        Eq.mpr
          (id
            (congrArg (fun _a => _a = SpecialTransformations.Section3.RVOperations.rvHom b)

                  DiamondIntegral.Section2.rv M x = DiamondIntegral.Section2.rv M a →

  [inst_1 : M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] (a b a' b' x : DiamondIntegral.Section2.VF M),

      a' ≠ 0 →

      Eq.ndrec (motive := fun core => x ∈ DiamondIntegral.Section6.UnaryApertureImage a b ρ core → x ≠ 0)

        (fun hx he =>

          have hv := (DiamondIntegral.Section6.rv_eq_iff_value_close hb).mp hrv;

                (Eq.mp

                              (congr
                                (congrArg Prod.mk
                                  (congr
                                    (congr
                                      (congrArg Function.update (congrArg Prod.fst ((fun p => X.projection_value p) p)))
                                      F.coordinate)
                                    (congr
                                      (congrArg HAdd.hAdd
                                        (congr
                                          (congrArg HSub.hSub
                                            (congr (congrArg Prod.fst ((fun p => X.projection_value p) p))
                                              F.coordinate))
                                          (congrArg F.component.extendedFocus ((fun p => X.projection_value p) p))))
                                      (ite_congr
                                        (congrFun'
                                          (congrArg Eq (congrArg F.component.core ((fun p => X.projection_value p) p)))
                                          true)
                                        (fun a =>
                                          congrArg (HMul.hMul F.component.coefficient)
                                            (congrArg F.component.extendedFocus ((fun p => X.projection_value p) p)))
                                        fun a => Eq.refl 0))))

                                  (congrArg Fin.append
                                    (funext fun x =>
                                      DiamondIntegral.Section6.branchTag.congr_simp
                                        (F.component.core ↑(X.projection.toFun p))
                                        (F.component.core (fun x => (↑p).1 i, (↑p).2 ∘ X.labels))
                                        (congrArg F.component.core ((fun p => X.projection_value p) p))))
                                  (congrArg Prod.snd ((fun p => X.projection_value p) p)))))
                            ⟨0, Nat.le_refl 1⟩)))
                      (Eq.refl
                        ((↑p).1 i - F.component.extendedFocus (fun x => (↑p).1 i, (↑p).2 ∘ X.labels) +
                          if F.component.core (fun x => (↑p).1 i, (↑p).2 ∘ X.labels) = true then
                            F.component.coefficient * F.component.extendedFocus (fun x => (↑p).1 i, (↑p).2 ∘ X.labels)
                          else 0)))
                  (eq_of_heq tail_eq))
              (eq_of_heq head_eq) (Fintype.complete j))
        (fun b {as} a h =>
          List.cons.noConfusion h fun head_eq =>
            Eq.ndrec (motive := fun b =>
              [] ≍ as →
                Fintype.complete j ≍ List.Mem.tail b a →
                  (fun x => (H.component.point ↑p).1 i,
                          (H.component.point ↑p).2 ∘ DiamondIntegral.Section6.prefixLabelSelection X.labels).1

                  ∀ (a : List.Mem j as),

                      (fun x => (H.component.point ↑p).1 i,
                              (H.component.point ↑p).2 ∘ DiamondIntegral.Section6.prefixLabelSelection X.labels).1
                          j =
                        (F.component.point ↑(X.projection.toFun p)).1 j)

                      [] = a_1 →
                        a ≍ x →

                                  (H.component.point ↑p).2 ∘ DiamondIntegral.Section6.prefixLabelSelection X.labels).1

                  (eq_of_heq tail_eq) a)
              (eq_of_heq head_eq))

      (Eq.trans
        (congr

            (Eq.trans

                (congrArg Function.comp

    DiamondIntegral.Section2.IsRVPullback A.carrier →

                      (↑(f.toFun a)).2 = (↑(f.toFun p)).2 ∧ D.core ↑(f.toFun a) = true ↔
                        ↑a ∈ DiamondIntegral.Section6.unaryTaggedDisc (↑p) γ :=
fun {M} [SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M] [M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {S}
    {r s} {A} {B} {f} {p} {γ} C hA hp hγ hf D hu hFocus hEndpoint a =>
  Eq.mpr
    (id
      (congrArg (fun _a => (↑(f.toFun a)).2 = (↑(f.toFun p)).2 ∧ D.core ↑(f.toFun a) = true ↔ _a)
        (Eq.symm (propext (DiamondIntegral.Section6.UnaryCoreChart.preimage_disc_exact C hA hp hγ hf a)))))
    {
      mp := fun a_1 =>
        And.casesOn a_1 fun hTags hCore =>
          have huA := Eq.symm hTags ▸ hu;
          have h :=
            of_decide_eq_true
              (Eq.mp
                (congrArg (fun _a => _a = true)
                  (DiamondIntegral.Section6.UnaryRelativeApertureData.core_active D
                    ⟨↑(f.toFun a), ⟨(f.toFun a).property, huA⟩⟩))
                hCore);
          ⟨hTags,
            Eq.mp
              (congrArg (fun _a => _a < DiamondIntegral.Section2.vfValue ((↑(f.toFun a)).1 0 - (↑(f.toFun p)).1 0))
                hEndpoint)
              (Eq.mp
                (congrArg
                  (fun _a =>
                    DiamondIntegral.Section2.vfValue (D.endpoint (↑(f.toFun p)).2) <
                      DiamondIntegral.Section2.vfValue ((↑(f.toFun a)).1 0 - _a))
                  hFocus)
                (Eq.mp
                  (congrArg
                    (fun _a =>
                      DiamondIntegral.Section2.vfValue (D.endpoint _a) <
                        DiamondIntegral.Section2.vfValue ((↑(f.toFun a)).1 0 - D.focusData.focus _a))
                    hTags)
                  h))⟩,
      mpr := fun a_1 =>
        And.casesOn a_1 fun hTags hClose =>
          ⟨hTags,
            have huA := Eq.symm hTags ▸ hu;
            Eq.mpr
              (id
                (congrArg (fun _a => _a = true)
                  (DiamondIntegral.Section6.UnaryRelativeApertureData.core_active D
                    ⟨↑(f.toFun a), ⟨(f.toFun a).property, huA⟩⟩)))
              (decide_eq_true
                (id
                  (Eq.mpr
                    (id
                      (congrArg
                        (fun _a =>
                          DiamondIntegral.Section2.vfValue (D.endpoint _a) <
                            DiamondIntegral.Section2.vfValue ((↑(f.toFun a)).1 0 - D.focusData.focus _a))
                        hTags))
                    (Eq.mpr
                      (id
                        (congrArg
                          (fun _a =>
                            DiamondIntegral.Section2.vfValue (D.endpoint (↑(f.toFun p)).2) <

      p ∈ A.carrier →

  have hi := Subsingleton.elim i 0;

              (∀ (x y : DiamondIntegral.Section2.VF M),
                  SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.VFValued.predV x y ↔ Valued.v x ≤ Valued.v y) →
                ∀ (V : Set M),

                    DiamondIntegral.Section2.NontrivialDefinableGamma { real := S, gamma := ∅ } →
                      (∀ a ∈ V, SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.iVF a) →
                        V ⊆ S →
                          S ⊆ SpecialTransformations.Section3.algebraicClosureSet V →
                            (∃ x, x ≠ 0 ∧ Valued.v ↑x ≠ 1) →
                              ∀

                                  SpecialTransformations.DefinableGeometry.DefSet

                                            p.2 = q.2 →

                                                DiamondIntegral.Section2.tupleRV M q.1) →
                                        ∀

                                              ∀ (j : Fin r)

                                                (P :
                                                  Fin k →
                                                    SpecialTransformations.DefinableGeometry.DefSet

fun {M} [SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M] [M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {S}
    {r s} {A} {B} hc {κ} hκ hs hsmall f hf =>
  let E := {q | q.1 0 = 0};
  have hE :=
    Set.Finite.subset (Set.finite_singleton 0) fun ⦃x⦄ a =>
      Exists.casesOn a fun q h =>
        And.casesOn h fun hq right =>
          right ▸
            Set.mem_singleton_iff.mpr
              (funext fun i =>
                List.Mem.casesOn (motive := fun a x => List.finRange 1 = a → Fintype.complete i ≍ x → q.1 i = 0 i)
                  (Fintype.complete i)
                  (fun as h =>
                    List.cons.noConfusion h fun head_eq =>
                      Eq.ndrec (motive := fun i =>
                        ∀ (this : i ∈ Fintype.elems), [] ≍ as → this ≍ List.Mem.head as → q.1 i = 0 i)
                        (fun this tail_eq =>
                          Eq.ndrec (motive := fun as =>
                            this ≍ List.Mem.head as →
                              q.1 ((fun i => i) ⟨0, Nat.le_refl 1⟩) = 0 ((fun i => i) ⟨0, Nat.le_refl 1⟩))
                            (fun h => hq) (eq_of_heq tail_eq))
                        (eq_of_heq head_eq) (Fintype.complete i))
                  (fun b {as} a h =>
                    List.cons.noConfusion h fun head_eq =>
                      Eq.ndrec (motive := fun b => [] ≍ as → Fintype.complete i ≍ List.Mem.tail b a → q.1 i = 0 i)
                        (fun tail_eq =>
                          Eq.ndrec (motive := fun {as} =>
                            ∀ (a : List.Mem i as),
                              Fintype.complete i ≍ List.Mem.tail ((fun i => i) ⟨0, Nat.le_refl 1⟩) a → q.1 i = 0 i)
                            (fun a h =>
                              List.Mem.casesOn (motive := fun a_1 x => [] = a_1 → a ≍ x → q.1 i = 0 i) a
                                (fun as h => False.elim (noConfusion_of_Nat List.ctorIdx h))
                                (fun b {as} a_1 h => False.elim (noConfusion_of_Nat List.ctorIdx h)) (Eq.refl [])
                                (HEq.refl a))
                            (eq_of_heq tail_eq) a)
                        (eq_of_heq head_eq))
                  (Eq.refl (List.finRange 1)) (HEq.refl (Fintype.complete i)));
  Set.Finite.subset (DiamondIntegral.Section6.unaryFieldImage_finite hc hκ hs hsmall (f.inverse hf) E hE) fun ⦃x⦄ a =>
    Exists.casesOn a fun p h =>
      And.casesOn h fun left right =>
        Exists.casesOn left fun a h =>
          And.casesOn h fun left ha =>
            Eq.ndrec (motive := fun p => p.1 = x → x ∈ DiamondIntegral.Section6.unaryFieldImage (f.inverse hf) E)
              (fun right =>
                right ▸
                  Exists.intro (f.toFun a)

                      Eq.mpr
                        (id
                          (congrArg (fun _a => (↑_a).1 = (↑a).1)
                            (SpecialTransformations.DefinableGeometry.Map.inverse_apply f hf a)))
                        (Eq.refl (↑a).1)⟩)
              left right

  [inst : SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M]

            (↑(Y.map.toFun (f.toFun a))).2 = (↑(Y.map.toFun (f.toFun b))).2 ↔

fun {M} [SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M] [M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {S R Q}
    {r₀ s₀ r s} {A₀} {B₀} {G} [LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero G] [Valued (DiamondIntegral.Section2.VF M) G] {hc} {K} {L}
    {A} {B} {hA} {hB} Z Y f C hC hPaired h00 hOrdinary a b =>
  {
    mp := fun hTags =>
      if ha : (↑(Y.map.toFun (f.toFun a))).2 ∈ Y.frame.liveLabels.carrier then
        have hb := hTags ▸ ha;
        have hOld :=
          (DiamondIntegral.Section6.UnaryFirstZeroState.nil_live_sameRV_iff_tags Y (f.toFun a) (f.toFun b) ha hb).mpr
            hTags;
        (DiamondIntegral.Section6.UnaryFirstZeroState.nil_live_sameRV_iff_tags Z a b
              ((DiamondIntegral.Section6.firstZero_paired_live_iff Z Y f C hC hPaired a).mp ha)
              ((DiamondIntegral.Section6.firstZero_paired_live_iff Z Y f C hC hPaired b).mp hb)).mp
          ((hOrdinary a b).mpr hOld)
      else
        have hSome :=
          Decidable.byContradiction fun hn =>
            ha ((DiamondIntegral.Section6.UnaryFirstZeroState.nil_live_complement Y (f.toFun a)).mpr hn);
        Exists.casesOn hSome fun q hqa =>
          Exists.casesOn (hC q) fun p h =>
            Eq.ndrec (motive := fun q => ↑(f.toFun a) ∈ L.disc q → (↑(Z.map.toFun a)).2 = (↑(Z.map.toFun b)).2)

                    (Eq.trans (Eq.symm hTags)
                      ((DiamondIntegral.Section6.UnaryFirstZeroState.nil_tags_iff_disc Y h00 (C p) (f.toFun a)).mpr
                        hqa));
                Eq.trans
                  ((DiamondIntegral.Section6.UnaryFirstZeroState.nil_tags_iff_disc Z h00 p a).mpr
                    ((hPaired p a).mpr hqa))
                  (Eq.symm
                    ((DiamondIntegral.Section6.UnaryFirstZeroState.nil_tags_iff_disc Z h00 p b).mpr
                      ((hPaired p b).mpr hqb))))
              h hqa,
    mpr := fun hTags =>
      if ha : (↑(Z.map.toFun a)).2 ∈ Z.frame.liveLabels.carrier then
        have hb := hTags ▸ ha;
        have hOld := (DiamondIntegral.Section6.UnaryFirstZeroState.nil_live_sameRV_iff_tags Z a b ha hb).mpr hTags;
        (DiamondIntegral.Section6.UnaryFirstZeroState.nil_live_sameRV_iff_tags Y (f.toFun a) (f.toFun b)
              ((DiamondIntegral.Section6.firstZero_paired_live_iff Z Y f C hC hPaired a).mpr ha)
              ((DiamondIntegral.Section6.firstZero_paired_live_iff Z Y f C hC hPaired b).mpr hb)).mp
          ((hOrdinary a b).mp hOld)
      else
        have hSome :=
          Decidable.byContradiction fun hn =>
            ha ((DiamondIntegral.Section6.UnaryFirstZeroState.nil_live_complement Z a).mpr hn);
        Exists.casesOn hSome fun p hpa =>
          have hpb :=
            (DiamondIntegral.Section6.UnaryFirstZeroState.nil_tags_iff_disc Z h00 p b).mp
              (Eq.trans (Eq.symm hTags)
                ((DiamondIntegral.Section6.UnaryFirstZeroState.nil_tags_iff_disc Z h00 p a).mpr hpa));

            ((DiamondIntegral.Section6.UnaryFirstZeroState.nil_tags_iff_disc Y h00 (C p) (f.toFun a)).mpr

  have hShift := fun z =>
    Eq.mp
      (congrArg (Iff (z ∈ SpecialTransformations.Section3.Balls.openDisc Valued.v (a + focusVal) ρ))
        (congrFun'
          (congrArg Membership.mem
            (congrFun'
              (congrArg (SpecialTransformations.Section3.Balls.openDisc Valued.v) (add_sub_cancel_right a focusVal)) ρ))
          (z - focusVal)))
      (Iff.symm (SpecialTransformations.Section3.Balls.sub_mem_openDisc_iff Valued.v (a + focusVal) focusVal z ρ));
  have hSource := fun z hz =>
    have hm :=
      DiamondIntegral.Section6.UnaryRootFamily.noncore_inverse_mem D h00 (hAmbient (z - focusVal) ((hShift z).mp hz))
        hFlag;
    id
      (Eq.mp
        (congrArg (Membership.mem A.carrier)
          (congrFun'
            (congrArg Prod.mk
              (funext fun x => sub_add_cancel z (D.unaryTagFocus (DiamondIntegral.Section6.UnaryRootFamily.oldTags u))))
            (DiamondIntegral.Section6.UnaryRootFamily.oldTags u)))
        hm);
  have hOldAvoid := fun z hz hzDisc =>
    have hq := hAmbient (z - focusVal) ((hShift z).mp hzDisc);
    Exists.casesOn (DiamondIntegral.Section6.UnaryRootFamily.noncore_input D h00 (fun x => z - focusVal, u) hq hFlag)
      fun p h =>
      And.casesOn h fun he right =>
        And.casesOn right fun hu right =>
          And.casesOn right fun hCore hScalar =>
            have hScalar' :=
              Eq.mp
                (congrArg (Eq ((↑p).1 0))
                  (sub_add_cancel z (D.unaryTagFocus (DiamondIntegral.Section6.UnaryRootFamily.oldTags u))))
                hScalar;
            have hpRoot :=
              have hpEq :=
                Prod.ext
                  (funext fun i =>
                    List.Mem.casesOn (motive := fun a x =>
                      List.finRange 1 = a → Fintype.complete i ≍ x → (↑p).1 i = (fun x => z, v).1 i)
                      (Fintype.complete i)
                      (fun as h =>
                        List.cons.noConfusion h fun head_eq =>
                          Eq.ndrec (motive := fun i =>
                            ∀ (this : i ∈ Fintype.elems),
                              [] ≍ as → this ≍ List.Mem.head as → (↑p).1 i = (fun x => z, v).1 i)

                              Eq.ndrec (motive := fun as =>
                                this ≍ List.Mem.head as →

                                    (fun x => z, v).1 ((fun i => i) ⟨0, Nat.le_refl 1⟩))

                      (fun b {as} a h =>
                        List.cons.noConfusion h fun head_eq =>
                          Eq.ndrec (motive := fun b =>
                            [] ≍ as → Fintype.complete i ≍ List.Mem.tail b a → (↑p).1 i = (fun x => z, v).1 i)

                                ∀ (a : List.Mem i as),
                                  Fintype.complete i ≍ List.Mem.tail ((fun i => i) ⟨0, Nat.le_refl 1⟩) a →
                                    (↑p).1 i = (fun x => z, v).1 i)
                                (fun a h =>
                                  List.Mem.casesOn (motive := fun a_1 x =>
                                    [] = a_1 → a ≍ x → (↑p).1 i = (fun x => z, v).1 i) a
                                    (fun as h => False.elim (noConfusion_of_Nat List.ctorIdx h))
                                    (fun b {as} a_1 h => False.elim (noConfusion_of_Nat List.ctorIdx h)) (Eq.refl [])
                                    (HEq.refl a))

                      (Eq.refl (List.finRange 1)) (HEq.refl (Fintype.complete i)))
                  hu;
              Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => _a ∈ R.roots.carrier) hpEq))
                ((DiamondIntegral.Section6.UnaryRootFamily.mem_fibre R v z).mp hz);

              (DiamondIntegral.Section6.UnaryRootFamily.mem_fibre (R.stepFamily D h00 hcoord hact hfocus) u
                    (z - focusVal)).mpr
                ((DiamondIntegral.Section6.UnaryRootFamily.remainingRoots_iff R D h00 (fun x => z - focusVal, u)).mpr
                  (Exists.intro p ⟨hpRoot, ⟨hCore, he⟩⟩));
            hAvoid (z - focusVal) hChild ((hShift z).mp hzDisc);

    (hShift (x + focusVal)).mpr
      (Eq.mpr
        (id
          (congrArg (Membership.mem (SpecialTransformations.Section3.Balls.openDisc Valued.v a ρ))
            (add_sub_cancel_right x focusVal)))
        hx);

        (DiamondIntegral.Section6.UnaryRootFamily.noncore_transported_form_value D h00 ω

  if hpB : DiamondIntegral.Section6.unaryFamilyBasePoint p ∈ B.carrier then
    let b := ⟨DiamondIntegral.Section6.unaryFamilyBasePoint p, hpB⟩;
    have hBase :=
      Eq.mpr
        (id
          (congrArg (fun _a => _a = ↑((D.unaryBaseFreeze hB).toFun b))
            (DiamondIntegral.Section6.FMT.FocusFreezingData.unaryFamilyBasePoint_freeze D p)))

          (DiamondIntegral.Section6.FMT.mixedFamilyFreeze D.balls D.centers 0

        id
          (Function.update_of_ne (Fin.succ_ne_zero i)

    have hfB := fun h =>

        Eq.mpr
          (id

              (DiamondIntegral.Section6.unaryFamilyBasePoint p)).mp
          hFrozen);

        Exists.casesOn ((DiamondIntegral.Section6.mem_unaryIndexedMixedFamily (D.unaryParameter hB η) T p).mp h)

    [LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero G] [Valued (DiamondIntegral.Section2.VF M) G] {r k} {S} {A} X h00 hc linear {κ} hκ

  have hH := fun i => Fin.cases X.sourceProper hC i;
  Exists.casesOn
    (DiamondIntegral.Section6.finite_properInvariant_uniform_named_radius h00 hc linear hκ hs hv hsmall hΓ H hH)
    fun β h =>
    And.casesOn h fun hβ right =>
      And.casesOn right fun hβ1 hInv =>
        Exists.casesOn
          (DiamondIntegral.Section6.gamma_form_all_levels_uniform_invariant h00 hc linear hκ hs hv hsmall hΓ

            (DiamondIntegral.Section6.gammaFormExtension_graph_definable ω) hLevels)
          fun α h =>
          And.casesOn h fun hα right =>
            And.casesOn right fun hα1 right =>
              And.casesOn right fun hInvA hInvLevels =>
                let δ := max α β;
                have hδ := DiamondIntegral.Section6.gamma_max_named α β hα hβ;
                have hAδ := fun u =>
                  DiamondIntegral.Section6.AlphaInvariant.larger_radius (hInvA u) fun x => le_max_left α β;

                  DiamondIntegral.Section6.AlphaInvariant.larger_radius (hInv i.succ u) fun x => le_max_right α β;

  Exists.casesOn
    (DiamondIntegral.Section6.exists_unary_gamma_obstacles hc hv A (DiamondIntegral.Section6.gammaFormExtension ω)
      (DiamondIntegral.Section6.gammaFormExtension_graph_definable ω))
    fun Q h =>
    And.casesOn h fun hQ hQControl =>
      Exists.casesOn (DiamondIntegral.Section6.exists_finite_unary_obstacles hc hv C) fun P h =>
        And.casesOn h fun hP hPControl =>
          let U := Q ∪ P;
          have hU :=
            id
              (Eq.mpr
                (id
                  (congrArg (fun _a => S.Definable₁ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV (Subtype.val '' _a))
                    (Finset.coe_union Q P)))
                (Eq.mpr
                  (id
                    (congrArg (fun _a => S.Definable₁ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV _a)
                      (Set.image_union Subtype.val ↑Q ↑P)))
                  (Set.Definable.union hQ hP)));
          have hUC := fun i a ρ hAvoid x hx y hy u =>
            hPControl i a ρ (fun z hz => hAvoid z (Finset.mem_union_right Q hz)) x hx y hy u;
          have hUG := fun γ a ρ hAvoid x hx y hy u =>
            hQControl γ a ρ (fun z hz => hAvoid z (Finset.mem_union_left P hz)) x hx y hy u;
          let R := DiamondIntegral.Section6.UnaryRootFamily.fromObstacles A U hU;

              ⟨fun u =>
                Finset.card_le_card fun ⦃x⦄ hx =>
                  ((DiamondIntegral.Section6.UnaryRootFamily.mem_fibre R u x).mp hx).right,
                ⟨fun i => DiamondIntegral.Section6.UnaryRootFamily.fromObstacles_control U hU (C i).carrier (hUC i),
                  DiamondIntegral.Section6.unaryFormRootControl_of_levels R
                    (DiamondIntegral.Section6.gammaFormExtension ω) fun γ =>
                    DiamondIntegral.Section6.UnaryRootFamily.fromObstacles_control U hU
                      {p | p ∈ A.carrier ∧ DiamondIntegral.Section6.gammaFormExtension ω p = γ} (hUG γ)⟩⟩)

@DiamondIntegral.Section6.OriginalBaseOrdinaryUnaryMatching.sameRV_iff : ∀ {M : Type}

    SpecialTransformations.Section5.SameRV ↑(F.targetMap.toFun (f.toFun a)) ↑(F.targetMap.toFun (f.toFun b))
theorem DiamondIntegral.Section6.OriginalBaseOrdinaryUnaryMatching.sameRV_iff : ∀ {M : Type}
  [inst : SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M]
  [inst_1 : M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {S : Set M} {r s : ℕ}
  {A : SpecialTransformations.DefinableGeometry.DefSet (SpecialTransformations.Section4.rawMixedSpace 1 r) S}
  {B : SpecialTransformations.DefinableGeometry.DefSet (SpecialTransformations.Section4.rawMixedSpace 1 s) S}
  {f : SpecialTransformations.DefinableGeometry.Map A B}
  (F : DiamondIntegral.Section6.OriginalBaseOrdinaryUnaryMatching A B f) (a b : ↑A.carrier),
  SpecialTransformations.Section5.SameRV ↑(F.sourceMap.toFun a) ↑(F.sourceMap.toFun b) ↔
    SpecialTransformations.Section5.SameRV ↑(F.targetMap.toFun (f.toFun a)) ↑(F.targetMap.toFun (f.toFun b)) :=
fun {M} [SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M] [M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {S}
    {r s} {A} {B} {f} F a b =>
  Eq.mpr
    (id
      (congrArg
        (fun _a =>
          _a ↔ SpecialTransformations.Section5.SameRV ↑(F.targetMap.toFun (f.toFun a)) ↑(F.targetMap.toFun (f.toFun b)))
        (propext
          (DiamondIntegral.Section6.ordinary_sameRV_iff_rvCoordinates ↑(F.sourceMap.toFun a) ↑(F.sourceMap.toFun b)))))
    (Eq.mpr
      (id
        (congrArg
          (fun _a =>
            DiamondIntegral.Section2.rvCoordinates M ↑(F.sourceMap.toFun a) =
                DiamondIntegral.Section2.rvCoordinates M ↑(F.sourceMap.toFun b) ↔
              _a)
          (propext
            (DiamondIntegral.Section6.ordinary_sameRV_iff_rvCoordinates ↑(F.targetMap.toFun (f.toFun a))
              ↑(F.targetMap.toFun (f.toFun b))))))
      {
        mp := fun h =>
          have h' := F.forward (F.sourceMap.toFun a) (F.sourceMap.toFun b) h;
          Eq.mp
            (congrArg
              (fun _a =>
                DiamondIntegral.Section2.rvCoordinates M ↑(F.targetMap.toFun (f.toFun a)) =
                  DiamondIntegral.Section2.rvCoordinates M ↑_a)
              (F.commutes b))
            (Eq.mp
              (congrArg
                (fun _a =>
                  DiamondIntegral.Section2.rvCoordinates M ↑_a =
                    DiamondIntegral.Section2.rvCoordinates M ↑(F.map.toFun (F.sourceMap.toFun b)))
                (F.commutes a))
              h'),
        mpr := fun h =>
          have h' := F.reverse (F.targetMap.toFun (f.toFun a)) (F.targetMap.toFun (f.toFun b)) h;
          have ha :=
            Eq.mpr
              (id
                (congrArg (fun _a => (F.map.inverse F.bijective).toFun _a = F.sourceMap.toFun a)
                  (Eq.symm (F.commutes a))))
              (Eq.mpr
                (id
                  (congrArg (fun _a => _a = F.sourceMap.toFun a)
                    (SpecialTransformations.DefinableGeometry.Map.inverse_apply F.map F.bijective
                      (F.sourceMap.toFun a))))
                (Eq.refl (F.sourceMap.toFun a)));
          have hb :=
            Eq.mpr
              (id
                (congrArg (fun _a => (F.map.inverse F.bijective).toFun _a = F.sourceMap.toFun b)
                  (Eq.symm (F.commutes b))))
              (Eq.mpr
                (id
                  (congrArg (fun _a => _a = F.sourceMap.toFun b)
                    (SpecialTransformations.DefinableGeometry.Map.inverse_apply F.map F.bijective
                      (F.sourceMap.toFun b))))
                (Eq.refl (F.sourceMap.toFun b)));
          Eq.mp
            (congrArg
              (fun _a =>
                DiamondIntegral.Section2.rvCoordinates M ↑(F.sourceMap.toFun a) =
                  DiamondIntegral.Section2.rvCoordinates M ↑_a)
              hb)
            (Eq.mp
              (congrArg
                (fun _a =>
                  DiamondIntegral.Section2.rvCoordinates M ↑_a =
                    DiamondIntegral.Section2.rvCoordinates M
                      ↑((F.map.inverse F.bijective).toFun (F.targetMap.toFun (f.toFun b))))
                ha)
              h') })
