@DiamondIntegral.Section6.UnaryRelativeApertureData.point_injective_on : ∀ {M : Type}
  [inst : SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M]
  [inst_1 : M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {r : ℕ} {S : Set M}
  {A : SpecialTransformations.DefinableGeometry.DefSet (SpecialTransformations.Section4.rawMixedSpace 1 r) S}
  (D : DiamondIntegral.Section6.UnaryRelativeApertureData A),
  M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF00 → Set.InjOn D.point A.carrier
theorem DiamondIntegral.Section6.UnaryRelativeApertureData.point_injective_on : ∀ {M : Type}
  [inst : SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M]
  [inst_1 : M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {r : ℕ} {S : Set M}
  {A : SpecialTransformations.DefinableGeometry.DefSet (SpecialTransformations.Section4.rawMixedSpace 1 r) S}
  (D : DiamondIntegral.Section6.UnaryRelativeApertureData A),
  M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF00 → Set.InjOn D.point A.carrier :=
fun {M} [SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M] [M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {r} {S}
    {A} D h00 ⦃p⦄ hp ⦃q⦄ hq he =>
  have hOld :=
    funext fun i =>
      Eq.mp
        (congr (congrArg Eq (Fin.append_right (fun x => DiamondIntegral.Section6.branchTag (D.core p)) p.2 i))
          (Fin.append_right (fun x => DiamondIntegral.Section6.branchTag (D.core q)) q.2 i))
        (congrArg (fun z => z.2 (Fin.natAdd 1 i)) he);
  have hTag :=
    Eq.mp
      (congr (congrArg Eq (Fin.append_left (fun x => DiamondIntegral.Section6.branchTag (D.core p)) p.2 0))
        (Fin.append_left (fun x => DiamondIntegral.Section6.branchTag (D.core q)) q.2 0))
      (congrArg (fun z => z.2 (Fin.castAdd r 0)) he);
  have hCore := DiamondIntegral.Section6.branchTag_injective h00 hTag;
  have hFocus := DiamondIntegral.Section6.UnaryRelativeApertureData.extendedFocus_same_tags D hp hq hOld;
  have hEnd := DiamondIntegral.Section6.UnaryRelativeApertureData.extendedEndpoint_same_tags D hp hq hOld;
  have hJ := congrArg (fun z => z.1 D.coordinate) he;
  have hField :=
    have hsub :=
      add_right_cancel
        (Eq.mp
          (congrArg
            (fun _a =>
              (p.1 D.coordinate - D.extendedFocus q + if _a = true then D.extendedEndpoint q else 0) =
                q.1 D.coordinate - D.extendedFocus q + if D.core q = true then D.extendedEndpoint q else 0)
            hCore)
          (Eq.mp
            (congrArg
              (fun _a =>
                (p.1 D.coordinate - D.extendedFocus q + if D.core p = true then _a else 0) =
                  q.1 D.coordinate - D.extendedFocus q + if D.core q = true then D.extendedEndpoint q else 0)
              hEnd)
            (Eq.mp
              (congrArg
                (fun _a =>
                  (p.1 D.coordinate - _a + if D.core p = true then D.extendedEndpoint p else 0) =
                    q.1 D.coordinate - D.extendedFocus q + if D.core q = true then D.extendedEndpoint q else 0)
                hFocus)
              (Eq.mp
                (congr
                  (congrArg Eq
                    (Function.update_self D.coordinate
                      (p.1 D.coordinate - D.extendedFocus p + if D.core p = true then D.extendedEndpoint p else 0) p.1))
                  (Function.update_self D.coordinate
                    (q.1 D.coordinate - D.extendedFocus q + if D.core q = true then D.extendedEndpoint q else 0) q.1))
                hJ))));
    Trans.trans
      (Trans.trans (Eq.symm (sub_add_cancel (p.1 D.coordinate) (D.extendedFocus q)))
        (congrArg (fun x => x + D.extendedFocus q) hsub))
      (sub_add_cancel (q.1 D.coordinate) (D.extendedFocus q));
  Prod.ext
    (funext fun i =>
      have hi := Subsingleton.elim i D.coordinate;
      Eq.symm hi ▸ hField)
    hOld

 Quot.sound]

                    ⟨↑p, hSrc p.property⟩ α (hαBound p)
                    (DiamondIntegral.Section6.VFDoublyBounded.nonzero hAD (hEA p.property) 0);
                have hTarget := fun p =>
                  DiamondIntegral.Section6.ordinary_chain_value_lt_pointRadius_bound F.targetSpecial.special.chain
                    ⟨↑(C.toFun p), hTgt (C.toFun p).property⟩ β (hβBound (C.toFun p))
                    (DiamondIntegral.Section6.VFDoublyBounded.nonzero hBD (f.toFun ⟨↑p, hEA p.property⟩).property 0);
                let K := D.sourcePlan hE hSource;
                let L := D.targetPlan hE hTarget (Function.Bijective.injective hf.bijective);
                have hCoverA := fun a =>
                  Iff.symm
                    (DiamondIntegral.Section6.OriginalBaseOrdinarySpecial.exceptions_iff_prepared_zero F.sourceSpecial
                      hc a);
                have hBoundA := fun p =>
                  LT.lt.trans (hαBound p)
                    (have this := D.sourceFloor p;
                    this);
                have hImage := fun b =>
                  {
                    mp := fun a =>
                      Exists.casesOn a fun p hpb =>
                        have he := Subtype.ext hpb;
                        have hp :=
                          (DiamondIntegral.Section6.OriginalBaseOrdinaryUnaryMatching.exceptions_paired F hc
                                ⟨↑p, hEA p.property⟩).mp
                            p.property;
                        Eq.mp (congrArg (fun _a => ↑_a ∈ (F.targetSpecial.exceptions hc).carrier) he) hp,
                    mpr := fun hb =>
                      let a := (f.inverse hf.bijective).toFun b;
                      have ha :=
                        (DiamondIntegral.Section6.OriginalBaseOrdinaryUnaryMatching.exceptions_paired F hc a).mpr
                          (Eq.mpr
                            (id
                              (congrArg (Membership.mem (F.targetSpecial.exceptions hc).carrier)
                                (congrArg Subtype.val
                                  (SpecialTransformations.DefinableGeometry.Map.apply_inverse f hf.bijective b))))
                            hb);
                      Exists.intro ⟨↑a, ha⟩
                        (have h :=
                          congrArg (fun q => ↑q)
                            (SpecialTransformations.DefinableGeometry.Map.apply_inverse f hf.bijective b);
                        h) };
                have hCoverB := fun b =>
                  Iff.trans
                    (Iff.symm
                      (DiamondIntegral.Section6.OriginalBaseOrdinarySpecial.exceptions_iff_prepared_zero F.targetSpecial
                        hc b))
                    (Iff.symm (hImage b));
                have hBoundB := fun p =>
                  Exists.casesOn (Function.Bijective.surjective hC p) fun q h =>
                    h ▸
                      id
                        (Eq.mpr
                          (id
                            (congrArg
                              (LT.lt

                            this)));
                Exists.casesOn
                  (DiamondIntegral.Section6.exists_unary_prescribed_core_realization h00 hc hκ hs hv hsmall
                    F.sourceSpecial K hA hAD hARV hATag hCoverA hBoundA)

                    (DiamondIntegral.Section6.exists_unary_prescribed_core_realization h00 hc hκ hs hv hsmall

                      (DiamondIntegral.Section6.relativePreparedMatchingOfTerminal Z Y f hf.bijective h00 C.toFun

    hs hsmall hv hf p hp J hJ =>

  let hα := DiamondIntegral.Section6.UnaryRelativeApertureChain.bijective H.sourceChain h00;
  let inv := α.inverse hα;
  have hInvInj := fun ⦃x y⦄ he =>
    have h := congrArg α.toFun he;
    Eq.mp
      (congr (congrArg Eq (SpecialTransformations.DefinableGeometry.Map.apply_inverse α hα x))
        (SpecialTransformations.DefinableGeometry.Map.apply_inverse α hα y))
      h;
  have hInvFin := SpecialTransformations.DefinableGeometry.Map.finiteFibres_of_injective hInvInj;
  have hInvUnit :=
    DiamondIntegral.Section6.inverse_generic_unit_derivative h00 hc hκ hs hsmall hv α hα
      (fun a ha =>
        DiamondIntegral.Section6.UnaryRelativeApertureChain.unit_derivative_of_independent H.sourceChain h00 hc hκ hs
          hsmall hv a ha)
      p hp;

    (SpecialTransformations.Section9.mixedVFJacobian_comp_of_independent hc hκ hs hsmall hv inv f hInvFin p hp)
    fun J₀ h =>

    hs hsmall hv hf ω σ hGeneric =>

theorem DiamondIntegral.Section6.unary_unit_preparation_conjugate_jacobian : ∀ {M : Type}
  [inst : SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M]

  CanonicalStructure.IsCanonical →

      Cardinal.aleph0 ≤ κ →
        SpecialTransformations.Section3.Saturated M κ →

            (∀ (x y : DiamondIntegral.Section2.VF M),
                SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.VFValued.predV x y ↔ Valued.v x ≤ Valued.v y) →

                        AlgebraicIndependent (↥(SpecialTransformations.Section3.vfParameterField S)) (↑p).1 →
                          ∀ (J : DiamondIntegral.Section2.VF M),

                              SpecialTransformations.Section9.HasMixedVFJacobianAt (β.comp (f.comp (α.inverse ⋯))).toFun
                                p J :=
fun {M} [SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M] [M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {S}
    {r s a b} {G} [LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero G] [Valued (DiamondIntegral.Section2.VF M) G] {A} {B} {A'} {B'} h00 hc
    {κ} hκ hs hsmall hv α β hα hβ f hf p hp J hJ =>
  let inv := α.inverse (DiamondIntegral.Section6.UnaryRelativeApertureChain.bijective hα h00);
  have hInvInj := fun ⦃x y⦄ he =>
    have h := congrArg α.toFun he;
    Eq.mp
      (congr
        (congrArg Eq
          (SpecialTransformations.DefinableGeometry.Map.apply_inverse α
            (DiamondIntegral.Section6.UnaryRelativeApertureChain.bijective hα h00) x))
        (SpecialTransformations.DefinableGeometry.Map.apply_inverse α
          (DiamondIntegral.Section6.UnaryRelativeApertureChain.bijective hα h00) y))
      h;
  have hInvFin := SpecialTransformations.DefinableGeometry.Map.finiteFibres_of_injective hInvInj;
  have hInvUnit :=
    DiamondIntegral.Section6.inverse_generic_unit_derivative h00 hc hκ hs hsmall hv α
      (DiamondIntegral.Section6.UnaryRelativeApertureChain.bijective hα h00)
      (fun a_1 ha =>
        DiamondIntegral.Section6.UnaryRelativeApertureChain.unit_derivative_of_independent hα h00 hc hκ hs hsmall hv a_1
          ha)
      p hp;
  Exists.casesOn
    (SpecialTransformations.Section9.mixedVFJacobian_comp_of_independent hc hκ hs hsmall hv inv f hInvFin p hp)
    fun J₀ h =>
    Exists.casesOn h fun K₀ h =>
      And.casesOn h fun hJ₀ right =>
        And.casesOn right fun hK₀ hFirst =>
          have hJ₀Eq :=
            SpecialTransformations.Section9.HasMixedVFJacobianAt.unique hJ₀
              (DiamondIntegral.Section6.HasMixedUnitDerivativeAt.jacobian_one hInvUnit);
          have hK₀Eq := SpecialTransformations.Section9.HasMixedVFJacobianAt.unique hK₀ hJ;
          let g := f.comp inv;
          have hgFin :=
            SpecialTransformations.DefinableGeometry.Map.finiteFibres_of_injective
              (Function.Injective.comp (Function.Bijective.injective hf) hInvInj);
          have hFirst' :=
            Eq.mpr
              (id
                (SpecialTransformations.Section9.HasMixedVFJacobianAt.congr_simp g.toFun
                  (fun a_1 => f.toFun (inv.toFun a_1))

                    (SpecialTransformations.DefinableGeometry.Map.comp.eq_1 f inv))

                hFirst);

          have hTargetUnit :=
            DiamondIntegral.Section6.UnaryRelativeApertureChain.unit_derivative_of_independent hβ h00 hc hκ hs hsmall hv
              (g.toFun p) hgInd;
          Exists.casesOn
            (SpecialTransformations.Section9.mixedVFJacobian_comp_of_independent hc hκ hs hsmall hv g β hgFin p hp)

            Exists.casesOn h fun K₁ h =>
              And.casesOn h fun hJ₁ right =>
                And.casesOn right fun hK₁ hLast =>
                  have hJ₁Eq := SpecialTransformations.Section9.HasMixedVFJacobianAt.unique hJ₁ hFirst';
                  have hK₁Eq :=
                    SpecialTransformations.Section9.HasMixedVFJacobianAt.unique hK₁
                      (DiamondIntegral.Section6.HasMixedUnitDerivativeAt.jacobian_one hTargetUnit);
                  id
                    (Eq.mp
                      (SpecialTransformations.Section9.HasMixedVFJacobianAt.congr_simp (β.toFun ∘ g.toFun)

                          β.toFun

  [inst : SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M] [M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF]

  (A : SpecialTransformations.DefinableGeometry.DefSet (SpecialTransformations.Section4.rawMixedSpace (n + 1) r) S),

    (SpecialTransformations.Section4.rawVFSpace m) S (DiamondIntegral.Section6.uncurriedFamilyRelation F A) :=

    {S} {n r m} F A =>
  let P := SpecialTransformations.Section4.rawMixedSpace (n + 1) r;
  let Q := SpecialTransformations.Section4.rawVFSpace m;
  have hSource := Set.Definable.preimage_comp Sum.inl A.definable;
  have hTarget :=
    Set.Definable.preimage_comp Sum.inr (SpecialTransformations.DefinableGeometry.Space.definable_domain Q S);
  have hFamily := Set.Definable.preimage_comp DiamondIntegral.Section6.uncurriedFamilyGraphIndex F.definable;

    (Eq.mpr
      (eq_of_heq
        ((fun M A L inst α s s' e'_6 =>
            Eq.casesOn (motive := fun a x => s' = a → e'_6 ≍ x → A.Definable L s ≍ A.Definable L s') e'_6
              (fun h =>
                Eq.ndrec (motive := fun s' => ∀ (e_6 : s = s'), e_6 ≍ Eq.refl s → A.Definable L s ≍ A.Definable L s')
                  (fun e_6 h => HEq.refl (A.Definable L s)) (Eq.symm h) e'_6)
              (Eq.refl s') (HEq.refl e'_6))
          M S SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV inst (P.Index ⊕ Q.Index)
          (P.relation Q (DiamondIntegral.Section6.uncurriedFamilyRelation F A))
          ((fun g => g ∘ Sum.inl) ⁻¹' (SpecialTransformations.Section4.rawMixedSpace (n + 1) r).preimage A.carrier ∩
              (fun g => g ∘ Sum.inr) ⁻¹' Q.domain ∩
            (fun g => g ∘ DiamondIntegral.Section6.uncurriedFamilyGraphIndex) ⁻¹' F.graph)
          (Set.ext fun z =>
            {
              mp := fun a =>
                Exists.casesOn a fun hx h =>
                  Exists.casesOn h fun hy h =>
                    And.casesOn h fun hA hF =>
                      ⟨⟨Exists.intro hx hA, hy⟩,
                        have hX := SpecialTransformations.Section4.mixedValues_decode ⟨z ∘ Sum.inl, hx⟩;
                        have hY := SpecialTransformations.Section4.vfValues_decode ⟨z ∘ Sum.inr, hy⟩;

                                Sum.casesOn val (fun i => congrFun hX (Sum.inl i.succ)) fun i => congrFun hY i;
                        id (he ▸ hF)⟩,

                And.casesOn a fun left hF =>
                  And.casesOn left fun left hy =>
                    Exists.casesOn left fun hx hA =>
                      Exists.intro hx
                        (Exists.intro hy
                          ⟨hA,

                                    Sum.casesOn val (fun i => congrFun hX (Sum.inl i.succ)) fun i => congrFun hY i;
                            Eq.symm he ▸ hF⟩) })))

theorem DiamondIntegral.Section6.boundaryCoefficientsForData_iff : ∀ {M : Type}
  [inst : SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M]
  [inst_1 : M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {S : Set M} {r s : ℕ}
  {A : SpecialTransformations.DefinableGeometry.DefSet (SpecialTransformations.Section4.rawMixedSpace 1 r) S}
  {B : SpecialTransformations.DefinableGeometry.DefSet (SpecialTransformations.Section4.rawMixedSpace 1 s) S}
  (hc : CanonicalStructure.IsCanonical) (f : SpecialTransformations.DefinableGeometry.Map A B)
  (E : SpecialTransformations.DefinableGeometry.DefSet (SpecialTransformations.Section4.rawMixedSpace 1 r) S)
  (hEA : E.carrier ⊆ A.carrier) (hRV : DiamondIntegral.Section2.IsRVPullback A.carrier)
  (hD : DiamondIntegral.Section6.VFDoublyBounded A.carrier)
  (D : SpecialTransformations.DefinableGeometry.DefSet (DiamondIntegral.Section6.pairedBoundaryDataSpace M (r + s)) S)
  (c : ↑(DiamondIntegral.Section6.positiveBoundaryCoefficients hc).carrier),
  ↑c ∈ (DiamondIntegral.Section6.boundaryCoefficientsForData hc f E hEA hRV hD D).carrier ↔
    ∀ (p : ↑E.carrier),
      ↑((DiamondIntegral.Section6.uniformPairedBoundaryDataMap hc f E hEA hRV hD).toFun
            (DiamondIntegral.Section6.boundaryPairInput hc E p c)) ∈
        D.carrier :=
fun {M} [SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M] [M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {S}
    {r s} {A} {B} hc f E hEA hRV hD D c =>
  {
    mp := fun a =>
      And.casesOn (motive := fun x =>
        ∀ (p : ↑E.carrier),
          ↑((DiamondIntegral.Section6.uniformPairedBoundaryDataMap hc f E hEA hRV hD).toFun
                (DiamondIntegral.Section6.boundaryPairInput hc E p c)) ∈
            D.carrier)
        a fun hcPos hcGood p =>
        Decidable.byContradiction fun hn =>
          let z := DiamondIntegral.Section6.boundaryPairInput hc E p c;
          let b := ⟨↑z, Exists.intro z ⟨rfl, hn⟩⟩;
          hcGood (Exists.intro b rfl),
    mpr := fun hGood =>
      ⟨c.property, fun a =>
        Exists.casesOn a fun b hb =>
          Exists.casesOn b.property fun z h =>
            And.casesOn h fun hz hBad =>
              have hCoeff := Eq.trans (congrArg Prod.snd hz) hb;
              let p := ⟨(↑z).1, z.property.left⟩;
              have hEq := Subtype.ext (Prod.ext rfl hCoeff);
              hBad (Eq.symm hEq ▸ hGood p)⟩ }

          ((SpecialTransformations.Section3.GammaParameters.gammaPullback_mem_codeValue_iff (p '' H) (z 0) ht).mp hz)

@DiamondIntegral.Section6.determinant_eq_active_of_fixed_rows : ∀ {n : ℕ} {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K]
  (A : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) K) (i : Fin n), (∀ (j : Fin n), j ≠ i → ∀ (k : Fin n), A j k = 1 j k) → A.det = A i i
theorem DiamondIntegral.Section6.determinant_eq_active_of_fixed_rows.{u_1} : ∀ {n : ℕ} {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K]
  (A : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) K) (i : Fin n), (∀ (j : Fin n), j ≠ i → ∀ (k : Fin n), A j k = 1 j k) → A.det = A i i :=
fun {n} {K} [Field K] A i h =>
  let I := 1;
  have he :=
    Matrix.ext fun j k =>
      if hj : j = i then
        Eq.symm hj ▸ Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => A i k = _a k) Matrix.updateRow_self)) (Eq.refl (A i k))
      else Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => A j k = _a k) (Matrix.updateRow_ne hj))) (h j hj k);
  have hr :=
    funext fun j =>
      Eq.mpr
        (id
          (congrFun'
            (congrArg Eq
              (Eq.trans (congrFun (Finset.sum_congr (Eq.refl Finset.univ) fun x a => Eq.refl (A i x • 1 x)) j)
                (Finset.sum_apply j Finset.univ fun c => A i c • 1 c)))
            (A i j)))
        (Eq.mpr
          (id
            (congrArg (fun _a => _a = A i j)
              (Finset.sum_eq_single j
                (fun k a hkj =>
                  of_eq_true
                    (Eq.trans
                      (congrFun'
                        (congrArg Eq
                          (Eq.trans (congrArg (HMul.hMul (A i k)) (ite_eq_right_of_eq_false 1 0 (eq_false hkj)))
                            (mul_zero (A i k))))
                        0)
                      (eq_self 0)))
                (of_eq_true
                  (Eq.trans
                    (implies_congr (Eq.trans (congrArg Not (Finset.mem_univ._simp_1 j)) not_true_eq_false)
                      (congrFun'
                        (congrArg Eq
                          (Eq.trans (congrArg (HMul.hMul (A i j)) (ite_eq_left_of_eq_true 1 0 (eq_self j)))
                            (mul_one (A i j))))
                        0))
                    IsEmpty.forall_iff._simp_1)))))
          (of_eq_true
            (Eq.trans
              (congrFun'
                (congrArg Eq
                  (Eq.trans (congrArg (HMul.hMul (A i j)) (ite_eq_left_of_eq_true 1 0 (eq_self j))) (mul_one (A i j))))
                (A i j))
              (eq_self (A i j)))));
  Trans.trans (congrArg Matrix.det he)
    (Eq.trans (congrArg (fun r => (I.updateRow i r).det) (Eq.symm hr))
      (Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => _a = A i i) (Matrix.det_updateRow_sum I i (A i))))
        (Eq.mpr
          (id
            (congrArg (fun _a => A i i • _a.det = A i i)
              (have this := rfl;
              this)))
          (Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => A i i • _a = A i i) Matrix.det_one))
            (Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => _a = A i i) (smul_eq_mul (A i i) 1)))
              (Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => _a = A i i) (mul_one (A i i)))) (Eq.refl (A i i))))))))

  [inst : SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M]
  [inst_1 : M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {n : ℕ}
  (op : DiamondIntegral.Section6.RVCoordinateOperation) (i j : Fin n) (x : Fin n → DiamondIntegral.Section2.VF M),
  SpecialTransformations.Section4.tupleRV (DiamondIntegral.Section6.coordinateArithmetic op i j x) =
    Function.update (SpecialTransformations.Section4.tupleRV x) i
      (op.value (SpecialTransformations.Section4.tupleRV x i) (SpecialTransformations.Section4.tupleRV x j)) :=

        Eq.mpr

                (SpecialTransformations.Section4.tupleRV x))))

            op = t →

        (Eq.trans

  [inst : SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M]
  [inst_1 : M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {S : Set M} {n r s : ℕ}
  {A : SpecialTransformations.DefinableGeometry.DefSet (SpecialTransformations.Section4.rawMixedSpace n r) S}
  {B : SpecialTransformations.DefinableGeometry.DefSet (SpecialTransformations.Section4.rawMixedSpace n s) S}
  (f : SpecialTransformations.DefinableGeometry.Map A B) (P : Fin n → Prop),
  (∀ (i : Fin n), DiamondIntegral.Section6.RVCoordinateDisplacement f i) →
    ∀ (i : Fin n), DiamondIntegral.Section6.RVCoordinateDisplacement (DiamondIntegral.Section6.vfInterpolation f P) i :=
fun {M} [SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M] [M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {S}
    {n r s} {A} {B} f P hD i p z he =>
  have hTags :=
    Eq.mp
      (congr (congrArg Eq (congrArg Prod.snd (DiamondIntegral.Section6.vfInterpolation_value f P p)))
        (congrArg Prod.snd (DiamondIntegral.Section6.vfInterpolation_value f P z)))
      he;
  Eq.mpr
    (id
      (congrArg
        (fun _a => _a.1 i - (↑p).1 i = (↑((DiamondIntegral.Section6.vfInterpolation f P).toFun z)).1 i - (↑z).1 i)
        (DiamondIntegral.Section6.vfInterpolation_value f P p)))
    (Eq.mpr
      (id
        (congrArg
          (fun _a =>
            (fun i => if P i then (↑(f.toFun p)).1 i else (↑p).1 i, (↑(f.toFun p)).2).1 i - (↑p).1 i =
              _a.1 i - (↑z).1 i)
          (DiamondIntegral.Section6.vfInterpolation_value f P z)))
      (if hi : P i then
        Eq.mpr
          (id
            (congr
              (congrArg Eq
                (congrFun'
                  (congrArg HSub.hSub
                    ((fun x_0 x_1 x_2 x_3 => (fun x_0 x_1 x_2 x_3 => if_pos hi) x_0 x_1 x_2 x_3)
                      (Classical.propDecidable (P i)) SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Transfer.VFType
                      ((↑(f.toFun p)).1 i) ((↑p).1 i)))
                  ((↑p).1 i)))
              (congrFun'
                (congrArg HSub.hSub
                  ((fun x_0 x_1 x_2 x_3 => (fun x_0 x_1 x_2 x_3 => if_pos hi) x_0 x_1 x_2 x_3)
                    (Classical.propDecidable (P i)) SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Transfer.VFType
                    ((↑(f.toFun z)).1 i) ((↑z).1 i)))
                ((↑z).1 i))))
          (hD i p z hTags)
      else
        of_eq_true
          (Eq.trans
            (congr
              (congrArg Eq
                (Eq.trans
                  (congrFun'
                    (congrArg HSub.hSub
                      ((fun x_0 x_1 x_2 x_3 => (fun x_0 x_1 x_2 x_3 => if_neg hi) x_0 x_1 x_2 x_3)
                        (Classical.propDecidable (P i)) SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Transfer.VFType
                        ((↑(f.toFun p)).1 i) ((↑p).1 i)))
                    ((↑p).1 i))
                  (sub_self ((↑p).1 i))))
              (Eq.trans
                (congrFun'
                  (congrArg HSub.hSub
                    ((fun x_0 x_1 x_2 x_3 => (fun x_0 x_1 x_2 x_3 => if_neg hi) x_0 x_1 x_2 x_3)
                      (Classical.propDecidable (P i)) SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Transfer.VFType
                      ((↑(f.toFun z)).1 i) ((↑z).1 i)))
                  ((↑z).1 i))
                (sub_self ((↑z).1 i))))
            (eq_self 0))))

    Exists.casesOn hB fun β hβ =>
      have hloA := inv_le_inv' (le_max_left α β);
      have hloB := inv_le_inv' (le_max_right α β);

@DiamondIntegral.Section6.update_comp_fin_equiv : ∀ {n : ℕ} {E : Type u_1} (a : Fin n → E) (e : Fin n ≃ Fin n)
  (j : Fin n) (v : E), Function.update a j v ∘ ⇑e = Function.update (a ∘ ⇑e) (e.symm j) v
theorem DiamondIntegral.Section6.update_comp_fin_equiv.{u_1} : ∀ {n : ℕ} {E : Type u_1} (a : Fin n → E)
  (e : Fin n ≃ Fin n) (j : Fin n) (v : E), Function.update a j v ∘ ⇑e = Function.update (a ∘ ⇑e) (e.symm j) v :=
fun {n} {E} a e j v =>
  funext fun i =>
    if hi : i = e.symm j then
      Eq.symm hi ▸
        of_eq_true
          (Eq.trans
            (congr
              (congrArg Eq
                (Eq.trans (Function.update_congr (Eq.refl a) (Eq.refl j) (Eq.refl v) (Equiv.apply_symm_apply e j))
                  (Function.update_self j v a)))
              (Function.update_self (e.symm j) v (a ∘ ⇑e)))
            (eq_self v))
    else
      have hOld := fun h =>
        hi (Eq.mp (congrFun' (congrArg Eq (Equiv.symm_apply_apply e i)) (e.symm j)) (congrArg (⇑e.symm) h));
      of_eq_true
        (Eq.trans
          (congr (congrArg Eq ((fun x_0 v f => (fun x_0 => Function.update_of_ne hOld) x_0 v f) (fun a => E) v a))
            ((fun x_0 v f => (fun x_0 => Function.update_of_ne hi) x_0 v f) (fun a => E) v (a ∘ ⇑e)))
          (eq_self (a (e i))))

  (fun i => if i = j then α else β i) ∘ ⇑e = fun i => if i = e.symm j then α else β (e i)
theorem DiamondIntegral.Section6.coordinate_radius_comp_fin_equiv : ∀ {M : Type}
  [inst : SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M]
  [inst_1 : M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {n : ℕ} (α : DiamondIntegral.Section2.Gamma M)
  (β : Fin n → DiamondIntegral.Section2.Gamma M) (e : Fin n ≃ Fin n) (j : Fin n),
  (fun i => if i = j then α else β i) ∘ ⇑e = fun i => if i = e.symm j then α else β (e i) :=
fun {M} [SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M] [M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {n} α β
    e j =>
  funext fun i =>
    if hi : i = e.symm j then
      Eq.symm hi ▸
        of_eq_true
          (Eq.trans
            (congr
              (congrArg Eq
                (Eq.trans
                  (ite_congr (Eq.trans (congrFun' (congrArg Eq (Equiv.apply_symm_apply e j)) j) (eq_self j))
                    (fun a => Eq.refl α) fun a => congrArg β (Equiv.apply_symm_apply e j))
                  (ite_true α (β j))))
              (Eq.trans
                (ite_congr (eq_self (e.symm j)) (fun a => Eq.refl α) fun a => congrArg β (Equiv.apply_symm_apply e j))
                (ite_true α (β j))))
            (eq_self α))
    else
      have hOld := fun h =>
        hi (Eq.mp (congrFun' (congrArg Eq (Equiv.symm_apply_apply e i)) (e.symm j)) (congrArg (⇑e.symm) h));
      of_eq_true
        (Eq.trans
          (congr
            (congrArg Eq
              ((fun x_0 x_1 x_2 x_3 => (fun x_0 x_1 x_2 x_3 => if_neg hOld) x_0 x_1 x_2 x_3)
                (instDecidableEqFin n (e i) j) (DiamondIntegral.Section2.Gamma M) α (β (e i))))
            ((fun x_0 x_1 x_2 x_3 => (fun x_0 x_1 x_2 x_3 => if_neg hi) x_0 x_1 x_2 x_3)
              (instDecidableEqFin n i (e.symm j)) (DiamondIntegral.Section2.Gamma M) α (β (e i))))
          (eq_self (β (e i))))

fun {M} [SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M] [M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {S}
    {n r s} {I} {e} {G} [LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero G] [Valued (DiamondIntegral.Section2.VF M) G] {A} {B} {X} {f}
    {P} h00 F hinj i hPA =>
  DiamondIntegral.Section6.defSet_eq_of_carrier_eq
    (Set.ext fun q =>
      {
        mp := fun a =>
          Exists.casesOn a fun p h =>
            h ▸
              let p' := ⟨↑p, DiamondIntegral.Section6.VFReindexRefinementFrame.selectedPiece_subset X (P i) p.property⟩;
              (DiamondIntegral.Section6.VFReindexRefinementFrame.mem_selectedPiece F.target (f.restrict hPA).image
                    ↑(F.map.toFun p')).mpr
                (have hOld :=
                  ((DiamondIntegral.Section6.VFReindexRefinementFrame.mem_selectedPiece X (P i) ↑p).mp
                      p.property).right;
                ⟨(F.map.toFun p').property, Exists.intro ⟨↑(X.oldPoint p'), hOld⟩ (Eq.symm (F.commutes p'))⟩),
        mpr := fun hq =>
          And.casesOn
            ((DiamondIntegral.Section6.VFReindexRefinementFrame.mem_selectedPiece F.target (f.restrict hPA).image q).mp
              hq)
            fun hqT hqOld =>
            Exists.casesOn
              (Function.Bijective.surjective
                (DiamondIntegral.Section6.SpecialCovariantChain.bijective
                  (DiamondIntegral.Section6.CentripetalChain.toSpecial
                    (DiamondIntegral.Section6.SynchronizedCentripetalChain.toChain F.chain))
                  h00)
                ⟨q, hqT⟩)
              fun p hp =>
              have hpoint := congrArg Subtype.val hp;
              have hComm := F.commutes p;
              Exists.casesOn hqOld fun a ha =>
                have hEq :=
                  Subtype.ext
                    (Eq.trans ha
                      (Eq.mp
                        (congrArg (fun _a => (_a.1 ∘ ⇑e.symm, _a.2 ∘ F.target.data.labels) = ↑(f.toFun (X.oldPoint p)))
                          hpoint)
                        hComm));
                have hOld := congrArg Subtype.val (hinj hEq) ▸ a.property;
                Exists.intro
                  ⟨↑p,
                    (DiamondIntegral.Section6.VFReindexRefinementFrame.mem_selectedPiece X (P i) ↑p).mpr
                      ⟨p.property, hOld⟩⟩
                  hpoint })

  [inst : SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M]
  [inst_1 : M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {n r : ℕ} {S : Set M}
  {A : SpecialTransformations.DefinableGeometry.DefSet (SpecialTransformations.Section4.rawMixedSpace n r) S}
  (D : DiamondIntegral.Section6.ZeroCenteredData A) (v : Fin (n + r) → DiamondIntegral.Section2.RVInfinity M),
  DiamondIntegral.Section2.vfFibre D.map.image.carrier v =
    DiamondIntegral.Section6.graphFibreRange D.bijection (v ∘ Fin.natAdd n) v :=
fun {M} [SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M] [M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {n r}
    {S} {A} D v =>
  Set.ext fun b =>
    {
      mp := fun a =>
        Exists.casesOn a fun p he =>
          id
            (fun he =>
              have hu :=
                funext fun i =>
                  id
                    (Eq.mp
                      (congrFun'
                        (congrArg Eq
                          (Fin.append_right (fun i => DiamondIntegral.Section6.branchTag (D.core (↑p) i)) (↑p).2 i))
                        (v (Fin.natAdd n i)))
                      (congrArg (fun q => q.2 (Fin.natAdd n i)) he));
              Exists.intro (↑p).1
                ((DiamondIntegral.Section6.ZeroCenteredData.graphFibre_iff D (v ∘ Fin.natAdd n) v (↑p).1 b).mpr
                  ⟨hu ▸ p.property, Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => D.point ((↑p).1, _a) = (b, v)) (Eq.symm hu))) he⟩))
            he,
      mpr := fun a =>
        Exists.casesOn a fun a ha =>
          And.casesOn ((DiamondIntegral.Section6.ZeroCenteredData.graphFibre_iff D (v ∘ Fin.natAdd n) v a b).mp ha)
            fun hp he => Exists.intro ⟨(a, v ∘ Fin.natAdd n), hp⟩ he }

          right hyz;

theorem DiamondIntegral.Section6.ZeroCenteredData.point_injective : ∀ {M : Type}
  [inst : SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M]
  [inst_1 : M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {n r : ℕ} {S : Set M}
  {A : SpecialTransformations.DefinableGeometry.DefSet (SpecialTransformations.Section4.rawMixedSpace n r) S}
  (D : DiamondIntegral.Section6.ZeroCenteredData A),
  M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF00 → Function.Injective D.point :=
fun {M} [SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M] [M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {n r}
    {S} {A} D h00 ⦃p q⦄ he =>
  have hu :=
    funext fun i =>
      Eq.mp
        (congr (congrArg Eq (Fin.append_right (fun i => DiamondIntegral.Section6.branchTag (D.core p i)) p.2 i))
          (Fin.append_right (fun i => DiamondIntegral.Section6.branchTag (D.core q i)) q.2 i))
        (congrArg (fun z => z.2 (Fin.natAdd n i)) he);
  have hb :=
    DiamondIntegral.Section6.ZeroCenteredData.tags_injective D h00 p.2
      (Eq.mpr
        (id
          (congr (congrArg Eq (congrFun' (congrArg D.tags hu) (D.core p))) (congrFun' (congrArg D.tags hu) (D.core q))))
        (Eq.mp
          (congrFun'
            (congrArg Eq
              (congrArg Prod.snd
                (congrArg (Prod.mk (p.1 + D.shift (D.core p))) (congrFun' (congrArg D.tags hu) (D.core p)))))
            (D.tags q.2 (D.core q)))
          (congrArg Prod.snd he)));
  have hVF :=
    add_right_cancel
      (Eq.mp
        (congrFun'
          (congrArg Eq
            (congrArg Prod.fst
              (congr (congrArg Prod.mk (congrArg (HAdd.hAdd p.1) (congrArg D.shift hb))) (congrArg (D.tags p.2) hb))))
          (q.1 + D.shift (D.core q)))
        (congrArg Prod.fst he));
  Prod.ext hVF hu

  [inst : SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M]
  [inst_1 : M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {n r : ℕ} {S : Set M}

    Sum.casesOn (motive := fun t =>
      i = t →
        D.codes (SpecialTransformations.Section4.mixedValues p) i =
          SpecialTransformations.Section4.mixedValues (D.point p) i)
      i
      (fun i_1 h =>
        Eq.symm h ▸
          id
            (if hc : D.core p i_1 = true then
              Eq.mpr
                (id
                  (congrArg (fun _a => _a = SpecialTransformations.Section4.mixedValues (D.point p) (Sum.inl i_1))

                              (fun a => Eq.refl D.center) fun a => Eq.refl 0)
                            (ite_true D.center 0))))))
                  (Eq.refl (SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.iVFAdd ↑(p.1 i_1) ↑D.center)))
            else
              have hn := fun h => hc ((DiamondIntegral.Section6.ZeroCenteredData.coreCode_at D p i_1).mp h);
              Eq.mpr
                (id
                  (congrArg (fun _a => _a = SpecialTransformations.Section4.mixedValues (D.point p) (Sum.inl i_1))

                (have hf := Bool.eq_false_iff.mpr hc;
                of_eq_true
                  (Eq.trans
                    (congrArg (Eq ↑(p.1 i_1))
                      (congrArg Subtype.val
                        (Eq.trans
                          (congrArg (HAdd.hAdd (p.1 i_1))
                            (Eq.trans
                              (ite_congr (Eq.trans (congrFun' (congrArg Eq hf) true) Bool.false_eq_true)
                                (fun a => Eq.refl D.center) fun a => Eq.refl 0)
                              (ite_false D.center 0)))
                          (add_zero (p.1 i_1)))))
                    (eq_self ↑(p.1 i_1))))))
      (fun i_1 h =>
        Eq.symm h ▸
          Fin.addCases
            (fun i =>
              Eq.mpr
                (id
                  (congrFun'
                    (congrArg Eq
                      (Fin.append_left
                        (fun i =>
                          if D.coreCode (SpecialTransformations.Section4.mixedValues p) i then
                            ↑(DiamondIntegral.Section6.branchTag true)

                    (SpecialTransformations.Section4.mixedValues (D.point p) (Sum.inr (Fin.castAdd r i)))))
                (if hc : D.core p i = true then
                  Eq.mpr
                    (id
                      (congrArg

                    (of_eq_true
                      (Eq.trans
                        (congrArg (Eq ↑(DiamondIntegral.Section6.branchTag true))
                          (congrArg Subtype.val
                            (Eq.trans (Fin.append_left (fun i => DiamondIntegral.Section6.branchTag (D.core p i)) p.2 i)
                              (DiamondIntegral.Section6.branchTag.congr_simp (D.core p i) true hc))))
                        (eq_self ↑(DiamondIntegral.Section6.branchTag true))))
                else
                  have hn := fun h => hc ((DiamondIntegral.Section6.ZeroCenteredData.coreCode_at D p i).mp h);
                  Eq.mpr
                    (id
                      (congrArg
                        (fun _a =>
                          _a = SpecialTransformations.Section4.mixedValues (D.point p) (Sum.inr (Fin.castAdd r i)))
                        (if_neg hn)))
                    (of_eq_true
                      (Eq.trans
                        (congrArg (Eq ↑(DiamondIntegral.Section6.branchTag false))
                          (congrArg Subtype.val
                            (Eq.trans (Fin.append_left (fun i => DiamondIntegral.Section6.branchTag (D.core p i)) p.2 i)
                              (DiamondIntegral.Section6.branchTag.congr_simp (D.core p i) false
                                (Bool.eq_false_iff.mpr hc)))))
                        (eq_self ↑(DiamondIntegral.Section6.branchTag false))))))

  [M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {S : Set M} {n r : ℕ} {ι : Type} [Finite ι]

theorem DiamondIntegral.Section6.scalarGraphDomain_at : ∀ {M : Type}
  [inst : SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M] [M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF]
  {S : Set M} {n r : ℕ} {ι : Type} [Finite ι] (R : Set (ι ⊕ (Fin n ⊕ Fin r) ⊕ Fin 1 → M)) (a : ι → M)
  {A : SpecialTransformations.DefinableGeometry.DefSet (SpecialTransformations.Section4.rawMixedSpace n r) S}
  {B : SpecialTransformations.DefinableGeometry.DefSet (SpecialTransformations.Section4.rawVFSpace 1) S}
  (f : SpecialTransformations.DefinableGeometry.Map A B),
  {z | Sum.elim a z ∈ R} =
      (SpecialTransformations.Section4.rawMixedSpace n r).relation (SpecialTransformations.Section4.rawVFSpace 1)
        f.graph →
    ∀ (x : Fin n ⊕ Fin r → M),
      Sum.elim a x ∈ DiamondIntegral.Section6.scalarGraphDomain R ↔
        x ∈ (SpecialTransformations.Section4.rawMixedSpace n r).preimage A.carrier :=
fun {M} [SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M] [M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {S}
    {n r} {ι} [Finite ι] R a {A} {B} f hSection x =>
  {
    mp := fun a_1 =>
      Exists.casesOn a_1 fun y hy =>
        have hEta :=
          funext fun i =>
            List.Mem.casesOn (motive := fun a x => List.finRange 1 = a → Fintype.complete i ≍ x → y i = y 0)
              (Fintype.complete i)
              (fun as h =>
                List.cons.noConfusion h fun head_eq =>
                  Eq.ndrec (motive := fun i =>
                    ∀ (this : i ∈ Fintype.elems), [] ≍ as → this ≍ List.Mem.head as → y i = y 0)
                    (fun this tail_eq =>
                      Eq.ndrec (motive := fun as => this ≍ List.Mem.head as → y ((fun i => i) ⟨0, Nat.le_refl 1⟩) = y 0)
                        (fun h => Eq.refl (y ((fun i => i) ⟨0, Nat.le_refl 1⟩))) (eq_of_heq tail_eq))
                    (eq_of_heq head_eq) (Fintype.complete i))
              (fun b {as} a h =>
                List.cons.noConfusion h fun head_eq =>
                  Eq.ndrec (motive := fun b => [] ≍ as → Fintype.complete i ≍ List.Mem.tail b a → y i = y 0)
                    (fun tail_eq =>
                      Eq.ndrec (motive := fun {as} =>
                        ∀ (a : List.Mem i as),

                    DiamondIntegral.Section6.scalarCodeExtension f x = y ∨
